title: Program Manager - MSP, SOW
description:
The Supply Chain member will be responsible for leading all labor supply chain management

activities for a portfolio of MSP & RPO customers. They will serve as a thought leader and industry

expert on projects and initiatives relative to all forms of contingent labor sourcing and

management (staff augmentation, IC/freelancers, services procurement and pay-rolling) along

with the sourcing partners. This professional will ensure RSR has established the proper supply

chain to deliver optimum performance, pricing and program compliance to each client within their

portfolio. The Supply Chain manager will be up-to-date on current marketplace trends and utilize

this knowledge to continuously advise our customers on supply chain best practices relative to

contingent labor sourcing, and in doing so, position RSR as a market leader in supply chain

management. They will be required to effectively develop and maintain executive level

relationships with the supplier community as well as our current and prospective clients. The

Supply Chain manager actively manages and drives performance and engagement from our

Operating Companies, ensuring on-going success of Randstad Sourceright.

key responsibilities

● Serve as a subject matter expert for supply chain projects and initiatives (i.e.: supplier

sourcing, RFx, optimizations, supplier forums & training, satisfaction surveys, etc.)

developing partner in the T2 countries

● Work directly with customers and RSR Program Office leadership to advise and recommend

optimal supply chain strategies

● Create, manage and evaluate supplier RFI/RFP events to source best-in-class suppliers

● Perform and/or participate in quarterly supplier performance review sessions in conjunction

with operations leadership

● Serve as the primary point of contact in mentoring/coaching our supplier partners

● Establish, manage and document supplier performance improvement plans, including

program suspension and/or removal if expected results are not achieved.

● Serve as a POC for new potential suppliers interested in joining the RSR supplier network or

a specific program’s Preferred Supplier List (PSL)

● Provide support, management and supplier training during the supplier vetting process as

new suppliers join RSR programs

● Regularly analyses data to identify gaps in the MSP program supply chain and make proactive

recommendations to client and RSR Program Office to ensure desired business results

● Partner with RSR Market Analytics team to obtain market information on niche positions, pay

rates, etc. Present findings and cost savings opportunities and/or risk analysis to program

Stakeholders

● Create and distribute critical communications to supply chain partners

● Support the client and operations team with supplier escalations, issues or concerns

● Organize, host and prepare content for supplier forum/summits

● Partner with department peers in other global regions to ensure consistency in the supply

chain strategy and supplier communications across global accounts

● Build expertise by continuously monitoring the industry landscape for regulatory changes

that could affect our supplier strategy, and proactively advise Operations Leadership and

client accordingly

● Utilize project management skills including communication, time management, organization

and planning to successfully manage supply chain activities across multiple MSP programs

across APAC

● Build effective executive level relationships with our supplier partners, and establish trust

and partnership among the supplier community

qualifications - education, knowledge, experience

● Bachelors/Master’s degree

● 10 to 15 years of Procurement, Staffing Industry, MSP or Services Procurement related work

experience

● Experience building effective relationships with senior level client and supplier

representatives

● Experience with staffing supplier contracts and services procurement (SOW business)

preferred

● Proven track record in negotiating contract terms

● Excellent attention to detail, with demonstrated ability to successfully handle multiple

concurrent tasks and adjust priorities on the fly

● Experience building effective business cases supported by data

● Understanding of labor and supply chain markets in India preferred

● Outstanding interpersonal skills, including the ability to work effectively in a team

environment, handle internal clients with tact and diplomacy, and maintain composure and

production quality under deadline pressure

● Ability to think strategically and execute tactically

● Comfortable in a fast-paced environment that values creativity, self-motivation, candor,

initiative, reliability and accountability

● Exceptional oral and written communication skills, including development of internal and

external communications

● Experience with small and large-scale program implementations and steady state projects

● Computer Skills

● Experience using Vendor Management Software (Fieldglass, Beeline, IQN, Ariba, etc)

required

● Proficiency in Microsoft Office (especially Word, PowerPoint and Excel) required

● Additional Requirements - Ability to travel to support clients within the region, internal

meetings and industry related conferences. This role can anticipate 20% - 40% travel

title: Real Estate Project Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Krishvi Group is a Bengaluru-based real estate developer with over three decades of experience delivering housing projects that cater to a wide range of homebuyers in the city’s growing market. The company is recognized for its professional, dedicated team of technical and financial experts who have successfully completed multiple residential projects with strong customer satisfaction. Krishvi Group focuses on creating “aspirational living” spaces that combine quality construction, thoughtful design, and long-term value. The organization continues to build landmark developments while maintaining a distinctive signature style and a commitment to excellence on all fronts of its business.

**Role Description**
The Real Estate Project Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Bengaluru, responsible for end-to-end management of residential real estate projects. This role involves planning project timelines, coordinating with architects, engineers, contractors, and vendors, and tracking progress against milestones. The Project Manager will oversee budgeting and cost control, ensure adherence to quality, safety, and regulatory standards, and manage documentation and approvals with relevant authorities. Day-to-day responsibilities include monitoring site activities, resolving project issues, communicating status updates to senior management and stakeholders, and supporting timely handover and customer satisfaction. The role also requires contributing to process improvements and aligning project execution with Krishvi Group’s vision of aspirational living.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong project management skills, including planning, scheduling, risk management, and stakeholder coordination.
* Candidates should possess expertise in real estate development and real estate operations, with practical understanding of residential project lifecycles.
* Candidates should possess solid budgeting and cost management skills, with the ability to track expenses and optimize project financial performance.
* Candidates should possess clear and effective communication skills, including the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and present project updates.
* Relevant degree or diploma in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Real Estate, or a related field; prior experience managing real estate projects is highly beneficial.
* Knowledge of local building codes, regulatory approvals, and compliance requirements in Bengaluru; familiarity with project management tools is an advantage.
* Strong problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and the capacity to work on-site in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
* 9-13 years experience is required with Residential projects only

stakeholders across government and public institutions, at central and state level.

• Drive agreements to signature. Lead the drafting, negotiation and sign-off of formal agreements, working with our legal team and the other side’s approvers, and keep the process moving through review cycles.

• Line up subject-matter experts. Identify, engage and coordinate domain and language experts,

and manage their reviews so that content is verified for accuracy before it goes out.

• Run delivery end to end. Turn the plan into milestones, owners and timelines; track dependencies

and risks; and keep a clear, honest status for leadership and partners.

• Rally internal teams. Align design, product and technology on priorities, requirements and trade-

offs, and make sure external inputs reach the right team in a usable form.

• Handle approvals and permissions. Navigate the approval chains, formalities and documentation

that come with working alongside public bodies.

• Protect confidentiality. Treat all program information as confidential, share it on a need-to-know

basis, and set the right expectations with partners and vendors.

• Report and escalate. Give leadership regular updates, flag issues early with options, and close out

actions.

**What you bring**

• 3–5 years of experience in program or project management, partnerships, business development or

public affairs.

• A record of taking multi-party initiatives from idea to signed agreement and then to delivery.

• Comfort with formal documents: you can read an agreement closely, frame the commercial and

operational points, and work effectively with legal counsel.

• Strong stakeholder management: patient, tactful and persistent with senior people, and able to earn trust in slow, process-heavy environments.

• Experience coordinating experts and reviewers outside the company, and managing quality and turnaround.

• Cross-functional leadership without formal authority: you can align design, product and technology teams around a shared plan.

• Excellent written and spoken communication in English and Hindi; additional Indian languages are

an advantage.

• Structured, organised and detail-oriented, with a bias for follow-through.

• Sound judgement and discretion with sensitive information.

• Willingness to travel as the work requires.

**Good to have**

• Prior experience in travel, culture, media, education or another field that works with public

institutions.

• Familiarity with content, localisation or translation workflows.

• Experience working with design and technology teams in a product company or start-up.

• Working knowledge of intellectual property and licensing basics.

title: Project & Creative Operations Lead
description:
**About TripleDart**
TripleDart Digital is an AI-native, full-funnel growth agency built for B2B SaaS. We run paid media, ABM, SEO/GEO, creative, web/CRO and RevOps for 100+ SaaS brands scaling from $5M to $100M+ ARR across the US, Europe and APAC. Clients measure us on qualified pipeline and revenue influenced, and we hold Google Premier, HubSpot Platinum and LinkedIn Corporate Partner status.
  
  
Our paid media and ABM programs generate a steady stream of creative work — ad concepts, static and video assets, landing pages, ABM personalization, reporting dashboards. Delivering that at scale, to a US client's expectations, is an operations problem. This role owns it.
  
  
**Role Summary**
You are accountable for the entire paid media and creative operations layer: intake, scoping, scheduling, capacity, SLAs, QC and delivery across the portfolio. Account managers own the client relationship and strategy; you own that what we committed gets built correctly and ships on time.
  
  
This is a run-the-system-and-make-it-better role. You've managed delivery at scale before, you know what a healthy ClickUp board looks like, and you don't wait for a miss to find out a process is broken.
  
  
**What You'll Own**
Project management across the portfolio
  
  

* Own intake to delivery for every paid media, ABM and creative request across ~15 accounts: scoping, briefs, estimates, scheduling, dependencies and sign-off.
* Run the weekly delivery rhythm — sprint planning, daily stand-ups with pods and creative, and a Friday portfolio review of what shipped, what slipped and why.
* Maintain a single, current view of every account's open work, due dates and blockers that an account manager or founder can read in 30 seconds.

SLAs and quality control
  
  

* Define and enforce SLAs by deliverable type (ad copy, statics, video, landing pages, dashboards, campaign builds) and report adherence weekly.
* Build and run the QC layer: checklists, review gates and sign-off before anything reaches a client. Brand, copy, spec, tracking and link checks are non-negotiable.
* Track rework and client-reported misses as a defect rate, root-cause them and close the loop with the function that caused them.

Creative operations
  
  

* Own the creative pipeline end to end: briefing standards, asset specs per channel (Google, LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit, CTV), versioning, approvals and asset handoff to paid media.
* Balance load across copy, design, video and web/dev; forecast creative demand from the media plan and staff or reprioritise ahead of the crunch.
* Maintain the creative library, naming conventions and templates so nothing ships off-brand or off-spec.

Capacity planning and ClickUp hygiene
  
  

* ClickUp is the source of truth and you keep it that way: every task scoped, owned, estimated, dated and in the right status. No work outside the system.
* Run capacity planning per pod and per function against the retainer scope; flag over-servicing and under-utilisation to leadership monthly.
* Own time-tracking discipline and the utilisation and SLA dashboards leadership uses to run the BU.

Client communication
  
  

* Be the delivery voice on client accounts alongside the account manager: status updates, timelines, revision rounds and expectation-setting on what ships when.
* Handle client-facing delivery escalations directly and proactively — before the client raises them.

Cross-functional problem solving
  
  

* Sit between account management, paid media pods, copy, design, dev and analytics. When something is stuck, you unblock it, and you fix the process so it doesn't stick again.
* Document and improve SOPs for recurring work; bring AI and automation (ClickUp automations, n8n, Claude) into intake, QC and reporting to cut manual effort.

How success is measured
  
  
Delivery is under control when the client never has to ask where something is.
  
  
KPITargetWhat it measuresOn-time delivery95%+ of deliverables shipped by committed dateScheduling and dependency control across the portfolioSLA adherence95%+ by deliverable type, reported weeklyTurnaround commitments kept per accountQC pass rate98%+ first-pass; zero client-reported brand, spec or tracking errorsQuality gates working before work reaches the clientRework rateUnder 10% of creative deliverables needing a second revision roundBriefing quality and QC disciplineClickUp hygiene100% of active work scoped, owned, estimated and dated; weekly audit scoreThe system reflects realityCapacity utilisationPods and creative functions within 90–95% planned utilisation; over-servicing flagged monthlyRetainer scope matched to effortClient delivery satisfaction4.5+ / 5 on delivery and communication in QBR feedbackClients trust the process, not just the peopleProcess improvementAt least one SOP or automation shipped per month with measured time savedThe system gets better, not just maintained
  
  
Targets are reviewed quarterly with the Head of Paid Media and feed the BU's business review.
  
  
**Who You Are**
Non-negotiables
  
  

* 5–8 years in project, delivery or operations management, with at least 3 years running delivery at scale — 10+ concurrent client accounts or 50+ live deliverables a month — at a marketing agency, creative studio or SaaS marketing team.
* A recognized PM certification: PMP, PRINCE2, CAPM, CSM/PSM or equivalent. Google Project Management or ClickUp certifications are a plus on top, not a substitute.
* Expert in ClickUp or an equivalent (Asana, Monday, Jira) — you've designed the workspace, the custom fields, the automations and the dashboards, not just used them.
* Hands-on experience running creative operations: briefing, asset specs across paid channels, review and approval cycles, and managing designers, copywriters and video editors' load.
* Working knowledge of paid media and ABM delivery — what a campaign build, a landing page or a reporting dashboard needs before it can ship — enough to QC it and estimate it.
* Accountability as a reflex. You have owned delivery outcomes personally, carried the miss, and fixed the process after.
* Clear, direct written and spoken English; you write client status updates and run calls with US stakeholders.
* Comfortable with US-overlap hours (2:00–11:00 PM IST) and a fully remote, cross-functional team.

Strong plusses
  
  

* Six Sigma, Lean or ITIL exposure; you think in defect rates and cycle times.
* Experience with capacity planning and utilisation reporting against retainer scopes.
* Familiarity with Figma, Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, GA4 and Looker Studio.
* Experience building ClickUp or n8n automations, or using Claude/ChatGPT to speed up intake, QC and reporting.
* Prior ownership of SOP libraries, onboarding playbooks or delivery handbooks.

**How You Work**
You are organized to the point of being predictable, and the team relies on that. You communicate early, especially bad news. You solve the problem in front of you and then remove the cause. You hold a standard without needing to be the loudest person on the call.
  
  
**Why join us**

* Own the whole system. Paid media and creative operations across the portfolio report into you — not a slice of one account.
* Scale that matters. 15 accounts, six delivery pods and a creative team shipping for US SaaS brands scaling to $100M+ ARR.
* Build with AI. We use Claude, n8n and ClickUp automations in delivery today; you'll have the mandate and budget to push that further.
* A direct line to leadership. You report to the Co-Founder running the BU; your dashboards are the ones the business is run on.
* A clear path. This role grows into Head of Delivery / Operations as the BU scales.

**Working Setup And Benefits**

* Fully remote. Work from anywhere in India.
* Fixed US-overlap shift: 2:00–11:00 PM IST, Monday to Friday, so you cover the India afternoon handoff and the full US morning.
* Learning and development budget — PM and platform certifications, courses and conferences.
* Full access to TripleDart's AI-native tooling stack (Claude, ChatGPT, ClickUp, n8n and internal platforms).
* Health insurance and wellbeing support [confirm plan details with HR].

**How To Apply**
**Apply through Keka, or email your resume and cover letter to sabari@tripledart.com.**

title: SR PROJECT MANAGER ENGINEER
description:
At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable and more connected world.
  
  
**Job Overview**
TE Connectivity Ltd. is a $16.5 billion global technology and manufacturing leader creating a safer, sustainable, productive, and connected future. For more than 75 years, our connectivity and sensor solutions, proven in the harshest environments, have enabled advancements in transportation, industrial applications, medical technology, energy, data communications, and the home. With 80,000 employees, including more than 7,500 engineers, working alongside customers in approximately 150 countries, TE ensures that EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS. Learn more at www.te.com
  
  
The Senior Project Management Engineer will lead strategic engineering projects and capability-development initiatives for the Mechanical Engineering Center of Excellence (ME COE) in AES, supporting next-generation data-center interconnect products.
  
  
Working with technical leaders, product development teams, and global cross-functional partners, this role translates technical roadmaps into executable plans, manages risks and dependencies, and drives timely delivery.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines mechanical or product engineering expertise with strong project management skills across simulation, design, testing, validation, and engineering process or tool development.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Lead the planning and execution of ME COE initiatives, including method and tool development, evaluation, and adoption across structural, thermal, and dimensional management domains, as well as project support within the CTO organization.
* Translate technical roadmaps into clear project scope, milestones, deliverables, ownership, schedules, and success criteria in partnership with technical leaders.
* Coordinate activities across global engineering, product development, laboratory, manufacturing, supplier, and cross-functional teams.
* Maintain project plans and performance dashboards to track actions, deliverables, resources, dependencies, risks, decisions, execution metrics and project impact; use these insights to support portfolio prioritization and capacity planning.
* Facilitate technical reviews, drive risk mitigation and escalation, and communicate status and priorities to leadership and stakeholders.
* Partner with technical leads to validation, standardization, document, and scale engineering methods, models, automation, and tools across the ME COE.
* Improve engineering workflows and knowledge-management practices to increase execution efficiency and reuse across the ME COE.

**Mandatory Skills**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in mechanical engineering or a related engineering discipline.
* 4+ years of engineering or product development experience, including leadership or coordination of technical projects.
* Experience in multidisciplinary environments involving mechanical design, simulation, testing, manufacturing, or product development.
* Proven ability to manage concurrent projects, schedules, resources, risks, dependencies, and stakeholders across global teams.
* Working knowledge of product development from concept through design, validation, and release, with the technical judgment to identify risks, decisions, and required stakeholders.
* Strong planning, organization, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.\

**Preferred**

* Experience with electrical interconnects, connectors, data-center hardware, electronics, or other high-reliability products.
* Familiarity with CAE and predictive engineering, including FEA, CFD, thermal, tolerance, reliability, or multiphysics analysis.
* Experience delivering engineering methods, tools, automation, or simulation workflows.
* Knowledge of Agile, Stage-Gate, APQP, or comparable development methodologies.
* Experience with project dashboards, KPIs, portfolio reporting, and resource or capacity tracking.
* PMP or comparable project management certification.

title: Digitalization Consultant
description:
**Hello Visionary!**
We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make a great addition to our vibrant international team.
  
  
We provide our Hire-to-Retire services along the complete lifecycle of an employee from onboarding to pension services and leverage our powerful ecosystem of leading external and internal partners and our network of key delivery centers. We believe in the value of industry best-practice standards achieved through evolving technology and digitalization. We focus on employee experience as a key driver of our actions. In doing so, we deliver flexibility, quality and efficiency for the businesses we partner with.
  
  
**Position Overview**
As Team Lead / Manager, you will own a portfolio of digital enablement initiatives within the H2R space and lead a team of Digital Process Enablement Associates and Consultants. You will be the connective tissue between HR business teams and technology — translating pain points into scalable, AI-powered solutions, and mentoring your team to do the same.
  
  
**You’ll Make a Difference By**
**Team Leadership & Delivery Management**

* Lead a team of DPE Associates / Consultants; manage workload, priorities, quality of output and career development.
* Set delivery cadence, review technical designs, and hold the team to a high standard of solutioning and execution.
* Coach team members on AI tooling, process thinking, solution design and stakeholder handling.
* Own the pipeline of transformation initiatives within your portfolio — sequencing, resourcing and prioritisation.

**Problem Discovery & Solution Design**

* Drive end-to-end diagnostic reviews across H2R sub-processes — recruitment, onboarding, core HR, payroll, time & attendance, benefits, performance, learning, offboarding.
* Identify bottlenecks, manual touchpoints, compliance gaps and redundancy through data analysis, process mining, stakeholder interviews and design thinking.
* Architect solutions ranging from workflow automations to AI-powered agents — leveraging GenAI, LLMs, RPA, intelligent chatbots, NLP and predictive analytics.
* Produce solution blueprints, process flows, functional specs and user stories that are precise enough to build from.
* Benchmark against Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, ServiceNow, ADP and emerging AI-native HR tools.

**Hands-on Build & Technical Ownership**

* Prototype solutions yourself in AI tools, low-code platforms and automation stacks — you do not delegate every build.
* Evaluate emerging AI platforms, run proofs-of-concept, and make build-vs-buy calls with clear rationale.
* Own solution architecture, integration design and non-functional considerations (security, data, scale, cost).
* Partner with IT / engineering on integration patterns, data models and deployment.

**Project Ownership & Stakeholder Management**

* Drive projects from ideation through go-live and value realisation; own timelines, risks and change management.
* Collaborate across HR COEs, payroll, compliance, IT and external vendors to land outcomes.
* Report progress, KPIs, adoption metrics and value delivered to senior leadership on a regular cadence.

**Storytelling & Communication**

* Craft executive-quality decks and narratives that communicate transformation vision, progress and impact.
* Facilitate design thinking workshops and working sessions with business stakeholders.
* Create thought leadership content and internal case studies to drive AI adoption across the function.

**Your Success Is Grounded In**

* Experience: 7–12 years overall experience in digital transformation or project consulting with an automation focus. MBA in any stream
* Team leadership: Prior experience leading a small team or a workstream, with demonstrated ability to coach and grow talent.
* Domain: Solid working knowledge of the Digital initiatives and problem solving
* Technical edge: Hands-on exposure to AI/ML, GenAI tools, LLM-based solutions, RPA or intelligent workflows. You have built or shipped something, not only reviewed it.
* Delivery: Proven track record of owning a project end-to-end and shipping outcomes, not just recommendations.
* Communication: Strong executive presentation and storytelling skills.
* Good-to-haves: Certifications in AI/ML, Digital Transformation, Lean Six Sigma, Design Thinking, Agile/Scrum or HR Technology.
* Experience with prompt engineering, agentic AI patterns, or LLM evaluation.
* Exposure to change management and adoption playbooks at scale.

**Join us and be yourself!**
We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us.
  
  
This role is based in
**Bangalore.**
You’ll also get to visit other locations in India and beyond, so you’ll need to go where this journey takes you. In return, you’ll get the chance to work with teams impacting entire cities, countries – and the shape of things to come.
  
  
We’re Siemens. A collection of over 312,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we encourage applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and imagination and help us shape tomorrow. #STS

title: TechOps-BizOps-Global PMO Resource Manager-Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Technology Consulting – GDS TechOps Global PMO Resource Management, Senior Manager 1/2**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking an experienced Senior Manager to lead Resource Management, Workforce Planning, and Talent Deployment across a strategic portfolio of managed services engagements. This leadership role will be responsible for driving workforce optimization, demand fulfillment, resource deployment, utilization management, hiring strategy, and capability development to support business growth and delivery excellence.
  
  
The successful candidate will work closely with Delivery Leaders, Account Leaders, Talent Teams, Experience Management, and Business Executives to align workforce supply with business demand, strengthen talent readiness, and ensure optimal utilization of resources across engagements. The role will provide strategic workforce insights, manage staffing risks, and drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance workforce effectiveness and operational performance.
  
  
This is a high-impact role requiring a blend of workforce strategy, operational leadership, stakeholder management, resource planning expertise, and data-driven decision-making, with a strong focus on enabling sustainable business growth through effective talent deployment and workforce optimization.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Workforce Planning & Demand Management**

* Develop and execute short-term and long-term workforce plans aligned with business growth objectives.
* Partner with delivery and competency leaders to forecast resource demand, skill requirements, and capacity needs.
* Drive proactive talent planning to ensure the right skills are available at the right time.
* Monitor workforce trends and provide actionable recommendations to leadership.

**Resource Deployment & Utilization**

* Lead resource allocation across engagements to maximize utilization and delivery outcomes.
* Govern bench management processes and drive timely deployment of available resources.
* Monitor utilization metrics and identify opportunities to improve workforce productivity.
* Facilitate cross-competency and cross-geography staffing opportunities.

**Talent Acquisition & Hiring**

* Collaborate with Talent and Hiring Managers to define hiring strategies and demand fulfillment plans.
* Review and validate resource requirements, job descriptions, and hiring priorities.
* Support lateral hiring, campus hiring, and strategic workforce expansion initiatives.
* Track fulfillment KPIs including demand aging, time-to-fill, and hiring effectiveness.

**Skills & Capability Management**

* Maintain visibility of workforce skills, certifications, and competency maturity.
* Identify skill gaps and partner with Learning & Development teams to build capability roadmaps.
* Support workforce transformation and future-ready skill development initiatives.
* Drive certification and upskilling programs aligned with market and business demand.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Act as a trusted advisor to Competency Leaders, Service Delivery Managers, Delivery Managers, and Business Leaders.
* Present workforce insights, capacity forecasts, and resource strategies to senior leadership.
* Manage escalations related to staffing, hiring, deployment, and workforce risks.
* Build strong relationships across Talent, Operations, and Delivery teams.

**Operational Excellence & Governance**

* Establish governance frameworks, dashboards, and resource management KPIs.
* Monitor key metrics including utilization, bench aging, deployment velocity, demand fulfillment, and attrition.
* Drive process improvements and automation across workforce management activities.
* Ensure compliance with organizational workforce and hiring policies.

**Team Leadership**

* Lead and mentor a team of Resource Managers and workforce coordinators.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and customer focus.
* Drive performance management, coaching, and career development within the team.

**Leadership Expectations**
This role is expected to operate as a strategic workforce leader, driving talent deployment, workforce optimization, and resource management excellence across the organization.
  
  
The Senior Manager will:
  
  

* Lead the Resource Management and Workforce Planning agenda for assigned service lines, ensuring alignment between talent supply and business demand.
* Influence senior stakeholders across Delivery, Account, Talent, and Business leadership teams to drive effective workforce decisions.
* Shape workforce strategies and talent roadmaps, enabling scalable growth, capability development, and future-ready skills.
* Coach and mentor Resource Management professionals, fostering a high-performing and collaborative team culture.
* Build credibility as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert in workforce planning, resource deployment, utilization management, and talent strategy.
* Represent the function in leadership reviews, workforce governance forums, hiring discussions, and strategic transformation initiatives.
* Drive a data-driven resource management culture, leveraging workforce insights, capacity forecasts, and utilization metrics to support business growth and delivery excellence.

**Skills & Attributes For Success**

* Strategic workforce planning and capacity management expertise.
* Strong understanding of resource management processes and workforce analytics.
* Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to make data-driven workforce decisions.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and leadership skills.
* Experience managing large, complex, and geographically distributed workforces.
* Strong knowledge of talent supply chain, hiring processes, and workforce transformation initiatives.

**Qualifications**
**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Human Resources, Engineering, Technology, or a related discipline.
* 15+ years of overall professional experience in Managed Services or Technology Services
* 5+ years managing workforce planning, resource management, talent operations, or similar functions.
* Experience working with large-scale delivery organizations and global teams.
* Strong knowledge of workforce management tools and reporting platforms.

**Preferred**

* Experience in consulting, managed services, or global delivery environments.
* Certifications in project management, resource management, workforce analytics, or IT service management.
* Experience with ProFinda, SuccessFactors, Power BI, or equivalent workforce management platforms.

**What We Look For**
We’re interested in passionate leaders with a strong vision and a desire to stay on top of trends in Technology Consulting space. If you have a strong passion for helping businesses achieve their IT strategy, this role is for you.
  
  
**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment**
: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture**
: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**

description:

* Excellent attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Effective communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate across global teams.
* Flexibility to work in global shifts when required.

One last thing
  
  
OpenText is more than just a corporation, it's a global community where trust is foundational, the bar is raised, and outcomes are owned. Along the way, you will have access to professional development opportunities, a comprehensive benefits package, and a vibrant, collaborative culture that embraces innovation and diversity. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that inspires every individual to bring their best self to work.

title: Program Manager, Amazon Freight
description:
**Description**
Amazon is looking for a motivated individual for the profile of Program Manager for its Amazon Freight Program team. The goal is to develop easy-to-use, reliable and transparent transportation services that beat all existing shipping alternatives for our customers. In doing this, Amazon Freight is deeply studying customer shipping needs and building innovative, market-leading solutions that will organically attract customers towards our services. To help us succeed in this large endeavor, we are looking for dynamic, self-starting and entrepreneurial individual who will organize, execute and deliver key features to the Amazon Shipping portfolio.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Define, design, launch and manage new products and programs for improving experience within the Amazon Freight program and thereby enabling scale.
* Gather requirements and conceptualize solutions to solve a business and shipper problems and work with key stake holders across various functions to define and launch the product/program.
* Monitor key metrics on the program and work with all involved stakeholder teams to drive necessary action with field teams, business ops, finance, sales and leadership teams, to achieve goals. Manage Daily/weekly performance, build mechanisms to detect and drive down defects and work on continuous improvements for all processes.
* Launch and expand the program as per the business requirements and build/own all the long term planning, program and product roadmap for Amazon Freight. Work extensively on industry bench marking, do shipper studies to understand the requirements of our prospective Shippers and work on building these capabilities.
* Use customer and market feedback, competitive analysis and bench marking, and business metrics to make informed decisions.
* Setup and manage end-to-end operational, performance measurement and customer satisfaction related processes for all shippers with whom amazon freight is tied up.

A day in the life
  
  
This role will require exceptional communication and influencing skills, and will work to influence stakeholders across shippers, Business, Operations, Sales and Tech teams. This role will require the ability to work effectively in a fast paced, startup environment, partnering with others as needed, and the ability to exercise sound judgment solving novel problems without clear direction from leadership. The successful candidate has demonstrated the ability to solve complex logistics challenges and possesses bias for action and deliver results in the role.
  
  
**About The Team**
Amazon Freight is the externalization arm for generating revenue by serving external shippers. We are leveraging our existing transportation network which serves a.in customers and use its infrastructure and capacity to serve external shippers who don't use a.in platform in anyway.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of program or project management experience
* 3+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
* 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Bachelor's degree

* 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 3+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

You will support projects, lead some of your own, and turn ambiguous problems into clear recommendations that senior stakeholders can act on. Working across research, development, regulatory, commercial and corporate areas, you will help GBS move with clarity and pace, so colleagues can focus on work that creates progress for people living with serious chronic diseases.
  
  
**What You’ll Bring**

* A master’s degree and 2–5 years of management consulting experience in a leading consulting firm.
* The ability to structure and organise ambiguous problems, tasks and information, and to act independently.
* Experience solving strategic problems with standard consulting frameworks and turning the analysis into clear recommendations.

**Useful, But Not Essential**

**What You’ll Do**
You will work alongside GBS Consulting project managers on the initiatives that matter most to GBS management and the affiliates, from supporting workstreams to leading projects as the need arises.
  
  

* Partner with global stakeholders, GBS colleagues and functional leaders on consulting projects across areas such as research, drug development, regulatory, medical affairs, safety, quality, supply chain, commercial and marketing.
* Run workshops that solve the problem at hand and help stakeholders reach decisions.
* Plan and track projects from scoping and design through validation and implementation: monitor progress, raise risks in the right forums and keep project documentation, such as agendas, minutes, memos and case studies, in order.
* Design solutions with stakeholders and build the tools, templates and governance cadence that help the team reach project milestones.

**Program Manager - First Mile / Middle Mile**
**About Blitz**
Blitz enables Same-Day Delivery for eCommerce brands to provide the best on-time delivery experiences to their customers. Blitz aims to simplify scalability & unlock the growth of new-age eCommerce brands by making Same-Day delivery more convenient, reliable & affordable. Same-Day Delivery helps brands with converting their browsers into buyers, serving as a competitive advantage and reducing working capital challenges. Blitz currently engages with enterprise brands with category focus into Fashion, Beauty & Personal Care and Healthcare; helping them with 30% - 40% increase in their website conversions & increasing retention by 2x by providing best in class experience.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Program Manager to drive initiatives across our first-mile and mid-mile network, covering the movement of goods from vendors to mother hubs and warehouses, and onward to dark stores. You will own programs that improve speed, cost, reliability, and scalability of inbound and line-haul operations, so that stores stay replenished on time in a high-velocity business.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Program Ownership**

* Plan and run first-mile and mid-mile programs end to end, from scoping and milestones to delivery and post-launch review.
* Maintain roadmaps, risk logs, and dependency trackers across Procurement, Warehousing, Transport, Finance, Tech, and Store Operations.
* Run weekly and monthly business reviews and give leadership clear updates on progress, risks, and blockers.

**First Mile Programs**

* Drive vendor pickup and inbound scheduling programs, including appointment booking, slot management, and dock-to-stock TAT improvement.
* Improve farm-to-hub and vendor-to-warehouse flows for fresh and perishable categories, with a focus on quality, wastage, and cold chain.
* Work with procurement on vendor delivery compliance, ASN accuracy, and inbound OTIF.

**Mid Mile Programs**

* Optimize line-haul and hub-to-dark-store movement through route planning, trip consolidation, and fleet utilization.
* Run transporter onboarding, rate contracts, and performance management programs (vehicle fill, TAT, damage, delivery adherence).
* Improve replenishment cycle times and cut-off adherence so stores receive stock before peak demand windows.

**Cost & Network Optimization**

* Reduce cost per kg / cost per case / cost per trip through route optimization, load planning, and vendor mix changes.
* Support network design decisions such as hub placement, cross-docking, and milk-run models.
* Build business cases and size savings for new initiatives.

**Process, Tech & Automation**

* Define requirements and work with product and tech teams on TMS, route optimization, vehicle tracking (GPS/telematics), and inbound/outbound visibility tools.
* Standardize SOPs for loading, unloading, seal and handover, GRN, and shortage/damage claims.
* Reduce manual effort and turnaround time through process redesign and automation.

**Analytics & Reporting**

* Build dashboards and track KPIs: inbound TAT, trip utilization, cost per trip, on-time dispatch and delivery, shortage and damage rates.
* Use data to find bottlenecks, run root-cause analyses, and drive corrective actions.

**Governance & Compliance**

* Ensure adherence to transport, safety, and statutory requirements (E-way bill, vehicle documentation, driver compliance, FSSAI for food movement).
* Manage transporter SLAs, penalties, claims, and dispute resolution.

**Qualifications**

* 4–8 years of experience in logistics, supply chain, transport operations, or program management, ideally in e-commerce, quick commerce, retail, FMCG, or 3PL.
* Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or equivalent from a reputed institute preferred.
* Proven record of delivering cross-functional programs with measurable cost, speed, or reliability impact.

**Job Description**

The Associate Project Manager is responsible for leading the end-to-end delivery of projects by managing scope, schedule, cost, quality, and stakeholder expectations. The role ensures successful execution through structured project governance, cross-functional coordination, risk management, and customer communication. The Associate Project Manager drives predictable delivery outcomes, ensures compliance to internal processes, and supports business success by improving execution efficiency, controlling risks, and enabling high customer satisfaction.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and manage project delivery from initiation to closure, ensuring adherence to scope, timeline, cost, and quality benchmarks.
* Lead cross-functional coordination with internal teams (Sales, PMO, Professional Services, Operations, Finance, Procurement, etc.) to ensure delivery readiness and execution success.
* Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, RAID logs (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies), stakeholder communication plans, and project closure documentation.
* Track milestones, dependencies, and critical path activities, proactively identifying bottlenecks and driving mitigation actions to avoid slippages.
* Ensure scope validation and change control by documenting exclusions, assumptions, customer approvals, and change requests through formal governance.
* Support budget and commercial governance including project cost tracking, vendor coordination, billing readiness, and delivery closure documentation.
* Drive lessons learned and process improvements to enhance delivery maturity and reduce recurrence of execution issues.

**Required Skills**

* Strong project management expertise across full project lifecycle (initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, closure)
* Schedule management, dependency tracking, and milestone governance
* Risk, issue, and escalation management with structured mitigation planning
* Change management and scope control with documentation discipline
* Strong commercial understanding (budgeting, cost control, billing readiness, vendor governance)
* Experience in managing customer-facing projects and delivery governance

**Functional / Behavioural Skills**

**About The Role**
The Digital Change transformation manager will define and manage programmes and transformation initiatives within the Digital change journey. This role will own the plan and execution of these initiatives and ensure that they are meeting the objectives of the overall Digital change journey and integrated with the cultural initiatives in Digital. These initiatives are basic components of the overall Digital Change Programme which seeks to positions Digital as an enabler for BT and its customers and an inspiration and driver of innovation.

* Digital Change Transformation Delivery –
* Leads the delivery of transformations and projects defining and maintaining realistic plans and managing project finances and progress against confirmed value drivers
* Build virtual teams to progress the transformation initiatives
* Acts as a credible advisor to key decision-makers, using data-led/technical insight and plans to help major business decisions to enable the Digital change journey

* Makes decisions on progressing actions to assist problem resolution and project delivery.
* Identifies opportunities to improve key benchmarks and value drivers

* Problem Solving – You will use a structured approach to identify problems, facilitate activity to identify root causes and develop optimal countermeasures to drive measured outcomes.
* Facilitation – You will facilitate large group workshops to scope, mobilise and drive project delivery.
* Stakeholder Management – You will building relationships and working with key partners across Digital and the units it works with
* Change Agent - Use of change implementation principles and tools to effectively implement sustained change into operational teams. Use communication and engagement to embed changes.
* Cultural change – you will role model the BT behaviours and the cultural change within Digital ensuring that the transformations you have responsibility consider both the ‘What’ and the ‘How’ of our journey
* Transformation strategy: you will driving continuous transformation and improvement of the operating and delivery model across the Digital change journey

**Essential Skills / Experience**

* 6+ years experience of portfolio management, project management or PMO
* Experience in change management frameworks
* Ability to build effective transformation and project plans to deliver benefits
* Conflict resolution skills, enabling the individual to cut across organisational and financial complexities to deliver meaningful change and to lead a multi-skilled team
* Knowledge of process improvement/project delivery/change management tools and techniques
* Ability to work with key stakeholders across Digital identify, scope, prioritise and mobilise transformation work packages.
* Confident managing board level/executive stakeholders across BT Group.
* Able to develop compelling reasons for change.
* Excellent logical investigation/root cause analysis skills.
* Confident leading teams through change & ambiguity in ever-changing environment as well as coaching and mentoring colleagues as required.
* Is an excellent collaborator: Builds great teams that are often ‘virtual’ in nature and often inclusive of people from other parts of BT Group.
* A confident and engaging managers who role models through their own behaviour and actions, the BT behaviours

BT Group is the UK’s leading communications group and the holding company behind some of the country’s most recognised brands – including BT, EE, Openreach and Plusnet. Our purpose is as simple as it is ambitious: we connect for good. Our customers include consumers, small, medium and large businesses, public sector organisations and other communications providers.
  
  
BT Group’s role is about setting direction, unlocking value and creating the conditions for our brands and businesses to thrive.
  
  
Having come through the most capital-intensive phase of our fibre investment, our focus now is on what comes next – simplifying how we operate, using technology and AI to work smarter, and organising ourselves to serve customers better and grow sustainably. We have a singular culture that unites all our people: we are customer-first challengers, who are committed, clear and connected. These behaviours unite us as one team to deliver for our colleagues, our customers, our stakeholders and the country. **About**
Fresenius Medical Care is the premier health care company focused on delivering the highest quality of care to people with renal and other chronic conditions. Through our industry-leading global network of more than 3,400 dialysis clinics and acute care canters, outpatient cardiac and vascular labs, Fresenius Medical Care provides coordinated health care services at pivotal care points for hundreds of thousands of chronically ill patients. As the world’s only vertically integrated renal company, we also offer specialty pharmacy and laboratory services, as well as manufacturing and distributing the most comprehensive line of dialysis equipment, disposable products and renal pharmaceuticals.
  
  
Fresenius Medical Care is a people business. Our success depends on having the best and brightest employees and helping them attain their personal and professional goals while delivering excellence in patient care and business results. Our employees embody our culture which is based on core values supporting our promise to improve the quality of life of every patient every day. These core values are: We Care. We Connect. We Commit.
  
  
**Senior Project Manager**
As a Senior Project Manager of the Global Business Services team, you will part of a dynamic team working across the enterprise to manage business process transitions from existing locations to offshore/nearshore or provider locations. Your primary focus will be transitions but other projects might be included as directed. Fresenius Medical Care is a fast-paced environment, and we are looking for someone who can hit the ground running to manage multiple responsibilities and projects while producing high-quality work.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Manage the transition scope and coordinate all stakeholders
* Build and manage transition plans
* Act independently to deliver to schedule, budget, and scope
* Run projects, monitor progress, track risks while escalating and driving to resolution as needed
* Report on status
* Support resource and financial reporting
* Run projects, monitor progress
* Execute project controls
* Support the business case creation, presentation, and gather approvals
* Create efficient and effective project plans, taking into consideration the respective organizational and operational structure needs and adjust approach accordingly
* Deliver on the transition/project plan Report project/transitions progress, and risks. Develop corrective action where necessary.
* Own communication and relationship with countries in respective region
* Execute on transitions/projects in line with recognized best practice methodology (planning, managing risk, governance, quality assurance, issue resolution, reporting) within the approved schedule
* Collect business/country requirements and understand the business needs
* Act as a liaison for all activities and stakeholders for assigned transition/project
* Manage day-to-day communication for assigned transition/project
* Manage the change and assess the risks and be able to implement proper mitigation plan where required.
* Coordinate and facilitate the process of documenting project/transition related policies and procedures, if required.
* Identify and document additional process improvements opportunities for possible implementation after the Transition and/or Projects closure.
* Coordinate the training/workshops of local personnel in the respected countries/regions or/and Shared Service Center employees
* Ensure seamless transfer of business processes from local sites to the Shared Services incl. service level agreements (in cooperation with GBS Service Management)
* Manage all stages of the migration process are successfully complete

**Qualifications:**

* Academic degree or equivalent experience in relevant subject matter
* Project Management certification is preferred
* Experience in transitioning complex projects
* Extended knowledge of service transition methodology, tools and templates. Has strong implementation experience.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in transition project management
* Good understanding of change management
* Background in business processes in BPO or Shared Service Center environment
* Knowledge of process improvement methodology a plus
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills paired with persuasiveness and self-confidence with strong intercultural skills and understanding.
* Team Player with a strong drive to create positive work environment, able to motivate and empower employees. Ability to work effectively across team.
* Passion for continuous learning, ability to solid comprehension and fast familiarization with new and complex tasks
* Solution-oriented, proactive and out of the box thinking personality
* Excellent skills to set priorities and self-manage high volume workload
* Ability to take the lead and proactively work on solving the issues or potential risks
* Very good planning and organizational skills
* Ability to work independently in ambiguous, dynamic environment.
* Very structured way of working with focus on efficient and effective processes even under pressure

**Key Skills**

* Communication - Able to clearly present information through the spoken or written word; read and interpret complex information; talk with customers or clients; listen well.
* Customer Focus - Able to demonstrate a high level of service delivery; do what is necessary to ensure customer satisfaction; deal with service failures and prioritize customer needs.
* Flexibility - Able to remain open-minded and change opinions on the basis of new information; perform a wide variety of tasks and change focus quickly as demands change; manage transitions effectively from task to task; adapt to varying customer needs.
* Planning, Prioritizing, & Goal Setting - Able to prepare for emerging customer needs; manage multiple projects; determine project urgency in a meaningful and practical way; use goals to guide actions and create detailed action plans; organize and schedule people and tasks.
* Policies, Process, & Procedures - Able to act in accordance with established guidelines; follow standard procedures in crisis situations; communicate and enforce organizational policies and procedures; recognize and constructively conform to unwritten rules or practices.

**Our offer:**

* Growth Opportunity: Be part of the dynamic growth and transformation of Fresenius Medical Care India Global Hub.
* Career Development: Access to challenging and rewarding opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.
* Hybrid Work Environment: Benefit from a flexible hybrid work setup that supports productivity and work-life balance.
* Transportation Facilities: Convenient company-provided cab services for pick-up and drop-off.
* Comprehensive Medical Benefits: Attractive medical benefits coverage for employees and their families.
* Cafeteria Benefits: Complimentary lunch facility at the workplace.
* Global Exposure: Gain valuable global exposure and access to diverse learning and development opportunities

title: ESC Project Leader
description:
3M has a long-standing reputation as a company committed to innovation. We provide the freedom to explore and encourage curiosity and creativity. We gain new insight from diverse thinking, and take risks on new ideas. Here, you can apply your talent in bold ways that matter.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Job Description**
**ESC Project Leader**
**Collaborate with Innovative 3Mers Around the World**
Choosing where to start and grow your career has a major impact on your professional and personal life, so it’s equally important you know that the company that you choose to work at, and its leaders, will support and guide you. With a wide variety of people, global locations, technologies and products, 3M is a place where you can collaborate with other curious, creative 3Mers.
  
  
**The Impact You’ll Make in this Role**
The Project Leader delivers projects that drive strategic improvements across ESC, ensures efficient execution through collaboration and innovative ways of working and leads projects end-to-end while engaging stakeholders to achieve results.
  
  
**You Would Be Expected To**

* Deliver projects end‑to‑end with clear scope and effective control across time, cost, and quality within defined guardrails.
* Engage stakeholders to support delivery through clear communication and alignment.
* Ensure governance and control by managing risks, maintaining documentation, and escalating key issues with mitigation actions.
* Align project outcomes to business goals, track benefits, and support sustainable adoption.
* Foster strong team collaboration, apply suitable methodologies, and drive continuous improvement in delivery practices.

**Your Skills And Expertise**
To set you up for success in this role from day one, 3M requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:
  
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in supply chain, engineering, business, or a related field with minimum 5+ years of project management experience
* Minimum 7+ years of experience in supply chain, procurement, planning logistics, engineering, manufacturing operations, network with 3+ years in a leadership role
* Advanced certifications in project management (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2) and Agile delivery (e.g., Scrum Master, SAFe) are required.

**Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:**

* Experience with AI, digital transformation, or emerging technologies in project delivery
* Proven ability to lead end-to-end projects across Agile and Waterfall environments and manage risks
* Strong problem-solving skills to analyse processes and drive improvements
* Effective communication and collaboration with diverse, cross-functional stakeholders

**Work Location:**
Hebbal, Bangalore (Karnataka), Hybrid Mode
  
  
**Supporting Your Well-being**
3M offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, 3M regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope.
  
  
Learn more about 3M’s creative solutions to the world’s problems at www.3M.com or on Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn @3M.
  
  
Safety is a core value at 3M. All employees are expected to contribute to a strong Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) culture by following safety policies, identifying hazards, and engaging in continuous improvement.

title: Project Manager
description:
As an Agile Project Manager at FTSE Russell, you will lead, coordinate, and drive the delivery of high-impact initiatives across multiple Scrum teams. You will collaborate with partners in Product, Engineering, and Operations to transform ideas into tangible outcomes, ensuring value is delivered from concept through realization.
  
  
This role demands a professional who can analyze data, visualize insights, and communicate effectively with senior leadership. You will standardize reporting processes, streamline workflows, and enable informed decision-making across diverse portfolios in a fast-paced environment.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Partner with collaborators to develop and present compelling cases for critical initiatives during the annual FTSE Russell Investment Planning Process.
* Translate Epics into prioritized User Stories with clear acceptance criteria in collaboration with Product Owners.
* Embed yourself within Scrum teams, facilitating daily stand-ups, sprint demos, retrospectives, and backlog refinement sessions to ensure delivery against sprint goals.
* Monitor and mitigate risks, lead cross-functional dependencies, and design rollout strategies for new capabilities, including UAT and training.
* Identify and resolve process inefficiencies, recommend improvements, and call out issues when necessary.
* Build and maintain a robust reporting framework to streamline status and MI reporting for multiple governance forums (Scrum meetings, Steering Committees, Investment Committees, Board meetings).

**Skills & Experience**

* Technical Proficiency: Advanced skills in MS Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Confluence, with expertise in data visualization.
* Analytical Strength: Strong numeracy and technical background, ideally in Computer Science, Finance, or Mathematics.
* Communication: Ability to influence, present, and engage partners at all levels, including C-suite.
* Agile Tools: Fully conversant with Jira.
* Experience: 3+ years handling Financial or Technology projects, with exposure to full SDLC and engineering standard processes (TDD, Pair Programming, Code Reviews, Regression Testing).
* Certifications: Certified Scrum Master.
* Attributes: Independent, adaptable, and capable of handling multiple initiatives simultaneously.

Desirable Skills
  
  

* Experience with Financial Indices.
* Programming knowledge (Java, Python, VBA, SQL).

Personal Attributes
  
  

* Curious: Continuously seeks to learn and improve.
* Problem-Solver: Diagnoses and resolves complex issues effectively.
* Positive: Transforms challenges into opportunities for improvement.
* Ethical: Demonstrates integrity and professionalism.
* Proactive: Takes initiative to drive progress and deliver results.

Work Environment
  
  

* Location: Bengaluru, India.
* Hours: Full-time, EMEA shift (1:00 PM – 10:00 PM IST), with occasional extended hours based on project needs.

**Career Stage:**
Manager
  
  
**London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) Information:**
Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.
  
  
Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of
**Integrity, Partnership**
,
**Excellence**
and
**Change**
underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.
  
  
Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25,000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce.
  
  
We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone’s race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.
  
  
You will be part of a collaborative and creative culture where we encourage new ideas. We are committed to sustainability across our global business and we are proud to partner with our customers to help them meet their sustainability objectives. Our charity, the LSEG Foundation provides charitable grants to community groups that help people access economic opportunities and build a secure future with financial independence. Colleagues can get involved through fundraising and volunteering.
  
  
LSEG offers a range of tailored benefits and support, including healthcare, retirement planning, paid volunteering days and wellbeing initiatives.
  
  
Please take a moment to read this privacy notice carefully, as it describes what personal information London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) (we) may hold about you, what it’s used for, and how it’s obtained, your rights and how to contact us as a data subject.
