title: Manager - R&D Project Management
description:
**At Elanco (NYSE: ELAN) – it all starts with animals!**
**As a global leader in animal health, we are dedicated to innovation and delivering products and services to prevent and treat disease in farm animals and pets.**
**At Elanco, we are driven by our vision of Food and Companionship Enriching Life and our purpose – all to Go Beyond for Animals, Customers, Society and Our People.**
**At Elanco, we pride ourselves on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment. We believe that diversity is the driving force behind innovation, creativity, and overall business success. Here, you’ll be part of a company that values and champions new ways of thinking, work with dynamic individuals, and acquire new skills and experiences that will propel your career to new heights.**
**Making animals’ lives better makes life better – join our team today!**
**Job Description for Manger - R&D Strategic Project Management Office (SPMO)**
**Main Purpose of Position:**
This role drives the application and integration of key project management (PM) processes and tools across teams and/or subsets of teams to deliver assets and portfolio value with quality on time, on budget and within scope. This role will implement sound project management process across product development teams and partners as needed with other project management functions in Elanco to deliver global, sustainable solutions in project management. The individual in this role is expected to exhibit key leadership behaviors which enable innovative solutions, a positive and motivating work environment, ultimately accelerating Best in Innovation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Strategic Planning & Execution**

* Lead the end-to-end planning and execution of R&D project management deliverables using PM principles as basis and utilizing advanced methodologies in MS Project, Fluid PPM, risk management tools, other PM tools.
* Develop and manage complex, integrated project schedules, ensuring critical path analysis and facilitate resource optimization.
* Maintain up-to-date project plans, milestones, and documentation in business systems.
* Independently identify and resolve project bottlenecks, ensuring deliverables remain on schedule and within budget, escalating deviations appropriately.

**Budget & Resource Management**

* Drive the financial forecasting process for assigned projects, partnering with Project Leads and Procurement to manage budgets via established processes and tools.
* Perform deep-dive variance analysis and provide strategic insights into cost drivers to inform senior leadership decision-making.
* Enable effective resource planning for technical functions by providing integrated project data and insights, facilitating optimization across diverse business processes.

**Global Stakeholder Management**

* Facilitate regular project meetings, document decisions, and follow up on key actions.
* Manage complex stakeholder matrices, facilitating high-level project meetings and ensuring alignment across global stakeholders across sites (US, EMEA, APAC, others).
* Proactively communicate project health, risks, and dependencies to R&D leadership, providing data-driven recommendations.
* Foster a collaborative culture across R&D, Regulatory, Quality, Manufacturing, Finance, Marketing and other key stakeholders.

**Risk & Quality Oversight**

* Architect comprehensive risk mitigation strategies; lead the team in proactive scenario planning to prevent potential project delays.
* Maintain accurate, phase-appropriate project documentation in compliance with internal quality standards and governance processes.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Identify and implement process improvement initiatives within the PMO to enhance organizational efficiency and data accuracy.
* Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) for Innovation cycle, PM tools and digital productivity assets (e.g., Power BI, AI tools), driving adoption across R&D teams.
* Promote a culture of operational discipline, collaboration, and continuous improvement within R&D teams.

**Qualifications:**
**Education**

* Master’s degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Biotechnology, or a related technical field.
* PMP or equivalent certification is strongly preferred.

**Experience**

* ~ 6 to 8 years of project management experience in pharmaceutical, biotech, or R&D organizations.
* Experience with project and financial management tools (MS Project, Excel, SAP, Ariba).
* Familiarity with R&D, CMC, clinical, or regulatory processes is preferred.
* Working knowledge of Power BI or similar visualization tools. Familiarity with AI or digital productivity tools in project management is an advantage.
* Extensive experience working in a global matrix environment, with comfort managing meetings across multiple time zones.

**Skills & Attributes**

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills to manage cross-functional interactions.
* Analytical mindset with attention to detail and follow-through.
* Ability to prioritize, manage multiple tasks, and adapt to changing priorities.
* Agile learner with comfort navigating ambiguity.
* Demonstrated teamwork, accountability, and problem-solving capabilities.

Elanco is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status
  
  
Elanco may use automated tools, including AI, to support parts of our recruitment process, such as reviewing applications against job‑related criteria and/or transferrable skills. These tools help ensure a consistent, structured evaluation, but they do not make hiring decisions. All decisions involve a human reviewer. For more information on how we handle personal data, please see our Elanco Workforce Privacy Notice.

title: Technical Program Manager, Trust CX Innovations
description:
**Description**
Amazon builds for everyone. TCI's Inclusive Experience charter exists to make sure the products and experiences we ship work for the full range of people who use them, so that no customer is left behind by how a product is designed. We move inclusivity upstream into how products are built, hold it as a bar products meet before they launch, and turn it into experiences customers can feel.
  
  
We are looking for a Technical Program Manager to drive the programs that make this happen. You will own cross-functional initiatives that span product, engineering, design, and science teams. You will build and manage the plan, map dependencies across teams, surface risks early, and keep stakeholders aligned on a shared bar and timeline. You will operate at a technical level, understanding the systems and trade-offs well enough to ask the right questions and drive sound decisions, and you will use that credibility to keep partner teams accountable to shared commitments. Above all, you will be the connective tissue that turns inclusivity from a set of individual commitments into experiences that ship on time and serve every customer.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Own and drive cross-functional programs that advance inclusive experiences across product, engineering, design, and science teams.
* Build the program plan: define scope, milestones, and success criteria, and translate charter goals into an executable roadmap with clear owners.
* Map and manage cross-team dependencies, identify risks and blockers early, and drive them to resolution before they affect delivery.
* Help embed the inclusivity bar into how products are planned and built, so it is met before launch rather than inspected for at the end.
* Keep stakeholders aligned through clear written status, updates, and decision documents.
* Operate at a technical level: understand the systems and trade-offs well enough to ask the right questions and support sound decisions.
* Track the metrics that show whether inclusive experiences are reaching customers, and use them to inform prioritization.
* Keep partner teams accountable to shared commitments and timelines.

**About The Team**
The Trust CX Innovation team drives advancements across Amazon Devices & Services (D&S) products. Our mission focuses on maintaining trust as the foundation while ensuring universal access as AI technology evolves. Our team develops essential privacy safeguards and accessibility features that serve millions of customers globally.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 2+ years of software development experience
* 3+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

- ADCI - BLR 14 SEZ

title: Design Manager
description:
**The Team**
We are an award-winning global consultancy and have been named Building’s Engineering Consultant of the Year in 2024, 2022 and 2021. We are at the forefront of the industry, priding ourselves on our exemplary track record of designing innovative and sustainable projects.
  
  
Sustainability runs through everything we do at Cundall, and our people are empowered to drive change and decarbonise the built environment. By the end of this decade, we have set ourselves an ambitious goal to only work on projects that meet our zero carbon design criteria, a commitment we have called our Zero Carbon Design 2030 goal. We need engineers who share this passion for sustainability and thrive in designing energy efficient buildings and communities.
  
  
Our MENA team are a source of world leading expertise and offer a pro-active and collaborative approach to skill development, and professional excellence.
  
  
At Cundall we strive to maintain a healthy balance between work and life.
  
  
Explore exciting career opportunities with us.
  
  
**The Role**
The Design Manager will be responsible for the
**overall delivery of projects**
, ensuring they are completed on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards.
  
  
This role will focus on
**project execution and management**
, integrating design, procurement, construction, and handover phases while managing risks, contracts, and stakeholder expectations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the overall project delivery from initiation through design, procurement, construction, and handover.
* Quickly understand clients processes, needs and expectations and clearly communicate this to the team.
* Maintain a collaborative relationship with clients and stakeholders while ensuring that Cundall’s commercial, contractual, and professional interests are protected at all times
* Be the recognized and trusted point of contact for clients on projects.
* Hold project kick-off meetings at every stage and ensure that the delivery team are well versed in the project deliverables and requirements.
* Develop and maintain project execution plans on projects, including development of overall master delivery program in coordination with the delivery team leads, to support the delivery of the project.
* Be accountable for the financial out-turn of projects by managing discipline leads month end procedures, invoicing and debt management.
* Day to day decision making on project progress.
* Provide clear and concise instructions and direction to the delivery team and provide stable project control.
* Manage stakeholder relationships, including client, contractors, consultants, and authorities.
* Oversee procurement processes, contract administration, and risk management.
* Monitor project progress against cost, program, and quality benchmarks and report to Project Director.
* Chair progress meetings, prepare reports, and escalate risks/issues as required.
* Manage change control, claims, and commercial implications of project variations.
* Maintain clear and accurate records and reports.
* Identify and escalate internally any performance issues with the delivery teams before the client raises them.
* Act as an initial escalation point on the project when required.
* Work with a degree of autonomy leading large design teams, but with the ability to recognize when guidance is required.
* Knowledge of QA procedures and ensuring the QA procedures are being followed by all project teams.
* Ensure health, safety, and environmental compliance during project execution.
* Support lessons-learned and knowledge transfer for future projects.
* Actively participate in new growth initiatives internally and externally and to contribute to the development of internal systems and procedures.

**The Skills**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Architecture, Building Services Construction Management, or related discipline.
* 15+ years’ experience in project management of large/complex projects.
* Strong knowledge of project delivery methodologies (Design-Bid-Build, D&B, EPC, etc.).
* Proven leadership in managing contractors, consultants, and multi-disciplinary teams.
* High-level planning and scheduling expertise (Primavera P6, MS Project, etc.).
* Exceptional communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.

**Job Description**
Your career at Cundall
  
  
**We know that to be the best at what we do we need a diverse workforce underpinned by an inclusive culture. Creating environments where everyone can find joy doing their best work is also great for everyone. That’s why we positively welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and identities, and encourage, support, and celebrate the diverse voices of our people.**

title: PMO - ERP Delivery Lead - Senior Associate
description:

title: Technical Delivery Manager
description:
**"ABOUT US:**
LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a commitment to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, handle risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years.
  
  
Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity.
  
  
LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 70 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia PaDecific. LSEG’s ticker symbol is LSEG.
  
  
**OUR PEOPLE:**
People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our culture of connecting, creating opportunity and delivering excellence shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential.
  
  
We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and exciting experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential.
  
  
We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder – which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and exciting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise.
  
  
**PROGRAMME SUMMARY:**
LSEG are embarking on a large transformation programme to streamline and optimise our current capabilities, and to deliver next-generation, industry-standard Financial Crime (FC) processes, technologies and tools to support our Customer and Third-Party onboarding. While continuing to meet internal stringent policies and our external obligations, this programme shall introduce new ways of working and standards, drive efficiencies and transforme the way we deliver value towards customer journey lifecycle at LSEG.
  
  
**ROLE PROFILE:**
A fantastic opportunity for a proven and experienced Technical Delivery Manager with a background in Know Your Customer (KYC), Customer Due Diligence (CDD), Financial Crime (FC), Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Sanctions, Transaction Monitoring and Regulatory Transformation, to lead and support the delivery of key technology initiatives underpinning the FC Transformation programme.
  
  
The successful candidate will operate at the intersection of business, technology and programme delivery, driving requirements definition, collaborator alignment, execution governance and change implementation. This individual will act as a trusted partner to business leaders, technology teams, architects, vendors and programme leadership, ensuring the successful delivery of strategic and regulatory initiatives through the full delivery lifecycle.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Lead Business and Technology Transformation**

* Partner with business, operations, risk and technology stakeholders to define strategic objectives, business requirements and delivery outcomes.
* Analyse business processes, operating models, systems and data flows to find opportunities for optimisation and transformation.
* Lead requirements definition activities including workshops, process mapping, user story development and acceptance criteria definition.
* Ensure business requirements are traceable through design, testing and implementation.

**Drive Delivery Excellence**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of complex technology initiatives from discovery through implementation.
* Develop delivery plans, manage dependencies and ensure alignment across multiple teams and workstreams.
* Identify and proactively manage risks, issues and delivery challenges.
* Monitor progress against achievements and ensure successful execution of programme commitments.
* Champion Agile delivery approaches, selecting the most appropriate methodology for each initiative.

**Build Strong Partnerships**

* Act as a trusted advisor to business and technology stakeholders.
* Facilitate alignment across teams with differing priorities and objectives.
* Provide clear communication and regular reporting to programme leadership and senior stakeholders.
* Influence decision-making through data-driven insights and thoughtful recommendations.

**Lead High-Performing Teams**

* Manage, coach and develop a team of Business Analysts and delivery professionals.
* Create an inclusive environment where individuals can grow, develop and perform at their best.
* Support career development, succession planning and capability building across the team.
* Ensure resources are effectively allocated to meet programme and organisational priorities.

**Deliver Sustainable Technology Solutions**

* Collaborate with architecture, engineering and product teams to design and implement scalable solutions.
* Support delivery of Financial Crime technology capabilities including onboarding, KYC, CDD, screening, monitoring and reporting solutions.
* Ensure solutions align with governance, security, data and regulatory requirements.
* Promote continuous improvement and adoption of standard methodologies across delivery teams.

**Enable Data-Driven Decisions**

* Partner with data, reporting and engineering teams to define information requirements and reporting solutions.
* Support delivery of management information, operational insights and performance reporting.
* Ensure data quality, integrity and consistency across delivered solutions.

**Experience**
**What You'll Bring**

* Significant experience leading business analysis and technology delivery within Financial Services, Risk, Compliance or Financial Crime domains.
* Demonstrated success delivering large-scale business and technology transformation initiatives.
* Experience leading and developing teams in a people management capacity.
* Experience working with senior stakeholders across business, operations and technology organisations.
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a complex, fast-paced environment.

**Knowledge & Skills**

* Strong understanding of Financial Crime processes including KYC, Customer Due Diligence, Sanctions Screening and Transaction Monitoring.
* Excellent business analysis, process improvement and requirements management capabilities.
* Strong project and delivery management experience, including planning, dependency management and governance.
* Ability to simplify complex problems and translate business needs into practical technology solutions.
* Strong communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working within Agile, Waterfall or hybrid delivery environments.
* Knowledge of enterprise technologies, data platforms, workflow solutions and system integrations.

**Preferred**

* Experience delivering Financial Crime technology platforms, in-house built solutions around customer
* Professional certifications in Business Analysis, Agile, Project Management or Product Management.
* Experience working across global teams and multiple time zones.

**Why Join Us?**
This is an opportunity to shape the future of Financial Crime technology at LSEG, leading critical transformation initiatives that improve customer experience, strengthen controls and support global regulatory obligations.
  
  
You will have the opportunity to lead talented teams, influence strategic decisions and drive delivery of solutions that create meaningful business impact across the organisation.
  
  
**We're proud to have been recognised as a Great Place to Work® in India ‘25**
**Career Stage:**
Manager
  
  
**London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) Information:**
Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.
  
  
Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of
**Integrity, Partnership**
,
**Excellence**
and
**Change**
underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.
  
  
Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25,000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce.
  
  
We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone’s race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.
  
  
You will be part of a collaborative and creative culture where we encourage new ideas. We are committed to sustainability across our global business and we are proud to partner with our customers to help them meet their sustainability objectives. Our charity, the LSEG Foundation provides charitable grants to community groups that help people access economic opportunities and build a secure future with financial independence. Colleagues can get involved through fundraising and volunteering.
  
  
LSEG offers a range of tailored benefits and support, including healthcare, retirement planning, paid volunteering days and wellbeing initiatives.

Lead end-to-end HRMS implementations, partner with clients, manage stakeholders, drive change, and ensure successful project delivery and go-live

* Requirements:

+ Master’s Degree (preferably in HR) or relevant work experience after bachelor.
+ Min. 3 years of experience in HR transformation & change management/HCM implementation roles/HR consulting roles.
+ Understanding of Technology systems. HRMS system implementation and understanding would be preferred.
+ Proficient in productivity tools like MS Excel, MS Word and MS PowerPoint.
+ Key behavioural traits: Agility, Analytical, Persistence and Ability to stretch.

* You will thrive in this role and Darwinbox  if you are –

+ A hustler who can work in a fast-paced environment and stretch themselves.
+ Responsible and take complete ownership of projects and team assigned to you.

+ Analytical and can solve problems on-the-go.

title: Principal Technical Program Manager
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
  
  
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
  
  

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

**An Overview Of This Role**
As a Technical Program Manager on GitLab's all-remote R&D PMO team, you will own complex, end-to-end programs that are central to our AI-powered DevSecOps strategy. You will drive high-priority initiatives across product, engineering, data, and security teams, transforming strategic vision into executable plans that deliver innovative capabilities like the GitLab Duo Agent Platform and next-generation developer tools. You will work closely with executive leaders and cross-functional stakeholders, serving as the bridge between strategy and execution through clear communication, proactive risk management, and structured program delivery. In your first year, you will independently lead strategic programs, driving predictable execution, thoughtful tradeoffs between quality and speed, and transparent stakeholder alignment.
  
  
**Some Examples Of Our Projects**

* Leading the GitLab Duo Agent Platform from GA through enterprise adoption, including customer onboarding, support models, and billing integration for AI-driven capabilities
* Delivering data-intensive platform initiatives that enhance developer productivity and enterprise analytics capabilities
* Driving infrastructure modernization and scalability programs that support our growing customer base
* Orchestrating security and compliance initiatives that maintain our industry-leading DevSecOps standards

**What You Will Do**

* Lead end-to-end technical programs across product, engineering, data, and security, from initial scope through launch and continuous improvement
* Collaborate closely with executive leaders and senior stakeholders to translate strategic vision into actionable roadmaps and align on priorities and tradeoffs
* Coordinate distributed teams across time zones using strong asynchronous communication, providing structure, clarity, and consistent status updates
* Develop and maintain comprehensive program plans, proactively identifying and mitigating risks and dependencies while facilitating decisions that balance speed, quality, and customer impact
* Partner with customer success and cross-functional teams to refine communication plans, and operational workflows
* Champion GitLab's values and culture within programs, fostering collaborative excellence, continuous improvement, and innovation

**What You Will Bring**

* Proven experience leading technical program initiatives in product, engineering, data, or security environments, with demonstrated success delivering complex programs from inception through scaled adoption
* Demonstrated ability to define strategy and create clarity within extreme ambiguity
* Strong background in SaaS, cloud infrastructure, or DevOps technology companies, with ability to quickly master the GitLab platform and AI/ML initiatives
* Proven experience influencing and driving impact at a division and company-wide scale, affecting market position and revenue
* Excellence in cross-functional leadership, with experience partnering with engineering, product, security teams and engaging effectively with senior and C-level stakeholders
* Outstanding communication skills, including asynchronous collaboration, executive reporting, and the ability to translate technical complexity into clear business impact
* Track record of success in fast-paced, dynamic environments with evolving technical requirements and market opportunities
* Strong facilitation and influence skills, with ability to drive consensus across diverse stakeholder groups while building trust through transparency and delivery excellence
* Expertise in high-level stakeholder management, including masterful communication with Executive Boards and enterprise Customers
* Collaborative leadership style aligned with GitLab's values, including respect, openness to feedback, and commitment to team success
* Proven track record of redefining organizational operations and serving as an escalation point to resolve highly complex, enterprise-level challenges
* Welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds, including those with consulting, enterprise technology, or technical leadership experience who have owned outcomes and delivered transformational initiatives
* Ability to act as a visionary leader, shaping R&D direction and fostering technical excellence across the organization

**About the team:**
The Technical Program Management team sits within GitLab's R&D Program Management Office and drives product, engineering, data, and security initiatives across our AI-powered DevSecOps platform. You will join our growing, distributed team of Technical Program Managers currently spanning North America and Europe. We own the end-to-end delivery of complex, cross-functional programs including AI platform capabilities, enterprise customer initiatives, and strategic technology transformations. As an all-remote team, we excel at asynchronous communication to coordinate across time zones while partnering closely with executive leaders and stakeholders to deliver business-critical outcomes.
  
  
**How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees**

* Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Team Member Resource Groups
* Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan

Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.
  
  
**Country Hiring Guidelines:**
GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.
  
  
**Privacy Policy:**
Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.

title: Associate Clinical Operations Leader
description:
**About Parexel**
Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.
  
  
We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose, moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking an Associate Clinical Operations Leader to join our team in Bengaluru in remote capacity. As an Associate Clinical Operations Leader, you will take on Clinical Operations Leader responsibilities for assigned countries or selected tasks, supporting clinical research activities that advance new treatments for patients. This position plays a key role in study execution, ICH-GCP and regulatory compliance, and clinical data quality. You will work under the guidance of an experienced Clinical Operations Leader, collaborate with cross-functional teams, follow industry-standard processes, and contribute to study operations from start-up through close-out.
  
  
Responsibilities include coordinating clinical teams on small to midsize projects, serving as a role model and coach for your team, and managing site and study issues, with opportunities to deepen your expertise and influence study outcomes. This role may also be part of a global project management team.
  
  
You will join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through study start-up, site performance, and timely, high-quality study delivery. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Associate Clinical Operations Leader can explore career paths and expand skills across clinical researc
**h.**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate and direct clinical project team members on small to midsize studies, providing productivity targets, performance feedback, and input to study-specific training
* Manage study start-up activities, including input to project plans, site selection strategy, monitoring plans, and patient recruitment and retention plans
* Monitor study timelines, patient recruitment, patient retention, and data cleaning to support a successful project outcome
* Address escalated site issues and drive them to closure, identifying potential problems early and supporting contingency planning
* Communicate effectively with internal and external customers, sponsors, investigational sites, and third-party vendors, prioritizing urgent requests
* Evaluate resourcing needs and monitor the use of resources across the project life cycle
* Prepare for and participate in audits and inspections, and support the maintenance and quality checks of central files
* Ensure compliance with ICH-GCP, local regulatory requirements, and Parexel SOPs, work instructions, and operational guidelines
* Collaborate on database lock, project close-out, and archiving activities with Project Leaders and Data Operations Leaders
* Support process improvement initiatives and contribute lessons learned at study close-out

**Candidate Profile**
**You Will Thrive In This Role If You Bring**

* Strengths in leading virtual teams across locations and cultures, negotiating and influencing with diplomacy, and root cause analysis
* Substantial experience in clinical research, with an understanding of cross-functional activities in data processing, data cleaning, and site management
* The ability to collaborate across teams, build trust with clients and colleagues, and communicate clearly in writing and in person
* A commitment to high-quality work, strong attention to detail, and a sense of urgency
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook) and WebEx, and the ability to become proficient with Parexel systems

**Required Qualifications**

* Degree in a life science or a nursing qualification, or relevant clinical or clinical management experience
* Substantial relevant work experience in clinical research operations, such as Clinical Research Associate (CRA) experience or equivalent
* Knowledge of International Council for Harmonisation (ICH) Good Clinical Practice (GCP), regulatory requirements, and clinical trial processes across the full project life cycle
* Strong command of written and spoken English, with local language proficiency as required
* Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize workload with attention to detail

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Coordinating experience, preferably gained in a Senior CRA or Senior CMA position
* On-site monitoring experience
* Local language proficiency for assigned countries
* Ability to travel as required

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.
  
  
If this job doesn't sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know of someone who'd be a perfect fit, send them the link to apply!

**Why Haleon?**
Our Win as One Framework is a simple, stretching definition of our future direction. It includes our purpose, ambitions, strategic drivers, and behaviours that will enable us to Win as One. This framework guides our decision-making, strategy, and culture. The successful candidate will demonstrate the following capabilities:
  
  

* Consumer first, always: Engage key business counterparts and operational stakeholders to deliver operational execution of Haleon strategies related to eCommerce activities, always putting the consumer first.

title: Global Banking and Market Operations - TxB Ops Enablement-Vice President-Bengaluru
description:
**Job Description**
At Goldman Sachs, we connect people, capital and ideas to help solve problems for our clients. We are a leading global financial services firm providing investment banking, securities and investment management services to a substantial and diversified client base that includes corporations, financial institutions, governments and individuals. For us, it’s all about bringing together people who are curious, collaborative and have the drive to make things possible for our clients and communities.
  
  
**GLOBAL BANKING & MARKETS**
We make markets in and clear client transactions on major stock, options and futures exchanges worldwide. Through our global sales force, we maintain relationships with our clients, receiving orders and distributing investment research, trading ideas, market information and analysis.
  
  
**OPERATIONS**
Transaction Banking Operations is a part of Transaction Banking within Investment Banking. We are responsible for building, developing and supporting Goldman Sachs’ Transaction Banking offering which is delivering a range of treasury and cash management products to our corporate client base. Transaction Banking Operations provide essential risk management and controls architecture to preserve and enhance the firm’s assets and reputation. For every new product launched and every trade executed, it is Operations that develop and manage the processes and controls that enable business flow.
  
  
**OUR IMPACT**
Transaction Banking Operations is focused on scaling the Transaction Banking businesses and supporting the constantly evolving suite of innovative Transaction Banking Services we offer clients, while adapting to the rapidly changing payment landscape.
  
  
Our organization is the first line of defense for control and governance to protect both clients’ and the firm’s financial assets, while delivering a differentiated, best-in-class client service. Transaction Banking Operations is a growing team with regional presence in Singapore, Bengaluru, Amsterdam, London, New York, and Dallas. All our offices work closely together as a single global team in support of our Transaction Banking business.
  
  
The team plays a critical role in understanding the end-to-end client journey, identifying which Operations teams will be impacted by roadmap deliverables, and coordinating readiness activities so that the functional operations teams are prepared to support clients effectively.
  
  
In addition to business-as-usual operational readiness, the team supports key enablement programs across Transaction Banking Operations.
  
  
**YOUR IMPACT**
We are seeking a Vice President to join our Operations Enablement team in TxB Operations. The Operations Enablement team provides central services that drive the growth, scalability, and execution discipline of Operations in support of TxB and its clients.
  
  
The ideal candidate will provide senior leadership to ensure new products, features, and enhancements are operationally ready before go-live. The Vice President will be expected to establish direction, influence senior cross-functional stakeholders, exercise sound judgment, and drive complex initiatives from strategy through execution. The candidate must also be comfortable using approved Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools responsibly to improve productivity, strengthen analysis, and identify opportunities to streamline operational processes.
  
  
**How You Will Fulfill Your Potential**

* Lead operational readiness for Transaction Banking product roadmap deliverables, ensuring impacted Operations teams are prepared to support new products, features, enhancements, and client-facing capabilities before go-live.
* Serve as a senior Operations partner to Product, Engineering, Risk, Legal, Compliance, and functional Operations leaders; define readiness strategy, assess operational impacts, resolve dependencies, and drive accountable execution.
* Develop and apply a strong understanding of the end-to-end Transaction Banking client journey to anticipate impacts across teams, processes, controls, procedures, technology, and client support models.
* Establish governance and lead complex readiness workstreams, including stakeholder engagement, milestone management, risk and issue escalation, communication planning, training, procedure updates, and post-launch stabilization.
* Provide oversight and challenge for user acceptance testing by shaping operational test strategy, confirming appropriate participation and coverage, monitoring defects and risks, and informing readiness and go-live decisions.
* Produce concise executive updates, recommendations, decision materials, and readiness reporting using tools such as JIRA, Confluence, Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI, and Amazon Quick.
* Lead Operations Enablement programs that improve operational transparency, client experience, control effectiveness, and execution discipline across Transaction Banking Operations.
* Champion the responsible adoption of approved AI and machine learning capabilities; identify high-value use cases, evaluate risks and controls, and partner with stakeholders to streamline manual workflows, strengthen decision-making, and reduce operational bottlenecks.
* Mentor junior team members, promote consistent standards, and help build a high-performing, collaborative, and forward-looking Operations Enablement function.

**Basic Qualifications**
**SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE WE ARE LOOKING FOR:**

* Bachelor’s degree with at least 7 years of relevant professional experience in Operations, project or program management, business analysis, product implementation, client service, or a related financial services function
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional change initiatives, product or feature launches, operational implementations, or transformation programs from strategy through execution
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence senior partners, establish accountability, navigate competing priorities, and drive timely decisions without direct authority
* Advanced project and program management capability, with experience managing governance, milestones, dependencies, resources, risks, issues, and executive-level reporting across multiple workstreams
* Ability to understand product strategy, business requirements, client journeys, operating models, and control considerations and translate them into scalable operational readiness plans
* Experience leading or overseeing user acceptance testing, including test strategy, scenario coverage, participant coordination, defect management, risk assessment, and readiness recommendations prior to launch
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and control mindset, with sound judgment and the ability to identify material risks, challenge constructively, and recommend practical solutions
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information into clear executive updates, presentations, recommendations, and decision materials
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint and familiarity with project, collaboration, and reporting tools such as JIRA, Confluence, Power BI, and QuickSight
* Comfort and practical fluency using approved AI tools to support research, analysis, drafting, summarization, process improvement, and productivity, with appropriate attention to accuracy, confidentiality, governance, and human oversight

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Deep experience in Transaction Banking, cash management, payments, client onboarding, client implementation, client service, or Operations support functions
* Strong knowledge of the Software Development Life Cycle, Agile delivery practices, product roadmaps, release management, and production go-live governance
* Experience using JIRA and Confluence to govern delivery, manage documentation, coordinate issue resolution, and provide transparency across complex initiatives
* Experience with Power BI, Amazon QuickSight, or similar reporting and data visualization tools, including hands-on dashboard development and interpretation of operational data
* Experience with operating model design, process re-engineering, process mapping, procedure documentation, control design, or operational workflow analysis
* Experience identifying, piloting, or scaling AI, automation, or data-driven solutions in a controlled business environment
* Proven ability to operate effectively in ambiguity, connect related workstreams, provide thought leadership, and bring senior stakeholders to clear decisions
* Experience mentoring or developing colleagues and promoting consistent standards across teams

**About Goldman Sachs**
At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.
  
  
We believe who you are makes you better at what you do. We're committed to fostering and advancing diversity and inclusion in our own workplace and beyond by ensuring every individual within our firm has a number of opportunities to grow professionally and personally, from our training and development opportunities and firmwide networks to benefits, wellness and personal finance offerings and mindfulness programs. Learn more about our culture, benefits, and people at GS.com/careers.
  
  
We’re committed to finding reasonable accommodations for candidates with special needs or disabilities during our recruiting process. Learn more: https://www.goldmansachs.com/careers/footer/disability-statement.html

* Pricing & Price-Pack Architecture
* Promotion Effectiveness & Optimization
* Trade Spend & Investment Governance
* Assortment & Portfolio Optimization

* Lead governance forums, value reviews, and roadmap discussions for RGM initiatives.

* Support recruitment, onboarding, and capability uplift in RGM-specific skills.
* Embed best practices in RGM analytics delivery, documentation, and quality assurance.

Ensure high quality, scalable deliverables aligned to commercial KPIs such as:
  
  

* Net Revenue Growth
* Price Realization
* Promo ROI
* Trade Efficiency
* Margin Improvement

**Responsibilities:**

* Track value realization, not just output delivery.
* Drive standardization and reusability of RGM assets, models, and dashboards.

* Shaping solution approaches and proposals
* Contribute to RGM practice building frameworks, accelerators, POVs, and case studies

* 12 ± 1 years of overall experience, with 8+ years in analytics delivery.

This role will report to Chief Operating Officer, Cyber & Data Resilience. Expected to operate in hybrid work model from Bangalore, India.
  
  
This role combines structured project delivery with operational and leadership support, helping ensure priorities are clearly defined, work is coordinated effectively, and execution proceeds with discipline and momentum. The Project Manager, CDR Operations is critical to turning strategy into aligned, measurable execution across CDR, supporting sustained progress on priorities across functions.
  
  
**Day To Day Responsibilities**
**Project Delivery & Execution**

* Own end‑to‑end delivery of assigned CDR initiatives, from planning through close‑out
* Develop and maintain clear project plans, milestones, timelines, and dependencies
* Drive day‑to‑day execution, ensuring work progresses as planned and issues are addressed proactively

* Escalate issues appropriately when timelines, scope, or outcomes are at risk

**Leadership Enablement & Operating Cadence**

* Support the operating rhythm of CDR leadership teams, including structuring and prioritizing agendas, aligning stakeholders ahead of key discussions, and ensuring timely follow‑up on decisions and agreed actions
* Drive preparation and alignment for monthly business reviews, including developing substantive content, ensuring message clarity, data integrity, and consistency of narrative, and coordinating inputs across functions and teams

**Stakeholder Coordination & Strategic Execution**

* Advance strategic initiatives through structured collaboration, stakeholder engagement, and data‑driven insights
* In partnership with CDR lifecycle leadership, liaise with service line and functional leaders to ensure consistency in processes, reporting, and performance measurement, and support coordinated execution across capabilities and regions
* Serve as a connective conduit across capabilities, ensuring alignment, coordination, and message consistency

**Delivery Discipline & Continuous Improvement**

* Apply consistent project management disciplines to support predictable, high‑quality execution
* Facilitate project management and organizational change efforts that drive cost efficiency, scalability, and delivery effectiveness
* Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, reduce manual effort, and improve clarity
* Partner with Operations and Technology teams to support process improvement, automation, and improved ways of working

**What Success Looks Like**

* Strategic initiatives move forward with clarity, structure, and follow‑through
* Lifecycle leaders are supported with strong preparation, alignment, and execution rigor
* Stakeholders have clear visibility into progress, risks, and decisions
* Project delivery risks are identified early and actively managed
* Execution across CDR feels coordinated, predictable, and outcome‑focused

**Essential Traits**

* Experience supporting leadership teams, operating cadences, or business reviews in addition to formal project delivery
* Experience in cybersecurity, technology, data, or regulated services environments
* Demonstrated experience delivering cross‑functional initiatives involving multiple stakeholders, timelines, and dependencies
* Proven ability to translate business objectives into clear, executable project plans and drive delivery to completion
* Hands‑on experience managing scope, timelines, risks, dependencies, and financials
* Experience influencing outcomes and driving alignment without direct authority

**Prerequisite**

* Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Business Administration, Technology, Engineering, or a related field
* 5–7 years of progressive experience managing projects or initiatives in professional services, consulting, technology, or similarly complex, matrixed environments
* Familiarity with waterfall, hybrid, or Agile delivery approaches and common PM tools (e.g. Jira, Monday.com, Smartsheet, ADO)

description:

Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions.
  
  
**About BNP Paribas Group**
BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialised businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.
  
  
**Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected and can bring their authentic selves to work. We prohibit Discrimination and Harassment of any kind and our policies promote equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants, irrespective of, but not limited to their gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, colour, national origin, age, religion, social status, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status etc. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in.
  
  
**Job Title**
Vice President – Project Manager
  
  
**Date**
Department:

Location:
  
  
Bengaluru / Mumbai
  
  
**Business Line / Function**
Drive India

**Grade**
(if applicable)
  
  
(Functional)
  
  
**Number Of Direct Reports**
Directorship / Registration:
  
  
NA
  
  
**Position Purpose**
Project Managers within DRIVE play the role of architects (end-to-end) of the GM / ALMT Value Chain. Within DRIVE, the Project Implementation practice hosts the Project Managers for vertical (Front-Office to accounting) or transversal (across several FO business lines or users’ groups or locations/entities) projects, especially for their implementation phase. The DRIVE Project Implementation (DRIVE PI) covers GM and ALMT business lines globally.
  
  
Project Managers are involved in the study and/or implementation of the projects allocated to DRIVE PI, which encompasses to:
  
  

* Frame the project upfront, define the most adequate governance to lead the project to success and get signoff,
* When relevant, consolidate the design the solution that the project is to deliver, with proper signoff from clients & IT architecture & relevant contributors,
* Build/consolidate and maintain the project plan, effectively manage unplanned events, manage dependencies and critical path,
* Drive the project team to completion in close interaction with the Project Sponsor, ensure effective communication, continuous alignment of all contributors and timely running of governance routines,
* Take responsibility for – when appropriate – some of the actions and analysis related to the project, without losing focus on the roadmap,
* Secure the staffing of the project team, with the support of line managers and/or relevant governance body in charge of allocating resources,
* Perform project retrospective to leverage on experience and learn lessons for improvement for the future.

The key interactions are with the project sponsor, front-office teams, operations teams, IT and Finance. Depending on the nature of the project, liaison with GM Reg, Compliance, Legal, Risk, GM QR and Tax is required too.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
The Experienced Project Manager will be able to take in charge a large / complex project or handle 2 less complex/smaller projects in parallel. In either case, this will include:
  
  
Preliminary step: project framing
  
  

* Clarify the objective, the scope, the dependencies, the major risks & issues.
* Confirm the sponsorship.
* Ensure a clear business rationale is associated to the contemplated project (incl. high level ROI), identify benefits.
* Size roughly the effort required to design the solution & execute the projects.
* Identify contributors to be on-boarded for the study.

**Study / Design Phase**

* Clearly state the business requirements, cost and time-frame of the project.
* Coordinate & challenge experts to put together a solution meeting the business requirements.
* Identify risk and dependencies that could jeopardize project execution.
* Establish the full financial of the project (cost, associated revenues or savings).
* Design the project governance (roles & responsibilities, governance bodies, stakeholders identification).
* Design project roadmap (i.e. the overall execution plan).
* Secure the resource plan (skills, capacity) and prioritization / funding for those resources.

**Execution Phase**

* Drive the execution of the roadmap.
* Ensure aligned project status/progress is shared amongst the project community.
* Identify risk & issues and propose a mitigation action plan.
* Raise alerts / escalate issues / review the roadmap if required.
* Monitor the budget consumption.
* Monitor the feedback from contributors on project management and adjust when required.
* Prepare and chair governance bodies, produce adequate reporting, communicate.

Completion phase
  
  

* Collect feedback from project participants.
* Identify good practices/factors of success and fields of improvement.
* Update project management toolkit with lessons learnt.

The Project Manager Is Also Accountable To Ensure That Solutions Designed For The Project Fit With The Principles And Are Validated By The Relevant Validation Bodies
  
  

* Overall sound IT architecture.
* Target Operating Model with clear mandate for each team.
* Strong controls framework.
* Simple and efficient working.

It is also expected from the PM that they will:
  
  

* Be able to provide Project progress KPI, allowing to demonstrate adherence (or not) to initial plan
* Proactively propose and set-up mitigation plans.

Publish their own highlights relative to their project for review of their Team Leader
  
  
**Technical & Behavioral Competencies**
**Technical Skills Required**

* Good knowledge of our environment (products, markets, practices, processes, systems, organisation and people).
* Ability to deliver the various phases (framing, study / design, execution, completion/closure) of large / complex projects.
* Ability to manage indirectly other project resources working on the project under their lead, within DRIVE or not.
* Ability to develop a culture of the planning, be able to keep a direction in order to meet the deadlines in an autonomous manner.
* Ability to take decisions linked to the project when necessary and when it goes under PM mandate.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong analytical skills
* Strong problem-solving and negotiation skills
* Comfortable operating with a strong level of autonomy, self-driven
* Organised and delivery-focused, with attention to detail.
* Good communication and reporting skills
* Is able to articulate a message clearly and succinctly.
* Is able to tailor communication style to relevant audiences (i.e. communicate complex issues / matters in a simple understandable way).
* Showing leadership and assertiveness
* Working capacity and efficiency
* Ability to detect political situations by themselves & to address those thanks to the coaching of their Team Leader / a more senior PM
* Team Player/ Networking Skills

* Ability to lead, motivate and develop high-performing teams across locations.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Ability to balance quality, timelines and cost.

* Collaborative leadership with clear accountability for outcomes.

* Strong Microsoft 365 and SharePoint migration or modernization expertise.
* Proven experience leading teams and delivering complex technology engagements.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

BPI Program Governance and Reporting

title: Video Production Manager
description:
**Company: Alttred Nexxus**

**Website:**
https://www.alttrednexxus.com/

**Location: Bommanahalli, Bangalore**

**Experience: 2–5 Years**

**Salary: ₹6–9 LPA CTC**

**Work Mode: Hybrid — 3 days a week from the office**

About Alttred Nexxus

Alttred Nexxus is a creative studio bringing strategy, design, development, and production under one roof. We work with brands across industries to create compelling digital experiences, performance creatives, and video content that drives results.

We're looking for a Video Production Manager who can take ownership of the entire video production workflow, from receiving client briefs to delivering final, approved videos.

You'll work directly with clients, manage deliverables, coordinate an extended team of 8–10 in-house and freelance video editors, and ensure projects are delivered on time without compromising creative quality.

This role is ideal for someone who understands video editing, enjoys managing people, communicates confidently with clients, and can keep multiple projects moving without letting deliverables fall through the cracks.

What You'll Do

1. Team Management & Leadership

* Coordinate and manage the workflow of 8–10 in-house and freelance video editors.
* Allocate deliverables based on project priorities, editor capabilities, availability, and deadlines.
* Translate client briefs into clear editing instructions and communicate expectations to the respective editors.
* Track daily output and ensure editors complete their assigned deliverables within the committed timelines.
* Review edits, provide constructive feedback, and maintain consistent quality standards across the team.
* Manage the workload and availability of freelance editors alongside the in-house team.
* Identify bottlenecks, resolve workflow issues, and ensure the team operates efficiently.
* Hold team members accountable for deadlines, quality, and timely communication.

2. Client Communication & Coordination

* Act as a key point of contact for clients regarding video production and deliverables.
* Understand client briefs, requirements, creative expectations, and delivery timelines.
* Communicate project progress, delivery commitments, and pending requirements proactively.
* Follow up with clients for timely feedback, reviews, and approvals.
* Translate client feedback into actionable instructions for the editing team.
* Coordinate revisions and ensure requested changes are completed within agreed timelines.
* Proactively identify potential delays, clarify ambiguous briefs, and resolve issues before they affect delivery.
* Ensure clients have clear visibility into the status of their projects and deliverables.

3. Project & Workflow Management

* Own the complete video production workflow, from receiving client briefs to coordinating edits, managing revisions, and delivering final videos.
* Track deliverables, deadlines, revision cycles, approvals, and pending feedback across multiple client accounts.
* Ensure smooth coordination between clients, internal teams, and in-house and freelance editors.
* Maintain clear project trackers so every deliverable has an assigned editor, deadline, and status.
* Prioritise tasks based on urgency, client commitments, team capacity, and campaign requirements.
* Ensure projects don't get delayed because of poor communication, unclear ownership, or a lack of follow-ups.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth execution across campaigns.
* Take ownership of delivery commitments and ensure all projects progress as planned.

4. Video Editing & Creative Quality

* Have a strong understanding of video editing, storytelling, pacing, transitions, sound design, and visual composition.
* Understand creative briefs and assess whether edits meet the client's objectives.
* Review deliverables before they are shared with clients and ensure they meet the expected quality standards.
* Provide clear creative feedback to editors to improve the final output.
* Stay updated on social media trends, performance marketing creatives, and AI-powered video creation tools.
* Step in to edit or troubleshoot videos when required, while maintaining ownership of team coordination and project delivery.

What Your Usual Day Looks Like

This role is about managing the entire delivery pipeline, not just editing videos or assigning tasks.

* Coordinate with clients: Receive briefs, understand requirements, confirm deliverables, and align on expectations and timelines.
* Delegate work: Break down briefs into clear tasks and assign deliverables to the appropriate in-house or freelance editors.
* Manage the production workflow: Coordinate between clients, internal teams, and editors to keep every project moving from brief to final delivery.
* Track daily output: Check progress and ensure every editor completes their assigned daily deliverables.
* Follow up on feedback and approvals: Ensure clients review deliverables and provide feedback on time so projects don't remain stuck.
* Manage revisions: Communicate requested changes to the respective editors, track progress, and ensure revised videos are submitted within the agreed timelines.
* Resolve bottlenecks: Address delays, unclear briefs, workload imbalances, and pending approvals before they affect delivery.
* Quality-check deliverables: Ensure videos meet creative expectations and client requirements before final submission.
* Close the loop: Confirm that deliverables have been shared, feedback has been addressed, and approvals or next steps are clearly tracked.

What We're Looking For

* 2–5 years of professional experience in video editing, video production, creative project management, or a similar role within an agency or production environment.
* Strong practical understanding of video editing and production workflows.

**The role**
As a senior technical program manager (STPM), you'll lead our most complex, cross-team and cross-geography programs, such as cloud cost optimization, platform migrations, and large multi-team launches. You'll turn ambiguity into clear plans, keep every team aligned on what matters, and give senior leadership an honest, current view of progress, risks, and trade-offs.
  
  
You'll also be the bridge between executive leadership and engineering. You'll translate business priorities into engineering plans, and translate technical reality into decisions leaders can act on. You won't manage the engineers, but you'll earn their trust and drive results through influence.
  
  
**What you'll do**

* **Lead complex programs end to end.**
  Own programs that span multiple engineering, product, data, and finance teams across time zones, from scoping and planning through launch and post-launch review.
* **Coordinate product and engineering roadmaps.**
  Align product and engineering roadmaps across teams and regions. Reconcile priorities, capacity, and dependencies, keep one integrated view of what ships when, and flag trade-offs early so leadership can make informed calls.
* **Drive cost and efficiency initiatives.**
  Partner with engineering and finance to analyze cloud and infrastructure spend, identify savings, set targets, and track delivery against them.
* **Keep leadership informed.**
  Run regular program reviews and steering committees. Write concise executive updates covering status, milestones, risks, dependencies, decisions needed, and business impact.
* **Bridge executives and engineering.**
  Translate strategy and customer priorities into technical roadmaps and milestones, and explain technical constraints and trade-offs in plain business terms.
* **Manage dependencies and risk.**
  Surface cross-team dependencies early, own the critical path, escalate with clear options and recommendations, and keep the plan honest.
* **Define and track metrics.**
  Set KPIs, SLAs, and success criteria for each program, and report results with data that leaders can trust.
* **Build repeatable ways of working.**
  Improve planning, intake, prioritization, and delivery processes across engineering. Standardize the practices that work.
* **Raise the bar.**
  Mentor program managers and engineering leads, and share best practices across the organization.

**What you'll bring**

* 5+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering management, or a closely related role, including 5+ years leading cross-functional programs with software engineering teams.
* A track record of delivering large, multi-team programs across geographies, with measurable outcomes in scope, schedule, budget, and quality.
* Strong technical depth. You can discuss architecture, cloud infrastructure, data platforms, and CI/CD with engineers and spot risk before it becomes a delay.
* Excellent written and verbal communication. You've presented to VP and C-level audiences and can turn complex detail into a clear story and a clear ask.
* Experience leading cost reduction or efficiency programs, including cloud spend (FinOps), vendor contracts, or resource optimization.
* Proven ability to influence without authority, resolve conflict, and make decisions with incomplete information.
* Comfort with program tooling (Jira, Confluence, or similar) and with building dashboards and reports from engineering and financial data.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

**Nice to have**

* Background as a software engineer or technical lead.
* Experience at a SaaS, ecommerce, or data and AI company operating at scale.
* Experience with generative AI or agentic AI product development.

**How we'll measure success**

* Programs deliver on agreed scope, timeline, and budget, with risks raised early.
* Cost and efficiency targets are met and tracked transparently.
* Leadership has a current, accurate view of program status and the decisions needed.

**Why CommerceIQ**
You'll work on programs that shape how leading brands win in ecommerce, with direct access to senior leadership and real influence on how engineering operates. We put customers first, communicate clearly, and value people who take ownership.
  
  
*We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other category prohibited by applicable law.*

Network & Security Fundamentals

Security & Network Technologies
