title: Data Migration Manager
description:
**External Job Ad**
****Data Migration Manager****
**Amazing Career Moments Happen Here**
Applied Systems, Inc., a worldwide leader in insurance technology, is currently searching for a Data Migration Manager to lead a team within our Data Services organization. This role is responsible for the people leadership, delivery oversight, and client-facing communication needed to ensure that customer data migrations from competitor and legacy systems into Applied Systems SaaS products are executed seamlessly, on time, and with a high standard of quality and customer satisfaction.
  
  
**Job Summary**
As a people leader within Data Services, the Manager owns the team's delivery outcomes end to end — from understanding what each customer expects and why, to translating those expectations into the technical work the team needs to complete, to confirming the outcome meets the customer's requirements. The Manager oversees a team of Data Migration Engineers, coaching and guiding their day-to-day work, while personally attending customer meetings during US hours to represent Data Services, answer questions in real time, and build trust with the customer directly.
  
  
This role works closely with a US-based Relationship Manager who coordinates with the India-based teams across multiple workstreams. The Data Migration Manager partners with this Relationship Manager on project status, customer sentiment, risk escalation, and resourcing, ensuring the two roles present a unified, well-coordinated front to the customer.
  
  
This role operates within a global, Follow the Sun delivery model. To attend customer meetings in US time and to keep migrations moving seamlessly across regions and time zones, this position requires willingness to work a night shift aligned with US business hours.
  
  
****What You'll Do****

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Data Migration Engineers, setting clear expectations, providing regular feedback, and supporting career growth
* Own team performance management, including workload planning, capacity and resourcing decisions, and day-to-day people management (attendance, conduct, goal-setting, and performance reviews)
* Attend customer meetings during US business hours, serving as the primary point of contact for customers — especially US-based clients — providing regular status updates and managing expectations
* Understand each assigned migration project end to end: what the customer expects, why they expect it, and what the team needs to do — technically and operationally — to meet those expectations, translating customer requirements into clear direction for the team
* Work closely with the US-based Relationship Manager who liaises with the India teams across multiple engagements, aligning on project status, customer sentiment, risks, and priorities so both roles speak with one voice to the customer
* Oversee assigned migration projects at a program level, tracking timelines, dependencies, and deliverables, and stepping in to unblock the team or escalate issues before they impact the customer
* Act as an escalation point for complex, sensitive, or at-risk migrations, working cross-functionally with Onboarding and Success Services, Development, Operations, Solution Services, and Support to resolve issues quickly
* Support and reinforce the global Follow the Sun delivery model, ensuring smooth handoffs, clear documentation, and continuity of work across regions and time zones, including during night shift hours
* Communicate project status, risks, and outcomes clearly to both technical team members and non-technical stakeholders, including customer contacts, the Relationship Manager, and internal leadership
* Champion standardized, repeatable processes and best practices across the team; identify opportunities to improve migration quality, speed, and the overall customer experience
* Partner with leadership on staffing, training, and tooling needs as Data Services processes and platforms (including cloud-based platforms such as BigQuery and emerging automation/AI-assisted tooling) continue to evolve
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen Data Services delivery capabilities, tooling, and customer outcomes

****What You'll Need to Succeed****

* Proven experience managing, leading, or mentoring a technical team, ideally within a services, IT, or software delivery environment
* Excellent communication skills — written and verbal — with demonstrated ability to build rapport and manage expectations with clients, especially customers based in the United States
* Ability to understand a project end to end — grasping customer requirements and business context well enough to translate them into clear technical and operational direction for the team
* Working knowledge of data migration, ETL, or database concepts (for example, data extraction, transformation, data quality, and SQL fundamentals) sufficient to guide a technical team and speak credibly with customers
* Comfort working closely with a Relationship Manager or similar counterpart, coordinating on status, risk, and customer sentiment so the customer experiences one consistent point of view
* Willingness and ability to work a night shift schedule, including attending customer meetings in US time, to support the global Follow the Sun delivery model
* Strong people management skills, including experience with performance feedback, coaching, conflict resolution, and team motivation
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and priorities while remaining calm, organized, and customer-focused under pressure
* Strong sense of ownership and accountability, balanced with the ability to align the team to shared standards, processes, and delivery goals
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related discipline

****Additionally, You May Have****

* Prior experience in a Data Migration, ETL, or data services delivery role before moving into management
* Experience managing distributed or global teams across multiple time zones
* Experience working alongside a client-facing Relationship Manager, Account Manager, or similar role on shared accounts
* Exposure to cloud data platforms (such as Google Cloud Platform / BigQuery) or automation and AI-assisted tooling used in migration delivery
* Experience using Jira, SharePoint, or similar tools to track team workload, manage projects, and report on delivery status
* Experience presenting to or managing relationships with enterprise or SaaS customers

and recognizes that you aren’t just an employee; you are a teammate, and you matter. We thrive on the benefits of our different experiences and celebrate the uniqueness our teammates bring to work with them every day.

PMP, PRINCE2 Practitioner or equivalent program/project management certification

description:

Selling Partner Support (SPS) safeguards customers, brands, selling partners, and Amazon against fraud, counterfeit, and abuse, while delivering world-class support and building loyalty with Amazon's Retail accounts. Within SPS, the Selling Partner Identity Verification (SPIV) organization focuses on understanding and verifying the identities of everyone we do business with — both vendors and sellers — and applying the right verification processes at every stage of their lifecycle. This includes detecting identity changes such as dormancy, reactivation, and ownership transfers, re-verifying as needed, mapping relationships between entities, and identifying partners who pose unacceptable risk.

This is a highly visible, cross-functional global role requiring close collaboration with international teams, senior stakeholders, and operational partners across Quality, Auditing, and Program Management.

You will lead the development of a goal commitment strategy for the Seller Experience Improvement team, build a quality project roadmap, and prepare strategic recommendations and program updates for senior leadership — all with a singular focus on the long-term direction of the SPIV organization.

Bring strong program management experience, with a proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and enable business teams to deliver measurable results.
  
  
Demonstrate excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a customer-focused, detail-driven, and professional approach.
  
  
Leverage data to identify and isolate issues, develop solutions, and prioritize opportunities — particularly in support of Finance.
  
  
Collaborate with stakeholders to design the right mechanisms for timely and effective program execution.
  
  
Operate independently and resourcefully, delivering results with minimal direction while maintaining a strong sense of urgency.
  
  
Excel at multi-tasking and problem-solving, including in high-pressure, fast-moving environments.
  
  
Build structure where none exists, with a track record of delivering in ambiguous, fast-paced settings.
  
  
Remain adaptable to shifting priorities while keeping selling partner quality as the north star.
  
  
Serve as a visible champion of Amazon's customer-centric culture, advocating for Finance's needs and using data and technology to anticipate and exceed them.

* 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience

* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

title: Research Manager, The Centre for Health Economics and Policy
description:
**About IIMB**

The Indian Institute of Management Bangalore (IIMB) is a leading graduate school of management in Asia. Under the
**IIM Act of 2017**
, IIMB is an Institute of National Importance.

The Centre for Health Economics and Policy, housed within IIMB’s Centre for Public Policy — is an interdisciplinary research centre that generates rigorous, policy-relevant evidence to strengthen health systems in India. Its work spans universal health coverage, primary health care, health financing and insurance, digital health, and health-system strengthening, combining academic rigour with practical translation for government, funders, industry, and civil society across research, capacity-building, and outreach.

**Industry / Service:**
Higher Education / Research

**Post / Job Title: Research Manager,**
The Centre for Health Economics and Policy

**Job Purpose**

Indian Institute of Management Bangalore invites applications for the position of Research Manager for The Centre for Health Economics and Policy.

The Research Manager will provide day-to-day operational and delivery leadership for the Centre’s research programmes and projects. Working under the guidance of the Centre’s leadership, the appointee will plan, coordinate, and execute projects end-to-end — managing timelines, deliverables, budgets, partners, and staff — and ensure that the Centre’s research translates into high-quality outputs and on-time commitments to funders and partners.

The role blends hands-on project management with research and stakeholder coordination in a fast-growing, multi-stakeholder centre. It suits a proactive, well-organised professional who can move fluidly between planning, execution, and delivery while maintaining quality and attention to detail.

**Job Type: Full-Time Consultant**

**Principal Accountabilities & Responsibilities**

**Programme & Project Management**

* Plan, coordinate, and deliver the Centre’s research programmes and projects on time, within scope, and to agreed quality standards.
* Develop and maintain workplans, timelines, milestones, and deliverable trackers, and proactively manage risks and dependencies.
* Coordinate day-to-day execution across faculty, research staff, partners, and administration, keeping all stakeholders aligned.

**Research & Knowledge Support**

* Support study design, literature reviews, data collection and management, and coordination of analysis across project teams.
* Assist in preparing research papers, policy briefs, industry reports, and other knowledge products, ensuring quality and timeliness.
* Maintain research documentation, datasets, and records in line with data-integrity and compliance standards.

**Grants & Financial Administration**

* Track project budgets and expenditure, and support timely, accurate donor and funder reporting.
* Assist in developing proposals, concept notes, and funding applications.
* Coordinate procurement, vendor engagement, and project-level administrative processes.

**Stakeholder Coordination & Events**

* Liaise with partners, government bodies, funders, and vendors on day-to-day project matters.
* Organise workshops, roundtables, webinars, and consultations, managing logistics, communications, and follow-up.

**Team & Operations Support**

* Coordinate and support research assistants and project staff, including onboarding and workflow management.
* Maintain operational systems, records, and reporting processes that keep projects running smoothly.

**Monitoring, Reporting & Communications**

* Maintain project trackers and monitoring data and prepare periodic progress and performance reports.
* Support dissemination and outreach, including digital content, to help the Centre’s work reach relevant audiences.

**Key Skill and Ability Requirements**

* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Strong project-management, organisational, and multitasking abilities, with the capacity to manage multiple deadlines.
* Attention to detail and a commitment to quality in research and reporting outputs.
* Comfort working with data, research documentation, and reporting tools.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a multidisciplinary team and coordinate across stakeholders.
* Familiarity with budgeting and grants administration (desirable).
* A mature, confident, and self-motivated attitude, with the ability to discuss issues constructively.
* Commitment to strengthening India’s health systems.

**Qualification and Personal Profile**

* **Education:**
  A postgraduate degree in Health Economics, Public Policy, Management, Statistics, Social Sciences, or a related field. A Ph.D. preferred.
* Minimum of 8-10 years of relevant experience in research or programme/project management, preferably in the health, public-policy, or development sectors.
* Proven track record of managing research projects and coordinating multi-stakeholder deliverables to deadline.
* Familiarity with India’s health systems and health-policy environment (desirable).
* Experience with grants administration, budgeting, and donor reporting (desirable).
* Strong organisational, coordination, and writing skills.

Credit Team decisions credit actions across the lifecycle of a customer – from acquisition to account management to collections and recover – we work towards managing credit and fraud losses and elevating customer experience through powerful and proprietary insights on customer risk and credit behaviors. * Work independently with minimum to moderate supervision

* Bachelor’s degree with 2 + years of experience, or in lieu of a degree 4 + years of relevant work experience

* Minimum 2 + years of experience with design, test and control environments working with large amounts of data
* Minimum 1+ years analytical and decision-making experience.

* 1 year of experience with FISERV/FD Rules/ Strategy Manager Development (batch mode)
* 1 year of Project Management Experience
* Ability to effectively prioritize and manage multiple projects concurrently with commitment to deadlines.
* Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate and present business results to management

* Bachelor’s degree with 2 + years of experience, or in lieu of a degree 4 + years of relevant work experience

title: Manager, Clinical Operations
description:
**About Parexel**
Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.
  
  
We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose. We move with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a Manager, Clinical Operations to join our team in Bengaluru in a onsite capacity. As a Manager, Clinical Operations, you will oversee a team and support clinical research activities that advance new treatments for patients. This position plays a key role in study execution, regulatory compliance, and the delivery of high-quality project deliverables on time. You will resource client projects with suitably developed professionals, develop and retain your team, and provide clinical consultation to project teams, working independently under the supervision of a Senior Manager, Associate Director, or Director. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, follow industry-standard processes, and contribute to study operations from planning through closeout.
  
  
Responsibilities include overseeing project delivery and team performance, with opportunities to deepen your expertise and influence study outcomes. Your leadership shapes how efficiently and effectively new therapies move from study planning to the patients who need them.
  
  
You will join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through project delivery excellence, talent development, and client partnership. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Manager, Clinical Operations can explore career paths and expand skills across clinical research.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Monitor performance through close interaction with project and functional leadership, ensuring project documentation and correspondence are accurate and complete, and serve as an ongoing liaison with project teams, sponsors, and management regarding the performance of direct reports.
* Manage and oversee team activities, including appropriate resourcing of staff, staff assignments, quality control, and the efficiency of project deliverables.
* Produce accurate resourcing plans with appropriate project team members, and monitor resource needs throughout the project.
* Develop action plans with management and project leadership to keep projects on time and within budget, and facilitate metrics collection.
* Recruit, retain, and develop a skilled, experienced, and motivated team through training, mentoring, and allocation of staff according to their ability.
* Conduct quality checks of deliverables and take appropriate remedial action to ensure departmental and project productivity and quality metrics are met.
* Provide technical support and clinical consultation to project teams, ensuring staff have the knowledge required to fulfill their duties.
* Support staff in improving their efficiency and effectiveness at prioritizing work, and participate in formal staff review processes, including performance and salary reviews.
* Serve as a senior-level contributor on project teams, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of your own deliverables and generating study-specific status reports for study teams, sponsors, and management.
* Maintain working knowledge of, and ensure compliance with, ICH Guidelines, Good Clinical Practice, regulatory agency requirements, and Parexel and sponsor SOPs.
* Where appropriate, contribute to project bids, client presentations, and business lead generation.

**Candidate Profile**
**You'll Thrive In This Role If You Bring**

* Strengths in managing and motivating direct reports, developing talent, and resourcing projects effectively
* Experience working in clinical research, healthcare, or a regulated environment
* The ability to collaborate across teams and communicate clearly
* A patient-focused mindset and strong attention to detail
* Comfort working with resourcing plans, project metrics, and quality control processes

**Required Qualifications**

* Educated to degree level, or an equivalent nursing qualification or relevant clinical or other equivalent experience
* Substantial monitoring or data management experience, or equivalent experience in clinical research, with a strong understanding of the clinical trials environment
* Knowledge of ICH-GCP, regulatory requirements, and clinical trial processes
* Experience with study documentation and quality control processes, including Central File documentation
* Competency in the local language and written English
* Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Degree in a biological science, pharmacy, or other health-related discipline
* Oral English competency

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.
  
  
If this job doesn't sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know of someone who'd be a perfect fit, send them the link to apply!

title: On-Site Installation Lead
description:
**About the role**

You will own how Wakefit Home Interiors gets installed in customers' homes: on time, right the first time, at a sustainable cost.

This is a 0 to 1 role. There is no inherited playbook to run. You will build the systems for on-site quality and timely execution, then lead a team of carpenters and work with external agencies to deliver against them.

Expect unknowns. The right person treats each new problem as a reason to build a repeatable, cost-effective solution rather than a one-time fix.

**Key responsibilities**

**Build the on-site quality system**

* Define installation quality standards and site checklists for each stage of installation.
* Create SOPs that carpenters can follow consistently, with minimal dependence on any one person.
* Set up snag capture, root-cause tracking and closure, so repeat issues are fixed at the source.
* Own the handover standard: what "complete" means before the customer signs off.

**Build the timely execution system**

* Plan and schedule installations so sites are ready, material is on site and crews are assigned before work starts.
* Track every installation against its committed timeline and flag delays early.
* Work with production and dispatch so what reaches the site matches what was designed.

**Lead the carpenter team**

* Hire, onboard and train carpenters on Wakefit standards and SOPs.
* Allocate crews across sites to balance quality, timelines and productivity.
* Build skill development and accountability into how the team works.

**Manage external stakeholders**

title: Lead - Digital Construction [T500-28816]
description:
**About Suffolk:**

Suffolk is a national enterprise that builds, innovates, and invests. We provide value across the entire project lifecycle through our core construction management services and complementary business lines in real estate investment, design, self-perform construction, and technology start-up investment through Suffolk Technologies.

With more than $10 billion in annual revenue and projects across healthcare, life sciences, higher education, mission critical, aviation, transportation, commercial, and other complex sectors, Suffolk is redefining how America builds through innovation, technology, and operational excellence.

**About Suffolk Global:**

Suffolk Global is a strategic extension of Suffolk Construction, established to unlock the full potential of a globally integrated delivery model. Based in Bangalore, India, Suffolk Global brings together world-class talent, advanced technology, and innovative processes to enhance how Suffolk designs, plans, and builds.

By partnering closely with teams across the United States, Suffolk Global will help drive quality, scalability, and innovation while creating new opportunities for technical professionals to contribute to some of the most complex construction projects in North America.

**About Digital Delivery:**

Suffolk is building the next generation of Digital Delivery capabilities to transform how buildings are designed, coordinated, and constructed. By combining Building Information Modeling (BIM), data-driven workflows, automation, and emerging technologies, our goal is to create a more connected, efficient, and predictable project delivery process.

As part of this vision, Suffolk Global is establishing a high-performing Digital Delivery team in Bangalore that will partner directly with project teams across the United States. Together, we will develop scalable modeling standards, improve coordination workflows, enhance quality through digital reviews, and create innovative solutions that support some of the most complex construction projects in North America.

This is an opportunity to help build a new capability from the ground up and play a leadership role in defining how Digital Delivery services are delivered globally.

**Lead - Digital Construction**

**Title:**
Digital Delivery Lead

**Location:**
Bangalore, India (Onsite)

**Role Summary;**

The Digital Delivery Lead is responsible for leading the day-to-day execution of Digital Delivery services across multiple projects and teams. This role provides technical oversight, resource coordination, quality management, and team leadership to ensure the successful delivery of BIM models, coordination services, constructability reviews, and digital project deliverables.

The Digital Delivery Lead serves as the primary connection between project teams, Digital Delivery leadership, and production staff, ensuring that work is delivered efficiently, consistently, and in alignment with Suffolk standards. This role is responsible for developing team capability, driving accountability, and establishing a culture of quality, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Delivery Leadership:**

* Lead execution of Digital Delivery services across multiple concurrent projects.
* Coordinate project assignments, priorities, and workloads across Digital Delivery Engineers and Senior Digital Delivery Engineers.
* Monitor project schedules, deliverables, and resource requirements to ensure successful execution.
* Identify delivery risks and proactively develop mitigation strategies.
* Serve as an escalation point for technical and project delivery challenges.

**Team Leadership & Development:**

* Provide day-to-day leadership, coaching, and mentoring for Digital Delivery team members.
* Support onboarding and development of new staff.
* Conduct regular reviews of work quality and performance.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Support career development planning and technical skill growth across the team.

**Quality & Standards Management:**

* Ensure compliance with Suffolk Digital Delivery standards, workflows, and governance processes.
* Oversee QA/QC reviews across assigned projects.
* Monitor model quality, coordination performance, and deliverable consistency.
* Drive adoption of standards, templates, content libraries, and best practices.
* Review lessons learned and implement corrective actions where needed.

**Technical Oversight:**

* Provide technical guidance related to BIM modeling, coordination, constructability analysis, and content development.
* Support resolution of complex technical issues and project challenges.
* Collaborate with Senior Digital Delivery Engineers to maintain standards and technical consistency.
* Ensure proper application of modeling workflows and coordination processes.

**Stakeholder Management:**

* Collaborate with U.S.-based project teams, Digital Delivery leadership, and project stakeholders.
* Support project planning and workload forecasting activities.
* Communicate project status, risks, resource needs, and delivery performance.
* Build strong working relationships across project and operational teams.

**Operational Excellence:**

* Monitor team utilization and workload balancing.
* Support staffing and resource planning activities.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, quality, and delivery performance.
* Drive implementation of process improvements and operational best practices.
* Contribute to the growth and scalability of Suffolk Global's Digital Delivery organization.

**Required Qualifications:**

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or related discipline.

**Experience:**

* 8–12 years of experience in BIM, Digital Delivery, VDC, architecture, engineering, or construction technology.
* Demonstrated experience leading BIM delivery teams or coordination teams on complex building projects.
* Experience managing multiple concurrent projects and competing priorities.

**Technical Skills:**

* Expert-level proficiency in Autodesk Revit.
* Strong experience with BIM coordination and clash detection workflows.
* Deep understanding of BIM standards, model governance, QA/QC processes, and digital delivery best practices.
* Experience with BIM content development, template management, and standards implementation.
* Strong understanding of architectural, structural, and MEP systems.

**Leadership Skills:**

* Proven ability to lead and develop technical teams.
* Strong organizational and planning skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* Strong decision-making and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to balance technical quality with delivery commitments.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with Navisworks Manage.
* Experience with Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) or BIM 360.
* Experience with point cloud and Scan-to-BIM workflows.
* Experience developing BIM standards and enterprise delivery processes.
* Experience supporting global or distributed project teams.

**Success Measures:**

**A successful Digital Delivery Lead will:**

* Deliver projects on schedule and in accordance with quality expectations.
* Maintain high levels of team productivity and utilization.
* Improve model quality, QA/QC performance, and coordination outcomes across projects.
* Successfully develop and mentor Digital Delivery team members.
* Ensure consistent adoption of Digital Delivery standards and workflows.
* Build strong partnerships with project teams and stakeholders.
* Contribute to the growth, scalability, and operational maturity of the Digital Delivery organization.

title: Field Excellence Program Manager
description:
**Job Summary**
The Field Excellence Program Manager is responsible for translating APAC and global sales strategies into measurable field execution across India. The role focuses on driving program adoption, behavior change, and business impact by enabling sales and technical teams with clear execution plans, operating rhythms, and actionable insights.
  
  
This role acts as a bridge between the field, APAC leadership, and global stakeholders, ensuring programs are localized, practical, and effectively implemented. Success is measured by conversion of strategy → execution → adoption → revenue outcomes.
  
  
Job Requirements
  
  
**Experience**

* 10+ years in Sales Program Management / Field Excellence / RevOps / Enablement / GTM roles
* Strong exposure to enterprise B2B sales environments
* Experience working with senior leaders in matrix organizations
* Proven track record of managing end-to-end program lifecycle (planning → adoption → impact)

**Core Skills & Capabilities**

* Strategic translation: Converts strategy into actionable execution
* Program management rigor: Strong in planning, tracking, risk management
* Commercial acumen: Understands pipeline, bookings, forecasting, margin
* Data-driven mindset: Uses dashboards and insights to drive action
* Stakeholder management: Influences without authority across levels
* Communication: Clear executive updates, field messaging, and documentation
* Change management: Drives adoption during transformation initiatives
* Preferred Skills
* Experience in enterprise technology (cloud, storage, SaaS, infrastructure)
* Familiarity with Salesforce, pipeline analytics, dashboards
* Exposure to MEDDICC, solution selling, partner-led growth
* Experience supporting leadership events and execution cadences in APAC
* Success Metrics
* Programs successfully land and scale in India with measurable adoption
* Sales teams demonstrate clear behavior change and execution discipline
* Dashboards provide actionable insights and early risk detection
* Strong field feedback loop improves program effectiveness
* India contributes scalable best practices across APAC

Job Responsibilities
  
  
Field Excellence & Sales Transformation Lead
  
  

* Establish and lead the Field Excellence organization to foster a high-performance sales culture, driving consistency, accountability, and operational excellence across the sales organization.
* Lead transformation initiatives aimed at enhancing sales effectiveness through strong leadership, coaching, and change management practices.
* Design, implement, and continuously optimize sales processes to improve execution across geographically distributed teams, leveraging performance measurement and stakeholder feedback.
* Partner with executive leadership to align on strategic priorities, key programs, roadmaps, and the execution of sales strategies and best practices.
* Collaborate closely with the Worldwide Chief Customer Office (WW CCO) and APAC leadership teams to drive successful program implementation and adoption.

Program Management & Execution
  
  

* Understand program objectives, target audiences, routes-to-market (RTM), and desired business outcomes.
* Develop and execute launch plans across Areas, Countries, Segments, and Districts based on program requirements and organizational priorities.
* Identify and engage key program stakeholders, including Sales, Marketing, Channel Partners, Presales, Sales Operations, Professional Services, Finance, Business Desk, Customer Success, and other cross-functional teams.
* Define success metrics, milestones, and key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure program effectiveness and business impact.
* Establish management system data points, including pipeline goals, booking targets, revenue metrics, and adoption indicators, to support execution and governance.
* Implement performance measurement frameworks to evaluate program outcomes, identify improvement opportunities, and drive increased sales success.

Governance & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Integrate program outcomes into existing sales management systems and encourage stakeholder-driven insights to improve effectiveness.
* Develop and maintain a structured feedback mechanism to assess program adoption, critical success factors, business impact, and areas requiring course correction.
* Provide regular updates and recommendations to the Global CCO team to support ongoing optimization and scalability of initiatives.
* Drive continuous program improvement by identifying enhancements to processes, tools, communication strategies, and execution frameworks.
* Enable agile decision-making by monitoring program performance and recommending adjustments when results differ from expected outcomes.
* Ensure alignment and coordination across multiple concurrent initiatives, including product launches, professional services programs, renewals, customer success initiatives, and learning services.

Cross-Functional Leadership
  
  

* Work collaboratively across all business functions to ensure programs are aligned with organizational goals, strategic priorities, and revenue objectives.
* Serve as a central point of coordination, governance, and support, ensuring consistent execution, communication, and stakeholder engagement across the organization.
* Promote best practices, operational rigor, and a culture of continuous improvement to maximize business impact and sales productivity.

description:
# Job Description: DGM – Concierge Delivery (PMO)
  
  

* Experience:\*\* 10–14 Years
* CTC:\*\* ₹25–30 LPA
* Notice Period:\*\* Up to 60 Days
* Shift Flexibility:\*\* Must be open to rotational shifts when required

##
**Role Overview**
We are looking for an experienced PMO leader to manage high-touch client onboarding, enterprise migration programs, and cross-functional project execution across IT infrastructure, cloud, and digital workspace environments.
  
  
The role requires strong program governance, executive-level stakeholder management, customer-centric delivery, and the ability to ensure smooth transitions, timely execution, and a seamless client experience throughout the migration lifecycle.
  
  
##
**Key Responsibilities**
\*\*1. Program & PMO Governance\*\*
  
  

* Lead PMO activities for global client onboarding and enterprise migration programs.
* Govern project plans, milestones, deliverables, dependencies, risks, and timelines.
* Ensure projects are delivered within agreed scope and timelines.
* Monitor program health and provide regular status updates to leadership.

\*\*2. Client Onboarding & Delivery\*\*
  
  

* Own the client onboarding experience during Day-0 and Day-1 delivery.
* Act as the primary point of coordination between client IT leadership, internal technical teams, and external partners.
* Ensure smooth transition, effective communication, and faster time-to-value for clients.
* Manage escalations and resolve delivery-related concerns proactively.

\*\*3. Stakeholder & Partner Management\*\*
  
  

* Coordinate cross-functional teams across India and North America.
* Align stakeholders, vendors, and technical teams on program objectives and deliverables.
* Communicate project progress, risks, mitigation plans, and key milestones to executive sponsors.
* Manage conflicts and stakeholder expectations effectively.

\*\*4. Process Standardization & Continuous Improvement\*\*
  
  

* Develop and maintain PMO frameworks, transition playbooks, and standardized delivery processes.
* Establish change management procedures and post-go-live handover workflows.
* Identify process gaps and implement improvements to enhance delivery efficiency and client satisfaction.

\*\*5. Risk, Issue & Dependency Management\*\*
  
  

* Identify project bottlenecks, vendor delays, resource constraints, and adoption challenges.
* Develop mitigation plans and drive timely resolution of critical issues.
* Ensure smooth coordination between project teams to minimize delivery risks.

##
**Must-Have Skills & Experience**

* 10–14 years of relevant experience in project/program management, PMO, or IT delivery.
* Proven experience in \*\*IT Infrastructure, Cloud, or Digital Workspace migration program delivery\*\*.
* Strong understanding of enterprise client onboarding and transition management.
* Experience managing cross-functional teams, vendors, project dependencies, and escalations.
* Excellent customer-facing communication and executive stakeholder management skills.
* Strong capabilities in program governance, risk management, issue resolution, and milestone tracking.
* Demonstrated organizational stability, preferably with 3+ years in an organization.
* Willingness to work rotational shifts when required.

**PMP, PRINCE2, or Agile/Scrum Master certification mandate.**

* Notice period of up to 60 days.

## Nice-to-Have Skills
  
  

* Exposure to VDI/EUC migration programs involving Citrix, Omnissa Horizon, or Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD).
* Experience coordinating global delivery teams across different geographies.
* Knowledge of IT service transition, change management, and post-go-live handover practices.

title: Manager - Software Engineering (Digital Commerce) - Salesforce
description:
Columbia Sportswear Company connects active people with their passions and is a global multi-brand leader in outdoor, active, and lifestyle products, including apparel, footwear, accessories, and equipment. Founded in 1938 in Portland, Oregon, the company's brands are sold in 122 countries. Alongside its flagship Columbia brand, the company owns Mountain Hardwear, SOREL, and prAna — together spanning hiking, trail running, snow sports, fishing, hunting, mountaineering, yoga, climbing, and everyday outdoor lifestyle apparel and footwear. With a strong global presence across wholesale, direct-to-consumer, and e-commerce channels, Columbia Sportswear Company India Sourcing Pvt Ltd plays a key role in supporting the organization's sourcing and supply chain operations worldwide.
  
  
**About The Position**
Although we're an apparel and footwear-focused company, technology is central to everything we do. Columbia Sportswear’s Digital Technology (CDT) group enables an IT infrastructure and applications across four global brands, a global supply chain, and 500+ geographically dispersed stores. These teams support in-store, mobile, and data platforms to enhance customer interface and service in an ever-evolving industry.
  
  
The Delivery Manager/Software Manager, Digital Commerce leads teams responsible for the design, development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and support of Enterprise Ecommerce and Customer service solutions. Ensures quality, security, privacy, reliability, availability, maintainability, performance, and integrations of solutions throughout. Oversees delivery across Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC), Salesforce Order Management System (OMS), and Salesforce Service Cloud platforms. Advances the teams' technical foundation to deliver modern, simple, and secure solutions while developing engineering talent and driving continuous improvement. Scope of delivery and sphere of influence spans multiple squads and cross-functional teams supporting digital commerce operations.
  
  
**How You’ll Make a Difference**

* Responsible for managing teams delivering the design, development, testing, deployment, maintenance, monitoring, and support of digital commerce platforms and applications.
* Ensures thoughtful application design, technical quality, and alignment with business objectives.
* Builds subject matter expertise across ecommerce, order management, and customer service platforms.
* Oversees and coordinates delivery across multiple teams. Partners with Product Owners, Solution Architects, and business stakeholders to establish priorities, refine backlogs, and ensure work is appropriately scoped and sequenced.
* Identifies dependencies, manages risks, and ensures alignment between technical delivery and business roadmaps.
* Balances new capabilities, operational support, technical debt, modernization, and platform stability.
* Leads agile delivery practices, including planning, backlog refinement, reviews, and retrospectives. Establishes delivery expectations, monitors team capacity and performance, and drives accountability for commitments.
* Actively seeks opportunities to improve team effectiveness, predictability, and collaboration.
* Partners with Solution Architects and technical leads to understand, define, and adopt enterprise architecture patterns and technology goals.
* Provides oversight of solutions across Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Salesforce OMS, and Service Cloud.
* Ensures integration patterns and technical decisions support scalable, reliable, and cost-effective business operations.
* Manages, mentors, and develops software engineers and technical team members. Provides coaching, performance feedback, career development, and support for individual growth.
* Builds team capabilities through hiring, resource planning, knowledge sharing, and opportunities for technical development.
* Establishes and manages quality standards across teams. Leverages automation where possible. Ensures application performance, uptime, and scale. Oversees testing, code quality, security, and release management practices. Drives resolution of complex defects, integration issues, and technical bottlenecks.
* Improves software development lifecycle processes and ensures operational documentation and support playbooks are maintained.
* Oversees the health, availability, and performance of production commerce platforms. Coordinates incident response, root cause analysis, and corrective actions.
* Ensures proactive monitoring and alerting mechanisms are in place to identify issues before they impact consumers, customer service operations, and business stakeholders.
* Collaborates with cross-functional teams to support end-to-end commerce workflows, including product and pricing integrations, cart and checkout, order orchestration, fulfillment, returns, refunds, and customer service processes. Ensures reliable integration and data flow between commerce platforms and downstream enterprise systems.
* Employs DevOps practices to advance the technical foundation of solutions.
* Drives improvements in CI/CD, deployment automation, operational readiness, and platform reliability.
* Stays current on ecommerce technology trends and Salesforce platform capabilities. Ensures solutions remain modern, simple, and secure.

**YOU HAVE**

* Bachelor’s degree, applicable certification or equivalent experience.
* Typically requires 8–12 years of professional experience, including experience leading software engineering or technical delivery teams.
* Strong experience with enterprise ecommerce platforms, preferably Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC).
* Strong understanding of order management systems (OMS), including order orchestration, fulfillment, inventory, returns, refunds, and order lifecycle management.
* Experience with Salesforce Order Management or comparable enterprise OMS platforms.
* Familiarity with Salesforce Service Cloud and customer service integrations preferred.
* Experience managing engineering teams responsible for enterprise applications and integrations.
* Strong understanding of ecommerce architecture, including storefront, checkout, payment, order management, and fulfillment workflows.
* Experience delivering complex, cross-functional technology initiatives involving multiple platforms and business stakeholders.
* Experience managing agile software development teams, including sprint planning, capacity management, backlog prioritization, and delivery forecasting.
* Experience in design and development of enterprise CI/CD processes and DevOps practices.
* Working knowledge of APIs, middleware, event-driven integrations, and enterprise system architecture.
* Experience with production support, incident management, root cause analysis, and operational monitoring.
* Experience establishing engineering quality standards, automated testing practices, and release management processes.
* Strong understanding of SDLC and change management.
* Experience managing technical resources, including hiring, performance management, coaching, and career development.
* Excellent project and time management skills.
* Ability to work and collaborate with cross-functional teams and manage partner expectations.
* Ability to influence without direct authority.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and oral.
* Ability to evaluate processes and drive continuous improvement.
* Ability to foster new ideas and concepts and make decisions surrounding complex issues.
* Strong understanding of retail and ecommerce business processes.
* Experience with Salesforce ecosystem technologies and enterprise integrations preferred.
* Experience working with distributed or offshore engineering teams preferred.

title: Senior Technical Program Manager- Data Center Infrastructure Delivery
description:
**Job Description**
This high-impact role puts you at the center of multi-million dollar construction initiatives, managing cutting-edge infrastructure delivery from concept to completion. You'll work with executive-level stakeholders, lead top-tier vendor relationships, and drive strategic projects that directly fuel Oracle's explosive growth-all with exceptional autonomy and visibility. If you're ready to shape the backbone of tomorrow's cloud technology while accelerating your career at one of tech's most influential companies, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact the development and implementation process of a specific company product.
  
  
**Team Overview**
The Data Center Infrastructure Delivery team at Oracle Cloud Infrastructure is a dynamic group of professionals dedicated to delivering state-of-the-art data center facilities at scale and at pace. This team comprises experienced project managers who work collaboratively with vendors and internal teams to ensure the successful execution of complex data center construction and network projects. They bring a wealth of expertise in project management, technical design, and on-site construction, ensuring that our data centers meet the highest standards of quality, efficiency, and sustainability. This team plays a crucial role in supporting Oracle Cloud Infrastructure's data needs and driving our growth and success.
  
  
**Job Summary**
Strategically, you will be responsible for developing and implementing comprehensive plans that optimize efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and operational excellence in delivery. You will engage with key stakeholders, manage high-stakes vendor relationships, and navigate the complexities of regulatory compliance. Your ability to anticipate and mitigate risks to datacenter delivery will be crucial in maintaining project timelines and budgets. This is a high- impact role that will lead, drive, and ensure the successful management and delivery of critical initiatives on our strategic roadmap.
  
  
The role comes with a high degree of personal accountability and autonomy and will require effective engagement across Design, Engineering and Operations. Your ability to anticipate and mitigate risks will be crucial in maintaining project timelines and budgets. The successful candidate will demonstrate the ability to own end-to-end delivery of network and data center capacity across concurrent builds.
  
  
This role will oversee data center focused projects and initiatives. Managing these construction projects well is key to the overall success of customer deliveries. You will engage directly with our Colo and LV partners' leadership and project management teams, driving accountability and improvements to meet our customers' needs. You will also engage with internal teams to make sure we deliver the proper design and process documentation to the Colo, execute on our ISP circuit contracts, and update all internal tracking tools for handover to our operations teams at the end of the project.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities Include:**

* Being the end-to-end TPM leader in charge of the program across multiple sites up to 1GW of capacity, coordinating with multiple principal TPM from shaping the approach, prioritizing the resources and achieving the desired outcomes through delivery.
* Project Planning: Develop and implement long-term strategies for data center construction and network build projects to align with organizational goals.
* Partner with the design team to ensure design and construction are fully coordinated in advance of contracting.
* Partner with Construction team to ensure collaboration and seem less handoff
* Project Management: Oversee all phases of complex data center construction projects, ensuring they are completed on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards.
* Tenant Fit Out and LV Integration: Work closely throughout design, construction, commissioning and LV fit out to fully coordinate and integrate the separate scopes of tenant fit out projects with the overall project scope.
* Vendor Management: Select, negotiate, and manage external vendors, contractors, and suppliers to ensure project success.
* Budget Oversight: Develop and manage project budgets, ensuring cost-effective use of resources and adherence to financial constraints.
* Risk Management: Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies to minimize impact on project timelines and costs.
* Stakeholder Communication: Maintain clear and effective communication with internal and external stakeholders, providing regular updates on project status and addressing any concerns.
* Quality Assurance: Implement and oversee quality control processes to ensure the highest standards of construction and operational efficiency.
* Regular project visits to ensure schedule, coordination, and quality will be required throughout the life of the project on an as needed basis.

**Required Skills**

* Project management experience in delivery mission critical Data Centre Construction, Cabling, Compute, Networking, AI infrastructure project.
* At least 5 years of Program/Portfolio management experience.
* PMP/ITIL v3 or equivalent certification
* Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities to address complex challenges in a fast-paced construction environment.
* Strategic Planning: Expertise in developing and implementing long-term strategies and establishing program-level requirements for construction projects.
* Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of data center design, construction, and operational requirements, with a focus on cutting-edge technologies and sustainability.
* Project Management: Proven expertise in managing large-scale data center construction projects from inception to completion, ensuring timely and within-budget delivery including advanced project scheduling and tracking.
* Leadership: Demonstrated ability to lead under pressure, mentor, and inspire a diverse team of project managers, engineers, and construction professionals.
* Budget Management: Proficiency in creating, managing, and optimizing project budgets to ensure cost-effective use of resources.
* Risk Management: Ability to identify potential risks and develop effective mitigation strategies to minimize impact on project timelines and costs.
* Vendor Management: Extensive experience in selecting, negotiating, and managing contracts with external vendors, contractors, and suppliers.

**Qualifications**
Career Level - IC3
  
  
**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

title: Senior Program Manager
description:
Job Title
  
  
Senior Program Manager
  
  
**Job Description**
**Senior Program Manager – Intelligent Systems & AI**
At Philips, our purpose is to improve people's health and well-being through meaningful innovation. Across enterprise imaging, radiology, cardiology and digital pathology, our healthcare informatics solutions help clinicians and health systems turn complex data into better-informed decisions. Doing that at scale takes more than great products: it takes exceptional technology, operations and execution behind them.
  
  
That is where Intelligent Systems & AI (IS&AI), within Philips Healthcare Informatics, comes in. We connect business priorities with platforms, data, automation and AI to improve how our business sells, delivers and supports customers. From commercial and service workflows to enterprise technology transformation, we work across teams and systems to remove friction, improve outcomes and create lasting value. We are looking for someone who wants to help build that future, not simply manage a plan.
  
  
The opportunity
  
  
You will lead high-impact, cross-functional technology programs from an ambiguous business problem to an implemented solution and measurable result. You will partner closely with business leaders, product managers, engineers, architects and technology partners. Expect to move between strategic choices and operational detail, influence technical trade-offs, unblock teams and help reshape how programs run in an AI-enabled organization. This is a hands-on leadership role, not a reporting-only PMO position.
  
  
Your Role
  
  

* Translate customer and business problems into clear goals, success measures, practical scope and decisions. Work backwards from customer experience, adoption, productivity, cost or revenue impact rather than treating delivery milestones as the finish line.
* Drive complex programs from discovery and prioritization through design, build, integration, launch, adoption and value realization. Make sequencing and capacity trade-offs, resolve blockers and take accountability when plans change.
* Work closely with engineering and architecture on systems, APIs, data flows, integrations and technical dependencies across CRM, CPQ, ERP, service platforms and other enterprise applications. Understand enough to ask the hard questions and challenge choices constructively.
* Align commercial and service business leaders, product teams, engineering, operations, vendors and system integrators around one coherent roadmap. Build accountability and make decisions without relying on formal authority.
* Establish fit-for-purpose operating mechanisms that show the real risks, dependencies, owners and decisions. Communicate trade-offs clearly to senior leaders and distinguish meaningful progress from status reporting.
* Use AI, automation and modern digital tools to reduce coordination overhead, detect issues earlier and improve decision quality. Experiment, learn and scale what works, with appropriate security, privacy and human accountability.

You may be a great fit if you
  
  

* Have 7+ years of experience leading complex enterprise software, digital transformation or technical programs spanning multiple teams, systems and business stakeholders.
* Bring experience from product-led technology, cloud/SaaS or enterprise-platform businesses, or from technology and digital transformation consulting where you owned delivery through implementation and adoption - not just strategy, governance or reporting.
* Hold a master's degree in engineering, computer science, information systems, business or a related discipline, or an MBA. Comparable exceptional experience in technical program leadership may also be considered.
* Think from first principles: you can break down an unclear problem, test assumptions, identify the real constraint and make sensible decisions with incomplete information.
* Have a track record of personally moving difficult programs forward and can explain the decisions you made, the trade-offs you navigated and the business or customer outcomes that resulted.
* Combine strategic judgment with hands-on execution. You are as comfortable framing a direction with executives as getting into the details with engineers or removing a delivery blocker.
* Bring practical technical fluency in enterprise systems, cloud or SaaS platforms, integrations and data; you can collaborate credibly with product and engineering without needing to be the person writing production code.
* Are an effective, concise communicator who earns trust across functions and cultures, surfaces uncomfortable facts early and makes complex decisions understandable.
* Are curious and comfortable using AI tools in your own work today, with a strong appetite to experiment and continuously improve how you and your team operate.

**How We Work Together**
We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week. Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities. Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.
  
  
#Healthcareinformatics
  
  
**About Philips**
Are you ready to do the work of your life to help the lives of others? Learn more about our business, discover our rich and exciting history and learn more about our purpose.
  
  
If you’re interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our culture of impact with care.

title: Principal Technical Program Manager
description:
**ABOUT QUINCE**
Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.
  
  
What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.
  
  
**OUR CULTURE**
Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.
  
  

* We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
* Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
* Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.
  
  
**THE ROLE**
As a Principal Technical Program Manager, you will own execution for large, cross-functional technical programs at Quince to help us scale and grow in existing geographies or launch new countries. You will work across product, engineering, business, and legal to align on scope, priorities, and dependencies. You will typically work with several engineering teams, product and business counterparts across the globe, and a commercial deadline.
  
  
This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will run several large, cross-functional programs at a time and be accountable for their delivery, on both timeline and impact.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Own end-to-end delivery, from scoping through launch and post-launch measurement.
* Work directly with engineering & product leads and architects on technical/business trade-offs.
* Drive alignment across US and India teams, including product and business leadership in Pacific time.
* Surface risks early and push for decisions when teams are stuck.
* Communicate status, risk, and asks to senior leadership in clear writing.
* Build the execution mechanisms this team needs as it scales.

**Qualifications**
**Required:**

* 10-14 years of experience, with the last several as a TPM on product programs that shipped to customers.
* A bias for ownership. You take charge of ambiguous problems without waiting to be assigned, and you hold your ground with senior stakeholders when you believe the call is wrong.
* A record of owning launches end to end.
* Technical depth. An engineering background, or experience shaping architecture and design decisions.
* Experience running programs across time zones with US or headquarters stakeholders.
* Strong written communication with senior stakeholders.

****Good to have**
:**

* E-commerce, D2C, or marketplace experience
* Exposure to global expansion, localization, or regulatory programs

**WHY QUINCE?**
Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.
  
  
**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY**
Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.
  
  
Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.
  
  
Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.
  
  
*Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds*
At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. title: Associate Manager, Product Planning and Adoption, EIP
description:
**Place of Posting -**
Bengaluru
  
  
**Team :**
Economic Inclusion Program
  
  
**About The/Nudge**
**The/Nudge**
is an action institute building resilient livelihoods to alleviate poverty. We work with women, farmers, tribals, and youth across rural development, agriculture, skilling, and economic inclusion, in partnership with 15+ central and state governments.
  
  
Our economic inclusion journey towards serving 25 million Indians spans 10 states and currently reaches over 1.5 million people. Through our incubator, accelerator, and grand challenges, we have supported 200+ social entrepreneurs, including Forbes 30 Under 30 honorees, Earthshot Prize winners, and nationally recognized changemakers.
  
  
Founded with the support of 130+ eminent philanthropists, 40+ corporates, and 15+ foundations, The/Nudge is working towards a poverty-free India, within our lifetime.
  
  
**What are we solving for?**
We are solving for households in poverty who are also financially and socially vulnerable through a targeted, multi-faceted, and sequenced model called the graduation approach, which has demonstrated that we can durably pull households out of poverty.
  
  
At The/Nudge Institute, We Have Been Piloting This Program For The Past 3 Years And Are Now Scaling It Across Multiple States. Our Purpose Is To Enable The Most Excluded Individuals To Become Contributing Members Of The Economy. We Will
  
  

* Enable government to adopt by providing research, design, and implementation support
* Continue to iterate on the program design to create impact at scale through our own implementations
* Support more NGOs in adopting graduation approach by offering technical expertise and capacity building
* Build evidence on graduation approach to nudge governments to adopt at-scale
* Develop technology solutions that enable NGOs and governments to adopt and implement the program at scale & with quality

**Position Overview**
**What are some of the principles/ approaches we use?**

* First principles thinking
* Human centered design (thoughtful, action oriented, experimental & iterative process) with a gender lens (unbiased and reflective approach)
* Systems thinking (analytical, stakeholder oriented and holistic)
* Strategic planning (result oriented, logical & coherent with clearly defined outcomes, grounded in current realities)

**What will you do?**
We are hiring an Associate Manager, Product Planning Feedback and Adoption to independently own planning, adoption and feedback workstreams across multiple state programs. The person will translate program priorities into measurable plans, ensure that product interventions and tools are used effectively, and build feedback loops that turn field experience into product and operating improvements.
  
  
This role combines hands-on program management with analytical and strategic ownership. The Associate Manager will work closely with State Operations, Product, Technology, Insights, Livelihood, Learning and Development, and program leadership. The role requires the ability to facilitate decisions, identify risks early and drive actions to closure with limited supervision.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Planning and program visibility

+ Strengthen governance. Design weekly, fortnightly and monthly review rhythms that result in clear decisions, owners and next steps.
+ Strengthen collaboration between State Operation teams and Central Product teams through a regular cadence.

* Adoption and data driven action

+ Own adoption across states. Lead the adoption of product interventions and tools from rollout through sustained and meaningful use.
+ Define meaningful metrics. Establish metric definitions, data sources, reporting frequency and data quality checks.
+ Interpret performance. Analyse trackers and dashboards, segment gaps by state, block, cohort or tool, and distinguish process, product and data issues.
+ Convert insights into action. Develop state-specific recommendations, align owners and timelines, and monitor whether interventions improve adoption.

* Feedback systems and product improvement

+ Design end to end feedback cycles. Define the milestone, respondents, sampling approach, questions, scoring logic and success measures.
+ Ensure reliable data collection. Coordinate with state teams, monitor response quality and resolve collection gaps without compromising timelines.
+ Synthesize field evidence. Combine quantitative and qualitative inputs into clear product and process recommendations prioritised by impact, urgency and feasibility.
+ Close the feedback loop. Track accepted actions with owners and timelines, communicate decisions to stakeholders and verify closure.

* Stakeholder leadership and communication

+ Anchor cross-functional forums. Set the agenda, prepare concise pre-reads, facilitate the discussion and keep reviews focused on decisions and actions.
+ Influence without authority. Build alignment across State Operations, Product, Technology, Insights and domain teams, and escalate dependencies with context and options.
+ Create leadership visibility. Prepare scorecards, reviews and written updates that explain progress, risks, underlying causes and specific asks.
+ Raise execution standards. Guide team members and partners on data discipline, meeting preparation, documentation and follow-through.

**What Success Looks Like**
Success in this role means that program plans and adoption metrics are trusted and used in reviews; risks are surfaced early with clear recovery plans; state and product teams receive recommendations that improve adoption; and field feedback leads to prioritised, tracked and communicated product or process improvements.
  
  
**Who are we looking for in this role?**

* Experience and education

+ Relevant experience. 6+ years in program management, product operations, strategy and operations, implementation consulting or large-scale operations.
+ Independent ownership. Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional, multi-location or multi-state workstreams from planning through closure.
+ Education. A postgraduate degree or MBA is preferred. Candidates with a bachelor's degree and strong relevant experience will also be considered.

* Core capabilities:

+ Analytical fluency. Can define and interpret metrics, question data quality, identify patterns and translate analysis into practical recommendations.
+ Structured problem solving. Can break down ambiguous problems, identify root causes, evaluate options and make sound recommendations.
+ Stakeholder management. Can build credibility, navigate differing priorities and influence senior and cross-functional stakeholders without formal authority.
+ Executive communication. Can facilitate effective meetings and communicate complex information clearly in written and verbal formats.
+ Execution discipline. Is organized, detail-oriented and proactive about follow-ups, risks and escalation while managing multiple priorities.
+ Tools. Is proficient in Excel or Google Sheets and comfortable working with dashboards and presentation tools.
+ Language and travel. Has strong written and spoken English and Hindi, and is willing to travel to and stay in rural program locations when required.

* Good to have:

+ Sector experience. Exposure to livelihoods, social impact programs, government systems or large-scale field implementation.
+ Product adoption. Experience driving adoption of digital tools or process interventions across distributed teams.
+ Research and feedback. Experience with survey design, qualitative research, feedback synthesis or user research.

*We aspire to be an inclusive and diverse organization and encourage qualified individuals irrespective of their religion, caste, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, or any other dimension of identity, to apply.*

Konovo is a global healthcare intelligence company on a mission to transform research through technology- enabling faster, better, connected insights.

With a workforce of over 300 employees across 5 countries: India, Bosnia and Herzegovina, the United Kingdom, Mexico, and the United States, we collaborate to support some of the most prominent names in healthcare. * **Build and lead a high-performing team.**

* **Create the delivery operating system.**
