title: Manager - Special Projects & Sustainability
description:
**Position Title**
- Manager – Special Projects & Sustainability

**Department:**
Business Development

**Reporting to:**
Director – Business Development

**Location:**
Corporate Office, with travel to manufacturing sites as required

**1. Role Purpose**

Identify, evaluate and execute strategic projects that deliver measurable business value through technology adoption, green energy, brewing-process optimisation, waste-to-wealth initiatives and resource efficiency.

The role combines technology scouting, data analytics, financial modelling and end-to-end project execution. The incumbent will be responsible for converting opportunities into commercially viable investments and ensuring delivery against approved business cases, frozen engineering designs, budgets, specifications and timelines.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Technology Scouting and Special Projects.**

* Maintain current knowledge of developments in renewable energy, industrial energy efficiency, waste recovery, circular economy and emerging technologies relevant to brewing and process manufacturing.
* Identify and evaluate opportunities in solar and other green energy solutions, heat recovery, energy optimisation, biogas, compressed biogas (CBG) and alternative fuels.
* Identify opportunities to convert brewing by-products and manufacturing waste—including spent grain, surplus yeast, effluent and other process residues, as applicable—into saleable products, energy or useful raw materials.
* Benchmark industry practices, assess technology providers and develop a prioritised pipeline of commercially attractive projects.

**B. Data Analytics and Business Case Development**

* Analyse plant operating data, energy consumption, production yields, waste streams, water usage and operating costs to identify improvement opportunities.
* Independently develop detailed, data-driven business cases and financial models covering capital expenditure, operating costs, revenue potential, savings, payback, NPV, IRR and sensitivity analysis.
* Compare alternative technologies and commercial models, validate assumptions and assess technical feasibility, investment risks and expected returns.
* Prepare evidence-based investment recommendations for management approval, supported by clear assumptions and quantified benefits.
* Use advanced Excel for financial modelling and data analysis. Proficiency in Power BI or equivalent dashboarding tools is desirable; familiarity with SQL, Python and AI-enabled analytical tools is an advantage.

**C. Project Execution and Commissioning**

* Take approved projects from detailed planning and engineering through procurement, installation, commissioning, performance testing and operational handover.
* Establish and maintain the approved design, scope, specifications, budget, quality standards and schedule as the execution baseline.
* Coordinate with engineering consultants, technology providers, contractors, plant teams and internal stakeholders to ensure timely and effective implementation.
* Enforce strict adherence to the frozen design and approved specifications. Any proposed deviation must undergo documented technical and commercial evaluation and formal approval before implementation.
* Monitor project progress, expenditure, risks, quality and milestones; promptly escalate deviations and implement corrective actions.
* Ensure commissioning, performance validation, documentation, training and handover, followed by verification of actual financial and operational benefits against the approved business case.

**D. Sustainability and Resource Efficiency**

* Develop projects to reduce energy consumption, conventional energy costs.
* Evaluate waste-to-energy, waste-to-wealth, water recovery.
* Quantify environmental and financial benefits against defined baselines and identify opportunities to replicate successful projects across manufacturing locations.
* Ensure proposed initiatives meet applicable regulatory, environmental, quality and safety requirements.

**E. Stakeholder Management**

* Work closely with Engineering, Plant Operations, Finance, Procurement and other relevant functions to validate proposals and deliver approved projects.
* Build relationships with technology providers, equipment manufacturers, consultants and potential commercial partners.
* Present investment proposals, project updates, risks and benefits realisation to the Director – Business Development and senior management.

3. Qualifications and Experience

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical, Energy, Environmental or another relevant engineering discipline.
* A postgraduate qualification in energy management, sustainability, project management or business management is desirable.

**Experience**

* Approximately 8–12 years of relevant experience in industrial project execution, engineering, energy management, process manufacturing or technology implementation.
* Demonstrated experience in delivering projects from feasibility through commissioning.
* Proven capability in financial modelling, investment evaluation and project cost and schedule control.
* Exposure to renewable energy, brewing or fermentation, bioenergy, CBG, waste management, resource recovery or industrial energy efficiency is desirable.

**Preferred industry background**

Brewing and distilleries, food and beverage, bioenergy and CBG, chemicals, cement, paper and pulp, renewable energy, industrial engineering or EPC project execution.

4. Critical Competencies

* Strong technical understanding of industrial processes, utilities, energy systems and resource efficiency.
* Advanced Excel proficiency and the ability to independently build comprehensive financial models and data-backed business cases.
* Strong quantitative, analytical and commercial decision-making skills.
* Hands-on project planning, execution, commissioning and performance validation experience.
* High discipline in engineering design freeze, scope control, change management, quality and cost control.
* Ability to challenge vendor assumptions and translate technical opportunities into measurable financial returns.

5. Key Performance Indicators

Performance will be measured against agreed annual targets:

1. **Value creation:**
   Verified cost savings and incremental revenue delivered.
2. **Project execution:**
   Projects commissioned within approved budgets and timelines.
3. **Design compliance:**
   Adherence to frozen designs and formal change-control procedures.
4. **Investment performance:**
   Actual returns against approved business cases.
5. **Resource efficiency:**
   Measurable improvements in energy, and identified oppurtunties
6. **Waste-to-wealth:**
   Commercial value realised from by-products and waste streams.
7. **Benefits realisation:**
   Achievement of agreed technical, financial and environmental outcomes after commissioning.

title: ESG Programme Implementation Lead
description:
**ESG Programme Implementation Lead - Education Sector**

**Location: Hybrid, Bangalore**

The ESG Programme Implementation Lead is responsible for turning ESG strategy and priorities into action. This is a hands-on delivery role for someone who takes ownership, creates momentum and ensures initiatives are effectively implemented across an international business.

The role requires strong project leadership, stakeholder management and problem-solving skills, with accountability for taking initiatives from planning through to implementation, adoption and measurable outcomes.

Success will be measured by what is implemented, adopted and achieved — not simply by the quality of project plans, trackers or reporting.

The post holder is expected to act with integrity, treat colleagues and stakeholders with care and respect, work collaboratively across teams and locations, use resources responsibly, and remain committed to continuous learning and improvement.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Implementation & Project Delivery**

* Lead the end-to-end implementation of key ESG initiatives, taking accountability for agreed outcomes, timelines and impact.
* Translate strategic priorities into practical delivery plans, taking ownership of the approach, defining actions, resources, and dependencies.
* Drive implementation across locations and external partners, removing barriers and resolving issues to maintain momentum.
* Identify risks, dependencies and emerging challenges, implementing mitigation actions and escalating decisions where required.
* Lead the onboarding of new entities into ESG framework, sustainability practices and energy reporting requirements, from initial engagement through to adoption and ongoing compliance.
* Monitor implementation effectiveness and identify opportunities to improve, standardise and scale ESG initiatives.

**Stakeholder Engagement & Capability Building**

* Develop and implement stakeholder engagement and communication approaches that support adoption of ESG initiatives.
* Build effective relationships with regional teams and senior stakeholders, influencing teams to secure commitment and deliver agreed actions.
* Lead the ESG Community of Practice and other knowledge-sharing forums to drive adoption, share learning and build implementation capability.
* Facilitate training, workshops and knowledge-sharing sessions to enable effective implementation of ESG processes, tools and best practice.
* Capture project outcomes, lessons learned and impact to support case studies, organisational learning and sustainability reporting.

**Strategic Project Support & Governance**

* Provide proactive strategic and operational support to the Group Head of ESG and wider sustainability team, translating priorities into action and maintaining momentum across key initiatives.
* Lead critical projects and ad hoc initiatives, bringing structure, pace and accountability to delivery.
* Prepare high-quality presentations, recommendations and materials for leadership teams, steering committees and other stakeholders.
* Support Board and shareholder reporting, GHG audits, assurance processes and other strategic ESG activities, ensuring information is accurate, timely and evidence-based.

**Project Management & Process Improvement**

* Establish appropriate project management approaches, tools and governance to provide visibility and accountability for delivery.
* Maintain project plans, dashboards and reporting that clearly track actions, owners, dependencies, risks, decisions and deadlines.
* Coordinate project meetings and working sessions, ensuring clear decisions, actions and follow-up.
* Develop and maintain practical process documentation, user guides and standard operating procedures to support consistent implementation.
* Identify and implement opportunities to simplify, improve and standardise processes across the organisation.
* Use data, stakeholder feedback and lessons learned to evaluate effectiveness and drive continuous improvement.

**Skills, Qualifications And Experience**

* **Project leadership:**
  Significant proven experience leading complex programmes across multiple sites or institutions, from scoping through to implementation and completion, with a strong track record of delivering outcomes.

* **Implementation & delivery:**
  Proven ability to translate strategy into action, manage risks and dependencies, solve problems and drive initiatives through to measurable results.

* **Stakeholder management:**
  Strong experience engaging and influencing stakeholders at different levels and across functions, cultures and geographies, including senior leadership.

* **Facilitation & Capacity Building:**
  Confident facilitator with experience designing and delivering training, workshops, and peer learning networks.

* **Strategic and operational thinking:**
  Able to understand the strategic objective while determining the practical actions, resources and decisions required to deliver it.

* **Problem solving & judgement:**
  Solutions-focused and comfortable navigating ambiguity, making sound decisions and taking action without requiring detailed direction.

* **Project governance & process improvement:**
  Experience establishing effective project management processes, monitoring delivery and implementing improvements to increase efficiency and impact.

* **Communication:**
  Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience producing clear reports, presentations and communications for senior stakeholders. ESG or sustainability reporting experience is desirable.

* **ESG / sustainability:**
  Experience in ESG, sustainability or a related field is desirable, particularly within a complex or multinational organisation.

* **Organisation & adaptability:**
  Highly organised and adaptable, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively within a small, agile team.

* **Sustainability mindset:**

description:

**Reports to**
GDS SMO Global Leader
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are currently seeking an experienced and dynamic
**Senior**
to support the delivery and governance of our multi-country payroll operate engagements. The role will support the engagement team utilizing one global methodology to track the end-to-end process and provide subsidiary governance throughout the client life-cycle to mitigate risk, increase corporate transparency, improve compliance, ensure leveraging of key data insights and provide clients will additional product offerings.
  
  
The role will reside within our Service Management Office (SMO). SMO is a centralized function responsible for overseeing and coordinating the delivery of payroll services across multiple-countries and servicing the client globally in line with the EY Payroll Operate practices.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Act as the SMO for multi-country clients and implementations.
* Support the engagement team with the global MCPO delivery of multiple clients and all client escalations.
* During the implementation phase, support the implementation and engagement teams to ensure the projects are delivered on time, within scope, and budget, and managed in a compliant manner.
* Support the smooth takeover of implemented projects into an operational delivery and manage the account governance on an ongoing basis in line with the client expectations and the Global Payroll Operate procedures.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including sales, operations, and technology, to ensure seamless integration and delivery of payroll services.
* Contribute to continuous improvement. Leverage Global Payroll Operate tools, technology, methodology and processes.
* Learn and help to transmit global methodology and best global payroll practices to all team members.
* Develop and maintain strong stakeholder relationships and support the engagement team with client-related communications.
* Support the preparation for regular client reviews and preparation of reports on progress, challenges, and solutions to stakeholders.
* Help to identify opportunities for process optimization and drive the implementation of innovative solutions to enhance service delivery.
* Coordinate annual rollover tasks, such as calendar preparation and EY tool updates.
* Work with the engagement team to address escalations, resolve issues, prepare root cause analysis, and communicate outcomes to account teams.
* Support the processing of scope changes and related contract adjustments, including change requests and documentation updates.
* Be involved in client-related change management efforts, including the adoption of new tools, processes, and system upgrades.
* Contribute to proactive management of risks and issues, ensuring effective mitigation and transparent communication for a seamless experience.
* Support the EP/EMs on client budget preparation, handle invoice management.
* Manage client and EY team access to engagement platforms.
* Provide ad-hoc support to clients and EY teams for service-related inquiries and tasks.

**Skills / Knowledge / Experience**

* Minimum 7 years of work experience
* Understanding of payroll processes
* Experience with payroll technology platforms
* Project Management experience and skills
* Problem solving skills
* Client service experience and skills
* Strong analytical skills, interpersonal, and written/verbal communication skills
* Problem-solving ability and attention to detail
* Excellent English language skills
* Flexibility to operate in a global across-time-zones environment

**About EY Payroll Operate**
EY Payroll Operate is part of the Global Compliance and Reporting (GCR) service offering of EY. Payroll Operate is on a transformational journey. The vision is for EY to become one of the top payroll outsourcing service providers globally.
  
  
For EY Payroll Operate to achieve its stated vision, the key to its success lies in adding a new, globally industrialized way of working, adopting a central delivery model through our Global Delivery Services (GDS) centers. title: Engineering Manager
description:

We are experts in end-to-end pharma engineering, and our success is built on our relationships, both with our colleagues and our customers. If you want to work on projects shaping the future of sustainable and intelligent pharma facilities, NNE is the place to be.
  
  
**Working along with CFT and With in PM area on Projects**
**Expected travel activity**
: 20 % time in a year
  
  
**Location: Bangalore, India**
**Geographical scope**
: Own country or deputation based on project requirements
  
  
The
**Engineering Management**
specialisation is responsible for leading and coordinating the design work in the project and implementing operational plan for project completion. **Main Tasks**

* Plan and take responsibility for design and follow process from design to handover. Responsible for interfaces and coordination between disciplines and for handling changes to scope of work. Responsible for consistency of work, cross-disciplinary quality/reviews and compliance with codes and regulations. Responsible for common picture of design between customer and NNE throughout project. Part of project management team

* Responsible for planning/execution and for coordinating/delegating tasks
* Expected to monitor project performance and identify and address project risks and issues proactively and recommend mitigation strategies.

**Education**

* BE/BTech in Engineering or similar
* Added advantage for the role if PMP certified etc.
* Fluent in English, spoken and written

* Understanding Process Equipment Interfaces with Centralized Services
* Having Experiences around know how on Clean Utility and Black utility and their interfaces
* Risk assessment in Engineering Systems and Tools Like PMD /PFD know-how is must have

**Proficiency**

* Masters and stays updated on project management tools and working methods
* Requires skill set in stakeholder management towards senior management level
* Proven communication & leadership skills

**Personal profile**

* Passionate about Pharma Engineering services
* Ability to maintain overview when challenged
* Result-oriented and focused on resolving problems to the benefit of all stakeholders
* Good communicator, coordinator and negotiator
* Structured with planning and controlling skills
* Team Builder

**Success criteria**

* Execution of major projects that meet customer expectations and Project success criteria as defined by PM and stakeholders on Projects
* Ensure relevant Project Engineering and that project is executed efficiently
* Ensure that opportunities to develop people and methods are integrated in project in dialogue with line managers
* Customer & employee satisfaction score on or above target
* Align with customers and running workshops based
* Building understanding on NNE Practices and other relevant systems

**Decision power**

* Able to execute independently on planning, coordination and prioritizing to meet
* Responsible for project-related decisions within framework approved by PM and stakeholders

* Drive innovation in project management working methods

Communication and coordination with customer’s staff and management, suppliers, contractors and authorities

title: Assistant Manager - ERP (Netsuite)
description:
**Role Overview:**
This role will bridge the gap between technology and business needs for a particular function, serving as the interface for managing IT application development, testing, deployment, and support to end-users. Enabling the alignment of ERP initiatives with business objectives.

***Key Responsibilities:***

**Business Delivery for a function:**

* Oversee all aspects of project management, including planning, organizing, implementing solutions, and reporting against plans weekly/monthly
* Working along with Senior Manager – ERP to ensure ERP changes required by the function are prioritised and delieverd
* Serve as the interface with assigned business units or functional areas to facilitate solution discovery, and manage service delivery, risk, and relationships.
* Partner with business leadership and stakeholders to define opportunities, prioritize IT projects/workstreams, and ensure alignment with functional needs.
* Provide consulting-level support and guidance through key IT initiatives, leveraging technology to build competitive advantage and enhance efficiency and effectiveness within the assigned function (Demand/Supply/S&OP/Finance)

**Process Excellence:**

* Conduct business needs analysis and collaborate on mapping technical specifications to develop and implement function need-based solution roadmaps, ensuring successful introductions across the organization and with customers for the function.
* Coordinate the development of robust contingency, risk management, and business continuity plans, overseeing existing solution/platform utilization, impact, benefit, and resolution of day-to-day operational issues
* Drive continuous improvement in IT operations, security, and system performance by proposing, negotiating, and managing IT budgets in accordance with internal procedures to ensure best value and quality

**Technology Expertise:**

* Understand functionality, oversee configuration, implementation and maintain expertise on specific technologies supporting processes.
* Demonstrate capability to integrate multiple technologies to build business solutions
* Partner with architecture and operations teams to ensure solution compatibility with company standards
* Collaborate with end-users and tech partners to map and deliver a wide range of reporting formats and automated upload tools
* Conduct awareness-building programs for new hires, employees to facilitate knowledge enhancement and improved functional effectiveness towards ongoing and new tools and applications.

**Relationship Management:**

* Act as the primary liaison for the assigned function to other functional areas, including business units, IT, and external vendors, ensuring effective project delivery to realize business benefits and efficient IT support for ongoing business processes
* Facilitate regular meetings and consultations with stakeholders to gather feedback, address concerns, and drive consensus on project priorities and requirements
* Serve as a trusted advisor to business units, IT teams, and customers, providing guidance and support for their needs, anticipating potential issues or conflicts and implementing strategies to mitigate risks and maintain positive relationship

**Desired Profile:**

* Demonstrated exposure to established ERP/CRM systems, preferably with experience in leading or participating in ERP implementations
* Solid understanding of ERP concepts and their benefits to businesses
* Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in working with the teams involved in strategic planning, business development, or client management across diverse business units
* Proficient in handling a large user base, ranging from approximately 50 to 300 users
* Technical proficiency coupled with analytical orientation to effectively address complex business challenges
* Ability to effectively manage project delivery through partners and prioritize projects in alignment with senior stakeholders to deliver business value
* Strong business acumen enabling the identification of relevant solutions and the ability to introduce new technologies
* Capability to inspire confidence among business users and maintain positive relationships with internal and external stakeholders
* Proven strategic thinking and planning skills, coupled with a track record of operational execution excellence

***Why Ample:***

**We value our team members, and you can look forward to**

* Humane work environment with strong focus on people well - being
* Work Culture that is growth oriented and fun
* Continuous learning - on the job as well as through programs, and mentoring
* Compensation in line with the best in the industry

**Ample is a 29 years old organisation. What does it mean for you?**

* We are a stable organisation with over 29 years of experience in SI / IT - in an environment where companies rarely cross 10
* We have built trusting relationships - with team members, customers and partners, several of them for over a decade, and many over two decades.
* We have navigated diverse challenges, disruptions and have navigated them all, and emerged triumphant.

**The foundation for future growth is on the following foundations**

* Globally revered brands in partnerships with Ample - in the enterprise and retail industry
* You would be representing a brand that the market has revered and valued over two decades
* We aspire to grow at a trailblazing pace over the next 5 years, and reach USD 1 Billion. This will need leaders who can take the mantle of responsibility towards this opportunity.
* Our current enterprise base of 1500 customers is spread across the country and will become the core of our growth engine

**We live our vision and values**

* Our customers and team members experience this every day, making it a place to be for anyone engaging with us
* We have an open culture where people are expected to focus on what-is-right instead of who-is-right. Feedback, suggestions and comments are encouraged, and acted upon. Anyone can speak to anyone in the organisation.

title: Sr Manager, Business strategy & PMO
description:
Walmart Marketplace is a rapidly growing e-commerce platform that empowers businesses of all sizes to reach millions of customers. We are looking for an experienced and highly motivated Senior Manager - Business Strategy and PMO to join our dynamic team. In this critical role, you will shape strategic priorities, establish a rigorous operating cadence, and drive cross-functional execution of high-impact initiatives for the India Cross Border Trade business.

**About the Team**

The Walmart India Cross Border team provides an opportunity for Indian brands, manufacturers, MSMEs, and other potential sellers to sell their products across global Walmart online marketplaces, helping them expand internationally as cross-border sellers on Walmart Marketplace.

**About the Role:**

As the Senior Manager - Business Strategy and PMO, you will partner with business leaders and cross-functional teams to translate strategic priorities into clear plans, measurable outcomes, and disciplined execution. You will lead annual and long-range planning, portfolio governance, business reviews, and executive reporting while proactively identifying risks, dependencies, and opportunities. This role requires strategic thinking, strong program leadership, analytical depth, executive communication, and the ability to influence across a fast-paced, matrixed organization.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop and drive the business strategy, annual operating plan, and long-range priorities for the India Cross Border Trade organization.
* Identify key opportunities for business growth; develop and execute plans to leverage these opportunities.
* Drive internal productivity and operational efficiency improvement projects.
* Translate strategic objectives into clear workstreams, milestones, owners, success metrics, and governance mechanisms.
* Lead the PMO for high-impact, cross-functional programs from definition through execution, ensuring alignment on scope, timelines, dependencies, and outcomes.
* Establish and manage operating cadences, including weekly program reviews, monthly business reviews, quarterly business reviews, and leadership updates.
* Create executive-ready narratives, dashboards, and decision documents that communicate progress, insights, risks, and recommendations clearly.
* Partner with Business Development, Category Management, Account Management, Operations, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Finance, Legal, and Compliance teams to drive coordinated execution.
* Identify business performance trends, root causes, and growth opportunities through structured analysis and translate insights into actionable plans.
* Define and track key performance indicators, program health metrics, and benefits realization across the strategic portfolio.
* Proactively surface risks, interdependencies, and resource constraints, and drive mitigation and escalation with the appropriate stakeholders.
* Improve planning and execution mechanisms by standardizing processes, templates, governance, and decision-making frameworks.
* Lead strategic problem-solving on ambiguous business questions, evaluate options, and develop recommendations for senior leadership.
* Ensure accountability and follow-through across workstreams while enabling teams to move quickly and make informed decisions.
* Support organizational goal setting, resource prioritization, and change management for new initiatives and operating model improvements.
* Build strong stakeholder relationships and influence outcomes without direct authority across a complex, matrixed environment.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master's degree (MBA) or equivalent advanced degree.
* 8+ years of experience in business strategy, program management, management consulting, business operations, e-commerce, or a related field.
* Proven track record of leading complex, cross-functional programs and converting strategic priorities into measurable business outcomes.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data and develop structured, actionable recommendations.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience creating executive-level narratives and presentations.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, manage competing priorities, and drive accountability in a matrixed organization.
* Experience establishing PMO governance, business review cadences, KPI frameworks, and portfolio-level reporting.
* Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, ambiguous, and rapidly changing environment.

**Why Walmart?**

At Walmart, we believe in providing opportunities for our associates to grow and succeed. You will be part of the India Cross Border Trade team that is transforming the retail landscape and helping businesses expand internationally. Join our team and help shape strategy, strengthen execution, and deliver sustainable growth for Walmart Marketplace.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

Walmart, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer By Choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions while being welcoming of all people.

Walmart doesn’t charge any recruitment or similar fee in the recruitment process, including but not limited to interview, offering, and onboarding.

title: Manager - Process Excellence
description:
**About:**

River is a design company building personal transportation for livelihood.

We focus on creating multi-utility products for those independently carving their own path. We’re building from the ground up, bringing together design, engineering and technology to solve real, everyday problems. Our signature two-wheeler, Indie – The SUV of Scooters, is built to be a dependable companion for getting things done.

Today, we’re 1,500+ people strong, headquartered in Bengaluru, and have raised our Series C.

River is backed by leading global automotive OEMs, international tech investors, and top institutional asset managers, including Yamaha Motor, Al-Futtaim Automotive Group, Toyota Ventures, Mitsui & Co., Marubeni Ventures, Lowercarbon Capital, Maniv Mobility, Elev8 Venture Partners, Claypond Capital, Trucks Venture Capital, 360 ONE Asset, HDFC AMC, Singularity AMC, Anicut Capital, and JIF Capital.

**Key Responsibilities:**

- Ensure comprehensive documentation of processes, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and best practices to maintain consistency and compliance.
- Lead change management efforts to ensure successful adoption of new processes and practices, minimizing resistance and maximizing engagement.
- Manage and execute Transformation projects independently for internal stakeholders across the Value Stream . Lead the creation of current and future state value stream maps to identify inefficiencies and opportunities for improvement.
- Identify opportunities for automation and digital tools to enhance process efficiency and effectiveness.
- Responsible for spearheading initiatives to enhance value streams by integrating process excellence methodologies with digital technologies
- Identify opportunities for operational efficiency, Implement lean methodologies and create processes and procedures across Value Streams.
- Apply Lean, Six Sigma, and other process improvement methodologies to streamline operations, reduce cycle times, and eliminate non-value-added activities.
- Develop a structured qualification program encompassing various levels (e.g., Green Belt, Black Belt) to standardize process excellence competencies across the organization.
- Work closely with stakeholders across departments to design and implement process changes that align with organizational goals.
- Lead process audit efforts for identified value streams for compliance on defined processes.
- Deep understanding of DMAIC frameworks, waste elimination (Muda, Mura, Muri), cycle-time reduction, and root-cause analysis.
- Understanding of structured audit execution, compliance monitoring, and root cause analysis (5-Why, Fishbone, FMEA, A3 problem solving.)
- Strong coordination and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence without formal authority

**Ideal Candidate:**

- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Operations, or a related discipline
- 8+ years experience within commercial functions across industries like Automotive, CPG, FMCG, High-Tech is mandatory for this role.
- Certifications as a Lean Practitioner/ Six Sigma Green Belt, or Certified ISO Internal Auditor will be an added advantage
- Advanced proficiency in creating & analyzing workflow design, mapping current vs. future states process, and identifying bottlenecks, waste, and friction points.
- Ability to design, document, and enforce Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and best practices to ensure compliance and quality control.
- Familiarity or hands-on experience in commercial functions like Sales, Marketing, Service, Dealer Development, Customer Service, Customer Experience is highly desirable.
- 100% on-schedule completion of process mapping/ VSM workflow and deployment for the identified value streams.
- Timely completion of assigned process audits along with management report-out of findings.
- Minimizing recurring value stream process gaps and operational bottlenecks via improvements

title: PROGRAMMING MANAGER
description:
Business Introduction At GSK, we have bold ambitions for patients, aiming to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade. Our R&D focuses on discovering and delivering vaccines and medicines, combining our understanding of the immune system with cutting-edge technology to transform people’s lives. GSK fosters a culture ambitious for patients, accountable for impact, and committed to doing the right thing, making sure that we focus our efforts on accelerating significant assets that meet patients’ needs and have the highest probability of success. We’re uniting science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease together.
  
  
Find out more:
  
  
Our approach to R&D Position Summary You will lead clinical programming for multiple studies, ensuring high-quality, regulatory-ready data and reports. You will work closely with statisticians, data managers, clinical colleagues, and external partners. We value clear communication, practical problem solving, and a coaching mindset. This role offers significant growth, the chance to mentor others, and a meaningful impact aligned with GSK’s mission to unite science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease together. Join us to build your career where your work truly matters. Responsibilities This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following: - Plan, manage, and deliver programming outputs such as datasets, tables, listings, and figures across multiple studies. - Provide technical leadership and oversight for outsourced programming and external vendors. - Define, implement, and maintain programming standards, templates, and processes to ensure quality and regulatory readiness. - Review and contribute to study documents including analysis plans, output specifications, and submission materials. - Identify risks early, propose practical solutions, and escalate issues to keep projects on track. - Coach and mentor programming team members to build skills and support professional growth. Why You? Work model: Hybrid. Combine on-site collaboration in India with flexible remote working. Basic Qualification We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals: - Bachelor’s degree in computer science, statistics, mathematics, life sciences, or a related field. - Minimum 5 years of clinical or statistical programming experience supporting clinical trials. - Strong skills in SAS programming, including macro development and writing reusable code. - Practical understanding of clinical data standards, such as SDTM and ADaM, and clinical data flows. - Experience managing programming deliverables and providing oversight to vendors or contract research organizations. - Clear written and verbal communication skills for both technical and non-technical audiences. Preferred Qualification If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus: - Master’s degree in statistics, data science, computer science, or a related field. - Experience with R, Python, or other scripting languages for analysis and automation. - Familiarity with regulatory submission processes and define.xml generation. - Experience working with Agile methods and tools such as Jira. - Demonstrated leadership in study teams and effective cross-functional collaboration. - Proven track record of mentoring team members and improving programming processes. What we value You are collaborative and inclusive. You focus on delivering results while balancing priorities. You make evidence-based decisions and keep teams informed. You enjoy developing others and are always looking for ways to improve how we work together. Ready to apply? If this role fits your skills and ambitions, we encourage you to apply. We look forward to seeing how you will grow with us and help get ahead of disease together.
  
  
**Skills**
Agile Leadership, Agile Methodology, Clinical Development, Data Engineering, Data Science, Influencing Without Authority, Learning Agility, Problem Solving, Statistical Programming
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
  
  
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.
  
  
**Inclusion at GSK:**

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

We have built working relationships which span decades with many of the world’s largest energy and commodity companies. We believe that this is because we put our people first and are passionate about providing our clients with deep technical and industry insights that deliver pragmatic solutions. As we continue to grow domestically and internationally, we become more diverse. This rich diversity fuels our business and enriches our culture

 

**About the role**

 

We are currently growing our ETRM/CTRM Endur practice and are looking for experienced Endur Consultants with expertise in Commodity or Energy markets and Trading and Risk Management System Implementations. You will be part of the team involved in implementation/upgrade/support of Endur, bringing SME knowledge in deal modelling, deal valuations, risk management, scheduling, invoicing, and accounting for commodities and energy. You will ensure successful project delivery, employing consultancy and best practices. 

 

**Key Responsibilities:**

 

* Collaborate with clients and prospects to determine business requirements and processes to be addressed by key areas of the Endur solution, with the ability to identify improvement potential and drive change management.
* Work as part of a team on the functional implementation, encompassing design, configuration, functional testing and support transition to operations of Endur solution.

* Document business requirements, implementation designs, test plans/results, and other deliverables required by the project.
* Follow best practices, documentation standards, and resolution process flow for all deliverables.
* Collaborate with technical teams to create customisations based on specific client needs
* Provide industry and functional advisory as needed.
* Apply appropriate resourcing techniques given project-specific needs, risks, and differences in core project team member skill levels and relevant modules to be delivered in client projects.
* Maintain highly effective communication with client and internal stakeholders and adept in handling business changes and managing stakeholder expectations.
* Provide guidance and training on Endur functionality and general ETRM/CTRM topics.

**Skills**

 

* Endur Modules: Good working knowledge in key modules of Endur and commodity/energy operations with working knowledge of V19 and above.
* Endur Risk Management: Knowledge of Endur risk and valuation functionality including results (MTM, PnL, VAR), and EOD automation (TPM and Services Manager).
* Endur Customisation: Deep knowledge of standard and customisation approaches for implementation of requirements, support for reporting, building complex desktops, APM pages, and pre/post-processing logic.
* Endur Architecture: Understanding of Endur architecture and best implementation practices to optimize its strengths for the client solution.
* Functional Knowledge: Strong functional knowledge and understanding of Gas, Power, Renewables, LNG or Crude and Refined Products.
* Excellent interpersonal skills and stakeholder management.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Multi-tasking and Project Management skills.
* Strong organisational & analytical skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, detailed oriented environment and work independently or in a team.

 

**Required Experience**

 

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Engineering, Economics, or equivalent experience in a related field
* 4+ years hands-on with Endur as a consultant, business analyst, functional specialist, QA specialist or IT support specialist with working knowledge of V19 and above.
* At least 4+ years of industry work experience.
* Good working understanding of various functional areas and relevant modules of Endur.
* Experience in conducting comprehensive testing and quality assurance activities to validate the functionality, performance, and reliability of Endur solutions.
* Worked as part of a cross-cultural/geographical team including flexibility to support multiple time zones when necessary.
* Worked as part of a project team structure and delivered results with limited guidance.
* Ability to travel to onsite client locations for limited time as per project requirement.

**Preferred Experience**

 

* Subject matter expert or functional consultant in Commodity Trading, Risk or Logistics business areas in large enterprise environments.
* Worked in Front, Middle or Back Office functions with specialty in any of the following: Trading (Derivatives, Physical), Risk (Market, Credit, Operational, Compliance), Logistics (Pipeline, Vessel, Nomination) or Settlements (AR/AP Process, Invoice Management).
* Experience with Endur gMotion or cMotion modules would be advantageous.

**What to expect as a capSpire consultant**

 

As part of a capSpire team, you’ll experience the full project life-cycle and be part of a dynamic team in which diversity, camaraderie and professional excellence are celebrated. We like to have fun as a team, encourage knowledge sharing and continuous learning and take pride in delivering the best possible outcomes for our clients. 

 

If you think you have the necessary skills and experience to excel as a capSpire Consultant we are keen to speak with you.

title: Post Production Manager
description:
**👩 💻 The role**

As
**Post-Production Manager**
, you'll lead video editing at Headout, building the team, systems, and creative standards that make great travel content possible at scale.

We create long-form and short-form videos that help millions of people make better travel decisions. From explaining the London Underground to breaking down museum tickets or navigating an unfamiliar city, our videos turn complicated information into something simple, useful, and engaging.

You'll own creative quality, editorial standards, timelines, and the post-production pipeline while building workflows that help the team deliver excellent videos consistently. You'll partner with producers and writers to improve storytelling and formats, use YouTube performance data to make better creative decisions, and develop editors who can work independently.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll continue editing and independently own a smaller slate of videos alongside your management responsibilities, with lower individual output targets than the editors you manage.

**🤩 What makes this role special?**

* **Set the Editorial Standard:**
  You'll define what great looks like across storytelling, pacing, motion graphics, visual clarity, and audience retention. Your goal is to make informational travel content genuinely engaging without relying on unnecessary effects or visual complexity.
* **Build a Scalable Post-Production System:**
  You'll own the pipeline from asset handover and first cuts to feedback, quality checks, and final delivery. You'll build workflows, templates, and reusable visual systems that help the team produce better videos, faster.
* **Stay Hands-On with the Craft:**
  You'll continue editing videos yourself, experimenting with formats, and making creative decisions. You'll balance your own editing responsibilities with leading the team and maintaining quality across projects.
* **Build a Team of Independent Editors:**
  You'll lead editors working across long-form and short-form content, owning creative quality, timelines, feedback, and delivery. You'll mentor them, strengthen their editorial judgement, and build a culture of ownership and constructive feedback.
* **Shape Stories That People Want to Watch:**
  You'll work closely with producers and writers to improve formats, identify storytelling opportunities, and solve creative challenges. You'll turn information people are actively searching for into content they find useful and enjoyable.
* **Use Data to Make Better Creative Decisions:**
  You'll use YouTube metrics, including click-through rate (CTR), audience retention, and average view duration, to understand what's working and improve future edits. Data will inform your creative judgement, not replace it.
* **Make Creative Work More Efficient:**
  You'll experiment with new tools, including AI, to eliminate repetitive tasks and give editors more time to focus on creative decisions. You'll build systems that reduce firefighting, improve consistency, and make every project easier to execute than the last.

**💝 What skills & experience do you need?**

* **4–6 years of experience**
  in video editing and post-production, with experience leading editors or managing multiple projects.
* **Strong editing skills:**
  A portfolio demonstrating excellent storytelling, pacing, motion graphics, visual clarity, and editorial judgement. A portfolio is a must.
* **Team leadership:**
  Experience leading editors, managing feedback and timelines, maintaining creative quality, and developing team members.
* **Strong storytelling instincts:**
  Ability to make informational content engaging and easy to understand without relying on unnecessary effects or visual complexity.
* **Workflow management:**
  Ability to manage multiple deadlines, streamline post-production processes, and build reusable templates and systems that improve speed and consistency.
* **Understanding of YouTube:**
  Familiarity with how editing decisions influence click-through rate (CTR), audience retention, and average view duration.
* **Technical expertise:**
  Strong knowledge of editing software, motion graphics, asset management, and collaborative workflows.
* **Feedback and mentorship:**
  Ability to give clear, actionable feedback that strengthens editorial judgement and helps editors become more independent.
* **Hands-on ownership:**
  Willingness to continue editing videos while managing and developing a team.
* **A systems-first mindset:**
  Someone who simplifies workflows, balances quality with speed, uses data to inform creative decisions, and looks for ways to make every project more efficient than the last.

This is not a "PowerPoint PMO" role. We are looking for a builder—someone who can roll up their sleeves, prototype with GenAI tools, facilitate process redesign workshops, run agile delivery, and personally drive change alongside business and technology stakeholders.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Program Strategy & PMO Leadership
* Establish and run the AI Efficiencies & Workflow Redesign PMO as a cross-BU center of excellence.
* Build the enterprise opportunity pipeline of AI/GenAI use cases; prioritize based on value, feasibility, and risk.
* Define program governance, KPIs (productivity gains, FTE re-deployment, $ savings, NPS, cycle time), and a value-tracking framework with Finance.
* Maintain an executive-level program dashboard and report progress to the C-suite and steering committees.
* Hands-on Program & Delivery Management
* Personally drive end-to-end delivery of multiple concurrent AI/workflow initiatives across BUs.
* Run discovery, design, pilot, scale, and adoption phases using agile/lean methods.
* Manage cross-functional pods comprising business SMEs, data scientists, AI engineers, designers, and change managers.
* Own risks, dependencies, budgets, vendor management, and stakeholder communication.
* Workflow Redesign & Process Re-engineering
* Lead "as-is to to-be" workflow mapping using Lean, Six Sigma, and design-thinking techniques.
* Identify automation, augmentation, and elimination opportunities; redesign processes to be "AI-native."
* Partner with BU heads to redefine operating models, roles, and SOPs post-AI deployment.
* GenAI Tooling, Experimentation & Solutioning
* Stay deeply hands-on with leading GenAI tools and platforms (e.g., ChatGPT/Enterprise, Microsoft Copilot, Google Gemini, Claude, GitHub Copilot, LangChain, LlamaIndex, vector databases, agentic frameworks, RAG architectures, low-code/no-code AI builders).
* Personally prototype, demo, and pilot GenAI solutions—prompt engineering, custom GPTs/agents, workflow bots—before scaling.
* Evaluate build vs. buy decisions; partner with AI/IT teams to operationalize solutions responsibly.
* Maintain a working knowledge of model capabilities, limitations, cost, and Responsible AI considerations.
* Change Management & Adoption
* Drive end-user adoption through training, communications, and "AI champions" networks across BUs.
* Co-create change management plans with HR and BU leadership; address concerns related to role evolution and reskilling.
* Build internal capability through playbooks, reusable assets, and knowledge repositories.
* Governance, Risk & Responsible AI
* Ensure all initiatives comply with data privacy, security, IP, and Responsible AI policies.
* Partner with Legal, Risk, InfoSec, and Compliance to maintain guardrails for GenAI usage.
* Establish review checkpoints for model risk, bias, and ethical implications.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* 15+ years of total experience, with a strong foundation in program/project management, business transformation, and operations.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or related field; MBA or equivalent preferred.
* Minimum 1–3 years of hands-on experience working with GenAI/AI tools in an enterprise setting—either delivering AI products, leading AI transformation programs, or running AI-led process redesign.
* Proven track record of leading large-scale, cross-functional transformation programs spanning multiple Business Units, geographies, or functions.
* Demonstrated experience in workflow re-engineering, process automation, and operating model design (Lean/Six Sigma certifications a plus).
* Strong delivery credentials: PMP, Prince2, SAFe, or equivalent Agile certifications preferred.
* Experience managing budgets, vendors, and senior stakeholder relationships at the VP/CXO level.

**Required Skills & Competencies**
**Technical & Tooling**

* Hands-on proficiency with GenAI platforms (ChatGPT Enterprise, Copilot, Gemini, Claude) and prompt engineering.
* Familiarity with RAG, AI agents, automation platforms (UiPath, Power Automate, n8n, Zapier), and integration patterns.
* Working understanding of LLMs, APIs, data pipelines, and AI governance frameworks.
* Comfort with analytics and visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau).

**Program & Business**

* Exceptional program management, structured problem-solving, and prioritization skills.
* Strong financial acumen—able to build business cases and quantify ROI.
* Outstanding executive communication, storytelling, and stakeholder influence.
* Change leadership and the ability to drive adoption in resistant environments.

**Personal Attributes**

* Hands-on operator's mindset—comfortable moving between strategy and execution.
* Intellectually curious; continuously experiments with emerging AI tools.
* Bias for action, outcome orientation, and high ownership.
* Collaborative, low-ego, and able to thrive in ambiguity.

**What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months)**

* Month 3: PMO operating model, governance, and value-tracking framework established; cross-BU use-case pipeline built and prioritized.
* Month 6: 3–5 high-impact GenAI/workflow pilots delivered with measurable productivity outcomes.
* Month 9: Scaled adoption of top 2–3 use cases across BUs; reusable playbooks and AI champions network in place.
* Month 12: Demonstrated enterprise-level efficiency gains (quantified $ savings / FTE productivity); AI-native workflows embedded into BAU; second-wave roadmap funded and underway.

**Why This Role**
This is a rare opportunity to shape and lead the AI transformation agenda of an entire enterprise. You will work directly with senior leadership, influence the future operating model of the organization, and play a defining role in how our people and processes evolve in the age of AI.
  
  
If you are a seasoned program leader who is equally excited by strategy decks and tinkering with the latest GenAI agent—this role is built for you
  
  
**Benefits**
We understand the importance of work-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well-being day to promote revitalization and success.

description:

* Hands-on experience with MVB, WTB, and Ethernet communication protocols; TRDP knowledge is an advantage.

All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow.

title: Design Manager - Rail
description:
**Job Description**
WSP is seeking a skilled individual to support the Design and Engineering Management function on multidisciplinary project delivery, from concept stage through to detailed design.
  
  
The role focuses on coordinating and delivering design outputs across multiple disciplines, supporting best practices in design production, coordination, and integration.
  
  
Accountabilities include design coordination, technical delivery support, and stakeholder engagement, with a proactive and hands-on approach to ensuring high-quality, integrated design outcomes.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Manage and coordinate multidisciplinary design delivery across all project stages, ensuring integrated and high-quality outputs
* Coordinate design interfaces, inputs, assumptions, and constraints across technical disciplines
* Support delivery of design scope to agreed programme, budget, and quality requirements
* Identify, track, and manage design risks, issues, and changes, ensuring timely resolution and communication
* Support implementation of design management plans, processes, and governance requirements
* Participate in design reviews, assurance processes, and technical coordination forums to ensure compliance with standards and client requirements
* Collaborate with internal teams, external consultants, and stakeholders to facilitate design progression and decision-making
* Contribute to design reporting, documentation, and maintenance of audit trail for decisions and deliverables
* Monitor design progress and implement corrective actions where necessary
* Provide technical guidance to junior staff and support a collaborative, delivery-focused team environment
* Drive innovative and cost-effective engineering solutions.
* Participate in technical reviews and design assurance activities.
* Proactively manage stakeholder expectations and resolve design-related issues.
* Support engineering assurance and approval processes.
* Ensure all deliverables undergo necessary quality and technical reviews before submission.
* Lead and develop multidisciplinary design teams.
* Manage workload allocation and resource utilization.
* Delivery of design packages as per agreed programme.

Key Competencies / Skills
  
  

* Experience in metro and rail infrastructure projects, including station design, with a good understanding of multidisciplinary design requirements and delivery environments
* Strong design coordination capability, with the ability to organise, track, and integrate inputs across multiple disciplines
* Proven ability to manage complex design interfaces and stakeholder interactions, ensuring alignment across internal teams, consultants, and clients
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, enabling effective coordination, clear reporting, and facilitation of design discussions
* Proactive and solution-oriented approach to problem-solving, risk management, and delivery, with a focus on achieving project outcomes
* Preferably Chartered or working towards chartership with a recognised professional institution, demonstrating commitment to professional and technical excellence

**Experience**

* Demonstrated experience in design coordination on large-scale infrastructure and metro projects, supporting delivery across complex multidisciplinary environments
* Proven involvement in progressing designs through the full project lifecycle, from concept and preliminary stages through to detailed design and issue of coordinated deliverables
* Experience supporting design management processes, including design planning, coordination, interface management, and progress tracking in line with programme and project requirements
* Familiarity with engineering design and deliverables, including reports, drawings, and specifications developed in accordance with relevant codes, standards, and project requirements
* Strong exposure to multidisciplinary project environments, including working across engineering, architectural, and specialist disciplines to deliver integrated design solutions
* Experience in design assurance and quality processes, including participation in design reviews, checking, verification, and compliance with QA/QC systems
* Understanding of Safe by Design principles, HSE requirements, and constructability considerations, supporting safe and practical engineering solutions
* Experience coordinating across internal teams, external consultants, and stakeholders, supporting effective communication and resolution of design interfaces

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor of Engineering, Bachelor of Technology, Bachelor of Architecture
* Master's Degree preferred.

**Professional Memberships (Preferred)**

* Chartered Engineer (CEng)
* ICE/IET/IRSE
* PMI/PMP Certification
* APM Qualification

BGV:
  
  

* Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India.
* Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

**About Us**
WSP is one of the world's leading professional services consulting firms. We are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower. We are technical experts and strategic advisors including engineers, technicians, scientists, architects, planners, surveyors and environmental specialists, as well as other design, program and construction management professionals. We design lasting solutions in the Transportation & Infrastructure, Property & Buildings, Earth & Environment, Power & Energy, Resources and Industry sectors, as well as offering strategic advisory services. Our talented people around the globe engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come.
  
  
With approximately
**4,000 talented people**
across 3 locations (Noida, Bengaluru & Mumbai offices) in India and more than
**73,000 globally**
, in 550
**offices across 40 countries**
, we engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come.
  
  
At “WSP” we draw on the diverse skills and capabilities of our employees globally to compete for the most exciting and complex projects across the world and bring the same level of expertise to our local communities. We are proud to be an international collective of innovative thinkers who work on the most complex problems. Uniﬁed under one strong brand, we use our local expertise, international reach and global scale to prepare our cities and environments for the future, connect communities and help societies thrive in built and natural ecosystems. True to our guiding principles, our business is built on four cornerstones:
**Our People, Our Clients, Our Operational Excellence and Our Expertise.**
**www.wsp.com**
**We are**

* Passionate people doing purposeful and sustainable work that helps shape our communities and the future.
* A collaborative team that thrives on challenges and unconventional thinking.
* A network of experts channeling our curiosity into creating solutions for complex issues.

***Inspired by diversity, driven by inclusion, we work with passion and purpose.***
**Working with Us**
At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.
  
  
**Our Hybrid Working Module**
With us, you can operate in a flexible, agile, yet structured work environment and follow a Hybrid Work Model.
  
  

* Maximize collaboration.
* Maintain product quality and cultural integrity.
* Balance community, collaboration, opportunity, productivity, and efficiency.

**Health, Safety and Wellbeing**
Our people are our greatest asset, and we prioritize a safe work environment. Health, safety, and wellbeing are integral to our culture, with each of us accountable for fostering a safe workplace through our “Making Health and Safety Personal” initiative. Our Zero Harm Vision drives us to reduce risks through innovative solutions, earning recognition for our global health and safety practices with the prestigious RoSPA Health and Safety Awards for six consecutive years.
  
  
**Inclusivity and Diversity**
WSP India is dedicated to fostering a sustainable and inclusive work environment where our greatest strength - Our People -feel valued, respected, and supported. We ensure an unbiased approach in hiring, promotion, and performance evaluation, regardless of age, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, marital status, physical ability, education, social status, or cultural background.
  
  
**Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.**
Join our close-knit community of over 73,300 talented global professionals dedicated to making a positive impact. Together, we can make a difference in communities both near and far.
  
  
**With us, you can.
  
  
Apply today.**
**NOTICE TO THIRD PARTY AGENCIES:**
*WSP does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters, employment agencies, or other staffing services. Unsolicited resumes include any resume or hiring document sent to WSP in the absence of a signed Service Agreement where WSP has expressly requested recruitment/staffing services specific to the position at hand. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers or other business leaders, will become the property of WSP and WSP will have the right to hire that candidate without reservation – no fee or other compensation will be owed or paid to the recruiter, employment agency, or other staffing service.*

title: Program Buyer
description:
**Job descriptions may display in multiple languages based on your language selection.**
**What We Offer**
At Magna, you can expect an engaging and dynamic environment where you can help to develop industry-leading automotive technologies. We invest in our employees, providing them with the support and resources they need to succeed. As a member of our global team, you can expect exciting, varied responsibilities as well as a wide range of development prospects. Because we believe that your career path should be as unique as you are.
  
  
**Group Summary**
Transforming mobility. Making automotive technology that is smarter, cleaner, safer and lighter. That’s what we’re passionate about at Magna Powertrain, and we do it by creating world-class powertrain systems. We are a premier supplier for the global automotive industry with full capabilities in design, development, testing and manufacturing of complex powertrain systems. Our name stands for quality, environmental consciousness, and safety. Innovation is what drives us and we drive innovation. Dream big and create the future of mobility at Magna Powertrain.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**
**Job title:**
Program Buyer
  
  
**Job Introduction**
Fulfillment of expectations of external and internal customers through target-oriented transition to mass production (price, deadline, quality) of the project in partnership with the supply base. Coordination of Simultaneous Engineering based on the process descriptions (Intranet), area Purchasing. To lead and guide a cross-functional team over different locations. Motivate team to generate best possible outcome.
  
  
**Major Responsibilities**

* Responsibility and tracking of sourcing and launch related activities on time (e.g. PPAP, Toolings, sourcing/nominations, prototype orders, deliveries, etc.)
* Report supplier readiness and cost cost status to program management and Project status to PUR Sr. Management
* Prepare and lead supplier negotiations regarding costs, timing, legal and contractual topics, and mirror customer requirementsetc. including alternative negotiation concepts and support make or buy decisions
* Prepare, invite and execute supplier workshops (cost down, feasibility, synergies, supply chain issues, etc.)
* Applying of existing Lessons Learned, organize and execute future Lessons Learned workshops
* Apply and ensure continuous improvement methodology, implement and transfer knowledge
* Support cost estimate and target price setting
* Purchasing Process Execution (e.g. RFQ package and execution, quote analyses, negotiations and nominations, Change requests, etc.)
* Order processing and supervision of prototypes, samples and serial tools until hand over to plant
* Development, definition and tracking of cost-saving potentials
* Monitor and track costed BOM, scrutinize technical concepts and designs from acquisition to SOP
* Support, preparation and presentation of project-relevant data to relevant stakeholders
* Creating and maintain an expert understanding of the supplier markets incl. their key sub suppliers and maintaining supplier business relationships
* Support acquisition projects including support quote process to customer
* Act as "Head of project" and functional leadership (Purchasing)
* Being PUR representative in all relevant project meetings
* Prepare and present project-relevant data to relevant stakeholders incl. Mgt. Board
* Drive acquisition projects as a Purchasing lead
* Monitoring safe and timely launch activities and support resolution of occurred issues
* First escalation level, sparring partner and trainer for colleagues and team
* Support and drive department development
* Drive cost saving initiatives
* Organize and set up PUR project team
* Continuous improvement
* Promotion, maintenance and deployment of cross-divisional best practices, Initiating Lessons Learned workshops
* Supporting development, improvements and challenge of existing purchasing tools and methods
* Synergies identification among different Projects
* Implement process landscape improvements
* Screening of helpful IT-Tools

**Customers And Business Interfaces**
Communicate to all levels:
  
  

* Suppliers
* Core Tech SE Team members
* Customer Application SE Team members
* Internal partners SCM, SQD, AME, CE, ENG, Finance/Controlling
* Middle to Top Management (SLT)

**Educational Qualifications**
Bachelor’s Degree required with a business or technical emphasis
  
  
**Work Experience**
3 to 5 years of experience in similar positions, as PUR or Program lead, relevant experience within the automotive industry preferred
  
  
**Competences & Skills**

* Excellent skills and experience in contract negotiation and price negotiation in a manufacturing environment
* Ability to understand global footprints and their interfaces, find synergies cross continent and have a vision of the “Big picture”
* Proficient in Microsoft Office (PPT, Excel)
* Fluent in English language
* SAP ERP experience desired but not mandatory
* Strategic and solution-oriented thinker and implementer of effective tactical plans
* Leading competences and proven experience in managing complex projects
* Willingness to travel (approx. 10-15% domestic and international)

**Awareness, Unity, Empowerment**
At Magna, we believe that a diverse workforce is critical to our success. That’s why we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We hire on the basis of experience and qualifications, and in consideration of job requirements, regardless of, in particular, color, ancestry, religion, gender, origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity. Magna takes the privacy of your personal information seriously. We discourage you from sending applications via email or traditional mail to comply with GDPR requirements and your local Data Privacy Law.
  
  
**AI-Assisted Screening Disclosure**
As part of our commitment to a fair, consistent, and efficient recruitment process, we may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in the initial screening of applications submitted through our Workday system. These tools help identify qualifications and experience that align with the role requirements. Please note that AI is used solely to support our recruiters. Final decisions are always made by the hiring manager and the hiring team. Importantly, no applicant data is shared externally through these AI tools. All information remains securely within our systems and is handled in accordance with our privacy and data protection policies.
  
  
**Under conditions defined by applicable law, you may have the right to request an explanation of how AI is used to support decision-making.**
If you have any questions or concerns about this process, feel free to contact our Talent Attraction team.
  
  
**Worker Type**
Regular / Permanent
  
  
**Group**
Magna Powertrain
