title: Lead Specialist, Technology Solutions - Agentic Automations
description:
**About Pearson**

  
  

At Pearson, our purpose is simple:
**Add life to a lifetime of learning.**

  
  

As a global leader in digital learning, we are transforming how people learn through innovative, AI-powered experiences that improve outcomes and create meaningful impact. Pearson is embracing a digital-first future where AI, automation, and intelligent systems enable employees to focus on higher-value work while accelerating business transformation.

  
  

The
**Office of the CTO**
powers this transformation by delivering scalable, secure, resilient, and intelligent enterprise platforms. Within Digital & Technology (D&T), the
**AgentOps Team**
leads the next generation of enterprise automation through Agentic AI, intelligent workflows, and autonomous systems that drive measurable business value.

  
  

**Why Join AgentOps?**

  
  

This is an opportunity to be at the forefront of enterprise AI innovation and help shape how humans and AI agents collaborate at scale.

  
  

You will:

  

  
* Build cutting-edge agentic AI solutions deployed across Pearson's global enterprise
  
  
* Create intelligent workflows that combine automation, reasoning, and human oversight
  
  
* Solve high-impact business challenges using advanced AI technologies
  
  
* Influence enterprise-wide AI engineering and automation standards
  
  
* Help define the future of a symbiotic workforce where humans and AI agents work together seamlessly
  

  

**Role Overview**

  
  

The
**Lead Specialist, Agentic Automations**
is a senior practitioner and solution leader responsible for driving the end-to-end discovery, design, and delivery of enterprise-scale Agentic AI and intelligent automation solutions.

  
  

This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, process transformation, and AI engineering. You will work closely with business leaders, architects, engineers, and product teams to identify automation opportunities, design scalable agent ecosystems, and deliver solutions that generate measurable business outcomes.

  
  

As a critical member of AgentOps, you will translate complex business challenges into intelligent, AI-powered workflows while ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, governance, risk, compliance, and ROI objectives.

  
  

You will play a key role in advancing Pearson's vision of an AI-enabled enterprise powered by agentic systems and intelligent automation.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

  
  

**Business Analysis & Opportunity Discovery**

  

  
* Lead end-to-end requirements gathering, process discovery, and stakeholder workshops for agentic automation initiatives.
  
  
* Analyze business processes to identify opportunities for intelligent automation, autonomous agents, and AI-driven workflow transformation.
  
  
* Facilitate cross-functional discussions with SMEs, product owners, operational teams, and business leaders.
  
  
* Document and validate business requirements, use cases, process maps, and success criteria.
  
  
* Translate business challenges into scalable AI and automation solutions with clearly defined value realization metrics.
  
  
* Establish measurable ROI, productivity, efficiency, quality, and cost optimization objectives.
  

  

**Solution Design & Agentic Architecture**

  

  
* Design intelligent workflows, multi-agent systems, and semi-autonomous business processes.
  
  
* Define agent behaviors, orchestration patterns, decision frameworks, escalation mechanisms, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  
  
* Create comprehensive solution artifacts including:
  
  
* Process Design Documents (PDDs)
  
  
* Solution Design Documents (SDDs)
  
  
* User Journeys
  
  
* Process Flows
  
  
* System Interaction Diagrams
  
  
* Agent Behavior Models
  
  
* Data & Integration Specifications
  
  
* Partner with architects and engineering teams to establish scalable and reusable design patterns.
  
  
* Ensure solutions align with enterprise platform, integration, security, and governance standards.
  

  

**Agentic AI & Automation Delivery**

  

  
* Lead the functional design and implementation of agentic automation solutions.
  
  
* Collaborate with developers, AI engineers, and automation specialists throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  
  
* Design workflows incorporating:
  
  
* Autonomous and semi-autonomous agents
  
  
* Human review and approval stages
  
  
* Escalation paths
  
  
* Exception handling
  
  
* Feedback loops
  
  
* Continuous learning mechanisms
  
  
* Drive adoption of reusable components, templates, skills, prompts, and accelerators across initiatives.
  
  
* Support enterprise rollout, change management, and operational readiness activities.
  

  

**Stakeholder Management & Leadership**

  

  
* Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, delivery teams, and leadership.
  
  
* Communicate solution vision, business value, risks, and implementation approaches to executive and technical audiences.
  
  
* Manage competing priorities and navigate ambiguity in complex transformation programs.
  
  
* Facilitate decision-making and proactively escalate risks, dependencies, and roadblocks.
  
  
* Mentor team members and promote best practices in agentic automation delivery.
  

  

**Responsible AI, Governance & Risk Management**

  

  
* Ensure all solutions comply with Pearson's Responsible AI framework.
  
  
* Implement controls to mitigate:
  
  
* Hallucination risks
  
  
* Prompt injection attacks
  
  
* Data leakage
  
  
* Model misuse
  
  
* Compliance and privacy risks
  
  
* Apply governance requirements based on solution risk levels including low, medium, and high-stakes use cases.
  
  
* Support auditability, explainability, transparency, and regulatory compliance requirements.
  
  
* Partner with security, legal, privacy, and risk teams to ensure enterprise readiness.
  

  

**Delivery Excellence & Business Impact**

  

  
* Partner with program and project managers to ensure successful execution and delivery.
  
  
* Define and track success metrics including:
  
  
* Productivity improvements
  
  
* Cost reduction and avoidance
  
  
* Time savings
  
  
* Automation utilization
  
  
* Employee experience improvements
  
  
* Customer experience outcomes

**Innovation & Capability Building**

* Automation accelerators

* Claude

**Engineering & Development**

* JavaScript
  
  
* SQL

**Required Qualifications**

  
  

**Education**

  

  
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
  
  
* Master's degree preferred but not required.
  

  

**Experience**

  

  
* 8+ years of experience in technology consulting, digital transformation, automation, AI, or enterprise solution delivery.
  
  
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional automation and AI initiatives.

title: Lead Applied Value Engineer - CPGR /CMT -NAM
description:

**Industry Expertise:**
Expertise in the High Tech industry and the ability to develop a deep understanding of industry trends and strategic opportunities
  
  
**Degree:**
In Technology & Management, Industrial/Business Engineering, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics or a comparable degree program

title: Project Manager-Cloud Solutions
description:
**Introduction**
A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
As a Project Manager for Cloud Solutions, you will oversee the successful delivery of cloud-based solutions to clients, managing project scope, cost, schedule, and deliverables to ensure alignment with service orders or contracts. You will employ project management techniques such as the Garage Method for Cloud, Design Thinking, and Agile Delivery Model to drive solution delivery.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**

* Manage Project Scope and Deliverables: Oversee project scope, cost, schedule, and deliverables to ensure alignment with service orders or contracts, employing project management techniques such as the Garage Method for Cloud, Design Thinking, and Agile Delivery Model.
* Lead Delivery Team: Lead the delivery team and interface with client project managers and other stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery.
* Interface with Clients: Collaborate with client project managers and other stakeholders to understand their needs and ensure that project deliverables meet their expectations.
* Apply Project Management Methodologies: Apply project management techniques such as the Garage Method for Cloud, Design Thinking, and Agile Delivery Model to drive solution delivery.
* Ensure Technical Alignment: Ensure that project deliverables align with technical requirements, including cloud migration, continuous modernization, and coexistence architecture.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Cloud Migration Experience: Exposure to cloud migration, continuous modernization, coexistence architecture, refactoring, containerization, APIs, Microservices, and Kubernetes.
* Cloud Platform Delivery: Hands-on experience in project delivery on at least one major cloud platform, such as IBM Cloud, AWS, Azure, Red Hat OpenShift, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Application Component Knowledge: Strong understanding of application components, including System of Engagement (SOE), System of Insight (SOI), System of Integration (SOI), and System of Records (SOR).
* Project Management Techniques: Exposure to project management techniques such as the Garage Method for Cloud, Design Thinking, and Agile Delivery Model.
* Technical Leadership: Experience leading delivery teams and interfacing with client project managers and other stakeholders in a cloud-based solution delivery environment.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Cloud Architecture Knowledge: Exposure to designing and implementing cloud architectures, including hybrid and multi-cloud environments, to support cloud migration and modernization efforts.
* DevOps Practices: Experience with DevOps practices and tools, such as continuous integration and delivery, to ensure smooth project delivery and operations.
* IT Service Management: Exposure to IT service management frameworks, such as ITIL, to ensure alignment with service orders or contracts and to drive solution delivery.

title: Technical Program Manager, AI & Cloud Efficiency
description:
**About Glean**
Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.
  
  
At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.
  
  
Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.
  
  
If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.
  
  
**About The Role**
Glean is looking for a Technical Program Manager, AI & Cloud Efficiency to provide end-to-end oversight of these initiatives: maintain the portfolio, set priorities, drive the operating cadence, unblock owners, and ensure savings land. Glean delivers AI at enterprise scale across a deliberately open, provider-neutral stack. This breadth necessitates numerous efficiency initiatives running in parallel across engineering — token yield, compute right-sizing, LLM Gateway quotas, provider commitments to name a few.
  
  
**You Will**

* Drive Cloud and AI/LLM efficiency
* Own a single, prioritised source of truth for all cost initiatives and drive them to measurable efficiency and margin gains.
* Pressure-test savings claims: verify realised vs. projected savings post-launch, and prevent silent cost regressions from eroding prior wins
* Build cost-attribution discipline: per-service, per-team, per-customer, per-feature tagging and allocation so every dollar has an owner
* Oversee LLM spend across providers: procurement and commitment sizing
* Govern internal AI tooling spend with per-user visibility, quotas, and value assessment
* Build the observability & automation layer
* Treat cost like production telemetry: real-time cost attribution, anomaly detection, alerting, and automated triage
* Automate the toil: cost-triage agents, regression detection, and self-serve attribution so the program scales

**About You**

* Deep, hands-on understanding of cloud infrastructure and AI/LLM economics
* Proficient in driving efficiency, capacity, or FinOps-adjacent programs
* Eng operations instincts: you think in SLOs, error budgets, telemetry, and postmortems, and you apply that discipline to spend
* Strong SQL and data skills; you can query BigQuery, build a Sigma workbook, and model a scenario

**Location:**

* This role is hybrid (3 days a week in our Bangalore office)

**Compensation & Benefits**
Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.
  
  
We are a diverse bunch of people and we want to continue to attract and retain a diverse range of people into our organization. We're committed to an inclusive and diverse company. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race.

At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work.
**As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role.**

Resources
  
  
Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people:
  
  

* OneTrust Careers on YouTube

Your Data

**.**

title: Project Manager  (Corporate Interior Fit-Out)
description:
Zyeta is looking for a technically strong and execution-focused Project Manager with experience in corporate interior fit-out, commercial workplace, and large-scale office projects. The ideal candidate should be capable of independently managing end-to-end project delivery, including C&I , MEP coordination and execution, vendor management, project cost and schedule control, and direct client communication.

Candidates with experience in GCC offices and multinational corporate workplace projects will be preferred.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage end-to-end project execution from project initiation and planning through construction, commissioning, and final handover.
* Lead C&I and MEP execution, ensuring seamless coordination across civil works, interior finishes, HVAC, electrical, plumbing, fire fighting, fire alarm, and ELV systems.
* Review and interpret architectural, interior, civil, and MEP drawings, specifications, BOQs, and shop drawings.
* Identify technical discrepancies, resolve site clashes, and coordinate with design and engineering teams to ensure constructability.
* Independently manage vendors, subcontractors, consultants, and site teams to achieve project milestones.
* Act as the primary point of contact for clients, managing technical discussions, progress reviews, project updates, and issue resolution.
* Prepare and monitor project schedules, resource plans, procurement timelines, and execution milestones.
* Track project costs, validate quantities and measurements, monitor variations, and control cost overruns.
* Coordinate with procurement teams to ensure timely material approvals, ordering, delivery, and site availability.
* Monitor workmanship, quality standards, safety compliance, and adherence to approved drawings and specifications.
* Identify project risks, resolve execution bottlenecks, and implement corrective actions to minimise delays and rework.
* Conduct regular site inspections, track project progress, and ensure timely snag closure and handover.
* Prepare project progress reports covering schedule, cost, quality, risks, vendor performance, and client requirements.
* Ensure completion of as-built drawings, testing and commissioning records, warranties, and handover documentation.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong knowledge of C&I execution, including partitions, flooring, ceilings, joinery, glazing, painting, and interior finishing works.
* Good understanding of MEP systems, including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, fire fighting, fire alarm, and ELV.
* Ability to read, interpret, and coordinate architectural, interior, civil, and MEP drawings.
* Experience in technical drawing reviews, shop drawing coordination, service clash identification, and resolution.
* Knowledge of BOQs, quantity take-offs, rate analysis, measurement verification, and variation management.
* Strong understanding of construction planning, critical path scheduling, project sequencing, and resource allocation.
* Experience in material submittals, technical approvals, method statements, inspection requests, and quality documentation.
* Knowledge of testing and commissioning, snagging, defect rectification, and project handover processes.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD, MS Project, and Microsoft Excel.
* Exposure to BIM/Revit coordination and clash detection is an advantage.

**Required Experience and Competencies**

* 10–15 years of experience in project management and construction execution, primarily in corporate interior fit-out or commercial workplace projects.
* Proven experience independently handling both C&I execution and MEP coordination on commercial interior projects.
* Strong technical understanding combined with hands-on site execution capabilities.
* Demonstrated experience managing vendors, subcontractors, consultants, and cross-functional project teams.
* Experience handling direct client communication, technical reviews, project updates, and escalations.
* Strong commercial awareness, including budget monitoring, BOQ validation, variation management, and cost control.
* Excellent planning, leadership, negotiation, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

Candidates must demonstrate a combination of
**technical expertise, hands-on C&I and MEP execution, vendor management, project cost and schedule control, and direct client-handling experience**
.

Tilia Children's House is a new Montessori-led school group that grows into Cambridge (IGCSE). We are opening and running campuses in Bangalore and Hyderabad, and we are backed by the K-12 / Orchids network.

Track enquiries, visits and enrolments weekly, and fix what is leaking.

Keep campuses running day to day: staffing, vendors, facilities, safety, compliance, parent communication.

Support campus launches, including setup checklists, hiring support and readiness for opening.

Manage budgets and cost discipline across campuses.

A builder's mindset: you are happy to work in a start-up setting where you will often have to make things up as you go.

Candidates with 8–10 years of experience managing operations across two or more preschools, primary schools, or school campuses. Strong experience in team leadership, admissions growth, parent engagement, budgeting, and academic operations is preferred.

title: Product Lifecycle Project Manager
description:
**Meet the Team**
The Product Operations team plays a critical role in delivering Cisco’s next-generation hardware products on a scale. Working at the intersection of engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing, the team ensures seamless product lifecycle execution—from new product introduction to high-volume production and customer delivery. With a strong focus on reliability, efficiency, and operational excellence, the team drives impact across global operations and enables successful product outcomes.
  
  
**Your Impact**
The Cisco Product Operations team is seeking a Product Lifecycle Program Manager (PLPM) to manage global cost management and the end-to-end product lifecycle from inception to End-of-Life (EOL). This is a role that requires the ability to work cross-functionally with stakeholders—including Manufacturing, Engineering, Marketing, and Executive Leadership—to align on strategy and execution for a portfolio of complex product solutions. You will be responsible for defining and implementing the frameworks that ensure operational efficiency and market competitiveness across our global manufacturing footprint.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Strategic Cost Management & Lifecycle Oversight: Serve as the primary architect for end-to-end product lifecycle strategy, driving rigorous cost management protocols from launch through EOL to ensure sustained profitability.
* Engineering Change Governance: Provide oversight for Engineering Change Management, ensuring seamless technical transitions and minimal operational disruption.
* Product Quality & Financial Stewardship: Maintain stringent control over product quality benchmarks and cost structures, ensuring alignment with organizational financial targets.
* Complex Problem Resolution: Lead the mitigation of critical sustaining issues, including line-stop resolutions, CAP account management, AVL optimization, and continuous manufacturing process improvement.
* EOL Strategy & Orchestration: Direct the development and execution of holistic EOL strategies, partnering with integrated product teams to ensure smooth sunsetting of legacy solutions.
* Enterprise Risk Management: Oversee proactive risk assessment, including multi-source technology evaluation, component-level analysis, cost variance mitigation, and comprehensive supply chain reviews throughout the lifecycle.
* Field Performance & Margin Optimization: Lead strategic action planning for product field performance and spearhead initiatives to drive continuous improvement in gross margins.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or related technical field.
* 2-5 years of experience in Supply Chain management within the high-tech sector.
* Basic Program Management and executive-level stakeholder management skills.
* Knowledge of supply chain dynamics, specifically within high-tech environments, product costing, and sophisticated margin analysis.
* Understanding of Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and sustaining product support

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of New Product Introduction (NPI) processes.
* Experience using Agile methodologies and advanced MSFT tools.
* Experience in the high-tech electronics industry and large-scale electronics manufacturing.
* Strong executive communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.

description:

website

**About the Role**

The Associate Director Project Management will lead the end-to-end delivery and governance of Managed Office and Design and Build projects across India. The role owns programme performance from project mobilisation through handover and commercial closure, ensuring that delivery commitments, quality, cost, safety, and operational readiness are consistently met. The role will provide strong leadership to regional project teams and act as a senior delivery partner to clients and internal stakeholders.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

**Programme and project delivery**

* Lead a portfolio of Managed Office and Design and Build projects across multiple cities, from design and scope readiness through construction, testing and commissioning, handover, and closeout.
* Own programme plans, critical-path reviews, milestone governance, and early escalation of risks that could affect opening dates, budget, quality, or member experience.
* Ensure design readiness, BOQ completeness, procurement release, site mobilisation, construction sequencing, testing and commissioning, and opening-readiness gates are properly controlled.
* Drive accurate Daily Project Reports and Weekly Project Reports for internal leadership and clients, with clear status, decisions required, risks, mitigations, and recovery actions.
* Ensure effective coordination between Design, Building Engineering Studio, Estimation, Procurement, Operations, Technology, and the on-site project team.

**Client and stakeholder leadership**

* Act as the senior execution point of contact for clients, establishing transparent governance, timely communication, and a high standard of service throughout delivery.
* Partner with Sales, Client Solutions, Legal, and Finance to ensure contracts, scope, timelines, change orders, billing milestones, and client commitments are understood and delivered.
* Lead senior reviews with PMCs, contractors, consultants, OEMs, and building stakeholders to resolve critical decisions and remove constraints.
* Coordinate with Finance and Business Development or Client Solutions teams on project billing and receivables, ensuring timely documentation, invoicing inputs, and escalation of overdue dependencies.

**Quality, safety, compliance, and handover**

* Establish and enforce standard project-management practices, site-management standards, quality benchmarks, safety requirements, and compliance controls across all projects.
* Conduct periodic project health checks and site reviews to identify quality, safety, schedule, and commercial risks early and ensure closure through accountable action plans.
* Ensure all project-related approvals, regulatory and local-authority compliance, statutory documentation, opening communications, and white papers are completed on time.
* Ensure operational handover is complete and controlled, including punch-list closure, as-built drawings, warranties, O and M documentation, DLP registers, and clear ownership of post-handover actions.

**Commercial and vendor management**

* Partner with Procurement on sourcing strategy, vendor allocation, tender evaluation, negotiations, contracting, and performance governance for assigned projects.
* Own budget visibility and project cost governance, including value-engineering opportunities, cost approvals, change control, forecast accuracy, and commercial closure.
* Drive performance improvement with vendors and consultants through structured reviews, quality feedback, recovery plans, and lessons learned.

**People and capability leadership**

* Lead and mentor project managers and project teams across key regions; set clear expectations for planning discipline, reporting, site ownership, quality, and stakeholder management.
* Build a high-accountability delivery culture through coaching, knowledge sharing, project retrospectives, and consistent use of approved project-management tools and checklists.
* Contribute to scaling the D and B and Managed Office delivery model by improving processes, standards, vendor capability, and cross-functional ways of working.

**Education and Desired Qualifications**

* Bachelor degree in Civil, Mechanical, or Electrical Engineering required. A postgraduate qualification in Construction Management or Project Management is preferred.
* 12 to 16 years of total experience, including substantial experience leading corporate interiors, commercial office fit-outs, Managed Office, or Design and Build projects.
* Demonstrated record of managing multi-city or large-scale projects, teams, budgets, and senior client relationships.
* Strong working knowledge of MEP, interior construction, testing and commissioning, safety practices, project controls, contracts, and local compliance requirements.
* Strong programme leadership, decision-making, and executive stakeholder management.
* Commercial acumen with sound understanding of contracts, change management, cost control, and vendor performance.
* High proficiency in project planning, reporting, and digital project-management tools.
* Ability to lead through ambiguity, manage competing priorities, and create recovery plans in a fast-moving delivery environment.
* Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to engage clients, senior leadership, and site teams effectively.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

WeWork India is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for our employees and members. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

We expect all employees to embody our values and all aspects of employment including the decisions to hire and promote, are based on merit, competence, performance and business needs.

Our total rewards philosophy is aimed at providing compensation that is competitive, performance linked and helps us attract and retain the talent we need to drive our business forward and serve our members. **Description**

Customer impact from day one. Strategic clarity and Execution that sticks.
  
  
Salesforce is hiring Deployment Strategists — Strategic Builders who are customer-facing advisors, who define AI strategy, shape agentic solutions, and drive measurable adoption for enterprise customers. description:

title: Manager-CSA
description:

Our
**Cyber Security Advisory (CSA)**
services include building GRC/Cybersecurity programs from the ground up, framework readiness, design and maintenance of critical security domains, managed internal controls testing and monitoring, co-sourced/outsourced internal audit, segregation of duties and access risk review, policy and procedure development, enterprise risk management, and IT and cybersecurity risk assessment.

* Relevant certification preferred, such as CISA, CISM, CISSP or AWS Cloud Practitioner

* You get the job done and have fun doing it

title: Project Manager – Monitoring, Evaluation & Learning (MEL)
description:
Project Manager – Monitoring, Evaluation & Learning (MEL)

Work With Us Project Manager – Monitoring, Evaluation & Learning (MEL)

**Job Description**
**Project Manager – Monitoring, Evaluation & Learning (MEL)**
**Location:**
Bengaluru, Karnataka
**Department:**
Monitoring, Evaluation & Learning (MEL)
  
**Reporting To:**
Senior Research Manager

**About the Role**

The Project Manager – Monitoring, Evaluation & Learning (MEL) will be responsible for transforming monitoring, evaluation and research findings into high-quality reports, knowledge products and communication materials for programme teams, senior management, funders and external stakeholders.
  
  
Working closely with the MEL team, statisticians, programme teams and external research partners, the role will synthesise evidence generated through SELCO Foundation's Monitoring, Evaluation & Learning (MEL) system—including Baseline, Midline and Endline (BME) evaluations, routine monitoring, and thematic research studies—into compelling reports, publications and actionable insights. The position will also support proposal development, dissemination of evidence, and management of evaluation studies.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Evidence Generation & Knowledge Management**

* Interpret findings from BME evaluations, monitoring systems and research studies to generate actionable programme insights.
* Translate quantitative and qualitative findings into clear, evidence-based reports and recommendations.
* Prepare learning briefs, case studies, evidence notes, success stories and programme summaries.
* Identify programme learnings, best practices and implementation challenges.
* Facilitate learning and reflection sessions with programme teams.
* Document organisational learning and support knowledge management initiatives.
* Promote the use of evidence for programme planning and decision-making.

**2. Proposal Development & Reporting Proposal Development**

* Support Programme and Partnerships teams in developing MEL concept notes in the funding proposals.
* Develop MEL sections of proposals, including results frameworks, indicators, MEL plans and evaluation approaches.
* Ensure proposed MEL frameworks are practical, measurable, aligned with organisational MEL systems and feasible within programme resources.
* Provide programme evidence, evaluation findings and impact data to strengthen proposals.
* Recommend appropriate monitoring and evaluation strategies, indicators and research activities for new programmes.

**Funder & Management Reporting**

* Maintain a reporting calendar for donor and management reporting requirements.
* Prepare high-quality donor reports, annual reports, impact reports, programme reports and management reports.
* Translate evaluation findings into compelling narratives for different audiences.
* Coordinate with programme teams to ensure reports are evidence-based, accurate and submitted on time.
* Support dissemination of reports through presentations, publications and stakeholder meetings.
* Maintain a repository of reports, case studies and knowledge products.

**3. Publications & Knowledge Dissemination**

* Develop evidence-based content for SELCO Foundation's website, newsletters and social media platforms.
* Prepare technical papers, policy briefs, research articles and other knowledge products for publication.
* Identify opportunities to publish evaluation findings in journals and sector platforms.
* Review and edit external evaluation reports before publication.
* Work with the Communications team to disseminate programme evidence and impact stories.

**4. Evaluation & Research Support**

* Support the planning and implementation of Baseline, Midline and Endline (BME) evaluations and other thematic studies.
* Develop evaluation concepts, methodologies, data collection tools and Terms of Reference (ToRs).
* Coordinate with external research agencies and consultants.
* Review evaluation protocols, field processes and final reports.
* Ensure evaluation activities meet organisational quality and ethical standards.

**5. Stakeholder Coordination**

* Collaborate with Programme Teams, MEL Team, Communications Team, Knowledge Team and external research partners.
* Support donor meetings, programme reviews and dissemination events.
* Build effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders to strengthen evidence generation and utilisation.

**Key Deliverables**

* Donor reports and management reports
* Annual reports and impact reports
* Learning briefs and evidence notes
* Case studies and success stories
* Proposal MEL sections and results frameworks
* Research publications and policy briefs
* Evaluation reports and dissemination materials
* Presentations for management and external stakeholders

**Qualifications**

* Master's degree in, Development Studies, Social Sciences, Statistics, Economics, Public Policy or a related discipline.

**Experience**

* 5–8 years of experience in Monitoring, Evaluation & Learning (MEL), research, programme evaluation or evidence generation.
* Demonstrated experience in preparing donor reports, impact reports and technical publications.
* Experience supporting proposal development and managing evaluation studies.
* Experience working with development sector programmes will be preferred.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Excellent analytical, report writing and communication skills.
* Strong ability to translate evidence into clear, actionable insights.
* Experience with programme evaluation and mixed-method research.
* Familiarity with MEL frameworks, theories of change and results frameworks.
* Strong stakeholder coordination and project management skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office; familiarity with Power BI dashboards and digital data collection platforms is desirable.
* High attention to detail, strong organisational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities.

**Success in the Role**

Success in this role will be measured by the timely delivery of high-quality reports, publications and knowledge products; effective support to proposal development and evaluation studies; and the ability to ensure that evidence generated through SELCO Foundation's MEL system is effectively communicated and used to strengthen programmes, inform decision-making and demonstrate impact.

**How to Apply**

Apply Now

title: SAP Project Manager
description:
We are seeking an experienced SAP Lead with strong expertise in SAP SD, MM, or FICO and good technical knowledge to lead SAP implementation, rollout, upgrade, enhancement, integration, and support initiatives.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on functional expertise in SAP SD, MM, or FICO, combined with a good understanding of SAP technical components, integrations, interfaces, and S/4HANA architecture.
  
  
The candidate will be responsible for providing functional leadership, solution guidance, technical coordination, stakeholder management, and delivery oversight across SAP projects. The role requires close collaboration with business users, functional consultants, technical teams, developers, integration teams, and other SAP workstreams.
  
  
Your future duties and responsibilities
  
  
SAP Functional Leadership
  
  

* Provide functional leadership in SAP SD, MM, or FICO.
* Analyze business requirements and translate them into SAP solutions.
* Lead requirement gathering, business process analysis, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support.
* Review existing business processes and recommend SAP best practices.
* Provide guidance to functional consultants and development teams.
* Ensure integration of SD/MM/FICO processes with other SAP modules and third-party applications.
* Participate in solution design and review Functional Specifications (FS).
* Ensure solutions are aligned with business requirements and SAP standards.

SAP Implementation & Delivery
  
  

* Lead SAP implementation, rollout, migration, upgrade, enhancement, and support activities.
* Manage activities across the complete SAP project lifecycle.
* Coordinate with business stakeholders, functional consultants, ABAP developers, integration teams, Basis teams, and other technical teams.
* Support project planning, estimation, resource allocation, timelines, and delivery tracking.
* Identify and resolve functional and technical issues.
* Manage risks, dependencies, defects, and escalations.
* Support production deployment, cutover, hypercare, and transition to support teams.

Technical Knowledge & Integration
  
  

* Strong understanding of SAP technical architecture and integration concepts.
* Good knowledge of SAP interfaces, IDocs, RFCs, APIs, web services, and third-party integrations.
* Good understanding of ABAP technical concepts, including debugging, enhancements, user exits, BAdIs, reports, interfaces, and custom developments.
* Ability to work closely with ABAP developers and review technical solutions.
* Understanding of SAP integration with external systems.
* Knowledge of SAP Fiori and S/4HANA technical architecture.
* Exposure to SAP BTP, CPI/Integration Suite, APIs, and cloud-based integrations is an advantage.
* Ability to troubleshoot functional issues by analyzing technical objects, logs, interfaces, and error messages.

Testing & Production Support
  
  

* Lead and coordinate Unit Testing, SIT, UAT, Regression Testing, and defect resolution.
* Review test scenarios and ensure adequate business-process coverage.
* Coordinate defect analysis between functional and technical teams.
* Support production deployments and cutover activities.
* Provide functional and technical support during hypercare.
* Analyze production issues and coordinate root-cause analysis.
* Ensure proper documentation, knowledge transfer, and support transition.

Stakeholder & Team Management
  
  

* Act as a key point of contact between business stakeholders and SAP delivery teams.
* Communicate effectively with business users, senior management, clients, and technical teams.
* Lead and mentor SAP functional consultants and team members.
* Coordinate with onsite/offshore and geographically distributed teams.
* Conduct requirement discussions, solution reviews, status meetings, and issue-resolution meetings.
* Manage vendor and third-party coordination when required.

**Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role**
Must-Have Skills
  
  
SAP Functional Skills
  
  

* 8–15+ years of SAP experience.
* Strong expertise in at least one of the following modules:
* SAP SD
* SAP MM
* SAP FICO
* Strong understanding of end-to-end SAP business processes.
* Experience in SAP implementation, rollout, upgrade, enhancement, and/or production support.
* Strong experience in SAP S/4HANA.
* Experience working with cross-functional SAP modules.
* Strong requirement gathering and solution-design experience.
* Ability to lead functional teams and provide solution guidance.

Technical Skills
  
  

* Good understanding of SAP technical architecture.
* Good knowledge of:
* ABAP concepts
* Debugging
* User Exits
* BAdIs
* Enhancements
* IDocs
* RFC
* APIs
* Web Services
* SAP Interfaces
* Third-party integrations
* Good understanding of integration between SAP and external applications.
* Knowledge of SAP Fiori applications and S/4HANA architecture.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with ABAP, Basis, Integration, Security, and other technical teams.

Leadership & Delivery
  
  

* Experience leading SAP functional teams or workstreams.
* Strong stakeholder management skills.
* Experience handling client/business interactions.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Experience managing multiple priorities and delivering solutions within agreed timelines.
* Strong communication and presentation skills.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
  
Good-to-Have Skills
  
  

* SAP BTP
* SAP CPI / Integration Suite
* SAP Fiori
* SAP Solution Manager
* SAP Signavio
* SAP Activate methodology
* RISE with SAP
* SAP Cloud solutions
* Agile/Scrum methodologies
* DevOps practices
* SAP Workflow
* SAP Analytics / reporting exposure
* SAP certification in SD, MM, FICO, or S/4HANA

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**

* SAP S/4HANA certification.
* SAP SD/MM/FICO certification.
* Experience leading global SAP implementations or rollouts.
* Experience working with onsite/offshore delivery models.
* Experience in large-scale SAP transformation programs.
* Strong knowledge of SAP Best Practices.
* Experience across industries such as Manufacturing, Retail, Healthcare, Banking, Insurance, or Life Sciences.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
  
Ideal Candidate
  
  
The ideal candidate should be a strong SAP SD/MM/FICO Lead with functional expertise and good technical understanding, rather than a purely functional consultant or a generic project manager.
  
  
The candidate should be capable of:
  
  
Business Requirement → Functional Analysis → Solution Design → SAP Configuration → Technical Coordination → Integration → Testing → Deployment → Hypercare → Production Support
  
  
The candidate should be comfortable working across both functional and technical teams and should be able to independently drive an SAP workstream from requirement through delivery.

title: Program Manager-Disaster & Climate Resilience
description:
Program Manager-Disaster & Climate Resilience

Work With Us Program Manager-Disaster & Climate Resilience

Job Details Designation: Program Manager – Disaster & Climate Resilience Role Type: Full-time Reporting to: Senior Programme Manager – Livelihood Innovation Location: Bengaluru (SELCO Foundation HQ) Travel Expectation: Regular travel across key project geographies (Northeast, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Odisha, and other disaster-vulnerable regions)

**ABOUT US**

SELCO Foundation, a not-for-profit, engages in field-based R&D and ecosystem building for the development of decentralised renewable energy solutions that alleviate poverty in urban, rural, and tribal poor areas. The organisation works across verticals such as energy access, built environment, health, skill development, energy entrepreneurship, and partners across various developmental sectors. SELCO Foundation seeks to inspire and implement socially, financially, and environmentally inclusive solutions by improving access to sustainable energy.

**ABOUT THE POSITION**

The Program Manager – Disaster & Climate Resilience will lead SELCO Foundation’s interventions aimed at building long-term resilience for disaster-prone communities through a decentralized energy and livelihood lens. Disasters—ranging from rapid-onset events like floods and cyclones to slow-onset crises like droughts—disproportionately impact climate-vulnerable communities and critical infrastructure.
  
  
This is a high-ownership, hybrid role involving both direct
**field implementation**
and strategic
**ecosystem orchestration.**
The candidate will possess 6 to 7 years of professional experience and will be responsible for designing, deploying, and managing interventions across all three phases of disaster management:
**Pre-disaster**
(risk mitigation, preparedness, resilient infrastructure planning),
**During disaster**
(emergency energy/livelihood relief access), and
**Post-disaster**
(sustainable livelihood recovery, rehabilitation, and long-term climate adaptation).

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Strategic Program Design & Livelihood Resilience**

* Conceptualize and implement decentralized renewable energy (DRE)-led disaster resilience strategies targeting vulnerable livelihood sectors (agriculture, micro-enterprises, healthcare, and community infrastructure) across priority geographies like Northeast India, Maharashtra, Karnataka, and Odisha.
* Apply a holistic lens across
  **Pre, During, and Post-disaster**
  phases to strengthen community resilience, safeguard assets, and minimize economic disruption caused by natural and human-induced hazards.
* Identify and scale sustainable technologies, resilient built-environment designs, and financial models tailored to flood, cyclone, and drought-affected regions.

**2. On-Ground Implementation & Field Operations**

* Oversee end-to-end execution of disaster mitigation and livelihood recovery projects in deep-rural and vulnerable geographies.
* Coordinate with regional field teams, local partner organizations, and community groups to ensure timely rollout of resilient infrastructure, energy systems, and livelihood interventions.
* Lead disaster preparedness audits and risk assessments for local physical infrastructure and community assets in targeted districts.

**3. Stakeholder Orchestration & Ecosystem Building**

* Act as an orchestrator across multiple actors—government departments (SDMAs/DDMAs), civil society organizations, local enterprises, financial institutions, and humanitarian relief agencies—to integrate energy access and sustainable livelihoods into broader disaster management frameworks.
* Facilitate multi-stakeholder coalitions to mobilize resources, streamline post-disaster livelihood restoration, and build regional capacity.

**4. Project Management, Tracking & Reporting**

* Maintain comprehensive project timelines, deliverable trackers, and budget allocations for all disaster-related grants and initiatives.
* Prepare high-quality, structured monthly progress reports, field documentation, and impact assessments for internal leadership, donors, and institutional partners.
* Conduct regular field visits to project sites to monitor implementation quality, capture field insights, and resolve operational bottlenecks.

**KEY DELIVERABLES**

Deliverables Table Deliverable What it looks like Disaster Resilience Framework A standardized operational framework for pre-, during-, and post-disaster DRE livelihood interventions. Regional Execution Roadmap Detailed work plans and resource allocation matrices for implementation across Karnataka, Maharashtra, Odisha, and the Northeast. Stakeholder & Partner Network Active partnerships mapped and operationalized with district disaster management authorities (DDMAs) and regional NGOs. Project Tracking & Budget Reports Monthly deliverable and expenditure trackers submitted to SELCO Foundation HQ. Impact & Field Documentation High-quality case studies, field photographs, and technical progress reports documenting community resilience and infrastructure outcomes.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Disaster Management, Environmental Science, Sustainable Development, Rural Management, Public Policy, Social Work, or a related discipline.
* **6 to 7 years**
  of relevant professional experience managing disaster risk reduction (DRR), climate adaptation, or livelihood-focused development programs.
* Demonstrated experience in field implementation and stakeholder orchestration across diverse Indian geographies (experience in Northeast, Maharashtra, Karnataka, or Odisha is highly desirable).

**DESIRED SKILLS**

* **Strong Program Management:**
  Proven track record in orchestrating multi-region projects, budget tracking, and deliverable management under changing field conditions.
* **Disaster & Livelihood Expertise:**
  In-depth understanding of disaster management cycles (pre, during, post), climate adaptation strategies, and rural livelihood vulnerabilities.
* **Field Leadership & Problem Solving:**
  Ability to navigate complex ground realities, resolve field bottlenecks proactively, and communicate effectively with local communities and high-level officials alike.
* **Cross-Sectoral Collaboration:**
  Skills to build consensus and orchestrate efforts between government bodies, NGOs, tech providers, and local enterprise networks.
* **Clear Written & Analytical Skills:**
  Proficient in developing structured field reports, policy inputs, and project documentation for internal and external stakeholders.
* **Proficiency in Digital Tools:**
  Comfort with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and collaborative online platforms.
* Willingness to travel extensively to remote and disaster-vulnerable field locations across India.

title: Payroll Implementation Lead
description:
**Role Purpose**
The Payroll Implementation Lead is accountable for ensuring payroll operations are fully ready to successfully transition to and operate the future-state payroll solution. The role acts as the payroll implementation readiness lead across design, testing, controls, training, cutover, and stabilization, providing vendor assurance that payroll can be delivered accurately, compliantly, and without disruption post go-live.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Payroll Readiness Leadership**

* Own end-to-end payroll readiness across people, process, technology, data, controls, and vendor support.
* Establish and manage readiness gates, entry/exit criteria, and go/no-go recommendations.
* Drive resolution of readiness risks, dependencies, and open issues impacting payroll delivery.

**Process & Operational Readiness**

* Validate future-state payroll processes, SOPs, operating procedures, and service delivery model.
* Ensure clear ownership, governance, escalation paths, and support structures are in place prior to go-live.
* Verify operational handover readiness between project, vendor, and payroll operations teams.

**Testing & Quality Assurance**

* Lead payroll business testing readiness, including SIT, UAT, parallel payroll, reconciliation, and control validation.
* Review testing outcomes, defect closure, and business sign-off quality.
* Ensure payroll accuracy and compliance requirements are demonstrated before deployment.

**Data, Controls & Compliance**

* Oversee workday data quality, payroll data readiness, migration validation, reconciliations, and audit evidence.
* Ensure key payroll controls, SOD, security access, and compliance requirements are embedded and operational.
* Validate mitigation plans for any residual control or compliance risks.

**Cutover & Go-Live Management**

* Coordinate payroll cutover activities, business sign-offs, contingency planning, and operational acceptance.
* Lead go-live readiness reviews and recommend go/no-go decisions based on evidence.
* Establish command center governance and hyper care support structures.

**Stabilization & Transition to Operations**

* Monitor post-go-live performance, payroll accuracy, SLA achievement, defects, and user adoption.
* Drive issue resolution during hyper care and stabilization.
* Confirm operational ownership transfer and readiness to move into business-as-usual support.

**Experience & Qualifications**

* 15+ years of HR & payroll implementation, and or HR or payroll transformation experience.
* Proven experience leading HR & payroll deployments, migrations, managed services transitions, or cloud HR & payroll implementations.
* Strong understanding of payroll controls, compliance, testing, cutover, and operational readiness.
* Experience working with HR - payroll vendors, HR technology platforms, and cross-functional teams including HR, Finance, IT, and Operations.
* Demonstrated ability to manage complex risks and deliver successful payroll go-lives in multi-country environments.

**Success Measures**
: The Payroll Implementation Lead is the
**single point of accountability for proving payroll is ready to operate successfully during transition, and after go-live.**

* Go-live readiness achieved with all critical gates completed.
* Payroll delivered accurately and on time during stabilization.
* No unresolved critical controls or compliance issues at deployment.
* Successful completion of knowledge transfer and operational handover.
* Stable payroll operations achieved within agreed hyper care period

title: Senior Manager – R&D Program & Commercialization
description:
**About US**
Scimplify is a science-first manufacturing company for Advanced Materials: from specialty chemicals to the emerging building blocks of next-generation energy applications, life sciences, and crop sciences.
  
  
We scale process development and manufacturing as one continuous system, supported by world-class R&D infrastructure and executed across a global network of 500+ manufacturing partners and thousands of scientists and technical partners. The result: new materials go from molecule to commercial scale in months, not years. Scimplify operates offices and teams across 5 countries with 1,000+ innovator customers in 40+ countries.
  
  
We are backed by investors such as Accel, Bertelsmann, Omnivore, Hitachi Ventures and 3one4 Capital, having raised over $80M.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a commercially driven and operationally strong professional to manage the end-to-end execution of Scimplify’s R&D portfolio, spanning customer-funded CDMO engagements and internally funded strategic R&D initiatives.
  
  
The role will bridge scientific teams, Business Development, Procurement, Finance, and manufacturing to ensure that R&D opportunities are evaluated effectively, commercially viable proposals are developed, resources are planned efficiently, and engagements are executed through successful delivery and commercialization.
  
  
The individual will drive the complete lifecycle, from lead evaluation, technical coordination, costing, and quotation management to execution tracking, process development coordination, scale-up, and commercialization. The role will also establish structured operating mechanisms, improve cross-functional collaboration, and ensure that R&D initiatives translate into measurable business outcomes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* R&D Program Management & Execution
* Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of R&D engagements, from opportunity assessment and planning through execution, delivery, and commercialization.
* Oversee multiple customer-funded and internally funded R&D initiatives, ensuring alignment with business priorities, timelines, budgets, and expected outcomes.
* Establish execution plans, milestones, resource requirements, timelines, and review mechanisms in collaboration with scientific and business teams.
* Track progress, identify bottlenecks, manage dependencies, and drive timely resolution of execution challenges.
* Maintain portfolio-level visibility through dashboards, review meetings, and structured reporting to leadership.
* Customer-Funded CDMO Business & Lead Management
* Coordinate with Business Development and scientific teams to evaluate incoming customer requirements and identify suitable R&D opportunities.
* Manage the opportunity pipeline from initial lead evaluation and technical feasibility through costing, quotation submission, conversion, and project initiation.
* Work with scientists to understand the scope of work, development requirements, resource needs, technical deliverables, and estimated timelines.
* Coordinate with Procurement to assess raw material costs, sourcing options, vendor availability, and other relevant cost components.
* Drive quotation preparation and pricing coordination, ensuring proposals are commercially competitive and financially viable.
* Track quotations, follow-ups, conversion status, and opportunity outcomes to improve pipeline visibility and win rates.
* Coordinate execution after project award, ensuring adherence to agreed timelines, customer deliverables, and commercial commitments.
* Facilitate customer communication, manage cross-functional dependencies, and support successful delivery and opportunities for repeat business.
* Strategic R&D Initiatives & Commercialization
* Manage internally funded R&D initiatives undertaken to develop new products, improve processes, or create strategic business opportunities.
* Translate business priorities into execution plans, development milestones, budgets, resource requirements, and commercialization targets.
* Work closely with scientific teams on process development, optimization, scale-up, and manufacturing readiness.
* Monitor development progress, timelines, costs, and commercial viability against defined milestones.
* Coordinate with manufacturing, Procurement, and other relevant functions to facilitate the transition from laboratory development to scalable production.
* Identify risks, delays, and commercialization challenges, enabling timely decisions on prioritization and resource allocation.
* Drive the progression of successful R&D initiatives towards commercialization and measurable business value.
* Procurement, Costing & Financial Coordination
* Partner closely with Procurement to plan sourcing requirements, raw material availability, vendor coordination, and cost estimates for R&D engagements.
* Coordinate with scientific teams to develop accurate estimates for materials, development activities, external services, and resource requirements.
* Work with Finance and relevant stakeholders to assess project economics, budgets, margins, and cost variances.
* Monitor estimated versus actual costs and identify opportunities to improve cost efficiency and resource utilization.
* Ensure commercial proposals and execution plans are aligned with agreed budgets and business objectives.
* R&D Operations & Process Excellence
* Establish standardized operating processes for lead evaluation, feasibility coordination, costing, quotation management, project initiation, execution reviews, and closure.
* Develop dashboards and reporting mechanisms to track the R&D pipeline, active engagements, timelines, budgets, resource utilization, and commercialization milestones.
* Introduce structured governance and review mechanisms to improve accountability, execution discipline, and operational efficiency.
* Identify gaps in existing workflows and implement SOPs and process improvements to support a scalable R&D operating model.
* Ensure clear ownership of deliverables, dependencies, and decisions across all stakeholders.
* Cross-Functional Stakeholder Management
* Act as a central coordination partner across R&D, Business Development, Procurement, Finance, and manufacturing teams.
* Drive alignment between customer expectations, scientific requirements, commercial commitments, and execution capabilities.
* Facilitate regular reviews to monitor progress, resolve bottlenecks, and maintain delivery commitments.
* Provide leadership with actionable insights on pipeline performance, resource requirements, execution risks, costs, and business outcomes.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related technical discipline.
* An MBA or additional qualification in operations, business management, or supply chain would be an advantage.
* Typically 8–12 years of relevant experience in R&D operations, CDMO/CRDMO, process development, technical program management, or R&D business operations.
* Experience managing customer-facing R&D engagements and/or strategic internal R&D initiatives from development through delivery or commercialization.
* Strong exposure to costing, pricing, procurement coordination, resource planning, and cross-functional execution.
* Experience managing multiple concurrent initiatives, timelines, budgets, stakeholders, and operational dependencies.
* Understanding of process development, scale-up, technology transfer, and manufacturing readiness is highly desirable.

**Preferred Industry Background**

* CDMO / CRDMO
* Specialty chemicals and chemical manufacturing
* Pharmaceutical R&D and API development
* Agrochemicals and crop sciences
* Contract research and process development organizations
* Advanced materials

**Key Skills & Competencies**

* R&D program and portfolio management
* Commercial acumen and business-oriented decision-making
* Lead pipeline and quotation management
* Costing, pricing, and financial analysis
* Procurement and supply chain coordination
* Process development and commercialization coordination
* Cross-functional stakeholder management
* Operational excellence and process standardization
* Data-driven decision-making and problem-solving
* Strong communication, planning, and execution capabilities

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Lead-to-quotation and quotation-to-win conversion rates.
* Timely execution and delivery of customer-funded R&D engagements.
* Accuracy of costing, pricing, budgets, and resource estimates.
* Adherence to agreed timelines and development milestones.
* Cost efficiency and utilization of scientific and laboratory resources.
* Progression of strategic R&D initiatives through scale-up and commercialization.
* Revenue contribution and commercial outcomes from R&D engagements.
* Repeat business and customer satisfaction.
* Effectiveness of cross-functional coordination and R&D operating processes.

title: Collaboration Manager - Advanced Therapies (Bengaluru)
description:
**Job Requirements**
Job Description: Collaboration Manager - Advanced Therapies
  
  
**Role Purpose**
The Collaboration Manager –The role focuses on translating customer and clinical insights into impactful research activities, product improvements, and innovation opportunities.
  
  
The successful candidate will actively engage with key customer sites, support collaboration programs from concept to outcome, and ensure alignment across country teams, global business lines, R&D, and other internal stakeholders. The role also includes driving visibility of collaboration outcomes in the public domain and strengthening long-term strategic partnerships with customers.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with leading clinicians and researchers (institutional and non-institutional) on furthering the field of angiographic imaging science by first understanding the clinical needs and then developing solutions to address those needs.
* Work with clinicians, research, technical, and medical staff, on-site, to support research-related interventional cases. Share clinical workflows to a broader audience within Advanced Therapies (AT) to further procedural knowledge.
* Act as the primary interface between external collaborators and internal stakeholders including business lines, R&D, product management, and country organizations. Work closely with KoLs, physicians and internal teams (including Innovation, Business Line, Sales, Marketing, R&D) to define and execute research studies.
* Work with AT Innovations, R&D (both in Forchheim, Germany), and on-site service personnel to install, learn detailed operation of, and pre-test prototype hardware and software.
* Analyze research data with physicians, and prepare reports, publications, and conference presentations. Promote a culture of generating clinically and scientifically relevant outcomes that are visible through publications, presentations, workshops, and other public scientific channels.
* Drive collaboration programs from initiation through execution, ensuring alignment on goals, milestones, timelines, deliverables, and outcomes. Track budget, milestones, and deliverables throughout the project.
* Work with legal, research, and logistics personnel on (both internally and with academic centers) to develop research agreements that define the required equipment, funding and deliverables for each research project.
* Facilitate strong coordination between local collaboration activities and global headquarters to ensure strategic alignment and sustainable integration. Work with project manager in Forchheim and the site Principal Investigator to define the research protocol for each project.
* Write and present reports to AT Headquarters and Senior management regarding project results and new project ideas from the field. Represent local collaboration activities and outcomes at regional and international forums, including conferences, scientific meetings, and internal review platforms
* Where applicable, work with the regional organization to develop research priorities for strategic partnerships with institutions.
* Continuously monitor technology landscape and evaluate technologies (tech transfer, start-ups, think tanks etc.) for applicability to angiographic systems
* Contribute to scientific marketing initiatives and customer engagement strategies related to collaboration programs and research outcomes
* Ensure close interaction and alignment with R&D and development center teams to connect customer insights with future product and solution development

**Attributes And Skills**
This position may suit you best if you are familiar with what is below, and would like to develop your career with Healthineers
  
  

* Strong customer engagement and relationship management skills with the ability to work effectively across clinical, academic, and business environments
* Excellent collaboration, communication, and stakeholder management capabilities
* Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously and drive execution with attention to detail
* Ability to work independently while also thriving in cross-functional and matrixed teams
* Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset with the ability to translate customer needs into actionable collaboration opportunities
* High level of ownership, follow-through, and accountability
* Comfortable working in a dynamic environment that requires adaptability and proactive engagement
* Proficient knowledge of protocol development and protocol writing to be compliant to scientific rigor is a plus
* Experience in evaluating external technologies for applicability to Siemens Healthineers portfolio.
* Experience in programming and medical image processing including AI programming skills is a plus

**Qualifications And Experience**

* Graduate / Postgraduate qualification in life sciences, biomedical engineering, medical technology, radiology, physics, or a related technical or medical field
* At least 10 years of professional experience in the healthcare industry, medical technology, academic research, or a related field
* Good understanding of academic research settings, healthcare delivery systems, and radiology workflows
* Experience working with hospitals, research institutions, or clinical investigators in a customer-facing or scientific partnership role is highly desirable
* Knowledge of the public or institutional research funding landscape in India is an advantage
* Basic understanding of medical image processing, data analysis methodologies, and emerging AI or machine learning concepts in imaging is desirable
* Strong interest in medical devices, healthcare innovation, and clinical research
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to engage with scientific and non-scientific stakeholders
* Technical understanding of medical imaging, especially 2D and 3D imaging on angiographic systems
* Thorough understanding of clinical workflows in interventional procedures (Cardiology, Interventional and Neuro Radiology, Vascular Surgery). Neuro experience preferred.
* Proficient knowledge in anatomical vasculature as they relate to interventional -ology (brain, liver, heart etc.)
* Proficient knowledge of clinical software and hardware applications available on angiographic systems (Siemens Healthineers, Philips, GE, Canon and United Imaging)
* Proficient knowledge of IQ for image analysis
* Proficient knowledge related to X-ray dose measurements
* Experience with other imaging modalities such as CT (preferred), MR and Ultrasound.
* Willing to travel up to 25-40%

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
  
Why this role matters
  
  
This role offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of customer collaboration, scientific innovation, and product development in one of the most advanced areas of diagnostic imaging. By building strong partnerships and translating real-world clinical needs into innovation opportunities, you will play a meaningful role in shaping the future of Advanced Therapy and improving patient care.

title: Manager – Data Governance & Protection Engineering
description:
**Cyber, Data, and Resilience Practice**
Kroll is seeking a Manager, Data Governance & Protection Engineering to help build and scale a high-performing global delivery capability focused on Data Security Posture Management (DSPM), Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Privacy Operations, and enterprise data governance technologies. This role combines technical leadership, implementation oversight, and offshore team development across enterprise cybersecurity, privacy, and data protection programs.
  
  
This is a client-facing consulting role responsible for leading technical delivery initiatives while helping establish and mature a scalable India-based delivery and engineering capability supporting global client engagements. The ideal candidate will possess strong hands-on experience across multiple governance, privacy, and data protection technology stacks while also demonstrating leadership capabilities in team development, operational scaling, and delivery management.
  
  
You will work closely with cybersecurity, privacy, cloud, infrastructure, and governance leaders to design, implement, integrate, and operationalize enterprise data protection and governance capabilities across complex regulated environments.
  
  
**RESPONSIBILITIES – Leadership & Global Delivery Development**

* Support development and scaling of an India-based delivery and engineering team focused on DSPM, DLP, privacy operations, and governance technology implementation.
* Assist with hiring, mentoring, onboarding, and developing technical practitioners across governance and data protection disciplines.
* Establish delivery standards, implementation methodologies, operational procedures, and reusable technical accelerators.
* Coordinate across global teams to support efficient delivery execution, knowledge transfer, and operational consistency.
* Support resource planning, workstream coordination, and offshore/onshore delivery collaboration models.
* Foster a culture of technical excellence, accountability, innovation, and continuous learning.

**RESPONSIBILITIES – Data Governance & Protection Engineering**

* Lead or support implementation and operationalization of enterprise data governance and protection platforms across cloud, hybrid, and on-premise environments.
* Design and implement governance and protection capabilities including data discovery, classification, DSPM, DLP, retention, access governance, privacy operations workflows, and sensitive data monitoring.
* Support integration of governance and protection tooling into enterprise security, CMDB, GRC, IAM, and IT ecosystems.
* Assist with governance architecture design and operationalization across structured and unstructured data environments.
* Support engineering automation and orchestration initiatives that improve scalability and operational efficiency.

**RESPONSIBILITIES – Privacy Operations & Governance Technology**

* Support operational privacy and governance programs including ROPAs, PIAs/DPIAs, consent management, data subject rights workflows, data mapping, and risk management workflows.
* Lead or support implementation and integration of privacy and governance technologies including OneTrust, BigID, Securiti, ServiceNow, Microsoft Purview, Varonis, Symmetry Systems, Cyera, and Zscaler.
* Assist clients with workflow engineering, governance reporting, operational metrics, and process optimization initiatives.

**RESPONSIBILITIES – Client Engagement & Delivery**

* Lead technical workstreams across data governance, DSPM, DLP, and privacy transformation engagements.
* Conduct technical assessments, architecture reviews, governance maturity evaluations, and implementation planning activities.
* Translate client business, regulatory, privacy, and cybersecurity requirements into scalable technical solutions and operational workflows.
* Participate in stakeholder workshops, architecture discussions, and executive status reporting.
* Ensure high-quality delivery outcomes, documentation standards, and implementation consistency across engagements.
* Support proposals, solution development, staffing discussions, and technical solution positioning.

**RESPONSIBILITIES – Risk, Compliance & Security Alignment**

* Support client alignment to regulatory and industry frameworks including GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, HIPAA, GLBA, NYDFS 500, SEC/FINRA, NIST, and ISO frameworks.
* Assist clients with operationalizing governance and protection controls related to sensitive data protection, retention, access governance, monitoring, and incident response.
* Support development of governance KPIs, risk dashboards, and operational reporting capabilities.

**REQUIREMENTS – Experience**

* 5–8 years of experience in Data Governance, Data Protection, DSPM, DLP, Privacy Operations, Cybersecurity Engineering, GRC Technology, or Technology Consulting.
* Prior consulting experience strongly preferred, ideally within Big 4 consulting, cybersecurity consulting firms, or enterprise technology consulting environments.
* Experience supporting offshore or global delivery models preferred.
* Demonstrated experience leading technical workstreams and mentoring junior technical resources.
* Experience implementing enterprise governance, privacy, or security technologies in regulated environments.

**REQUIREMENTS – Technical Skills**

* Hands-on or advisory experience with governance and protection technologies such as BigID, Securiti, Microsoft Purview, OneTrust, ServiceNow, Varonis, Symmetry Systems, Cyera, Zscaler, and Microsoft DLP.
* Understanding of DSPM architectures, DLP engineering, privacy operations workflows, data classification, lineage, metadata management, CMDB integration, and IAM concepts.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms including AWS, Azure, and GCP.
* Experience with APIs, workflow automation, or governance orchestration capabilities preferred.
* Exposure to Agile, Scrum, Jira, or DevSecOps delivery methodologies preferred.

**Certifications (Preferred)**

* CISSP
* CISM or CRISC
* CIPP/US or CIPP/E
* CDMP
* Microsoft Security or Purview certifications
* ServiceNow certifications
* AWS, Azure, or GCP cloud certifications
* SAFe, Scrum, or Agile certifications

Essential Traits
  
  

* Strong technical leadership and mentoring capabilities.
* Ability to balance strategic governance thinking with hands-on technical delivery.
* Excellent communication skills across technical and executive audiences.
* Strong organizational and delivery management skills.
* Collaborative and client-focused mindset.
* Passion for building scalable governance and protection capabilities.
* Interest in emerging governance, privacy, DSPM, and data protection technologies.

Success Metrics
  
  

* Successful establishment and scaling of offshore governance and protection delivery capabilities.
* High-quality implementation and operationalization of governance, DSPM, DLP, and privacy technology solutions.
* Development of reusable technical accelerators, standards, and methodologies.
* Strong client satisfaction and delivery execution outcomes.
* Team capability growth, technical mentorship, and certification advancement.
* Contributions to scalable cross-functional governance and data protection solutions within the practice.

Project, Client and Commercial Management
