title: Performance Lead - E Commerce (Endemic Ads)
description:
Role - Performance Lead - E Commerce (Endemic Ads)

Experience Required: 8 to 10 years of hands-on experience in E-commerce and Performance Marketing — ideally in a digital agency, a D2C brand, a marketplace-first environment, or a retail media team.

Location: Bangalore

**About the Role**

The Program Manager — E-commerce is the operational and strategic backbone of the Endemic Ads mandate. You will own the end-to-end health of the programme — across seller pipelines, pod performance, campaign outcomes, and client governance — while being the centre of gravity for a team of Pod Leads, Team Leaders, and Ad Consultants.

At the core, you are an E-commerce and Performance Marketing practitioner who can both set strategy and hold the team accountable to executing it. You will work at the intersection of marketplace commerce, seller growth, performance advertising, data-driven decision-making, and people leadership. You understand how online retail ecosystems work — how products are listed, how sellers are activated, how campaigns drive discoverability and sales, and how marketplace metrics translate into real business outcomes for brands.

If you have built and optimised e-commerce programmes on platforms like Flipkart, Amazon, Myntra, or equivalent Indian or global marketplaces — that is a strong advantage.

**What You Will Do**

**Programme Oversight**

* Own the overall health and performance of the Endemic Ads / E-commerce mandate — across all seller accounts, pods, and platform relationships.
* Track programme-level KPIs (seller activation rates, GMV contribution, campaign ROI, revenue targets, SLA adherence) and course-correct when numbers drift.
* Run structured scrums and reviews with Pod Leads; ensure nothing stays stuck at the pod level without escalation.
* Be the first line of accountability between the delivery team and the Account Lead.

**E-commerce Strategy & Seller Growth**

* Own the e-commerce strategy for the mandate — covering catalogue health, pricing competitiveness, content quality, seller onboarding velocity, and marketplace ranking signals.
* Guide sellers on the levers that drive organic discoverability on marketplaces — search rank, ratings, returns, and fulfilment metrics — and align paid advertising to reinforce those signals.
* Identify and activate new seller segments and product categories; work with the pipeline team to prioritise high-potential accounts.
* Advise clients on marketplace-specific levers: A+ content, brand store builds, flash sale participation, deal of the day, and category exclusives.
* Track category-level GMV performance and share of shelf across marketplace platforms; translate these into actionable seller strategies.

**Performance Marketing & Campaign Execution**

* Set the advertising strategy direction for the mandate — campaign structuring, targeting approach, creative guidance, and beta adoption on marketplace ad formats.
* Review and sign off on campaign plans before they go to clients; ensure alignment between client objectives and marketplace execution approach.
* Guide the team on campaign budgeting, pacing, and spend management — including large-budget accounts requiring senior oversight.
* Identify scaling opportunities and efficiency levers across the seller portfolio; push the team to act on insights, not just report them.
* Drive adoption of automation and tech tools across the AdOps team to improve reporting speed and campaign precision.

**Seller & Client Governance**

* Oversee all client-facing reporting — regular and ad hoc — ensuring depth of insight, not just data dumps.
* Lead Monthly, Quarterly, and Half-Yearly Business Reviews; represent the programme's e-commerce and advertising performance with clarity and confidence.
* Manage a portfolio of 4–6 anchor client relationships directly, while holding programme-level visibility on all accounts.
* Partner with the Account Lead on new business pitches — marketplace audits, e-commerce health assessments, and strategic recommendations.

**Seller Pipeline & Activation**

* Oversee the seller outreach, onboarding, catalogue audit, and activation pipeline; ensure the team runs a steady, clean funnel.
* Identify gaps in the pipeline early — stalled activations, catalogue gaps, under-performing sellers, credit blockers — and resolve or escalate decisively.
* Work with Pod Leads to prioritise the seller roster and focus team effort on highest-potential accounts.

**Data, Analysis & Insights**

* Hold the standard for analysis quality across the team — push for insights that drive e-commerce decisions, not vanity metrics.
* Oversee ad hoc deep-dives into campaign performance, category share, and seller health; present findings to clients and internal stakeholders.
* Stay current on marketplace trends, platform algorithm updates, e-commerce policy changes, and competitive activity relevant to the seller portfolio.

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Pod Leads, Team Leaders, and Ad Consultants.
* Own Personal Development Plans (PDPs) for direct reports; track progress and course-correct as needed.
* Build a culture of ownership and accountability in the pods — no postman behaviour, no dependence on escalations for routine decisions.
* Identify hiring needs and support recruitment for the team as the mandate scales.

**What We Are Looking For**

You bring 8+ years of hands-on experience in E-commerce and Performance Marketing — ideally in a digital agency, a D2C brand, a marketplace-first environment, or a retail media team. You understand how online retail works from the inside: listing, ranking, advertising, and sales measurement. You have managed real seller portfolios and advertising budgets, and you know what good looks like.

* Deep understanding of how Indian e-commerce marketplaces work — Flipkart, Amazon, Myntra, Meesho, or similar — including how the seller ecosystem, catalogue requirements, ad formats, and ranking algorithms function.
* Experience managing performance advertising campaigns on marketplace platforms — Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Display, and DSP — with the ability to guide strategy and review execution.
* Understanding of e-commerce metrics that matter: GMV, ROAS, TACOS (Total Advertising Cost of Sale), conversion rate, return rate, share of shelf, and buy-box win rate.
* Proficiency with marketplace tools and dashboards — Flipkart Seller Hub, Amazon Seller Central, Myntra Partner Portal — as well as ad platforms like Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager.
* Proven ability to manage a team of 5–10 people — Pod Leads, Executives, and Analysts — and hold them to outcomes.
* Strong analytical mindset: comfortable building performance narratives from data, not just pulling dashboards.
* Clear, confident communicator — with clients in Business Reviews and with leadership in programme updates.
* Strong project management instincts: you can track multiple workstreams, spot risk early, and drive resolution without waiting to be told.

**What Sets You Apart**

* You have run end-to-end e-commerce programmes — from onboarding a seller and setting up their catalogue through to driving their first sales and scaling their ad spend.
* You understand the full marketplace funnel: discoverability (SEO and ads), conversion (content and pricing), and retention (ratings, reviews, repeat purchase).
* You have managed large advertising spends (₹1 Cr+ per month) across marketplace and non-marketplace channels, and know how to keep pacing, quality, and ROI in balance simultaneously.
* You have built programmes or processes from scratch — scrums, reviews, seller SOPs, reporting cadences — not just inherited them.
* You think in seller outcomes and business growth, not just campaign metrics. You know that a healthy seller catalogue and customer experience drives sustainable ad spend.
* You are comfortable being the "accountability anchor" — the person the team comes to when things are stuck, and the person leadership comes to when they need a clear picture.

Interested Candidates please share your CV at pratiksha.sharma@dentsu.com along with following details

Total years of exp

Current Company

Notice Period

Current CTC

Salary expectations

Current Location

Open to work from Bangalore

title: Program Manager- Product
description:
**We're Hiring: Product Program Manager: Bangalore**

This is a delivery and visibility role, not a roadmap role.

You will be the single person who knows — at any moment, without having to go ask — what is in flight across the Product organisation, what is blocked, what is slipping, and who owes what to whom. You will own the integrity of the process the Product org runs on, chase the loops that would otherwise stay open, and escalate the things that need to move.

You will not own PRDs. You will not own the roadmap. You will not be asked to define what we build. You will be asked to make sure that what we have decided to build actually moves through the system on time, with the right people in the room and the right gates cleared.

If that boundary sounds like a limitation, this is not the role for you. If it sounds like the highest-leverage job in the org, read on.

𝗪𝗛𝗔𝗧 𝗬𝗢𝗨 𝗪𝗜𝗟𝗟 𝗢𝗪𝗡

1️⃣ Jira Workflow Integrity

– Own the health of the ticket lifecycle across the five-stage Product SOP — stage definitions, transition rules, and the bidirectional transition matrix.

– Enforce ticket hygiene: fields complete, stages accurate, ageing tickets surfaced, dead tickets closed.

– Maintain sprint templates and ensure teams actually use them rather than working around them.

– Flag and fix process decay before it becomes invisible. A workflow nobody follows is worse than no workflow.

2️⃣ SME Cadence Framework

– Run the nine-block SME cadence — L1, L2, L3, TAM, Presales, Product, Security, Technical Documentation, and QA & Engineering.

– Own scheduling, agendas, attendance, minutes and action-item closure across all nine blocks.

– Keep the cadence alive. Nine recurring forums decay quietly and fast without someone whose job it is to keep them useful.

– Escalate chronic non-attendance or non-participation to the CPO with evidence, not impressions.

3️⃣ Single Source of Truth

– Maintain the authoritative view of everything in flight across Product — status, owner, stage, dependency, risk.

– Map cross-functional dependencies between Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, Support and Presales, and surface collisions before they land.

– Track slippage against committed dates and make it visible early rather than accurately in hindsight.

– Ensure one version of the truth exists — not a Jira version, a slide version and a corridor version.

4️⃣ Executive Readouts

– Prepare CPO readouts for the MD and CEO — status, risks, decisions needed, asks.

– Work answer-first: the conclusion leads, the evidence follows. This is the house standard for communication and it is not optional.

– Produce release and incident summaries drawn from the Technical Release Meeting Playbook and the incident management framework.

– Ensure exec-facing numbers reconcile to the underlying systems. Every time.

5️⃣ Chase, Escalate, Close

– Own open loops across the org until they are shut. Politely, persistently, and without needing to be reminded.

– Escalate blockers on a defined clock rather than waiting for them to resolve themselves.

– Drive incident and RCA action items to genuine closure — not to "in progress" for six weeks.

– Be the person who asks the uncomfortable follow-up question in the room where it matters.

𝗪𝗛𝗔𝗧 𝗧𝗛𝗜𝗦 𝗥𝗢𝗟𝗘 𝗜𝗦 𝗡𝗢𝗧

Stated plainly, because the boundary is what makes the role work: product judgment stays with the CPO and the Product SMEs. Your leverage is delivery discipline — and in an organisation of this size and speed, that is a full-time job for someone very good.

𝗪𝗛𝗔𝗧 𝗦𝗨𝗖𝗖𝗘𝗦𝗦 𝗟𝗢𝗢𝗞𝗦 𝗟𝗜𝗞𝗘

📍 30 days — You can name every item in flight, its stage, its owner and its risk — without asking anyone.

📍 60 days — All nine SME blocks are running on cadence with published agendas, minutes and closed action items.

📍 90 days — Jira reflects reality. The CPO stops chasing status and starts reading it.

📍 6 months — Slippage is predicted, not discovered. Escalations happen on a clock. Exec readouts are trusted without re-verification.

𝗪𝗛𝗔𝗧 𝗪𝗘'𝗥𝗘 𝗟𝗢𝗢𝗞𝗜𝗡𝗚 𝗙𝗢𝗥

Essential:

✅ 7–12 years in program management, delivery management, technical program management or chief-of-staff roles within a product or engineering organisation.

✅ Non-negotiable: Domain background in CPaaS, telecom, messaging or communications infrastructure. A Program Manager without domain credibility will be ignored by this engineering org within six weeks.

✅ Deep, hands-on Jira administration — workflows, transition schemes, custom issue types, boards and reporting. Not "I have used Jira."

✅ Demonstrated experience running recurring governance forums and keeping them alive past month three.

✅ Track record of driving incident and RCA action items to closure in a production environment.

✅ Answer-first written communication. Executive-grade, evidence-backed, concise.

✅ The spine to escalate to senior stakeholders, and the judgment to know when to.

Desirable:

➕ Exposure to SMS, WhatsApp Business, RCS, Voice or Email channel delivery.

➕ Experience in a multi-geography operating environment (India, Middle East, LATAM).

➕ Familiarity with formal incident management frameworks and severity tiering.

➕ Experience supporting an org through a maturity step-change rather than steady-state operations.

𝗪𝗛𝗢 𝗪𝗜𝗟𝗟 𝗡𝗢𝗧 𝗦𝗨𝗖𝗖𝗘𝗘𝗗 𝗛𝗘𝗥𝗘

❌ Certification-first candidates whose depth begins and ends with a Scrum or PMP credential.

❌ Anyone who needs a mature engineering organisation around them to be effective. Ours is on a deliberate improvement path; you will be part of how it gets there.

❌ Anyone who treats "I sent the follow-up" as the completion of a task.

❌ Anyone who wants this as a stepping stone to a PM role in six months. Say so now and we will part as friends.

𝗪𝗛𝗬 𝗧𝗛𝗜𝗦 𝗥𝗢𝗟𝗘

This is a rare seat. You will sit directly with the CPO, with line of sight across the entire Product organisation and into Engineering, Infrastructure and Support. The operating machinery is newly built and genuinely good — it needs an owner, not an inventor.

The Product org is at an inflection point. The processes exist. The discipline is being built. You will be the person who decides, in practice, whether that discipline holds.

title: Project Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Senior Project Manager, Enterprise Security Program**
**Assistant Director | Global Delivery Services | Information Security | Enterprise Security Program**
**Role aligned to Enterprise Security Program – Information Security Management Services**
**The opportunity**
The Enterprise Security Program is seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead complex, global information security initiatives across EY. This Assistant Director role is designed for a project leader who can connect strategy to execution, bring together cross-functional teams, and drive outcomes that reduce enterprise risk while supporting business value and operational resilience.
  
  
The role sits within Information Security and will support the Enterprise Security Program’s Information Security Management Services Team. It requires strong leadership without direct authority, clear executive communication, and the ability to coordinate across Information Security, Member Firms, Enterprise Technology, Client Technology, vendors, and other stakeholders.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead complex global information security programs and projects from initiation through delivery, ensuring scope, plans, milestones, risks, budgets and outcomes are actively managed.
* Translate enterprise security objectives into clear execution plans that support business value, measurable benefits and risk reduction.
* Coordinate cross-functional and geographically distributed teams across Information Security, Enterprise Technology, Client Technology, Member Firms, vendors and contractors.
* Drive project governance, status reporting, issue escalation and decision-making with senior stakeholders and executive sponsors.
* Develop and manage detailed project plans, timelines, dependencies and RAID items using project management platforms and tools such as MS Project, Azure DevOps, or equivalent tools.
* Identify risks, issues, interdependencies and resource constraints across programs, busy seasons and organizational priorities, and develop pragmatic mitigation plans.
* Facilitate stakeholder alignment by integrating feedback, resolving conflicts and keeping teams focused on shared outcomes.
* Support continuous improvement of security processes, governance practices and delivery methods, including lessons learned and sustainable operating models.
* Mentor and coach project team members, build team engagement, and encourage accountability, collaboration and quality delivery.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
To succeed in this role, you will need to combine information security knowledge, disciplined program delivery, and strong executive presence. The strongest candidates will demonstrate:
  
  

* Technical and security knowledge: Understanding of information security technologies, including cloud, network, perimeter, messaging, endpoint and data security, along with familiarity with security frameworks such as NIST, ISO 27001 and CIS Controls.
* Project management depth: Proven ability to manage complex information security projects, including iterative and waterfall delivery methods, planning, budget management, risk management and stakeholder governance.
* Leadership without authority: Ability to build trusted relationships, motivate teams, establish a shared vision and drive delivery across teams that do not directly report to the role.
* Executive communication: Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to simplify technical matters for non-technical stakeholders and present concise, data-driven updates to senior leadership.
* Stakeholder engagement: Ability to engage executive leadership and key stakeholders, understand competing priorities and negotiate alignment at multiple levels of the organization.
* Risk and issue management: Ability to anticipate delivery risks, assess business impact, make timely recommendations and drive mitigation through structured plans.
* Problem solving: Strong analytical thinking, critical judgment, creativity and conflict-resolution skills in time-sensitive or ambiguous situations.
* Global mindset: Comfort operating across cultures, geographies, Member Firms and organizational structures, including awareness of political, regulatory and commercial factors that may affect delivery.

**To qualify for the role you must have**

* Proven experience leading complex global information security, technology or risk-related programs from initiation to closure.
* Strong understanding of information security technologies and operating environments, including cloud, network, endpoint, messaging and data security domains.
* Experience managing project plans, milestones, risks, issues, dependencies, budgets and executive reporting for complex initiatives.
* Knowledge of security frameworks, standards and risk management methodologies, including NIST, ISO 27001, CIS Controls, or comparable frameworks.
* Experience working with senior stakeholders and executive sponsors, including preparing clear status updates, recommendations and escalation materials.
* Ability to lead cross-functional teams without direct authority and drive outcomes through influence, structure and accountability.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical topics in business terms.
* Experience identifying interdependencies across other programs, operational timelines, business cycles and organizational priorities.
* Ability to operate in a global, matrixed environment with multiple stakeholder groups and competing priorities.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Relevant certifications such as PMP, CISSP, CISM, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience with project management and delivery platforms such as MS Project, Azure DevOps, or similar tools.
* Experience supporting compliance, privacy or regulatory requirements, including Privacy Impact Assessments and GDPR-related considerations.
* Experience improving security processes, practices and governance models in a global enterprise environment.
* Experience supporting security initiatives that align to business strategy, operational resilience and measurable risk reduction.
* Familiarity with vendor and contractor coordination in support of complex technology or security programs.

**What We Look For**
We are looking for a seasoned Information Security project leader who can bring structure to complexity, communicate with clarity, and deliver outcomes through influence. The successful candidate will be comfortable working with senior leaders, global teams and diverse stakeholders; will be able to connect security priorities to business value; and will lead with accountability, sound judgment and a strong focus on execution. This role requires someone who can remain steady during ambiguity, encourage collaboration during challenges, and keep teams aligned to a shared set of goals.
  
  
**What We Offer**
As part of this role, you'll work in a highly integrated, global team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial and social well-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here’s a snapshot of what we offer:
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**HOW YOU'LL SPEND YOUR TIME HERE:**

* Release Operations - Tieing product requirements to execution strategy
* You bring foundational knowledge of how enterprise-scale, customer-facing software products are built, validated, and shipped, and the integration instincts to stay embedded with Engineering and Product at every stage ensuring every release meets the quality and reliability bar that enterprise customers demand
* Engage with product and engineering teams across the full development lifecycle from system design and architecture through code management, branching strategy, QA, and release as a credible technical voice who builds efficient execution plans, catches risk early, and drives resolution before it reaches a gate
* Govern operational AI agentic workflows with the same rigor as the release itself defining what automation owns, where human judgment overrides, and how both are measured against customer-impacting outcomes. You bring a track record of deploying agentic systems that replaced manual program effort and the technical credibility to hold engineering accountable to the same standard across high-stakes, customer-facing delivery
* Model and uphold the quality bar for product requirements.You bring the judgment and influence to partner with Product Management to continuously raise the standard of how requirements are defined, reviewed, and handed off to Engineering

You bring the ability to turn ambiguous business and technical visions into structured, executable plans with clear ownership and measurable outcomes, without waiting for direction.

You bring hands-on experience operating these systems at enterprise scale and the judgment to govern what AI owns versus where human intervention is required.

* 5 - 7 years of related program management experience with a bachelor’s & masters degree in computer engineering, or a related technical field. System design fluency, and the ability to govern AI-augmented operations with authority.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**Who we are**
Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.
  
  
As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.
  
  
**About the role**
As an Engineering Manager, you will drive the successful delivery and execution of projects within your teams. You will manage end-to-end technical planning, ensuring that product requirements are translated into actionable tasks, while orchestrating collaboration between various stakeholders, including engineers, product managers, QA, and UX. This role requires a deep understanding of software design and development and the ability to plan, execute, and deliver product features in a timely and predictable manner. You will also be responsible for maintaining high technical standards, managing team bandwidth, and ensuring project milestones are met with efficiency and accuracy.
  
  
**What you’ll get to do**

* Own end-to-end delivery and execution across cross-functional teams within your product area, ensuring predictable and high-quality outcomes.

* Partner closely with Product Managers, UX Designers, and Engineers to continuously refine, groom, and prioritize the backlog.

* Monitor team velocity and capacity to optimize resource allocation, proactively balancing bandwidth against delivery commitments.
* Coordinate cross-team dependencies and stakeholder alignment to remove bottlenecks and maintain smooth execution.
* Stay hands-on in critical initiatives by guiding design decisions, enforcing sound design patterns, and participating in code reviews to maintain high engineering quality.
* Ensure robust monitoring, alerting, and observability for all owned services, consistently meeting defined SLIs and SLOs.
* Partner with Product Managers to define, track, and publish post-release product metrics, driving transparency and continuous improvement.

**To succeed in this role, you should have**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 8-10 years of experience as a Software Developer, Software Engineer, or in a similar hands-on technical role.
* 5+ years of strong experience building production systems using Java and Spring Boot.
* Minimum 3 years of proven engineering leadership experience managing high-performing teams.
* Solid grasp of Agile methodologies, including sprint planning, backlog grooming, and iterative delivery.
* Demonstrated ability to translate complex product requirements into well-structured EPICs, user stories, and tasks.
* Strong backend engineering expertise; exposure to frontend technologies is a plus.
* Experience with project planning and tracking tools to visualize and manage delivery timelines.
* Familiarity with engineering, product health metrics, and monitoring tools to drive data-informed decisions.
* Hands-on capability to debug complex production issues, lead incident response, and conduct blameless RCA.
* Good understanding of modern deployment practices, including CI/CD pipelines, release management, and associated metrics.
* Ability to drive alignment across cross-functional stakeholders, both technical and non-technical.
* Excellent risk management, dependency tracking, and stakeholder communication skills.
* Proven track record of improving team velocity, delivery predictability, and engineering excellence.

**Generic Skills**

* Problem-solving: Ability to assess complex problems, find solutions, and make sound decisions.
* Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, including technical documentation and stakeholder reporting.
* Adaptability: Able to thrive in a fast-paced, changing environment, adjusting strategies as needed.
* Attention to Detail: Meticulous in documenting technical requirements and ensuring all aspects of a project are accounted for.

**Supervisory skills**

* Team Management: Experience in managing and mentoring engineers, ensuring team growth and performance.
* Resource Allocation: Ability to assess bandwidth and manage resource distribution to optimize team performance.
* Feedback: Conduct regular performance reviews, providing constructive feedback and fostering a growth-oriented environment.
* Stakeholder Management: Lead project status reviews, manage expectations, and ensure smooth communication between teams and leadership.

**What we can offer you**

* Culture - We put our people first and prioritize the well-being of every team member. We’ve built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.
* Learning - We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks.
* Compensation - You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, paid leave, plus other benefits.

**What to expect in the hiring process**

* A preliminary phone call with one of our recruiters.
* A live coding and code review session.
* A system design and technical discussion round.
* A project planning, execution, and product thinking round.
* A behavioral and technical interview with the hiring manager.

* Direct experience managing component risk analysis (single/sole-sourced parts) and driving contract manufacturer (CM) accountability.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Proven ability to operate autonomously and resolve complex operational escalations in a fast-paced, matrixed technical environment.

* Experience leading early supplier/commodity engagement forums to align engineering technology requirements with procurement strategies.

title: Technical Program Manager, Google Search Platforms
description: Minimum qualifications:Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.5 years of experience leading technical program management initiatives and delivering infrastructure solutions.Preferred qualifications:Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.8 years of dedicated experience in a technical program manager role.Deep domain expertise in backend infrastructure, distributed systems, evaluation systems, or testing frameworks.Experience or strong interest in leveraging modern AI/ML capabilities, Large Language Models (LLMs), and agentic workflows to modernize Technical Program Manager (TPM) functions (e.g., automated dependency tracking, predictive risk modeling, and operational streamlining).Proven track record of driving cross-functional alignment, managing distributed teams across multiple time zones, and prioritizing complex workstreams amidst ambiguity.About The JobA problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.The Search Serving Infrastructure (SSI) team is at the heart of Google Search. Our mission is to provide a reliable, highly efficient, and performant serving framework that powers the Search ecosystem handling billions of queries a day. We address massive-scale engineering challenges, from reducing latency and CPU/TPU capacity footprints to driving large-scale architectural simplification efforts (like deprecating legacy monolithic servers in favor of modern, scalable services).In Google Search, we're reimagining what it means to search for information – any way and anywhere. To do that, we need to solve complex engineering challenges and expand our infrastructure, while maintaining a universally accessible and useful experience that people around the world rely on. In joining the Search team, you'll have an opportunity to make an impact on billions of people globally.ResponsibilitiesScope, shape, and lead large-scale programs spanning multiple engineering tracks. Co-develop strategies, goals, and success metrics for the broader organization.Perform technical assessments to evaluate engineering scope, establish milestones, define timeframes, and assess resourcing needs. Demonstrate technical judgment equivalent to a practicing Software Engineer in the infrastructure domain.Identify, anticipate, and manage risks, deliverables, and interdependencies across different Search Platforms and partner teams. Build mechanisms to optimize governance and information flow.Drive continuous optimizations in operational cadence, tooling, and communication, minimizing process friction while fostering development velocity and quality.Advocate alignment across disparate teams with differing objectives. Guide and influence cross-functional peers, driving consensus for technical directions and prioritizing features against constraints.Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

title: Associate Director - Global Study Lead
description: The Global Study Lead will lead the planning and delivery of a global clinical study and work with cross-functional teams across clinical development, data management, safety, regulatory and external partners. title: Continuous Improvement & Delivery Manager
description:
The Opportunity
  
  
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
  
  
As a Continuous Improvement & Delivery Manager, you will play a pivotal role in our Data and Analytics team, focusing on leveraging advanced analytical techniques to extract insights from large datasets and drive data-driven decision-making. Within our Internal Firm Services practice, you will utilize your skills in data manipulation, visualization, and statistical modeling to support clients in solving complex business problems and optimizing their operations to achieve strategic goals.
  
  
As a Manager, you will enhance your leadership style by motivating, developing, and inspiring others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching and leveraging team members' unique strengths while managing performance to meet client expectations. You will lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values meaningfully. Embracing technology and innovation, you will validate the successful planning, budgeting, execution, and completion of projects, encouraging others to develop skills outside their comfort zones.
  
  
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will analyze and identify the interactions between system components, address conflicts or issues, and uphold professional and technical standards. Your growing business knowledge will help identify opportunities that contribute to the success of our firm.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Drive service performance uplift across Tech Hub, using operational data, service insights, stakeholder feedback, and customer experience measures to identify improvement opportunities
* Move beyond service level objective monitoring by identifying root causes, shaping improvement plans, and embedding sustainable uplift in service outcomes
* Apply Lean process improvement methods to simplify ways of working, reduce waste, improve flow, and strengthen operational effectiveness
* Embed process and capability uplift across teams by supporting adoption, coaching stakeholders, and reinforcing improved ways of working
* Track Tech Hub Leadership Team deliverables for leadership-sponsored initiatives, Apply project management disciplines to plan, coordinate, track, and report on improvement initiatives, including milestones, risks, dependencies, decisions, and outcomes.
* Prepare clear reporting, insights, and recommendations that demonstrate service performance trends, improvement progress, and realised uplift including actions, dependencies, risks, decisions, progress, and outcomes

What You Must Have
  
  

* Any Graduate
* At least 8-14 years of experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart
  
  

* Lean process improvement qualifications and demonstrated experience applying Lean methods in an operational or technology environment
* Experience leading process improvement and customer experience initiatives that improve service outcomes and ways of working
* Experience driving service performance uplift beyond service level objective monitoring, including root cause analysis, improvement planning, and benefit tracking
* Proven ability to embed uplift in both process and capability through adoption planning, stakeholder coaching, communications, and reinforcement of improved ways of working
* Understanding of risk and controls in process improvement, including the ability to identify control impacts, manage operational risks, and embed sustainable and well-controlled improvements
* Experience leading or coordinating a small team, including setting priorities, coaching team members, and ensuring delivery quality
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate operational, service performance, and customer experience data into clear insights and actions
* Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to work with Technology teams, governance stakeholders, business partners, and service owners
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders and create transparency on progress, risks, dependencies, decisions, and delivery outcomes for leadership-sponsored initiatives
* Strong project management skills, including the ability to plan initiatives, manage milestones, coordinate stakeholders, track dependencies, escalate risks, and report progress against outcomes
* Ability to prepare clear reporting, insights, recommendations

**Job location -**
Only Bangalore

title: Product Lifecycle Management Consultant
description:

TE Energy offers a wide range of reliable and cost-effective products for the electrical power industry. Our position as a leading supplier of electrical components enables us to design next-generation products. For over 60 years, we have worked closely with our customers around the globe to develop innovative solutions to ever-changing challenges, known under names such as, Bowthorpe EMP, Crompton Instruments, Raychem, Simel, Kries, Harger and Richard Manufacturing

Project Manager Engineer is responsible for driving Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) activities for Energy BU. * Develop and implement PLM and data management processes, tools, methods, and standards.
* Lead and coordinate medium‑complexity projects related to PLM, environmental compliance, and data management.
* Prepare process documentation and deliver training to support PLM initiatives.
* Represent the Business Unit in Digital Part Management and Digital Marketing discussions.
* Act as engineering release and change management process owner for the BU.
* Drive engineering systems and application rollouts, manage risks, and negotiate trade‑offs to meet project goals.

* 5 years’ experience working in/with engineering
* Solid understanding of Engineering tools, Engineering Change Management, Bill of Materials
* Knowledge of Creo and PDM-Link
* Data Analysis, Data mining and reporting experience
* Excellent in English (verbal/written)
* Excellent communication, presentation skills
* Excellent in MS office, excel, PowerPoint
* Critical thinking, problem solving
* Experience leading global teams, including matrix assignment
* Flexible, result oriented, goal driven, team player

title: Managing Consultant - Endur Technical
description:
**Managing Consultant – Endur Functional**

**Locations:**
India (Remote)

**Role:**
Permanent/Full Time

**About the role**

We are currently growing our ETRM/CTRM Endur practice and are looking for experienced Managing Endur Consultants with expertise in Commodity or Energy markets and Trading and Risk Management System Implementations. You will be leading the implementation/upgrade of Endur, bringing SME knowledge in deal modelling, deal valuations, risk management, scheduling, invoicing, and accounting for commodities and energy. You will ensure successful project delivery, employing consultancy and project management best practices. In addition, you will be supporting the growth of capSpire’s Energy and Commodities consulting practice area.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Provide strategic advisory services to clients on the implementation of Endur Gas, Power, Renewables, LNG, Agriculture or Crude and Refined Products upgrades or implementations.
* Serve as the subject matter expert for Endur for all functional aspects for both physical products & derivatives.
* Collaborate with clients and prospects to determine business requirements and processes to be addressed by key areas of the Endur solution, with the ability to identify improvement potential and drive change management.
* Lead functional implementation work, encompassing design, configuration, functional testing, and support transition to operations of Endur solution.
* Demonstrate in-depth knowledge in key modules of Endur and in commodity/energy operations, financial products, risk management, and accounting.
* Document business requirements, implementation designs, test plans/results and other deliverables required by the project.
* Follow implementation best practices, documentation standards, and resolution process flow for all project deliverables.
* Collaborate with technical teams to create customisations based on specific client needs.
* Provide industry and functional advisory as needed.
* Apply appropriate resourcing techniques given project-specific needs, risks, and differences in core project team member skill levels and relevant modules to be delivered in client projects.
* Maintain highly effective communication with client and internal stakeholders and adept in handling business changes and managing stakeholder expectations.
* Provide guidance and training on Endur functionality and general ETRM/CTRM topics.
* Support development and growth of junior consultants.

**Skills**
:

* Endur Modules: Deep knowledge in key modules of Endur and commodity/energy operations with working knowledge of V19 and above.
* Endur Risk Management: Knowledge of Endur risk and valuation functionality including results (MTM, PnL, VAR), and EOD automation (TPM and Services Manager).
* Endur Customisation: Deep knowledge of standard and customisation approaches for implementation of requirements, support for reporting, building complex desktops, APM pages, and pre/post-processing logic.
* Endur Architecture: Understanding of Endur architecture and best implementation practices to optimize its strengths for the client solution.
* Functional Knowledge: Strong functional knowledge and understanding of Gas, Power, Renewables, LNG or Crude and Refined Products.
* Excellent interpersonal skills and stakeholder management.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Multi-tasking and Project Management skills.
* Strong organisational & analytical skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, detailed oriented environment and work independently or in a team.

**Required Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in finance, Accounting, Engineering, Economics, or equivalent experience in a related field
* 7+ years hands-on with Endur as a lead / principal consultant or team lead / project manger with working knowledge of V19 and above.
* At least 10+ years of industry work experience with 3+ years of experience in comparable consulting services.
* Should have been a key part of at least two large engagements for Endur end-to-end implementation or upgrade projects in Gas, Power, Renewables, LNG or Crude and Refined Products.
* Deep understanding of various functional areas and relevant modules of Endur.
* Experience in conducting comprehensive testing and quality assurance activities to validate the functionality, performance, and reliability of Endur solutions.
* Worked as part of a cross-cultural/geographical team including flexibility to support multiple time zones when necessary.
* Worked as part of a project team structure and delivered results with limited guidance.
* Ability to travel to onsite client locations for limited time as per project requirement.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Subject matter expert or functional consultant in Commodity Trading, Risk or Logistics business areas in large enterprise environments.
* Worked in Front, Middle or Back Office functions with specialty in any of the following: Trading (Paper, Physical), Risk (Market, Credit, Operational, Compliance, etc.), Logistics (Pipeline, Vessel, Nomination through Demurrage, etc.) or Settlements (AR/AP Process, Invoice Management, etc.).
* Experience with Endur gMotion or cMotion modules would be advantageous.

**What to expect as a capSpire consultant**

As part of a capSpire team, you’ll experience the full project life cycle and be part of a dynamic team in which diversity, camaraderie and professional excellence are celebrated. We like to have fun as a team, encourage knowledge sharing and continuous learning and take pride in delivering the best possible outcomes for our clients.

**In addition, we offer:**

* Gender Neutral Policy
* Equal Opportunity provider
* Extensive Medical benefits covering family and parents
* Health & Wellness plans
* Flexible work hours
* Remote working
* Generous Leaves option & Time-offs
* Employee Assistance Policies
* Annual Retreats

If you think you have the necessary skills and experience to excel as a capSpire Consultant, we are keen to speak with you.

title: Dy. Commercial Project Manager
description:
**Hello Visionary!**
We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make an outstanding addition to our vibrant team. Siemens Mobility is an independent run company of Siemens AG. Its core business includes rail vehicles, rail automation and electrification solutions, turnkey systems, intelligent road traffic technology and related services. In Mobility, we help our customers meet the need for hard-working mobility solutions. We’re making the lives of people who travel easier and more enjoyable while constantly developing new, intelligent mobility solutions!
  
  
**We are looking for Dy. Commercial Project Manager**
As a Dy. Commercial Project Manager, you will support the project to drive profitable project execution, manage working capital of the project, control the project’s costs and manage risk, prepare project forecast, review the project at periodic intervals and present the project progress to management on time to time basis.
  
  
**You’ll make a difference by**

* Active Customer Relationship Management. Proactively communicate with customers’ commercial representatives and manage solving of commercial issues.
* Checking that the overall project's contractual structure has been correctly created in the respective commercial tools
* Cross-Company coordination- Assurance of the correctness, consistency and transparency of the overall project's financial status
* Coordination of legal, fiscal and insurance subjects between the Siemens companies involved
* Consolidation and analysis of project figures across all company boundaries and accounting units
* Managing internal and external claims between all possible stakeholders
* Reporting- Responsible for summarizing global reporting to the relevant Management level
* Documentation in line with the mandatory internal and external requirements
* Project-internal- Managing commercial and legal subjects in the project
* Collaboration with the Project Manager in terms of the project's strategic orientation and its respective internal and external communication. Support the Project Manager to achieve the financial results according to set targets, managed with due professional care and optimize the project gross profit, cash flow and assets and financing instruments.
* Adherence to fiscal, commercial law and company-internal rules
* Commercial project coordination (e.g. application for and follow-up of bank guarantees, insurances, etc.) as well as coordination of legal, fiscal and insurance subjects
* Order entry calculation, concurrent costing and final costing. Ensure correct allocation and monitoring of costs.
* Asset and cash flow management - Optimize operating working capital throughout the project lifecycle to ensure positive free cash flow
* Preparation of invoices and follow-up of claims
* Project-internal controlling (deadlines, costs, quality)
* Regular project reporting / project status meetings / milestone reviews
* Involves in the creation of final project reports and summarization of lessons learned with feedback to the organization
* Overall handling of fiscal, currency-related aspects and insurance subjects, involving the department responsible and taking into consideration internal business models
* Steers the project's supply chain incl. procurement, delivery and ECC
* Calculation of Price Variations based on escalation formulae as per application indices and ensuring claim realization from customers and to vendors.
* Ensure the accuracy of project books and records and keeping our systems updated, e.g. SAP and ensure compliance with Financial Reporting Guidelines
* Contract management- Wording of the commercial and legal contractual conditions with customers, consortium members and subcontractors
* Involved in negotiations as well as interpretation and implementation of contracts in projects
* Analysis and assessment of complex, where applicable international contract constellations
* Drive Contract management throughout the project delivery phase including proactive opportunity and claim management strategies to maximize the project outcome.
* Risk, Claim and change order management
* Ascertain own claims from customers including Extension of Time Compensation and prevention of unjustified claims from vendors.
* Agreement on contractual amendments regarding the scope of supplies and services, prices, deadlines or other contractually stipulated conditions

title: Senior Program Manager – Retail Programs (Private Label)
description:
**About PlayShifu:**

PlayShifu is one of the fastest growing toy companies from India. We operate in 30+ countries and work with some of the biggest retailers in the world. Our private label and sourcing business with large US retailers is scaling quickly. We're looking for a program leader who can take products from design brief to the shelf, on time and to spec.

**The Role:**

You will own end-to-end delivery of private label programs for our key US big-box retail partners. You'll be the single point of contact for the retailer's cross-functional teams: Sourcing, Product Development, Quality, Packaging and Logistics. Internally, you'll drive PlayShifu's design, packaging, quality and operations teams so that every deliverable lands on time and to spec. You will run each program from product shortlisting to PO release, production and shipment.

**What you'll do:**

***Program & timeline management***

* Build and run the Time & Action (TnA) plan for every program, working backwards from retailer calendars. It covers design freeze, tooling, T0/T1/T2, packaging, testing, production, inspections and ship dates.
* Lead weekly calls with retailer Sourcing, Quality and Logistics teams. Publish status updates and escalate risks early.
* Hold internal teams accountable to TnA milestones, and flag dependencies and delays before they become misses.

***Product development***

* Manage the retailer's PD portal: create product IDs, track design feedback and revisions, and coordinate sample requests and timelines with internal teams against retailer ETDs.
* Work with our Toy Design team so that every feedback loop closes within the agreed timelines.
* Consolidate documentation from internal teams, including BOM, measurements, claims and Manufacturing Variability. Get it submitted and approved on time.

***Packaging***

* Translate the retailer's structural packaging guidelines and feedback into clear briefs and deadlines for our internal packaging team.
* Consolidate all packaging content (copy, claims, warnings, specs, imagery) from internal teams and submit it to the retailer.
* Lead the retailer-side proofing process with the retailer's artwork agency. Review soft and hard proofs for UPC/EAN, regulatory copy, battery instructions and font requirements, and route corrections through the internal packaging team.

***Quality & compliance***

* Track testing, inspection and audit milestones (DUPRO, FRI, TOP, quality and responsible sourcing audits) against the TnA. Work through the internal quality and operations teams, who manage labs, inspection agencies and factories.
* Act as the retailer's point of contact on quality and compliance. Make sure that issues, corrective actions and approvals are closed on time.
* Represent PlayShifu in placement and production-readiness reviews alongside the operations and quality team.

***Systems & costing***

* Work with the operations team's systems & item setup function to keep vendor portal data (costing, item setup, case pack, vendor order points, factory mapping) accurate and consistent with what's been agreed with the retailer.
* Track item-wise progress from costing to PO release, and flag gaps or delays that could hold up a business award or PO.
* Support cost submissions and cost-change management, working with the Head of Sales.

**What we're looking for:**

* 8–12 years in program management, merchandising or sourcing for consumer products. Toys, juvenile, hardlines or seasonal/outdoor preferred.
* Hands-on experience delivering private label programs for US big-box retailers. Buying house, sourcing agency, export house or vendor-side experience is ideal.
* Working knowledge of retailer vendor portals, product development workflows, packaging development and product compliance and testing. You need enough depth to review the work and challenge it. Hands-on vendor management is not required.
* Proven ability to drive cross-functional teams without direct authority. You set the timelines, hold teams accountable and escalate early.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication. You'll be the face of PlayShifu to senior retailer stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail, comfort with structured trackers, and the ability to run several programs in parallel.
* Willingness to work with a US time-zone overlap, and to travel occasionally to retailer offices and production-readiness reviews.

**Why join us:**

* Visibility and ownership from day one, working directly with leadership.
* A fast-growing business with some of the world's largest retailers as partners.
* Freedom to build processes for a program that is set to scale significantly.

title: Technical Program Manager
description:
**Overview**
Are you excited about Artificial Intelligence (AI) and what it can do to transform our day-to-day processes and activities? Join the Trust & Integrity Protection team and help shape the future of Digital Asset compliance automation at scale.
  
  
As Microsoft deploys new AI agents and AI-enabled technology to transform Digital Asset review processes, we need dedicated ownership for the performance, quality, and continuous improvement of these capabilities.
  
  
As an AI Solution PM, Compliance Automation, you will oversee the health and effectiveness of AI agents supporting Digital Asset reviews, identify new AI automation opportunities, and create proof cases that can progress to full production deployment. You will partner with domain experts, compliance stakeholders, operations teams, engineering, and vendors to translate changing risk signals into agent improvements so review coverage continues to grow and quality continues to improve.
  
  
This role is a Technical Program Management opportunity based in Bangalore, India. The role requires strong program management fundamentals, data-driven decision making, technical judgment, stakeholder influence, and the ability to manage cross-functional work with minimal guidance across multiple features, workflows, and compliance risk areas.
  
  
Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day, we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own program execution for AI-enabled Digital Asset review capabilities, including agent performance monitoring, issue triage, quality improvement planning, and readiness for launch and post-launch operations.
* Define and maintain success criteria, key performance indicators (KPIs), operational metrics, and telemetry needed to measure AI agent coverage, accuracy, review velocity, quality, risk reduction, and customer experience.
* Partner with risk domain experts to translate emerging risk signals, policy changes, and review findings into clear business requirements, evaluation criteria, backlog items, and prioritized improvement plans.
* Identify new AI and automation opportunities across the Digital Asset review lifecycle, develop hypotheses, evaluate feasibility and impact, and create proof cases that demonstrate readiness for production deployment.
* Coordinate cross-functional work across engineering, risk, compliance, operations, vendor teams, and business stakeholders to deliver improvements on schedule while managing dependencies, risks, tradeoffs, and stakeholder communications.
* Drive data-informed prioritization by analyzing review outcomes, agent performance trends, false positives, false negatives, escalations, feedback, and operational bottlenecks to recommend improvements that increase coverage and quality.
* Support solution design and implementation planning for multiple AI-enabled features or functional areas, ensuring requirements are clear, measurable, and aligned to privacy, security, Responsible AI, and business expectations.
* Develop and manage experimentation, testing, validation, and rollout plans for agent enhancements, including acceptance criteria, go/no-go recommendations, change management, documentation, and operational handoff.
* Create clear documentation, reporting, and stakeholder-ready narratives that explain agent performance, risks, opportunities, launch readiness, and business impact to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Contribute to program management best practices for compliance automation, including repeatable mechanisms for intake, prioritization, quality review, production readiness, operational support, and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications**
Required Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, Program Management, Compliance, Risk Management, or a related field AND 4+ years of experience in technical program management, product/program management, compliance technology, automation, operations, or related work; OR equivalent experience.
* Experience managing cross-functional technical programs, including requirements definition, prioritization, execution planning, dependency management, risk management, and stakeholder communications.
* Experience using data, metrics, KPIs, dashboards, or telemetry to evaluate program or product performance and drive measurable improvements.
* Experience working with AI, automation, workflow tooling, compliance systems, governance processes, or technology-enabled operations.
* Ability to translate ambiguous inputs into clear business requirements, success criteria, experiments, and implementation plans.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical and compliance concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with AI agents, machine learning evaluation, prompt or agent quality assessment, model performance monitoring, automated testing, or production readiness for AI-enabled solutions.
* Experience supporting compliance functions, governance, or risk management.
* Experience developing proof-of-concept or proof-case work and converting validated opportunities into production-ready solutions.
* Experience with reporting and workflow tools such as Power BI, Excel, Power Automate, Azure DevOps, or similar systems used to manage backlogs, metrics, and operational performance.
* Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders, resolve ambiguity, manage tradeoffs, and drive alignment across engineering, operations, compliance, and business teams.

Join the Equities Operations Transformation Team in India and help shape how the Equity Derivatives business manages risk globally. As a Project Manager/Business Analyst within the Equities Operations Transformation Team, you will lead the design, testing, and implementation of a strategic risk management system for the Equity Derivatives business globally. You will partner closely with Operations, Technology, Product Development, and Front Office to translate business needs into controlled, scalable delivery. You will provide cross-regional coverage on an 11:30 pm–7:30 am IST shift, with flexibility for stretch hours as required.

* Deliver a multi-year, complex risk management system migration for the Equity Derivatives business.
* Scope current-state workflows and define project boundaries, milestones, and outcomes.
* Elicit business requirements across trade capture, trade lifecycle management, and related processes.
* Analyze operational and technical issues to identify root causes and propose actionable solutions.
* Document requirements, process flows, and control impacts clearly for global stakeholders.
* Adopt agile ways of working to drive continuous improvement in efficiency, control, and user experience.
* Drive testing execution, defect triage, and timely remediation in a controlled manner.
* Partner with Operations, Technology, Product Development, and Front Office to align on delivery and decisions.
* Provide regular updates, risks, and dependencies to maintain engagement across the project lifecycle.
* Own assigned initiatives end-to-end while operating effectively with minimal supervision.
* Ensure delivery quality in a high-pressure, rapidly changing environment.

Required qualifications, capabilities and skills:
  
  

* Demonstrate strong knowledge of Equity Derivatives products, front-to-back processes, and system infrastructure.
* Apply hands-on experience with risk management systems, including trade capture, trade management, and lifecycles.
* Leverage business analysis, data analysis, and problem-solving skills to address operational and technical issues.
* Communicate exceptionally well in writing and verbally to build trust across regions and functions.
* Operate as a self-motivated contributor who delivers effectively with minimal supervision.
* Practice agile methodologies, design thinking, and structured problem solving in delivery.
* Bring 10+ years of investment banking experience (Middle Office/Trade Support/Project Management) and a degree in Finance/Economics (or related).

Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills:
  
  

* Lead global, cross-functional deliveries spanning Operations and Technology stakeholders.
* Demonstrate strong project governance, RAID management, and stakeholder influence across senior audiences.

* Exhibit deep understanding of trade lifecycle controls, operational risk, and change management impacts.
* Strengthen delivery through structured test strategy, UAT coordination, and defect management discipline.
* Maintain resilience and decision-making quality under tight timelines and shifting priorities.
* Developing experience using AI-powered analytics, workflow automation, or intelligent process tools to drive efficiency gains, reduce manual effort, or improve accuracy in operational processes.

title: SoC Program Manager
description:
CScale is building the interconnect for gigawatt-scale AI. As AI scale-up moves toward deployments spanning thousands of accelerators and dozens of racks, the network needs to deliver high bandwidth, predictable low latency, and continuous communication. CScale is building integrated optical interconnect designed for this new scale, enabling accelerators to work together like a single, much larger computer. But at this scale, performance is only part of the challenge. Optical failures are inevitable, and the system needs to keep running. CScale is designing the interconnect for continuity.
**Lasers will fail. Compute shouldn’t.**
The ambition is simple:
**Build AI interconnect you can take for granted.**
CScale came out of stealth in September 2026 with $145 million in Series C funding, bringing total funding to $188 million.
  
  
**Role And Responsibilities**

* Be the primary point of contact for SoC program execution, and own the end-to-end plan from concept to release to manufacturing: architecture, IP, RTL, verification, physical design, DFT, tapeout, bring-up, validation, qualification and sampling.
* Build the integrated plan across SoC and chiplet/multi-die design, hardware, firmware, software, foundry, packaging, test and QA.
* Set milestones, phase gates and the critical path (spec freeze, RTL freeze, netlist and timing signoff, tapeout readiness) with engineering leads, and own the gate reviews.
* Front-end: Drive RTL milestones and the RTL change-control process, track lint/CDC/RDC and DFT closure, and own verification closure (coverage, regression health, bug burn-down).
* Physical design: Drive floorplan, bump map, timing and power convergence, IR/EM and signoff, and coordinate netlist, constraint, IP-view and package handoffs across FE, PD, analog and packaging.
* Emulation: Own the emulation and FPGA prototyping plan, and make sure results feed back into RTL and firmware before tapeout.
* SW interfacing: Keep hardware and software aligned on register map, memory map, boot flow and driver/firmware interfaces, and track SW readiness for bring-up.
* Dependencies: Maintain a cross-team dependency tracker with owners and dates, resolve blockers, and escalate with options and a recommendation.
* Manage IP vendors (SerDes, PCIe/Ethernet/UCIe, processor cores, PHYs), the foundry and OSAT partners, holding them to delivery and quality commitments.
* Manage scope, schedule, budget, MPW/mask and resource plans, and drive decisions when they change.
* Identify technical and schedule risks early (IP maturity, timing, power, area, package co-design, test coverage), drive mitigation, and escalate.
* Define program health metrics and build the executive dashboards (bug burn-down, coverage, timing and power convergence, bring-up status).
* Own sample readiness and release-to-manufacturing criteria with engineering and operations, including ATE test, yield and silicon characterization.
* Run the program cadence across global sites and establish program management processes and tools as CScale moves into production.

**Skills And Knowledge**

* Strong technical program management: integrated scheduling, critical path ownership, driving issues to closure.
* Working knowledge of the full SoC flow: architecture, IP integration, RTL, verification (UVM, formal, emulation), physical design, STA, DFT, tapeout, post-silicon validation and qualification.
* Enough technical depth to engage engineers on PPA, IP configuration, clocking/reset, power domains and package co-design tradeoffs.
* Familiarity with emulation platforms, firmware/software bring-up, and high-speed interfaces (PCIe, Ethernet, UCIe, SerDes).
* Leads matrixed teams through influence, decides well with incomplete information, and communicates clearly with engineers and executives.
* Proficient with scheduling and tracking tools (MS Project, Jira, Notion).
* Bonus: reliability qualification (JEDEC/AEC), production test, yield ramp.

**Required Experience**

* 12+ years in semiconductor product development, including 7+ years leading SoC/ASIC programs, with earlier hands-on engineering experience.
* Has driven multiple SoC programs from concept through tapeout and release to manufacturing, ideally on advanced nodes.
* Experience managing IP vendors, foundries and OSAT partners, and leading programs across global teams.
* Startup or first-generation product experience.
* B.Sc. or higher in EE, Computer Engineering, Physics or a related field.
* Bonus: chiplet/multi-die and advanced packaging (2.5D/3D), silicon photonics or optical engine programs, high-speed connectivity products.

title: Site Strategy & Operations Program Manager (MBA, 8+ Years Experience)
description:
WD is building the infrastructure behind the AI-driven data economy.

As AI scales, so does data. Every interaction, every model, every system generates data that must be stored, managed, and made accessible over time. That’s where we come in.

We combine deep engineering expertise with global-scale manufacturing to deliver the storage systems that make AI possible, powering hyperscale data centers, cloud platforms, and enterprise infrastructure worldwide.

This isn’t theoretical work. It’s real systems, at real scale, people solving some of the hardest challenges in technology today.

We’re looking for people who want to build, solve, and operate at that level.

Join us and let’s shape the future of data.

**Job Description**

**Overview**

India site Strategy & Operations Lead will partner closely with India site leadership to drive global strategic priorities, operational excellence, employee engagement, and cross-functional, cross-geo initiatives.

This role will serve as a key connector between site leadership, employees, functional teams, compliance, employee relations, external partners, and cross-site/global stakeholders. The individual will translate leadership priorities into actionable programs, establish strong operating rhythms, and ensure effective execution across multiple initiatives.

The ideal candidate will be a highly collaborative and trusted business partner who can operate effectively across functions, build strong relationships with employees and leaders, manage complex programs, and drive execution in a matrixed environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategy & Operational Execution**

* Partner with India leadership to translate global business priorities and strategic objectives into actionable plans and measurable outcomes.
* Lead and manage site-level strategic programs and operational initiatives from planning through execution and narrative building.
* Establish operating mechanisms, governance routines, dashboards, and progress reviews to ensure timely execution.
* Identify operational gaps, risks, and opportunities and drive appropriate corrective actions.

**Employee Engagement & Organizational Effectiveness**

* Lead site level employee engagement initiatives and programs that strengthen employee connection, inclusion, collaboration, innovation and organizational culture.
* Lead and support Employee Resource Group (ERG) programs and initiatives.
* Build strong, positive relationships and communication channels with employees across the organization.

**Executive Leadership Support & Communication**

* Prepare executive-level updates, business reviews, presentations, dashboards, and status reports for India and cross-site leadership.
* Provide leadership with clear visibility into key initiatives, risks, milestones, employee engagement, and operational performance.
* Support leadership meetings by coordinating agendas, actions, decisions, and follow-through.

**Budget & Vendor Management**

* Manage budgets associated with assigned programs, and site-level activities.
* Partner with Finance and Procurement to ensure appropriate budget planning, approvals, and spend governance.
* Manage external vendors and service providers, including scope, performance, deliverables, and commercial coordination.

**Qualifications**

* **MBA degree required.**
* **8+ years of experience in site strategy, business operations, program management, site operations, or a related field.**
* Strong experience managing complex, cross-functional programs in a large or matrixed organization.
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to influence without direct authority.
* Experience working across multiple sites, functions, and geographies.
* Strong understanding of employee engagement, organizational effectiveness, and workplace operations.
* Experience partnering with Employee Relations, Compliance, Legal, or similar functions.
* Strong project management, problem-solving, and execution skills.
* Strong budget and vendor management capabilities

**Additional Information**

WD thrives on the power and potential of diversity. As a global company, we believe the most effective way to embrace the diversity of our customers and communities is to mirror it from within. We believe the fusion of various perspectives results in the best outcomes for our employees, our company, our customers, and the world around us. We are committed to an inclusive environment where every individual can thrive through a sense of belonging, respect and contribution.

WD is committed to offering opportunities to applicants with disabilities and ensuring all candidates can successfully navigate our careers website and our hiring process. Please contact us at jobs.accommodations@wdc.com to advise us of your accommodation request. In your email, please include a description of the specific accommodation you are requesting as well as the job title and requisition number of the position for which you are applying.

**Notice To Candidates:**
Please be aware that WD and its subsidiaries will never request payment as a condition for applying for a position or receiving an offer of employment. Should you encounter any such requests, please report it immediately to WD Ethics Helpline or email compliance@wdc.com.
