title: Senior Project Manager- (Corporate Interior Fit-Out)
description:
**About Acme Interiors**

Acme Interiors is a leading Design and Build and General Contracting company in the interior fit-out industry, with a track record of more than 30 years. The company delivers corporate, hospitality, and healthcare projects pan India, with a major presence in Bengaluru, Delhi NCR, Chennai, Hyderabad, Pune, and Mumbai. Acme Interiors is driven by a mission to revolutionise the interior design industry through innovation, technology, and sustainability, while consistently adding value to its clients, employees, and partners. The company is built on craft, precision, rigour, and integrity in everything it delivers.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to join our team in Bangalore/Gurgaon regions. The successful candidate will be responsible for end-to-end project management of large-scale workspace interior fit-out projects, managing teams of 5-15 members, and ensuring timely delivery of projects ranging from ₹5 crores to 50 crores with coverage areas from 50,000 to 2,00,000 sq. ft.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Project Planning & Execution**

* Lead comprehensive project planning from inception to completion
* Develop detailed project schedules, resource allocation, and milestone tracking
* Coordinate with design, procurement, and Costing/QS teams to ensure seamless delivery
* Manage project budgets and ensure cost optimization without compromising quality

**Team Management**

* Lead and manage project teams of 5-15 members across different functions
* Coordinate with site engineers, supervisors, and specialized teams
* Conduct regular team meetings and performance reviews
* Ensure effective communication and collaboration across all team levels

**Client & Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as primary point of contact for clients throughout project lifecycle
* Manage client expectations and maintain strong relationships
* Present project updates, resolve concerns, and ensure client satisfaction
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders including design, procurement, and commercials teams

**Quality & Compliance**

* Ensure adherence to quality standards and safety protocols
* Conduct regular site inspections and quality audits
* Implement and maintain project documentation and reporting systems
* Ensure compliance with all regulatory requirements and company policies

**Required Qualifications**

**Experience**

* 8-15 years of experience in workspace/corporate interior fit-out projects
* Minimum 10 large-scale projects executed as Project Manager
* Proven track record in managing projects worth ₹5+ crores to 30+ crores
* Experience in handling projects spanning 50,000 to 2,00,000 sq ft

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strong project management and leadership capabilities
* Technical knowledge of Civil & Interior activities and MEP Coordination
* Excellent client relationship management skills
* Proficiency in project management tools and software
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities
* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines

**Reporting Structure**

Acme Interiors is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion.

* Reports to: Senior Manager/General Manager - Project Execution
* Location: Bangalore/Gurgaon (based on project requirements)
* Team Size: 5-15 direct and indirect reportees

title: Lead Technology Program Manager
description:
Position Summary
  
  
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced
**Lead Technology Program Manager**
to drive the successful delivery of complex, cross-functional technology initiatives that support strategic business priorities and customer commitments.
  
  
In this role, you will partner with Product, Engineering, Architecture, Operations, and Business teams to plan, coordinate, and execute large-scale programs.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong program leadership, executive communication skills, technical acumen, and the ability to influence across a complex matrix organization. This leader will manage strategic customer initiatives and technology programs, cross-functional dependencies, risks, financial planning, and executive reporting while ensuring delivery against business objectives.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Program Planning and Execution
  
  

* Lead end-to-end execution of complex technology programs and strategic initiatives.
* Develop and maintain integrated program plans, roadmaps, schedules, and milestone tracking.
* Coordinate activities across multiple product, engineering, and business teams to ensure successful delivery.
* Track program progress and drive timely resolution of issues that may impact delivery commitments.

Cross-Functional Leadership
  
  

* Partner with Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, Operations, and Customer-facing teams to align priorities and execution plans.
* Facilitate cross-functional discussions to manage dependencies, remove obstacles, and resolve conflicts.
* Drive accountability across stakeholders while fostering a collaborative and results-oriented environment.

Governance and Communication
  
  

* Establish and manage program governance processes, operating rhythms, and reporting mechanisms.
* Prepare and deliver clear, concise program status updates for leadership reviews.
* Communicate key milestones, decisions, risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans to stakeholders.
* Ensure transparency into program health and delivery progress.

Risk and Dependency Management
  
  

* Identify, assess, and proactively manage program risks, issues, and interdependencies.
* Develop mitigation plans and coordinate execution of corrective actions.
* Escalate critical issues with clear recommendations and supporting data.

Customer and Business Alignment
  
  

* Support strategic customer initiatives and business-critical programs.
* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to understand objectives, requirements, and success criteria.
* Ensure business priorities are reflected in program planning and execution activities.

Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Drive adoption of AI-enabled program management best practices, tools, and processes.
* Identify opportunities to improve delivery predictability, operational efficiency, and team effectiveness.
* Contribute to organizational learning through lessons learned, retrospective reviews, and process enhancements.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related field.
* 7+ years of experience in Technology Program Management, Project Management, Product Delivery, or a related discipline.
* Proven experience leading large, cross-functional technology initiatives in a matrixed organization.
* Strong understanding of software development lifecycles, Agile methodologies, and technology delivery practices.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent programs and competing priorities.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with a data-driven approach to decision making.
* Experience managing program risks, dependencies, and executive communications.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting strategic customer programs, airline technology, travel technology, distribution platforms, or digital commerce solutions.
* Experience working across globally distributed teams.
* Familiarity with Agile frameworks, Jira, Rally, Azure DevOps, or similar delivery management tools.
* PMP, Agile, SAFe, or equivalent project/program management certification.
* Experience working in a fast-paced technology environment undergoing transformation and growth.

Success Measures
  
  
**Success In This Role Will Be Measured By**

* Delivery of committed program milestones and objectives.
* Effective management of risks, dependencies, and cross-functional coordination.
* Improved visibility and predictability of program execution.
* Stakeholder satisfaction and confidence in program governance.
* Achievement of customer and business outcomes.
* Contribution to continuous improvement and operational excellence initiatives.

Why Join Us
  
  
You will play a key role in delivering strategic technology and customer initiatives that drive business value and innovation. This position offers the opportunity to work with global teams, influence high-impact programs, and contribute to the successful execution of transformative technology initiatives.
  
  
**Join us and help shape the future of travel through technology.**

Amazon.com, Inc. seeks to be Earth's most customer-centric company, where customers can find and discover anything they might want to buy online, and endeavors to offer its customers the lowest possible prices. We operate retail websites in 20+ countries, offering millions of products in more than 40 categories worldwide, and we still like to work hard, have fun and make history.
  
  
Do you want to be part of the team that ensures Amazon keeps its “best price” promise across millions of products worldwide? Are you seeking an environment where you can drive innovation? Are you a passionate self-starter? If the answer to the above questions is a resounding “YES”, read on!

title: PRINCIPAL, TECHNICAL PROGRAM MANAGER
description:
**About Team**
Walmart Global Tech team enables our stores and eCommerce operations across the world. The platforms that we build are used in most of the markets where Walmart has its presence. Global Marketplace team focuses on building Seller Platforms and interfaces which enables sellers across multiple countries to sell and generate business on eCommerce platforms.
  
  
We're looking for highly skilled and experienced Principal Technical Program Manager with a breadth of skills who can create and execute a plan for new strategic initiatives as well as driving the global technology platforms across Global Tech. You should be able to drive high level design, solutioning & delivery of program with our next generation platforms keeping scalability, robustness and security aspects in focus. The platforms we build will be used by customers & sellers across multiple countries with each of them being a multi billion dollar business for Walmart. If you thrive on solving complex technical problems and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment with passionate software developers, then this could be the perfect opportunity for you. As our business continues to expand into new opportunities and evolve with innovations in supply chain and customer experience, we have an exciting opportunity to build software that scales our operations, leads the industry through innovation, and delights millions of customers worldwide. We leverage cutting-edge technologies such as big data, machine learning, AI, real-time analytics, and high-volume, low-latency, high-availability services to achieve these goals.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
As a part of the Marketplace Program Management team you will impact the shopping of our customers to build solutions that will enable a seamless, highly scalable omni-channel experience for a multi-billion dollar enterprise. You impact the Walmart business directly in driving technology strategies to enable the sellers with the best user experience to onboard, list items and sell and grow their business by selling on Walmart eComm platforms. description:

The Real Estate and Infrastructure Fitouts Lead will serve as the primary technical and execution authority for all civil construction and interior fitout projects across LTM’s India portfolio. **Job Title**
:
**Senior Manager - Real Estate & Administration**

**Location**
:
**Bengaluru**

* Process, certify, and validate vendor invoices to ensure accuracy and timeliness of payments.
* Assist in budgeting and cost tracking across the project lifecycle, flagging variances and recommending corrective actions.

**Stakeholder & Vendor Management**

**Scope, Risk & Documentation**

* Assist in defining project scope and objectives in collaboration with all relevant stakeholders, ensuring technical feasibility is validated upfront.
* Manage changes to project scope, schedule, and costs using appropriate change-control and verification processes.
* Measure and report project performance using relevant tools and techniques; maintain rigorous project documentation throughout the lifecycle.
* Perform risk assessments and implement risk management strategies to proactively minimise project exposure.
* Translate business requirements into actionable project execution plans with defined budgets and timelines.
* Support facility management teams with all project-related technical inputs post-handover.

**Core Competencies**

* Project & construction management
* Stakeholder & vendor management
* Risk identification & mitigation
* Commercial expertise & negotiation
* Customer focus & issue resolution
* Multi-project execution

**Technical Skills**

* AutoCAD (design & project execution)
* Budgeting & cost tracking
* BOQ preparation & review
* Interior fitout & civil works
* Quantity surveying
* Project planning & documentation

**Qualifications & Experience**

**Education:**
Bachelor of Engineering (BE) in Civil Engineering

**Experience:**
12–14 years in site execution and project planning for real estate Building construction and Interior fitout projects

**Industry Preference:**
IT/ITES workplace environments; experience with corporate fitout mandates at scale

**Other Requirements:**
Demonstrated ability to manage pan-India project portfolios across multiple concurrent sites

+ Build and manage integrated plans that cover business milestones, technical delivery, dependencies, data and reporting, and change management.
+ Track scope, timeline, budget, and quality, proactively identify risks and interdependencies and drive mitigations and trade-off decisions with stakeholders.

+ Partner with Sales Operations, Marketing Operations, Product Operations, Channel/Partner teams, and Commissions to prioritize and deliver programs across:

+ Partner with Procurement, Finance, and Legal to manage vendor relationships, SaaS licensing, and contracts across Sales & Marketing tools.

+ Ensure vendors and system integrators deliver to contracted scope, quality, and timelines.
+ Champion best practices in program management, GTM process design, and application lifecycle management for Sales & Marketing IT.
+ Identify and drive continuous improvement initiatives that reduce manual work, improve data quality, and enhance user experience.
+ Mentor project managers, business analysts, and scrum masters, foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.

**Experience You’ll Need**

* 12+ years of progressive experience in IT program / project management, technology consulting, or enterprise applications, with at least 8 years leading Sales & Marketing or GTM-focused programs.
* Understanding of Sales & Marketing processes across lead lifecycle, opportunity management, forecasting, campaign management, sales performance management, commissions, and partner programs.
* Hands-on experience delivering complex programs on CRM and marketing platforms (e.g., Salesforce Sales Cloud / Service Cloud, Marketo, Adobe Experience Manager, or equivalent).
* Hands-on proficiency with generative AI platforms (e.g., Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT) to automate project documentation, accelerate decision-making, and streamline cross-functional workflows.
* Demonstrated ability to leverage LLMs and prompt engineering to synthesize complex program data, conduct rapid risk analysis, and produce executive-level reporting.
* Track record of integrating frontier AI tools into daily program management practices to enhance operational velocity, optimize stakeholder communication, and drive efficient problem-solving.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional, global teams and manage stakeholders at multiple levels, including senior business leaders.
* Proven track record establishing program governance, managing budgets, and driving projects to successful completion in fast-paced environments.
* Proficiency with Agile and hybrid delivery models, and with project / program management tools such as JIRA, Confluence, Smartsheet, or similar.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to define business cases, quantify ROI, and make data-driven decisions.

**Nice To Have**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field. A Masters degree is a plus.
* Experience in high-growth technology companies working closely with global Sales, Marketing, and GTM Operations teams.
* Formal program / project management certifications (e.g., PMP, PMI-ACP, PRINCE2, SAFe, or equivalent).

description:
**Company**
Qualcomm India Private Limited
  
  
**Job Area**
Engineering Services Group, Engineering Services Group > Program Management
  
  
**General Summary**
Develops, defines, and executes plans of record, including: schedules, budgets, resources, deliverables, and risks. Monitors and drives the program from initiation through delivery, interfacing with internal and external stakeholders across functions on technical matters, as needed. Monitors budget/spending, on-time delivery, and achievement of program milestones. Represents the program and drives alignment across stakeholders.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
* 5+ years of Program Management or related work experience.
* Completed advanced degrees in a relevant field may be substituted for up to two years (Master’s = one year, Doctorate = two years) of work experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
* PMP Certification.
* 10+ years of Program Management or related work experience.
* 5+ years of work experience in a role requiring interaction with senior leadership (e.g., Director level and above).
* 3+ years of experience working in a large matrixed organization.
* 2+ years of experience with program management tools such as dashboards, Gantt charts, etc.

**Principal Duties And Responsibilities**

* Collaborates with key stakeholders and program sponsors to develop program goals, set the prioritization of deliverables, discuss involvement of business processes (e.g., program change management, communication) and drives decisions necessary for on time delivery.
* Manages and takes responsibility for multiple medium sized programs/technology with moderate complexity by applying up-to-date program management knowledge to meet deadlines.
* Develops and manages the execution of the program Plan of Record (e.g., on time, on budget, within scope) for multiple medium sized programs which include schedule and resource forecasting, stakeholders identification, method and frequency of communication, scope, and prioritization.
* Establishes key program metrics and manages team to take action outside their comfort zone to ensure program success when metrics deviate from Plan of Record.
* Identifies and secures resources to ensure alignment of team with program/technology demand for multiple medium sized programs with moderate complexity.
* Drives teams to identify program issues/risks, and create a risk mitigation plan for multiple medium sized or a single complex program(s). Maintains and updates the risk tracker.
* Promotes program vision and objectives within the team, ensures program objectives are met or exceeded, presents program vision to management, and gains buy-in from stakeholders.
* Promotes adoption of processes by applying best practices and identifying and executing process improvement initiatives across the Program Management team.

**Level Of Responsibility**

* Working independently with little supervision.
* Making decisions that are significant in impact; errors are not readily apparent due to the complexity of work process/product or time between decisions and results; errors typically result in significant expenditure of time, resources, and funds to correct.
* Using verbal and written communication skills to convey complex and/or detailed information to multiple individuals/audiences with differing knowledge levels. May require strong negotiation and influence, communication to large groups or high-level constituents.
* Having a moderate amount of influence over key organizational decisions (e.g., is consulted by senior leadership to provide input on key decisions).
* Completing tasks that require multiple steps that can be performed in various orders; tasks require simultaneously executing multiple cognitive abilities and maintaining information in short- or long-term memory.
* Exercising exceptional creativity to innovate new ideas and develop innovative products/processes without established objectives or known parameters.
* Using deductive and inductive problem solving; multiple approaches may be taken/necessary to solve the problem; often information is missing or conflicting; advanced data analysis and interpretation skills are required.
* Occasionally participates in strategic planning within own area affecting immediate operations.

title: Senior Technical Project Manager
description:
**About Elecbits** 




 Elecbits is a tech\-enabled B2B platform that helps Electronics Enterprises to go from an idea to a shelf ready, commercial Electronics Product. We cover the end\-to\-end intricacies involved in the Electronics product development \& manufacturing cycle using 25\+ micro\-services on our platform.
 



  





 We are proud to have worked with more than 100 eminent enterprises, digitizing their product development and manufacturing lifecycle. Some notable names are Ola Electric, Urban Company, Maruti Suzuki, Bosch, V\-guard, Luminous, Phone pe, Escorts Kubota, Napino, etc. We are the largest B2B Electronics development and manufacturing platform of its kind, having more than 3000 global Electronics manufacturers and suppliers on our platform.
 



  





**About the Business Unit ODM Practice** 




 The ODM (Original Design Manufacturing) practice turns client ideas into real, marketable products. Every engagement is bespoke: we design and build custom electronics end\-to\-end against each client’s requirements — across hardware, firmware, mechanical, testing, quality and certification — through to a manufacturing\-ready handover. The work rewards sharp requirement\-sensing, fast learning of new domains, and tight orchestration across engineering teams and vendors. The Senior Project Manager owns exactly that.
 



  





**Role Summary** 




 We’re hiring a Senior Project Manager to own a portfolio of ODM projects end\-to\-end, from concept to deployment. You’ll be the single point of accountability for scope, cost, timeline and quality across multiple projects, the primary face to the client, and the force that keeps firmware, hardware, testing, quality and vendors moving in sync. Beyond delivery, you’ll bring — strategy, customer empathy and data\-driven decisions — to every engagement, mentor junior PMs, and build the SOPs that let the practice scale.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Product Vision, Strategy \& Roadmap:** 



* Translate each client brief and the surrounding market into a clear product strategy, roadmap and prioritised plan, aligning every project to defined business outcomes and a compelling product narrative.
* Identify near\- and long\-term opportunities, validate the market and cost case, and secure buy\-in from clients and internal leadership for the chosen direction and its trade\-offs.



  





**Project Ownership \& Delivery:** 



* Own a portfolio of ODM projects from concept through deployment, serving as the single point of accountability for scope, cost, schedule, quality and customer satisfaction.
* Establish each project’s plan, milestones and critical path, define clear success criteria, and govern delivery by monitoring KPIs, surfacing variances early, and initiating corrective action.



  





**New Product Development (NPD):** 



* Drive products through the full lifecycle — concept, design, prototyping, validation, certification and transfer to manufacturing — clearing each stage\-gate with crisp entry and exit criteria.
* Govern design reviews and validation cycles, ensuring design\-for\-manufacturability, cost targets and compliance are met before production handover.



  





**Customer Empathy \& Market Insight:** 



* Develop deep understanding of client and end\-user needs, integrating user research, usage context and competitive analysis into requirements that maximise product impact.
* Build domain fluency quickly for new or unfamiliar products to scope accurately, anticipate engineering and non\-engineering risks, and brief clients and teams with authority.



  





**Data\-Informed Decisions \& Prioritisation:** 



* Define the metrics that matter for each project, instrument them, and let data drive prioritisation, trade\-offs and go/no\-go decisions.
* Evaluate cost, design and schedule trade\-offs with sound judgement, prioritise ruthlessly, and decide when to invest, pivot or stop.



  





**Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Influence:** 



* Lead internal teams across the product lifecycle — sequencing dependencies, resolving blockers, and driving alignment through influence while keeping team health high.
* Manage multiple concurrent projects, balancing shared engineering and vendor capacity against competing priorities and deadlines.



  





**Client \& Stakeholder Communication:** 



* Serve as the primary face to the client and the voice of the customer internally, managing expectations, communicating progress and risk proactively, and leading resolution when commitments are challenged.
* Influence senior stakeholders with structured, extremely clear communication and data\-backed storytelling, escalating roadblocks early with recommended options.



  





**Team Leadership \& Process Excellence:** 



* Mentor and develop junior project managers — delegating execution, coaching judgement, and building their capability to own projects independently.
* Establish and evolve SOPs, playbooks, templates and documentation standards that raise the bar and enable consistent, repeatable, scalable delivery, capturing post\-launch learnings for the next projects.



  





**Must\-Have Skills\-:** 




  




* 6–10 years in project or product management, owning complex cross\-functional projects end\-to\-end in a fast\-paced environment
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business management, or a related field (Master’s a plus)
* Strategic thinker who also executes — sets product direction and drives day\-to\-day delivery
* Customer\-obsessed and data\-informed — defines success metrics and uses data to drive decisions and trade\-offs
* Structured problem\-solving and bias\-for action to drive early closures

title: Operations Program Manager
description:
**About Stripe**
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and pursue new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
   

  

**About The Team**
 As Stripe’s user base and global footprint grow dramatically, we face unique support problems resulting from our scale and the types of businesses we partner with. The Stripe Delivery Center (SDC) strategy will provide operational support and expand Stripe’s portfolio of operational capabilities to meet the growing needs of external users and internal Stripe teams. Our support experience draws on a deep understanding of our products, the financial industry, money movement, and our customers’ products and users. Building this experience requires us to invest significant resources in talented teams of Stripes.
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

 We’re looking for dynamic and entrepreneurial leaders who will define our strategy for scaling the Core Payments team, improve operational workflows, and maintain a best\-in\-class Operations program. If you like hard problems, are analytical, are comfortable operating with ambiguity, and enjoy finding creative solutions, we want to hear from you.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead end\-to\-end product launches across multiple regions as an integrated program. Develop and maintain detailed launch plans that serve as the central point of coordination across globally distributed and highly cross\-functional teams, including Engineering, Product Management, go\-to\-market, cross\-functional review, Support, and other key partner teams.
* Drive operational excellence across the product launch lifecycle by designing, improving, and implementing scalable processes that strengthen stakeholder coordination, clarify dependencies, maintain alignment, and support consistent execution across regions.
* Monitor and report on progress through biweekly status updates to senior leadership while maintaining transparent documentation throughout.
* Support cross\-functional collaboration by identifying and documenting teams’ responsibilities for product launches, proactively communicating blockers, and providing transparent status updates and relevant documentation, such as product launch Gantt charts, program plans, and scope details.
* Define and improve operating rhythms that support efficient collaboration across teams. Manage operational cadences for product launches and business reviews, and track Stripe Objectives and Key Results (SOKRs).
* Establish scalable launch frameworks and operational structures to simplify execution, improve cross\-functional alignment, and support efficient multi\-region product rollouts.


**Minimum Requirements**
* More than 7 years of total work experience, including 4 to 5 years in program management, consulting, or a similar role within a high\-growth technology company, with a strong focus on managing strategic product initiatives from conception through implementation.
* A proven track record in process and project management, including creating operational processes, leading product roadmap reviews, and designing scalable systems in fast\-paced environments.
* Skill in scheduling, prioritizing tasks, and meeting deadlines to support the timely delivery of products and features.
* Comfort operating with ambiguity and executing complex projects while building collaboration across diverse teams and functions.
* Strong stakeholder engagement skills, including high\-level planning and ongoing communication to align project goals with operations.
* The ability to present ideas, product updates, and roadmaps clearly and persuasively to a range of stakeholders, including executives, to build alignment and understanding of project objectives.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in program management, consulting, or a similar role within payments or fintech.
* Familiarity with roadmap management tools and planning frameworks, and knowledge of how to apply them to manage projects effectively.
* The ability to understand the company’s strategic goals and align the product roadmap accordingly.
* Skill in helping stakeholders prioritize product features and initiatives based on business value, customer needs, and resource availability.
* A deep understanding of global markets and the ability to contextualize decisions and processes to account for regional nuances.
* Experience implementing process improvements and change\-management strategies to scale operations effectively.


 We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, we encourage you to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
   

  

 In\-office expectations
   

  

 Office\-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in\-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in\-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
   

  

 Pay and benefits
   

  

 Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.
   

  

 We look forward to hearing from you.
   

  

 At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.
   

  

 Apply now

title: Technical Programme Manager
description:
**About the role**
 The Online Technology team have led the way in delivering outcomes which are driving the transformation of the Tesco Technology platform: We have significantly grown the number of customers who rely on us to deliver their shopping to their home or convenient location. We saw substantial increases in volumes and customers through the pandemic which tested and proved the scalability of the platform. These increases saw use regularly exceed over 1\.3m orders a week though the retail platform.Since then we have scaled and changed the landscape of what we sell online by launching multiple propositions such as Whoosh, Marketplace and recently F\&F. Over the next few years we will be significantly growing Whoosh, continuously pushing the Marketplace proposition and scaling our Clothing mission to become the one stop shop. 
   

  

 Sitting in the Online team does not mean you are bound by the restrictions of Clothing, Marketplace, Groceries or Whoosh. We often are interfacing with the multiple business units and missions a customer comes to the website and app to fulfil, you will be part of the Online integrated programme, product and engineering space. The Online programme team unlock real world value for our customers across multiple shopping missions.
   

  

**You will be responsible for**
 Technical Programme Managers (TPMs) deliver complex, cross\-functional technology programmes that support colleagues and help serve our customers better. They work collaboratively, influence Product, Engineering and business colleagues and lead the programme to deliver value quickly and often.
   

 Whilst specific responsibilities will be dependent upon the changing needs of the Tesco business, the following provides an overview of the role’s key responsibilities and measures:
   

 • Deliver programmes with business and/or technical risks• Optimise or use a standard programme delivery methodology for delivering programme goals (e.g. agile, waterfall, iterative) • Bring together, coordinate and energise virtual technology teams to deliver programme goals• Create and track a plan to deliver the programme goals, including the technical implementation plan• Understand trade\-offs and resulting impacts; make impacts visible to Product, Infrastructure or Engineering for the right decision to be made • Managing dependencies, delivery timelines and implementations plans, using my knowledge of technical architecture• Appreciating and responding to delivery challenges, using my knowledge of engineering best practices and/or infrastructure implementations• Understand technology concepts, grasp new ones quickly and appreciate their implications on delivery• Effectively manage major incidents, ensuring stakeholders are updated with the right information to drive the correct decisions• Build positive relationships with suppliers \& external stakeholders to deliver software or professional services• Coach peers and other roles, teaching where required, on methodologies and programme management tools• This role will best suit an individual who enjoys working as part of a team, is well organised, pragmatic and a lateral thinker with an inquisitive mind who is motivated to make change for the better and, most importantly, puts our customers first.
   

  

**You will need**
 You’ll need to have:
   

 • A proven accomplished record of delivering technology and/or infrastructure; having done so across multiple teams in multiple geographies• Experience of building credible relationships and influencing management and leadership teams• Excellent verbal and written communication skills – you must be able to articulate complex concepts to a diverse audience.• The ability to influence without authority.Personal
   

 • Flexibility, ability to plan and organise, responsiveness, creativity, self\-starter • Demonstrate resilience during change and continue delivery
   

  

**Whats in it for you?**
  

 At Tesco, we are committed to providing the best for you. 
   

  
   

 As a result, our colleagues enjoy a unique, differentiated, market\- competitive reward package, based on the current industry practices, for all the work they put into serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day. 
   

  
   

 Our Tesco Rewards framework consists of pillars \- Fixed Pay, Incentives, and Benefits.  
   

  
   

 Total Rewards offered at Tesco is determined by four principles \-simple, fair, competitive, and sustainable. 
   

  
   

**Salary** 
 \- Your fixed pay is the guaranteed pay as per your contract of employment. 
   

  
   

**Leave \& Time\-off** 
 \- Colleagues are entitled to 30 days of leave (18 days of Earned Leave, 12 days of Casual/Sick Leave) and 10 national and festival holidays, as per the company’s policy. 
   

  
   

**Making Retirement Tension\-FreeSalary** 
 \- In addition to Statutory retirement beneets, Tesco enables colleagues to participate in voluntary programmes like NPS and VPF. 
   

  
   

**Health is Wealth** 
 \- Tesco promotes programmes that support a culture of health and wellness including insurance for colleagues and their family. Our medical insurance provides coverage for dependents including parents or in\-laws. 
   

  
   

**Mental Wellbeing** 
 \- We offer mental health support through self\-help tools, community groups, ally networks, face\-to\-face counselling, and more for both colleagues and dependents.  
   

  
   

**Financial Wellbeing** 
 \- Through our financial literacy partner, we offer one\-to\-one financial coaching at discounted rates, as well as salary advances on earned wages upon request.  
   

  
   

**Save As You Earn (SAYE)** 
 \- Our SAYE programme allows colleagues to transition from being employees to Tesco shareholders through a structured 3\-year savings plan.  
   

  
   

**Physical Wellbeing** 
 \- Our green campus promotes physical wellbeing with facilities that include a cricket pitch, football field, badminton and volleyball courts, along with indoor games, encouraging a healthier lifestyle. 
   

  

**About Us**
 At Tesco, inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. We believe in treating everyone fairly and with respect, valuing individuality and uniqueness to create a true sense of belonging. Diversity and inclusion are deeply embedded in our values—we treat people how they want to be treated. Our goal is for all colleagues to feel they can be themselves at work, and we are committed to helping them thrive. Across the Tesco group, we are building an inclusive workplace that actively celebrates the cultures, personalities, and preferences of our colleagues, who in turn contribute to the success of our business and reflect the diversity of the communities we serve. 
   

  
   

  At Tesco Bengaluru, we are proud to be a Disability Confident Committed Employer, highlighting our commitment to creating a supportive environment for individuals with disabilities. We are dedicated to offering equal opportunities for all candidates and encourage applicants with disabilities to apply. Our recruitment process is fully accessible, and we are happy to provide reasonable adjustments during interviews. If you need any accommodations to participate in the recruitment process, please let us know. We are here to ensure that everyone has the chance to succeed. 
   

  
   

  We also believe in fostering a work environment where you can excel both professionally and personally. Our hybrid model allows you to work flexibly—spend 60% of your week collaborating in person with colleagues at our office locations or local sites, and the rest of the time working remotely. We understand that everyone’s life journey is unique, whether you are starting your career, pursuing passions, or navigating life changes, and we are here to support you. Flexibility is a core part of our culture, and we encourage open conversations about how we can best accommodate your needs, so talk to us throughout your application process on the support required.

title: Project Controller
description:
**Department** 
 Projects
 



**Designation** 
 Senior Manager \- Project Controller
 



**Location** 
 Bengaluru
 



**Reporting To** 
 Vice President – Design \& Product
 



  





 Simpliwork is looking for an experienced
 **Project Controller** 
 to lead project planning, governance, documentation, commercial controls, and execution monitoring across multiple workplace fit\-out projects. The role will act as the central point of control for project schedules, budgets, documentation, risk management, stakeholder coordination, and performance reporting, ensuring successful delivery of projects within agreed timelines, cost, quality, and compliance standards.
 



  





 The ideal candidate should have extensive experience managing large\-scale commercial interior fit\-outs, corporate workplace projects, and multi\-location project portfolios with leading Project Management Consultants (PMC), real estate developers, or corporate real estate organizations.
 



  





**Role \& Responsibilities** 





 Project Planning \& Controls
 



* Develop and maintain integrated project schedules using equivalent planning tools (RDash).
* Prepare project execution plans, master schedules, critical path analysis, milestone trackers, and recovery plans.
* Monitor project progress against baseline schedules and proactively identify schedule risks and delays.
* Establish project governance frameworks, reporting standards, and performance monitoring mechanisms across multiple projects.



  






 Project Governance \& Documentation
 



* Develop and manage document control systems ensuring version control and timely approvals.
* Maintain project documentation including drawings, RFIs, submittals, change requests, design revisions, approval trackers, and project records.
* Ensure compliance with internal quality standards, client requirements, statutory regulations, and contractual obligations.
* Standardize project control processes across the organization.



  






 Commercial \& Financial Controls
 



* Track project budgets, cash flows, cost forecasts, commitments, and expenditure throughout the project lifecycle.
* Monitor procurement schedules, vendor commitments, payment milestones, and invoicing.
* Review BOQs, technical specifications, variation orders, and change management requests.
* Support value engineering initiatives and identify opportunities for cost optimization without compromising quality.



  






 Design \& Technical Coordination
 



* Coordinate with architects, MEP consultants, design teams, contractors, and vendors to ensure seamless project execution.
* Review design deliverables for constructability, technical compliance, and execution readiness.
* Facilitate timely design approvals and resolution of technical issues during execution.
* Support technical due diligence, statutory approvals, and design governance activities.



  






 Project Monitoring \& Reporting
 



* Prepare weekly, monthly, and executive MIS reports covering project progress, cost, schedule, risks, procurement status, and key performance indicators.
* Develop dashboards and project performance reports for senior leadership and clients.
* Present project health reviews and recommend corrective actions where required.



  






 Risk \& Change Management
 



* Maintain project risk registers and implement proactive mitigation strategies.
* Monitor project deviations, change orders, claims, and contractual obligations.
* Identify execution bottlenecks and drive timely resolution through cross\-functional collaboration.



  






 Stakeholder Management
 



* Serve as the primary coordination point between clients, consultants, contractors, internal departments, and leadership teams.
* Lead project review meetings, prepare meeting minutes, and ensure timely closure of action items.
* Foster effective communication across Design, Projects, Procurement, Finance, Sales, Leasing, and Operations functions.



  






 Procurement \& Vendor Coordination
 



* Coordinate RFQs, RFPs, vendor evaluations, technical bid reviews, and procurement planning.
* Track material approvals, procurement milestones, deliveries, and site readiness.
* Monitor vendor performance and contractual compliance throughout project execution.



  






 Quality, Compliance \& Handover
 



* Support quality audits, peer reviews, and project compliance checks.
* Ensure project deliverables meet client specifications, regulatory requirements, and Simpliwork quality standards.
* Coordinate final project documentation, snag closure, testing \& commissioning, and successful handover to Operations.



  





**Skillset required** 



* Experience in Project Controls, Project Planning, Design Management, or Project Management within commercial real estate or workplace interiors.
* Strong understanding of project planning, scheduling, cost control, documentation, procurement, and project governance.
* Experience working with leading PMCs, real estate developers, workplace consultants, or corporate occupiers.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to coordinate clients, consultants, contractors, and cross\-functional teams.
* Strong commercial acumen with experience in budgeting, cash flow management, contract administration, and value engineering.
* Knowledge of statutory approvals, technical due diligence, risk management, and change control processes.
* Excellent analytical, organizational, and communication skills.



  





**Experience (Years) required** 




 15\+ years of experience
 



  





**Qualification** 




 Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Interior Design, Construction Management, or related discipline.

title: Assistant Vice President - Stress Testing
description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.
   

  

 If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
   

  

 HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions.
   

  

 We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
 **Assistant Vice President – Stress Testing.**
**Purpose Of The Role**
 This role is responsible for delivering accurate, timely, and well\-governed stress testing results and management information end\-to\-end, including running/consolidating balance sheet and P\&L outputs, coordinating stakeholder submissions and regulatory responses, maintaining data and systems and strengthening the control environment through robust documentation, evidence, issue/risk management, and continuous process automation/improvement.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Support end\-to\-end production of management information and consolidated stress\-testing results. Execute and/or support model runs and results production for balance sheet and P\&L components including loans, deposits, revenue etc. and produce consolidated results.
* Submitting overlays, journals into TM1, CART etc. and ensure the MI is accurate, robust and aligned with the latest management hierarchies. Collaborate with Group to ensure any PRA submissions are completed timely, liaise on Bank of England queries, prepare draft responses relating to unstructured data requests.
* Perform analysis of stress test outputs including movement/variance analysis, sensitivities, trend reviews, and identification of key drivers. Managing stakeholders to ensure timely and complete submissions. Tracking actions, recording key decision points, distributing meeting materials and minutes.
* Support T\-zero data preparation for entity returns, coordinate with Group and ensure data quality throughout the process. Support R\&C and coordination of various stress test exercises and related approvals/governance, including coordination of inputs and evidence packs for exercises such as GIST/GRP/RST and relevant UK/Group regulatory requests (e.g., PRA\-related).
* Partner with model owners and accountable executives in Business, Risk, Finance to analyse, review and challenge stress test submissions. Support the impact assessment and change implementation for various stress\-testing data and systems, including CART, TM1 and maintain key mappings for products, global businesses, MICA etc.
* Implement new models, tools, processes or automated solutions to support any changes in the process or requirements. Build accurate, validated datasets for each stress\-testing cycle, with no critical data\-quality issues, and develop and maintain validation tools to support review activities.
* Improve efficiency, convert manual spreadsheets to automated solutions by leveraging HSBC artificial intelligence tools and other methods of automation. Ensuring processes are run in accordance with the Control framework and agreed procedures.
* Produce and maintain high\-quality stress testing documentation (methodology narratives, process/run books, evidence packs, control checklists, assumptions logs, and decision logs). Providing accurate information status reporting, risk and update on issues.
* Develop and actively manage delivery plans covering key milestones and interdependencies and coordinate cross\-functional stakeholders to ensure timely delivery. Support the development and maintenance of process flows, controls, documentation etc., embedding HSBC principles and ensure compliance with risk management framework.
* Support the annual Risk Control Assessment and contribute to ongoing strengthening of the stress testing control environment. Execute and evidence process controls and assurance activities, including maintaining records in relevant tooling (e.g., Helios for controls/assurance, where applicable).


**To Be Successful You Will**
* Qualifications: ACA, ACCA, MBA or similar.
* Experience: Demonstrable experience coordinating internal and external stress test submissions, with a strong understanding of governance and regulatory expectations. Strong analytical skills with business analysis experience or equivalent.
* Data and Systems: Strong understanding of data architecture, finance and accounting systems – ability to work with large, complex datasets.
* Presentation and Communication: Ability to present results effectively to senior stakeholders and distill complex messages into understandable plain English for non\-technical colleagues. Have confidence to review, challenge and improve submissions while maintaining strong relationships.
* Produce high\-quality outputs: Proven ability to produce high\-quality outputs, and to write concise, technically accurate papers, with strong attention to detail and clear audit trail.
* Delivery discipline and control mindset: Strong planning, tracking and reporting capability (run books, RAID, milestones). Understand risk management and control frameworks.
* Problem\-solving: Ability to navigate ambiguity, prioritise effectively and keep delivery moving at pace.
* Tools: Strong Microsoft Office skills (Excel, PowerPoint, Word); MI systems (TM1, CART, Saracen), and knowledge of Workviva, Harmony, RRIS.

title: Strategic Partner Manager

Our mission is simple safeguard the digital world and empower people to work securely and confidently. Join us in our pursuit to defend data and protect people.

**Bold** 
 in how we dream and innovate

 to feedback, challenges and opportunities

 for results and best in class outcomes
   

  

**Visionary** 
 in future focused problem\-solving

 in execution and impact

 In today’s cyber threat landscape, protection starts with people. At Proofpoint, that simple truth fuels our passion for protecting users, the data they create, and the systems they rely on from a uniquely people\-centric perspective.
   

  

 And we’re just as passionate about finding the right people to help us in that mission. When you join Proofpoint, you’re helping to
   

  

* Build and enhance our proven security platform
* Blend innovation and speed in a constantly evolving cloud environment
* Analyze new threats and offer deep insight through data\-driven intel
* Collaborate with customers to help solve their toughest security challenges


 We are singularly devoted to helping our customers protect their greatest assets and biggest security risk their people. That’s why we’re a leader in next\-generation cybersecurity—and why more than half of the Fortune 100 trust us as a security partner.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Strategic Partner Manager is a senior\-level individual contributor responsible for managing and optimizing operational performance across Proofpoint’s third\-party Technical Customer Support vendor partners. This role ensures that vendor activities are aligned with business priorities, drives operational improvements, and amplifies the effectiveness of our global support ecosystem.
   

  

 as a Strategic Partner Manager
   

  

 Acting as a key strategic advisor to the Director, Vendor Management, this role requires strong analytical skills, operational depth, and the ability to influence both internal stakeholders and external vendor leaders—without direct people management.
   

  

 Your day\-to\-day
   

  

 Vendor Strategy \& Relationship Management
   

  

* Partner closely with vendor leadership to ensure alignment with Proofpoint’s goals, support strategy, and customer experience standards.
* Serve as a strategic liaison between internal teams and vendor partners to drive transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Monitor contract adherence and identify opportunities to optimize vendor services.


 Operational Excellence
   

  

* Evaluate vendor performance across KPIs, SLAs, quality metrics, and productivity benchmarks.
* Identify operational gaps, propose structured improvement plans, and track progress through completion.
* Support readiness for product changes, workflow modifications, and major program rollouts.


 Cross\-Functional Partnership
   

  

* Collaborate with Engineering, Product, Customer Success, Support Operations, and internal Support teams to ensure vendor alignment with business needs.
* Represent the vendor organization in cross\-functional meetings, project discussions, and operational reviews.
* Communicate vendor impact, risks, and opportunities clearly to senior leadership.


 Program \& Process Leadership
   

  

* Lead vendor\-related initiatives and process improvement programs—driving structure, documentation, and execution.
* Maintain operational playbooks, escalation guides, SOPs, and readiness materials.
* Partner with training and quality teams to ensure consistent vendor skill development.


 Data Analysis \& Reporting
   

  

* Analyze vendor data to identify performance trends, root causes, capacity issues, and customer\-impacting concerns.
* Build dashboards, scorecards, and executive\-level summaries to highlight insights and drive decision\-making.
* Provide recommendations based on data—focusing on efficiency, quality, and customer experience.


 Escalation and Issue Management
   

  

* Support vendor escalations, incident management, and service disruptions.
* Partner with stakeholders to drive cross\-functional resolution and long\-term corrective action.
* Track recurring issues and propose systemic solutions.


 Strategic Support
   

  

* Support the Director in defining vendor strategy, long\-term operational planning, and organizational alignment.
* Assess vendor capabilities and recommend changes to staffing models, resourcing, or support coverage


 What you bring to the team
   

  

* 10\+ years of experience in Technical Support, Vendor Management, Customer Support Operations, or related fields.
* Strong background in global support environments or outsourced/BPO operations.
* Demonstrated ability to influence without authority across multiple teams and stakeholders.
* Advanced analytical skills with experience in metrics, dashboards, and performance reporting.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to tailor messaging for executive audiences.
* Experience managing complex projects or programs with cross\-functional collaboration.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office; experience with Salesforce or similar CRM platforms.
* Experience in SaaS, cybersecurity, or technical support environments.
* Familiarity with workforce planning, vendor capacity modeling, or support forecasting.
* Background in business process optimization or operational strategy.


 Why Proofpoint
   

  

 Protecting people is at the heart of our award\-winning lineup of cybersecurity solutions, and the people who work here are the key to our success. We’re a customer\-focused and driven\-to\-win organization with leading\-edge products—and many exciting reasons to join our team. We believe in hiring the best the brightest and cultivating a culture of collaboration and appreciation. We are a diverse, multinational company with opportunities in all functions, and leaders that welcome candidates from all walks of life. Apply today and explore your future .
   

  

**Why Proofpoint?**
 At Proofpoint, we believe that an exceptional career experience includes a comprehensive compensation and benefits package. Here are just a few reasons you’ll love working with us
   

  

* Competitive compensation
* Comprehensive benefits
* Career success on your terms
* Flexible work environment
* Annual wellness and community outreach days
* Always on recognition for your contributions
* Global collaboration and networking opportunities


**Our Culture**
 Our culture is rooted in values that inspire belonging, empower purpose and drive success\-every day, for everyone.
   

  

 We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. If you need accommodation during the application or interview process, please reach out to accessibility@proofpoint.com.
   

  

**How To Apply**
 Interested? Submit your application along with any supporting information\- we can’t wait to hear from you!

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




 We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead high\-performing team.
 



 You will shape the strategy, execution, reliability, and evolution of products and platforms that span mission\-critical payment systems, financial products, and fraud \& risk platforms — directly impacting hundreds of millions of Indians transacting on Flipkart every day.
 



  





 The role goes beyond engineering delivery. We are looking for a hands\-on technology leader who can build high\-performing teams, influence product strategy, drive technical excellence, and create products and platforms that are resilient, scalable, secure, AI\-enabled, and built for hyper\-growth.
 



 You will solve challenges at a scale very few engineering teams in India face. Every architectural decision you make directly impacts hundreds of millions of customers. You will work with some of the sharpest fintech engineers in the country and partner closely with innovative product and business leaders in building financial products and payments infrastructure.
 



  





**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES** 




 We are looking for an engineering leader who combines deep technical expertise with strong product development, operational excellence, and exceptional people leadership skills. As a Senior Engineering Manager, you will be responsible for building highly available, scalable, and secure fintech \& payment products while growing engineering teams.
 



  





 1\. Technical Leadership.
 



 2\. Operational Excellence \& Engineering Discipline
 



 3\. AI\-Native Mindset
 



 4\. Business \& Product Stakeholder Management
 



 5\. Team Leadership \& Culture
 



  





**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE** 



* Build scalable, resilient, and secure distributed systems that operate reliably at high scale.
* Apply deep fintech and payments expertise to solve complex customer and business problems.
* Influence product direction through technical leadership and business acumen.
* Leverage AI to fundamentally improve engineering productivity and software delivery.
* Build exceptional engineering organisations by developing leaders, raising technical standards, and fostering a culture of ownership, innovation, and continuous improvement.



  





**YOU (MUST HAVES)** 



* 10\+ years of polyglot engineering experience, with at least 1 to 2 years building payment or fintech products.
* Strong system design skills and the ability to guide architecture decisions for complex, multi\-system payment workflows.
* Experience designing and operating high\-availability \& low latency systems (99\.99%\+) where failures have direct financial and customer\-trust consequences.
* Hands\-on experience with one or more payment systems: payment gateways, UPI integrations, card payment flows, wallet infrastructure, loan origination system, settlement and reconciliation systems etc.
* Understanding of Indian payments \& fintech regulatory landscape: RBI, NPCI guidelines, PPI regulations, PCI\-DSS requirements.
* Proven track record of building and growing engineering teams; ability to hire strong engineers and develop them into senior contributors.
* BE/BTech in Computer Science or equivalent.



  





**NICE TO HAVES** 



* Familiarity with TPAP (Third\-Party Application Provider) architecture on the NPCI UPI stack
* Experience in card processing — authentication, authorization, clearing, and settlement flows; working knowledge of card scheme rules and interchange economics.
* Understanding of credit risk scoring, credit bureau integrations (CIBIL, Experian, CRIF), or credit lifecycle management for consumer/business lending.
* Exposure to real\-time fraud \& risk ML models and their integration into payment decisioning pipelines.
* Participation in fintech/payments industry forums or working groups.

title: Principal Software Engineering Manager | Ads Trust & Safety AI Platform
description:
**Overview**
 Microsoft Advertising serves billions of ad decisions every day across search, native, shopping, display, audience, and AI\-powered advertising experiences. Trust \& Safety is foundational to this marketplace: protecting users from harmful, deceptive, and low\-quality content; protecting advertisers, publishers, and partners from fraud and abuse; and ensuring Microsoft Ads operates with strong policy, privacy, security, compliance, and regulatory integrity.
   

  

 We are seeking a
 **Principal Software Engineering Manager** 
 to lead a key engineering areas within the
 **Ads Trust \& Safety AI Platform** 
 . This team builds platform capabilities for advertiser and domain intelligence, AI\-assisted investigation, model serving, decisioning, enforcement, human review, observability, and risk/fraud protection.
   

  

 This role is for an engineering leader who can combine technical depth, strong people leadership, execution discipline, and production judgment. The manager will lead a team delivering complex systems in close partnership with Applied Science, Product, Policy, Security, Privacy, Compliance, and partner engineering teams.
   

  

**The Larger Platform Scope Includes**
* AI\-powered Trust \& Safety intelligence for understanding advertisers, domains, websites, landing pages, business identities, reputation, provenance, and policy/fraud risk.
* Deep Research Agents and AI\-assisted workflows for advertiser investigation, domain review, evidence gathering, policy reasoning, reviewer assistance, appeals, and fraud analysis.
* Decisioning and enforcement systems for policy enforcement, fraud detection, abuse prevention, advertiser risk scoring, and marketplace protection.
* Model\-serving and orchestration infrastructure for LLMs, SLMs, wide \& deep models, ensembles, classical ML, heuristics, rules, and policy controls.
* Security, Risk, and Fraud systems for threats such as phishing, malware, cloaking, account takeover, payment abuse, fake business identities, compromised advertisers, coordinated abuse, and policy evasion.
* Human\-in\-the\-loop, audit, and governance systems with explainability, reproducibility, reviewability, and compliance readiness.
* Measurement and observability systems to track enforcement quality, false positives, false negatives, latency, cost, drift, reviewer burden, advertiser impact, and live\-site health.


 The ideal candidate has the technical credibility to guide architecture, the management experience to build and grow a high\-performing team, and the operational discipline to deliver reliable platform capabilities in a complex, high\-integrity environment.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead and grow a highly technical engineering team responsible for core areas of the Ads Trust \& Safety AI Platform, including advertiser/domain intelligence, content moderation, AI\-assisted investigation, decisioning, enforcement, human review, observability, and risk/fraud protection.
* Set technical direction and execution priorities across platform delivery, quality, reliability, operational excellence, and live\-site readiness.
* Hire, coach, and develop engineers and technical leads, helping them grow in architecture, execution, production quality, ownership, and technical judgment.
* Own delivery for major platform components across ingestion, signal processing, entity intelligence, model serving, content moderation, decisioning, enforcement, audit, and measurement.
* Partner with senior ICs, architects, Applied Science, Product, Policy, Security, Identity, and partner engineering teams to translate business needs into scalable platform capabilities.
* Drive productionization of AI/ML and agentic capabilities with clear quality, latency, cost, reliability \& safety mechanisms.
* Deliver real\-time, nearline, and batch decisioning systems for policy enforcement, content moderation, fraud detection, abuse prevention, advertiser risk scoring, and marketplace protection.
* Evangelize the team’s platform capabilities across Microsoft Ads and relevant Microsoft Trust teams, helping partner teams adopt shared systems.


**Qualifications**
* Required Qualifications
+ Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related technical field
+ 8\+ years of EM experience leading software engineering teams, including experience managing senior engineers, technical leads \& managers.
+ Experience leading engineering teams that build and operate large\-scale production systems with meaningful reliability, scalability, latency, correctness, availability, security, and operational requirements.
+ Technical depth in one or more of the following areas: AI/ML systems, model\-serving infrastructure, decisioning systems, distributed systems, data platforms, workflow platforms, risk platforms, security platforms, or Trust \& Safety systems.
+ Experience partnering with Applied Science, Product, or cross\-functional stakeholders to translate ambiguous requirements into shipped engineering systems.
+ Exposure to production AI/ML systems, including one or more of the following: LLM\-based workflows, retrieval\-augmented generation, model orchestration, automated reasoning, human\-in\-the\-loop systems, AI\-assisted operational tooling, or agentic workflows.
+ Understanding of production requirements for AI or decision systems, including evaluation, observability, quality measurement, rollout safety, fallback behavior, latency/cost tradeoffs, explainability, governance, and operational reliability.
+ Experience building high\-integrity systems where decisions must be auditable, reproducible, explainable, governed, and secure.
+ Demonstrated ability to hire, grow, coach, and retain strong engineering talent in complex technical areas.
+ Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical tradeoffs, risks, execution plans, and platform strategy to engineering, science, product, policy, and business stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualifications**
 The candidate is not expected to have deep experience in every area below. Broader coverage across these areas is preferred, especially where the candidate has demonstrated the ability to connect engineering execution, platform architecture, and production outcomes.
   

  

* Experience in Trust \& Safety, Fraud, Abuse, Risk, Security, Ads Quality, Marketplace Integrity, Policy Enforcement, or advertiser protection systems.
* Experience with adversarial systems, including phishing, malware, cloaking, account takeover, payment abuse, fake identities, compromised advertisers, coordinated fraud, and policy evasion.
* Experience building or managing teams that build Deep Research Agents, investigation agents, reviewer\-assist systems, retrieval\-augmented generation systems, LLM\-powered operational workflows, or AI systems that produce grounded evidence for human or automated decisions.
* Experience managing teams that build model\-serving, decisioning, enforcement, workflow, or human\-review platforms.
* Experience with entity intelligence, knowledge graphs, web crawling, domain reputation, business identity resolution, provenance, evidence extraction, or risk scoring.
* Experience designing or operating human\-in\-the\-loop review systems, appeals workflows, audit platforms, policy reasoning systems, or enforcement governance mechanisms.

As one of the founding members, you'll help shape a brand\-new engineering site while working on infrastructure that multiplies the productivity of the entire engineering organization.
   

  

 What the team works on
   

  

 GitLab (including GitLab Dedicated and Duo): operate the central source\-control and CI/CD platform and enable secure, AI\-assisted SDLC workflows.
   

  

 CI/CD runners: modernize Linux, macOS, iOS, and Android runner fleets improving isolation, queueing, and cost attribution.
   

  

 Progressive Delivery: scale canary, health\-gated, rollback\-aware deployment patterns.
   

  

 Artifactory and supply chain: operate a Tier\-0 artifact platform and improve upgrade, backup, retention, and lifecycle practices.
   

  

 Migration and modernization: retire legacy CI/CD (Concrete) using dashboards, partner engagement, and agentic migration.
   

  

 Mobile build/release and Mobile DevOps: sustain a high release cadence while modernizing build tooling.
   

  

**Zillow Group is a strategic, mission\-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes.** 
 Our work spans cross\-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow’s mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high\-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands\-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.
   

  

**About The Role**
 About the role
   

  

 As the Engineering Manager for the new India\-based Delivery Engineering team, you'll build and lead a founding, general\-purpose platform team responsible for high\-impact work across CI/CD and build infrastructure, Progressive Delivery, migration and deprecation programs, GitLab/Artifactory operations, and mobile release/build tooling.
   

  

 You'll own hiring, people management, performance, and career development while bringing enough technical depth to earn credibility, engage in design reviews, and represent India\-owned areas in engineering leadership forums. This is a founding leadership role: the standards you set and the first engineers you hire will define the long\-term success of Delivery Engineering in India.
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

* Build and grow a high\-impact founding team that owns platform, Progressive Delivery, migration, and mobile\-release work as first\-class contributors.
* Establish a follow\-the\-sun operating model with defined overlap, handoff practices, async\-first documentation, and a phased India on\-call rotation.
* Hire a senior founding team and set and hold a high hiring bar.
* Partner with US area leads and the TPM to allocate capacity, limit work in progress, reduce context switching, and drive predictable delivery.
* Raise the bar on operational excellence: on\-call practices, incident response, post\-incident reviews, SLOs, runbooks, and toil reduction.
* Champion AI\-first delivery across the SDLC, including agentic migration, AI code review, rollout analysis, and platform operations.
* Create a healthy engineering culture across time zones with clear goals, feedback, performance management, development plans, and technical\-leadership growth.


 This role has been categorized as an Office position. “Office” employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute.
   

  

 In addition to a competitive base pay, employees in this role are eligible for incentive compensation subject to applicable laws and relevant Zillow policies. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location.
   

  

 Who you are
   

  

****What you'll bring****
* 10\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 5\+ years managing engineering teams that build backend, platform, infrastructure, SRE, or developer\-productivity services.
* Staff\+ technical depth and sound judgment: able to align business goals with platform capabilities and guide architecture beyond the immediate team.
* Strong operating experience: production ownership, on\-call, incident response, observability, runbooks, and improving reliability over time.
* A proven hiring and talent\-development bar: able to recruit, assess, onboard, mentor, and manage performance with clarity and empathy.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication across seniority levels and geographies; comfortable with async\-first decision\-making.
* Demonstrated ability to build trust with distributed stakeholders and represent India engineering as a peer ownership function.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience building or scaling a new site or distributed engineering team, especially across US–India.
* Experience in DevEx, platform, CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, release engineering, or SRE organizations supporting many internal customers.
* Hands\-on familiarity with AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitLab, CI/CD runners, observability tooling, and modern incident management.
* Experience applying AI to engineering workflows with a quality, governance, and developer\-trust mindset.


 Why join
   

  

* Founding role: shape a new India engineering site and help set the technical and cultural bar from day one.
* High leverage: work on the platform used by every Zillow engineer and every major product surface.
* Modernization agenda: GitLab Dedicated, runner rearchitecture, Progressive Delivery, Artifactory modernization, and legacy retirement.
* AI\-first work: real production use cases across code review, migrations, incident analysis, and deployment safety.
* Global collaboration: partner directly with US engineering leaders while building durable India ownership.


 Get to know us
   

  

 At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers.
   

  

 As the most\-visited real estate platform in the U.S., Zillow helps millions of customers navigate buying, selling, financing, and renting with greater ease and confidence. Our teams in India play a critical role in building and scaling the technology, products, and operations that power this experience.
   

  

 Whether you’re working in tech, operations, or shared services, you’ll collaborate with global partners to solve meaningful problems and help more people make home a reality.
   

  

 Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S.. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2025, and included on the PEOPLE Companies That Care® 2025 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.
   

  

 No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.
