title: Technical Program Manager, Program Lead Engineer
description:
**The Impact You’ll Make**
 As a leading global supplier of wafer fabrication equipment and services to the semiconductor industry, Lam Research develops innovative solutions that help our customers build smaller, faster, and more power\-efficient devices.
   

  

 We are a company comprised of people who work hard, deliver outstanding results, and maintain a sense of humor during even the most challenging times. Our success results from our employees' diverse technical and business expertise, which fuels close collaboration and ongoing innovation. We know that our dynamic, global team of exceptional employees is essential to our continued growth.
   

  

 Join the Lam Research team, where you can play a vital role in the future of electronics and write your own success story.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 We are looking for a senior engineer who combines deep manufacturing quality expertise with the ability to drive Artificial Intelligence (AI)\-enabled transformation. This person will operate at the intersection of engineering, data, and software delivery — translating real\-world manufacturing and quality business rules into specifications that engineering and Information Technology (IT) teams can build, then validating that what gets built works on the shop floor.
   

  

 This is not a traditional quality engineer role and not a traditional software role — it is a hybrid "translator" position for someone who understands parts, drawings, and process data as fluently as they understand how to scope a business rule for a development team.
   

  

* Define and codify manufacturing and quality business rules by analyzing engineering drawings, GD\&T requirements, supplier/manufacturing data, inspection records, and critical\-to\-quality characteristics across a variety of commodities and manufacturing processes.
* Translate engineering and quality domain knowledge into clear, testable requirements that IT, software developers, data engineers, and contractors can implement in automation and AI\-enabled solutions.
* Apply advanced quality and statistical engineering methods including SPC, DOE, Gage R\&R, gage matching, control charts, and Type I/Type II error analysis to validate measurement systems, process performance, and solution accuracy.
* Partner with technical teams throughout the development lifecycle to review business logic, identify edge cases, guide solution design, test functionality, and ensure automation and AI solutions accurately reflect real\-world manufacturing requirements.
* Lead AI\-enabled process transformation initiatives end\-to\-end — identifying high\-value opportunities, determining when AI versus deterministic automation is appropriate, developing the business case, defining requirements, validating results, and driving successful implementation and adoption


**Who We’re Looking For**
 Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering, Data Science, AI, or a related discipline.
   

  

 Minimum 10 years of experience with a bachelor’s degree, or minimum 6 years of experience with a master’s degree.
   

  

* Proven experience in manufacturing, supplier quality, process engineering, or digital transformation roles.
* Strong knowledge of engineering drawings, GD\&T, SPC, DOE, Gage R\&R, and quality systems.
* Proficiency in data analysis tools such as Python, SQL, Minitab, JMP, or similar platforms.
* Understanding of AI/ML, Generative AI, automation, and their application in manufacturing environments.
* Proven ability to lead cross\-functional projects and communicate effectively with engineering, IT, and business stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* A track record of leading or co\-leading process improvement or digital transformation initiatives from idea through implementation and validation
* Practitioner of Lean Six Sigma techniques
* Experience managing suppliers remotely.
* Experience working with SAP databases or other database systems.


**Our commitment**
 We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results.
   

  

 Lam Research ("Lam" or the "Company") is an equal opportunity employer. Lam is committed to and reaffirms support of equal opportunity in employment and non\-discrimination in employment policies, practices and procedures on the basis of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, or military and veteran status or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. It is the Company's intention to comply with all applicable laws and regulations. Company policy prohibits unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees.
   

  

*Lam offers a variety of work location models based on the needs of each role. Our hybrid roles combine the benefits of on\-site collaboration with colleagues and the flexibility to work remotely and fall into two categories – On\-site Flex and Virtual Flex. ‘On\-site Flex’ you’ll work 3\+ days per week on\-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, with the opportunity to work remotely for the balance of the week. ‘Virtual Flex’ you’ll work 1\-2 days per week on\-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, and remotely the rest of the time.*

description:
**Job Description**
* Individual in this role, will manage execution and timely completion of engineering projects by analyzing project scope and determining project specifications, establishing test programs for product investigations, and preparing reports for clients.  A global leader in applied safety science, UL Solutions (NYSE: ULS) transforms safety, security and sustainability challenges into opportunities for customers in more than 110 countries. The UL Mark serves as a recognized symbol of trust in our customers’ products and reflects an unwavering commitment to advancing our safety mission. We help our customers innovate, launch new products and services, navigate global markets and complex supply chains, and grow sustainably and responsibly into the future. Our science is your advantage.

 Our buildings don’t just shape our skylines — they provide the backdrop to our lives. And knowing they’re safe matters. We’ve been helping to create safer structures since 1894, combining our expertise with innovative new technologies to help make sure both people and property are secure. Whether we’re simulating tornadoes or testing smoke alarms, the work we do on our team is used in buildings around the world to — quite literally — help save lives. Join our team and build your skills, build innovative solutions and help build a safer world.

title: Team Lead - Equity Index Data Management
description:
**Team Lead \- Equity Index Data — Job Description**
 Team Overview — Benchmarks \& Indices Operations
   

  

 Equity Index Data Management (EIDM) is part of the Benchmarks \& Indices Operations. We are a client\-focused, technology\-enabled team producing high\-value index data for internal and external clients. EIDM owns the underlying reference data used in the calculation of equity index products globally. We maintain LSEG intellectual property by generating and maintaining: ICB Classifications, Free Float, Voting Rights, Nationality, Universe preparation, Liquidity, and similar data points for Index Review, Rebalance, and Reconstitution cycles.
   

  

 Role Purpose
   

  

 The Team Lead \- Equity Index Data supervises the regional Bangalore team, owns global workflows, review deliverables and leads review planning with Index Review and Index Management. The role owns the performance metrics developed by Performance Enablement, supports the Manager in driving operational excellence and cross\-regional collaboration, and ensures quality and on\-time delivery across quarterly reviews, rebalances, and reconstitutions. The Team Lead will lead key initiatives, mentor team members, and contribute to product innovation, client engagement, vendor management, and automation.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Team Leadership \& Supervision: Supervise and mentor the regional Bangalore team to ensure consistent delivery and adherence to FTSE Russell standards; provide coaching, feedback, and development support.
* Global Workflow Ownership: Own end\-to\-end global workflows (daily BAU, exception management process, quarterly and semi\-annual reviews and other production checkpoints), ensuring operational continuity, data integrity, and cross\-regional coordination.
* Review Planning: Lead review planning with Index Review and Index Management for quarterly reviews, rebalances, and reconstitutions, aligning schedules, dependencies, and quality gates.
* Performance Metrics Ownership: Own the performance matrix/metrics developed by Performance Enablement; monitor, report, and drive continuous improvements in efficiency, quality, and SLA adherence.
* Index Data Operations: Lead daily operations for index data validation, updates, and maintenance across global indices; uphold policy and ground rules compliance and delivery SLAs.
* Core Attribute Research \& Validation: Own research and validation of core index attributes including Free Float, Voting Rights, NICB/ICB classifications, and Country Classification.
* Timely Dataset Updates: Ensure timely and accurate updates to index dataset during review cycles, incorporating corporate actions and market events.
* Data Infrastructure: Maintain SQL databases, validation scripts, and reporting tools that support global index data workflows.
* Product \& Policy Collaboration: Provide data\-driven analysis to support Index Policy on potential ground\-rule or policy updates and during complex client queries (impact assessments and recommendations).
* New Product Support: Collaborate on new index product development by identifying relevant data points, historical datasets, and designing scalable data pipeline requirements.
* Automation \& Tools: Support automation initiatives using Power BI, Power Automate, and SQL to enhance data quality and reduce manual effort; contribute to AI\-based research tools and workflow automation with internal tech teams.
* Vendor Onboarding \& Evaluation: Assist in vendor onboarding and evaluation; conduct due diligence on coverage, quality, SLAs, and alignment with FTSE Russell standards; perform multi\-vendor comparisons and feasibility testing; coordinate UAT/parallel validations.
* Stakeholder Management: Liaise with Index Management, Index Policy, and Delivery teams to ensure smooth review cycles and data alignment across regions.
* Client Engagement: Manage post\-review client queries and provide clear, data\-driven explanations for index decisions consistent with methodology and policy.
* Governance, Risk \& Resilience: Manage compliance with global data governance and business continuity standards; support enterprise risk and resilience initiatives in collaboration with the Manager.


**Qualifications**
 Required
   

  

* 5\+ years of experience in index operations, reviews, rebalances \& reconstitution.
* Strong understanding of equity markets, index construction, and corporate actions.
* Proven ability to lead teams and drive cross\-functional initiatives; excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Proficiency in SQL, Power BI, and automation tools; experience with AWS or BAW is a plus.


 Core Skills
   

  

* People leadership and mentoring; setting priorities, delegating effectively, and developing talent.
* Analytical rigour and problem\-solving; consistent interpretation and application of Index policies and ground rules.
* Strong written and verbal communication, including handling client\-facing explanations and escalations.
* Process discipline: documentation (SOPs, RCAs, QC feedback), control mindset, and continuous improvement orientation.
* Ability to manage complex operational cycles and drive improvements in data quality, governance, and efficiency across global workflows.


**Career Stage:**
 Senior Associate
   

  

**London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) Information:**
 Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you.

description:
**About The Role**
 Freight Tiger is looking for an Integration Lead to own end\-to\-end customer integration delivery between the Freight Tiger platform and customer ERP, SAP and Third party systems.
   

  

 The role combines technical integration expertise, solution design, customer engagement and delivery ownership . The person will work with customer IT/SAP teams, Integration Solution Engineers, Product, Engineering and DevOps to take integrations from requirements to production.
   

  

 This can be a strong IC or a team\-lead role , depending on experience. The person should be comfortable designing solutions, guiding engineers, managing delivery and resolving production issues.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own customer integration requirements and act as the primary technical integration contact.
* Lead requirement and solution\-design discussions with customer IT/SAP teams.

* Define integration architecture, interfaces, data mappings and dependencies.

**Integration Delivery**

**Delivery \& Production**

**Architectural Knowledge**

* Error handling, retry, idempotency and reconciliation
* Integration security and connectivity
* Basic distributed systems and microservices concepts
* Integration monitoring and production reliability

title: VP, IAM Assurance Leader (L13)
description:
**Role Title: VP, IAM Assurance Leader (L13\)**
**Company Overview**
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a premier consumer financial services company delivering one of the industry’s most complete digitally enabled product suites. Our experience, expertise and scale encompass a broad spectrum of industries including digital, health and wellness, retail, telecommunications, home, auto, outdoors, pet and more.
   

  

* We have recently been ranked \#2 among India’s Best Companies to Work for by Great Place to Work. We were among the Top 50 India’s Best Workplaces in Building a Culture of Innovation by All by GPTW and Top 25 among Best Workplaces in BFSI by GPTW. We have also been recognized by AmbitionBox Employee Choice Awards among the Top 20 Mid\-Sized Companies, ranked \#3 among Top Rated Companies for Women, and Top\-Rated Financial Services Companies.
* We provide best\-in\-class employee benefits and programs that cater to work\-life integration and overall well\-being.
* We provide career advancement and upskilling opportunities for all to take up leadership roles.


**Organizational Overview**
 The Identity and Access Management (IAM) team at Synchrony oversees key security functions including authentication, authorization, privileged access management, special programs, and federated controls governance. This team ensures comprehensive management of identity and access processes to maintain robust security and compliance across the organization. This role will oversee a team of seven and be a direct report into the VP, IAM Programs Leader.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 We are seeking an innovative and results\-driven leader to serve as VP, IAM Assurance Leader, responsible for leading the IAM Services Assurance function overseeing key controls across all centralized and decentralized IAM services. This role will work closely with IAM product owners and engineering teams to ensure adherence to Synchrony IAM standards and regulatory requirements without disrupting operational delivery.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will possess deep technical expertise and hands\-on experience across IAM controls, assurance operations, and identity/authentication platforms (e.g., Active Directory, LDAP technologies, Beyond Identity, and related IAM services). As a strategic leader, you will guide teams, enable cross\-functional collaboration, and drive continuous improvement in the effectiveness, reporting, and automation of IAM controls—particularly in critical areas such as logical access, authentication assurance, privileged access oversight, and control evidence for SOX/PCI and other regulatory obligations. You will blend technology insight with program management discipline to ensure success in execution and delivery, including the creation and modernization of assurance reporting capabilities and the automation of control remediation where appropriate.
   

  

**Essential Responsibilities**
* Create and Maintain Strategic Roadmaps: Develop and execute multi\-year roadmaps to drive innovation, strengthen security posture, meet regulatory requirements, and streamline IAM operations—specifically for IAM assurance capabilities, control monitoring, and evidence automation.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Build and nurture strong relationships across Security Operations, Technology Teams, Governance, Operational Risk, and Internal Audit, ensuring program alignment, audit readiness, and the ability to clearly demonstrate IAM control effectiveness to stakeholders and regulators.
* Risk and Progress Management: Identify, assess, and mitigate technical and organizational risks while regularly reporting blockers, corrective actions, and program milestones to executive leadership; ensure timely remediation of control gaps and recurring defects.
* Solution Design \& Automation: Lead and contribute to designing technical solutions for complex automation use cases, driving operational efficiency and scalability—especially automation to detect, track, and remediate IAM control defects.
* Program Integrity: Ensure standards, policies, and procedures are accurately documented and officially maintained for audit and compliance requirements; recommend updates to IAM standards based on security threats, regulatory expectations, and industry trends.
* Performance Tracking: Define, implement, and monitor Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to measure program maturity and overall effectiveness, including assurance coverage, control pass rates, remediation SLAs, defect recurrence, and reporting timeliness/accuracy.
* Assurance Operations Leadership: Lead assurance activities to track, validate, and remediate key logical access and authentication controls across centralized IAM services (e.g., Active Directory, Oracle LDAP, Beyond Identity) and decentralized implementations as applicable.
* Assurance Reporting Platform Ownership: Manage and evolve the IAM assurance reporting platform(s) used to monitor adherence to Synchrony standards, control design, and operational effectiveness; ensure reporting is accurate, resilient, and audit\-ready.
* Agile Partnership with Product Owners: Partner with IAM product owners and delivery teams using Agile methodologies to prioritize and implement control improvements, balancing risk reduction with service stability and customer impact.
* Control Evidence \& Audit Support: Ensure the organization can efficiently produce high\-quality evidence for SOX, PCI, and other examinations; proactively address audit issues with root\-cause correction and sustainable control improvements.
* Documentation \& Enablement: Oversee creation, maintenance, and review of operational process documentation and end\-user/training materials needed to support consistent execution of IAM assurance activities.
* Problem Resolution: Independently resolve technical challenges while escalating issues with clarity when necessary.
* Perform other critical duties or special projects as assigned.


**Qualifications/Requirements**
* BS/BA in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Business Management, or equivalent, plus 10\+ years IT experience, OR in lieu of a degree with 12\+ years IT experience demonstrating progressive responsibility.
* Minimum 5 years of experience leading multiple IAM service products (e.g., authentication, privileged access, identity governance) and driving outcomes across both centralized and distributed service models.
* Minimum 5 years of experience developing and improving IAM service processes and reporting on IAM service key controls (design and operating effectiveness).
* Minimum 3 years leading operations or assurance teams, including continuous monitoring, issue management, and control remediation.
* At least 2 years working with Agile methodologies in roles such as Product Owner, Scrum Master, or Technical Lead.
* Minimum 2 years of people management experience, leading teams of 2\+ engineers or contractors.


**Technical Expertise**
* Strong understanding of IAM directory services, such as Active Directory, LDAP, Oracle LDAP, or similar.
* Experience with assurance reporting, control monitoring dashboards, and/or metrics platforms used to track compliance and remediation status.
* Hands\-on experience with Security Control Design and Security Assurance Operations, including defining controls, validating operating effectiveness, and driving remediation.
* Hands\-on experience with Unix/Linux Server Access Administration and access security.
* Experience supporting or integrating IAM platforms and processes such as ServiceNow, SailPoint IdentityIQ, privileged access tooling (e.g., Bomgar/BeyondTrust), and authentication technologies (e.g., RSA Authentication Manager or equivalents).


**Skills**
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills for effective cross\-team collaboration and executive reporting, including the ability to translate technical risk into business impact.
* Strategic thinker able to develop and articulate long\-term program visions and actionable roadmaps.
* Strong organizational and prioritization skills, capable of managing multiple concurrent projects in complex environments.
* Proactive problem solver with the ability to navigate ambiguity and escalate appropriately.
* Strong analytical and clear\-thinking skills; ability to interpret control results, identify root causes, and drive durable corrective actions.
* Customer\-oriented mindset and ability to reduce friction for product teams while improving assurance outcomes.


**Desired Characteristics**
* Proven experience leading large\-scale IAM initiatives, including program design, execution, and cross\-functional collaboration in complex technical environments.
* Exceptional communication and organizational skills, with a track record of creating and executing long\-term strategic roadmaps.
* Strong ability to manage risk and complexity, navigate roadblocks, and drive corrective actions effectively.
* Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and manage teams while building partnerships across business units and fostering alignment to organizational goals.
* Strong commitment to providing outstanding customer experiences; ability to balance control compliance with minimal operational disruption.
* Self\-starter with a strong sense of urgency and flexibility to change directions quickly while maintaining delivery discipline.
* Experience with the process of creating, maintaining and reviewing operations process \& end user training documentation.
* Working knowledge of ServiceNow, SailPoint IdentityIQ, Active Directory, Bomgar/BeyondTrust privileged access, Unix LDAP, and RSA Authentication Manager (or comparable tools).
* Experience working in highly regulated industries (Finance, Healthcare, Government), particularly enterprise\-level security in a financial institution.
* Familiarity with compliance standards such as SOX, PCI, FFIEC, GDPR, HIPAA, or NIST cybersecurity frameworks, including NIST 800\-63 and logical access control expectations.
* Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, PMP, or relevant IAM\-focused certifications.


**Eligibility Criteria**
 BS/BA in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Business Management, or equivalent, plus 10\+ years IT experience, OR in lieu of a degree with 12\+ years IT experience demonstrating progressive responsibility.
   

  

**Work Timings** 
 : 9AM \- 5PM EST
   

  

 Role requires collaboration during India and US business hour overlap windows to support leadership and stakeholder discussions.
   

  

**For Internal Applicants**
* Understand the criteria or mandatory skills required for the role, before applying
* Inform your manager and HRM before applying for any role on Workday
* Ensure that your professional profile is updated (fields such as education, prior experience, other skills) and it is mandatory to upload your updated resume (Word or PDF format)
* Must not be any corrective action plan (First Formal/Final Formal, LPP)
* L11\+ Employees who have completed 18 months in the organization and 12 months in current role and level are only eligible.
* L11\+ Employees can apply

title: Principal PM, Personalisation, RBS
description:
**Description**
 Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:AMZN), a Fortune 500 company based in Seattle, opened on the World Wide Web in July 1995 and today offers Earth's Biggest Selection. Amazon.com, Inc. seeks to be Earth's most customer\-centric company, where customers can find and discover anything they might want to buy online, and endeavors to offer its customers the lowest possible prices. Today, we operate retail websites in nine countries, offering millions of products in more than 40 categories worldwide, and we still like to work hard, have fun and make history!
   

  

 Amazon's Retail Business Services (RBS) team is looking for a Principal Program Manager to drive a new investment in \*\*Systems Persona Awareness\*\*—a capability that enables Amazon systems to better understand the personalized needs, context, and intent of individual customers to unlock new conversion opportunities.
   

  

 \#\# Overview of the role
   

  

 Customer expectations are rapidly shifting toward experiences that understand them as individuals rather than treating every shopping interaction the same. Customers have different needs, preferences, circumstances, and intent—and Amazon has an opportunity to make its systems increasingly aware of those differences.
   

  

 Today, many Amazon systems operate with limited understanding of the customer's broader persona and personalized needs. This creates an opportunity to evolve from generalized customer experiences toward \*\*persona\-aware systems that can recognize customer context, anticipate needs, and deliver more relevant experiences.\*\*
   

  

 The Principal Program Manager, Systems Persona Awareness will lead this new investment, defining the strategy and mechanisms required to make Amazon systems more customer\-aware and unlock incremental conversion opportunities. This leader will work across product, technology, science, and business teams to translate customer understanding into scalable capabilities and measurable business outcomes.
   

  

 \#\# Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Define the long\-term strategy and vision for \*\*Systems Persona Awareness\*\*, establishing how Amazon systems can better understand and respond to personalized customer needs.
* Identify high\-value customer personas, needs, and use cases where greater system awareness can create meaningful improvements in customer experience and conversion.
* Develop mechanisms and frameworks to assess how effectively Amazon systems understand customer context, intent, preferences, and needs.
* Partner with product, technology, science, and business teams to translate persona insights into scalable customer experiences and measurable conversion opportunities.
* Identify gaps in Amazon's existing systems and develop a prioritized roadmap for improving personalization and customer relevance.
* Establish mechanisms to measure the impact of persona\-aware experiences on customer engagement, satisfaction, and conversion.
* Influence senior leadership by translating customer insights, data, and experimentation into clear strategic recommendations and investment decisions.
* Drive alignment across multiple organizations and operate effectively in a highly ambiguous, cross\-functional environment.
* Establish mechanisms that scale persona awareness beyond individual experiences and enable broader adoption across Amazon systems.


 \#\# Basic Qualifications
   

  

* 10\+ years of experience in program management, product management, strategy, technology, or a related field.
* Proven track record leading complex, cross\-functional initiatives and delivering measurable customer or business outcomes.
* Experience developing strategies and mechanisms for personalization, customer understanding, or large\-scale customer experiences.
* Demonstrated ability to operate independently in ambiguity, establish clarity, and influence senior stakeholders without direct authority.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with experience using data and customer insights to drive decisions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence technical and business audiences.


 \#\# Preferred Qualifications
   

  

* Experience with personalization, customer segmentation, recommendation systems, customer intelligence, or AI/ML\-driven experiences.
* Deep understanding of customer behavior, customer needs, and the factors that influence digital conversion.
* Experience translating customer insights into product, technology, or business strategy.
* Demonstrated ability to build mechanisms that scale across multiple products, teams, or organizations.
* Experience working across product, engineering, science, and business organizations in a large\-scale technology environment.
* MBA or advanced degree in computer science, data science, behavioral science, business, or a related field.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
* Bachelor's degree in a technical field or business\-related field
* Hands on experience in Retail, eCommerce and supply chain functions Proven history of delivering results while owning complex cross\-functional launches partnering with central teams


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership
* Familiarity or experience with autonomous systems and machine learning is a plus point for this role.

title: Manager III, Software Development, Trust CX Innovations
description:
**Description**
 We are building the future of responsible AI at Amazon. We deliver privacy\-first, accessible, and trustworthy AI experiences that millions of customers use daily. Our mission is to ensure that as we push the boundaries of generative AI innovation, we maintain the highest bar for customer trust, privacy, inclusion, and accessibility.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Lead multiple engineering teams building foundational systems and consumer\-facing features that enable trustworthy AI experiences at scale, owning architectural decisions across privacy\-preserving AI, responsible AI frameworks, and accessibility.
   

  

 Define and drive the technical strategy for privacy\-preserving architectures including federated learning, differential privacy, and on\-device processing that protect customer data while delivering high\-quality experiences.
   

  

 Build and scale teams developing AI evaluation frameworks, safety guardrails for large language models, and observability systems that monitor model quality, hallucination rates, and trust metrics in production.
   

  

 Partner with Product, Design, Legal, Policy, and Research teams to align on priorities, resolve trade\-offs between innovation speed and trust requirements, and drive adoption of responsible AI standards across business lines.
   

  

 Grow engineering leaders and create an inclusive team environment where engineers develop expertise in AI safety, privacy technologies, and responsible system design while delivering reliably against a multi\-year roadmap.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 You start your morning reviewing operational metrics and system health dashboards before joining a design review with your engineers. Mid\-morning, you collaborate with partner teams on roadmap alignment and trade\-off discussions. After lunch, you hold a one\-on\-one with a direct report to discuss their career development plan. Later, you dive into a technical document your team is authoring, providing feedback that sharpens the proposal. You close the day preparing a narrative for an upcoming planning review.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our team is responsible for the systems that make Amazon's AI experiences trustworthy, private, and accessible. We build privacy\-preserving data pipelines, AI safety guardrails, transparency controls, and evaluation frameworks used across multiple product lines. We work at the intersection of generative AI innovation and customer protection, partnering closely with research, policy, and product teams.
   

  

 We are focused on scaling responsible AI infrastructure as agentic and multimodal capabilities grow. If you are excited about leading engineers who solve novel problems in AI safety and privacy while shaping industry standards, we would love to hear from you.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of engineering team management experience
* 8\+ years of engineering experience
* 8\+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
* Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
* Experience partnering with product or program management teams
* Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
* Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

title: SAP S4 HANA FICO
description:
**The group you’ll be a part of**
 You will be part of Lam Research’s global Finance and Digital Transformation organization, supporting enterprise\-wide financial systems and processes. The team partners closely with Finance, IT, Manufacturing, and Program leadership to deliver scalable, compliant, and future\-ready SAP S/4HANA Finance solutions across regions and business units.
   

  

**The impact you’ll make**
 In this role, you will deliver enterprise\-level impact by shaping how Lam designs, governs, and executes financial processes during large\-scale migrations from SAP ECC/SAP Central Component to SAP S/4HANA and Central Finance. You will influence finance architecture decisions, evaluate fit\-for\-purpose migration strategies such as system conversion, selective data transition, Central Finance\-led adoption, and phased process transformation, and ensure business continuity, compliance, and financial integrity across global operations.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 Lead and own SAP Finance \& Controlling solution design for ECC to S/4HANA transformations, operating independently on complex, high\-impact initiatives.
   

  

 Drive end\-to\-end SAP S/4HANA and Central Finance migration strategy for FICO, including migration from SAP ECC/SAP Central Component to S/4HANA using differentiated approaches such as brownfield system conversion, greenfield implementation, selective data transition, or Central Finance as a stepping\-stone strategy. Conduct in\-depth analysis and redesign of complex business processes.
   

  

 Define future\-state finance architectures leveraging SAP S/4HANA capabilities such as Universal Journal, New Asset Accounting, embedded analytics, Central Finance for harmonized financial reporting and data replication, and Central Procurement implementation within the CFIN transformation scope.
   

  

 Compliance and Risk Management: Partner with the internal audit, Cybersecurity, and other IT teams to ensure processes and technologies adhere to regulatory requirements, financial reporting standards, and internal controls, maintaining high levels of data integrity.
   

  

 System Optimization: Analyze the effectiveness of existing systems, identify opportunities for improvement, and develop strategies to leverage technology for operational efficiency.
   

  

 Assisting with various state and local indirect tax consulting projects including sales \& use and excise tax overpayment reviews, tax implications of sales and purchase transactions, audit defense services, nexus planning, and voluntary disclosures.
   

  

 Must have proficiency in implementing/supporting tax technology products, such as Vertex, Corp Tax and other similar tax software
   

  

 Design, configure, and optimize SAP FICO modules with a strong focus on Product Costing (CO\-PC) and Cost Object Controlling (CO\-OM) in manufacturing environments.
   

  

 Serve as the functional authority for cross\-module integrations between FICO, SD, MM, and PP.
   

  

 Partner with Global partners in Europe, India and US.
   

  

 Guide integration with external and adjacent systems including FP\&A platforms, SAP RAR, tax engines, and financial close tools.
   

  

 Support Central Procurement implementation in the Central Finance landscape, including integration with sourcing, procurement, accounts payable, tax, intercompany, and financial reporting processes.
   

  

 Own financial data migration strategy and execution, ensuring accuracy, reconciliation, auditability, and compliance.
   

  

 Assess source\-system readiness, data quality, custom code, integration dependencies, and business process impacts to recommend the appropriate SAP ECC/SAP Central Component to S/4HANA migration path for each process area or region.
   

  

**Who We’re Looking For**
 We are looking for a recognized SAP Finance subject\-matter expert who operates with minimal supervision, exercises independent judgment, and influences decisions across organizational boundaries. The ideal candidate is a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders and thrives in complex, global environments.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Information Systems, or a related field.
* Minimum of 12 years of progressive SAP FICO experience across ECC and SAP S/4HANA environments.
* Deep expertise in manufacturing finance, product costing, External Tax Engine (Vertex) and controlling processes.
* Proven experience designing and governing cross\-module SAP solutions at enterprise scale.
* Strong ability to influence senior business and IT stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* SAP certification in FICO and/or SAP S/4HANA.
* Experience leading global SAP rollouts or multi\-region implementations.
* Experience with SAP Fiori.
* Knowledge of SAP integration and data migration tools.
* Experience with Central Finance\-enabled Central Procurement implementation and integration with SAP S/4HANA Finance processes.
* Knowledge of cloud\-based and on\-premises integration technologies (e.g., SAP Cloud Platform Integration, SAP Data Services, Migration Cockpit).

 We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results.

title: Risk Manager I, Relay Product Excellence
description:
**Description**
 As a Risk Manager of the Driver Identity Verification team, you will be responsible for providing the overall management for a team of employees and direct leadership to the investigation team, overseeing and developing employee performance and process improvement activities. This team conducts risk reviews on drivers with investigatory resources and tools to validate identity. The group has responsibility for taking appropriate actions on or accounts to protect Amazon from risk of account takeover and to prevent /mitigate fraud. The team aims and works towards zero fraud, zero account takeovers, zero false positives, and zero scams of any kind. The team seeks the best possible trade\-off between customer experience and risk related losses, and when they have to make difficult choices, they will err towards the customer experience.
   

  

 You will be responsible for building and maintaining SOP’s, implementing, managing and reporting through Metrics, Service Level Agreements and Key Performance Indicators through Strategic Leadership and Vision, Daily Operational Management and Continuous Process improvements. You will be responsible for building operational cadences and review mechanisms to enable the team to achieve performance standards. You will have a strong voice in the forecasting accuracy of investigations, the necessary staffing requirements to achieve SLAs, and in ensuring all coaching, training needs are met. You will be a functional Operations owner, who works closely with the global program owners to design and deploy business strategies for enhanced Customer experience, including SLAs, First Contact Resolution, feedback on policies and decision quality and overall tools enhancements.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Manage a team of investigators
* Provide data analysis \& conduct investigations (as needed)
* Pull data from numerous databases (using Excel, Access, SQL and/or other data management systems) and to perform ad hoc reporting and analysis as needed
* Take appropriate action to identify and help minimize the risk posed by fraud or abuse patterns and trends
* Identify and eliminate root causes of defects in order to drive efficiency in Amazon’s transportation operations
* Understand the business impact of the trends and make decisions that make sense based on available data
* Knowledge to systematically escalate problems or variance in the information and data to the relevant owners and teams
* Work within various time constraints to meet critical business needs, while measuring and identifying activities performed
* Written and verbal communication experience, as you will be required to create a narrative outlining your weekly findings and the variances to goals, and present these finding in a review forum
* The right individual will have solid business judgment, effectively communicate team goals, and drive a fast\-paced organization to deliver results with a focused and pragmatic approach to the business
* Achieve operational excellence and drive process improvements
* Develop employees and their skill sets to expand the team capabilities
* Manage and execute for defined metrics and quality, maintain clear metrics on our investigation handling volumes, performance, and decision quality
* Possess superior analytical abilities and judgment. Use quantitative and qualitative data to prioritize and influence, show creativity, experimentation and innovation, and drive projects with urgency in this fast\-paced environment
* The manager's success will be measured by their ability to drive operational efficiencies across all processing areas whilst improving internal and external customer experience
* Person should be willing to work in rotational shifts


**About The Team**
 It’s no secret that Amazon relies on its technology to deliver millions of packages every day to its customers – on time, with low cost. The Middle Mile Transportation Technology organization, builds complex software solutions that work across our vendors, warehouses and carriers to optimize both time \& cost of getting the packages delivered. Our services already handle thousands of requests per second, make business decisions impacting billions of dollars a year, integrate with a network of small and large carriers, owner operators and drivers worldwide, manage business rules for millions of unique products, and improve ordering and delivery experience for millions of online shoppers. That said, this remains a fast growing business and our technical journey has only started. With rapid expansion into new geographies, innovations in supply chain, unique delivery models for products ranging from Amazon Fresh groceries, ultra\-fast Prime Now deliveries of big\-screen TV’s, increasingly complex transportation network, and growing number of shipments worldwide, we see a brand new opportunity to fundamentally change the way people get the stuff they need, and make a big impact by cutting billions of dollars of transportation costs from the ecosystem. Our mission is to build the most efficient and optimal transportation solution on the planet, using our technology and engineering muscle as our biggest advantage. We aim to leverage latest technologies in big data, machine learning, optimization techniques, and operate high volume, low latency, and high availability services.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Experience with MS Office, MS Excel, and data retrieval languages
* 
* Min 2 years of experience working on identity verification/ fraud detection processes
* Prior experience in manufacturing, transportation, customer service, and/or distribution environments
* Min 5 years of overall experience out of which over 3 years of experience in leading an operational organization in a global environment, responsible for an overall team of 15\+ employees
* Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited university or equivalent
* Should be flexible to adapt to a 24 x 7 operating environment
* Ability to pull data from databases (using Excel, Access, SQL and/or other data management systems)
* Well\-versed with written and verbal communication skills both remotely and face to face
* Evidence of success in operational management, operational enhancement and operational change
* Coaching and leadership skills including evidence of successful succession planning models.
* 3 years\+ people and performance management experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in Lean and Six Sigma
* Data management \& data quality control experience with experience pulling and analyzing large sets of data
* Knowledge using data to drive root cause elimination and process improvement
* Knowledge in data and experience spotting the trends and fixing gaps

description:
**Mission**
 Energy Tech Academy aims to accelerate electrification worldwide by training our external ecosystem with critical technical and digital capabilities needed for the energy transition. We empower partners, electricians, technicians and end customers to thrive in the new energy tech era.
   

  

 The Technical Capability \& Workforce Development Lead shapes and scales Schneider Electric's technical learning ecosystem for external learners. Acting as the strategic bridge between Business Units, technical academies, subject matter experts, certification owners and external ecosystem partners, the role transforms Schneider Electric expertise into scalable learning pathways, certifications, communities and workforce\-development initiatives, with dedicated
 **role\-based programs** 
 for electricians and contractors
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical capability strategy**

**Role\-based learning pathways and certification architecture**

**Technical communities and learner engagement**

**Strategic external capability ecosystem**

* Strengthen Schneider Electric's positioning as a capability\-building leader for the energy transition.


**Education And Experience**
* Master's degree in electrical engineering, energy systems, automation, industrial engineering, digital technologies, education technology or a related discipline.
* 7\-15 years of experience in technical learning, engineering excellence, capability development, technical consulting, product management, customer enablement, workforce development or academy leadership.
* Proven experience leading complex, cross\-functional initiatives in a global matrix organization.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and technical leaders without direct authority.
* Experience designing competency frameworks, role\-based learning journeys, certification programs or workforce\-development initiatives.
* Experience working with electricians, contractors or comparable technical customer audiences is strongly preferred.

**Leadership competencies**
* Strategic leadership connecting business priorities, workforce needs and technical capability development.

* Technical credibility across energy\-management and related technology domains.

**Measures of success**

title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, Amazon Device Troubleshooting Team
description:
**Description**
 Amazon Device Troubleshooting Team exist to ensure device and application customers have delightful experiences using the product by enabling swift, precise, and privacy\-compliant observability and issue resolution across all devices and applications. Our mission is to transform vast amounts of device data into actionable insights that drive product stability and customer satisfaction. To achieve this mission, we provide comprehensive technology solutions spanning the entire observability lifecycle. This includes on\-device crash and log management, high\-scale data ingestion services, advanced analytics dashboards, and intuitive troubleshooting interfaces.
   

  

 As a Senior Technical Program Manager for the Amazon Device Troubleshooting Services team, you will drive critical initiatives that enhance the detection, diagnosis, and resolution of issues across Amazon's device ecosystem. This high\-visibility role requires exceptional leadership in coordinating across several engineering teams, data engineers, applied scientists,BIEs and senior stakeholders to deliver scalable troubleshooting solutions that improve customer experience. You will be responsible for influencing feature priorities and getting buy in from engineering teams for delivery of large cross\-organization programs. You will leverage your technical knowledge to drive technical trade\-off decisions. You will represent difficult trade\-off decisions and solutions clearly to technical and business leaders to help them understand decisions and options. As a Technical Program Manager, you will be one of the key leaders on the team and have an impact by defining strategy \& requirements, developing processes \& schedules, and driving forward progress on major initiatives.
   

  

 As a Senior Technical Program Manager, you will bring strong project management skills to systematically drive programs and deliver results. You possess good technical skills to deal with ambiguous programs to drive clarity in scope and execution. You are have demonstrated ability in driving programs with multiple stakeholders, use escalation mechanisms and negotiation skills to drive the right outcomes. You have good communication skills, both written and verbal and are adept in communicating with stakeholders and executives with right level of detail and clarity.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As the Senior Technical Program Manager, you will drive key business collaborations critical to improving the customer experience with Amazon Devices.
   

  

* You will partner with Senior Leaders within Amazon Devices to identify opportunities to increase device stability, reduce device resource utilizations, save costs and improve efficiency.
* You will define and implement strategical partnerships that enables businesses in Amazon Devices scale faster, save costs, and improve efficiency.
* You will establish mechanisms and processes that drive continuous improvement and operational efficiency.
* You will establish metrics and design self\-serve reports to keep stake\-holders informed and excited about the progress


 A day in the life
   

  

 This role will drive engagement across different product lines to design and drive programs that will improve the stability, reduce the resource utilization of the devices. You will also help build mechanisms to prevent duplication of tools across teams for troubleshooting and analysis. As a direct result, this role offers the challenge as well as the opportunity to bring structure and clarity to a fast\-moving space. This high visibility role is inherently cross\-organizational in nature. You will be a champion of this product to senior leadership.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Amazon Device Troubleshooting Services (ADTS) team ensures that troubleshooting is quick, easy, and privacy\-centric for device and application teams, so that end customers have delightful experiences with their Amazon Devices. We provide a single place for device and application teams to troubleshoot known issues, uncover emergent trends or regressions, and quantify the impact in the context of the customer journey. We build technology to deliver high\-quality user experiences for troubleshooting and analysis, ensure stability of the device, and proactively present critical issues and root causes to relevant teams based on a wide range of health and customer journey data.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 5\+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 3\+ years of software development experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience using English communication skills, both written and verbal, to foster seamless interaction with stakeholders at all levels


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi\-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership
* Experience leading highly technical programs involving infrastructure, complex systems, systems engineering
* Experience managing technical programs across cross\-functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience managing communication with geographically distributed teams

We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.

 We are seeking a Technical Program Manager to lead the delivery and ongoing success of technical advertising solutions. You will partner with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Ad Operations, and other cross\-functional teams to turn defined goals into clear plans and coordinate programs from planning through launch.
   

  

 You will bring structure to complex work, maintain alignment across stakeholders, and help teams identify and address risks, dependencies, and decisions. You will use established program practices while identifying opportunities to improve how teams plan, communicate, and execute.
   

  

 The role focuses three primary areas:
   

  

* Program \& Platform Delivery Delivery: Lead the end\-to\-end execution of defined, cross\-functional technical programs. Translate product and technical requirements into clear, dependency\-aware plans; coordinate milestones and delivery activities; and proactively surface risks, decisions, and tradeoffs. Apply established program practices while identifying opportunities to improve how teams plan and execute.
* Cross\-Functional Alignment: Partner with stakeholders across consumer\-facing teams, revenue teams, and shared technical platforms to deliver cohesive advertising experiences. Build shared understanding of scope, priorities, responsibilities, and delivery expectations. Facilitate timely decisions and help teams navigate competing needs and dependencies.
* Operational Excellence \& Experimentation: Support reliable, measurable, and continuously improving program execution. Partner with Product, Engineering, and Data teams to coordinate experiment readiness, performance monitoring, release planning, and incident follow\-up. Use program and operational insights to identify execution gaps and recommend improvements.


 This role has been categorized as an Office position. “Office” employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute.
   

  

 In addition to a competitive base pay, employees in this role are eligible for incentive compensation subject to applicable laws and relevant Zillow policies. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location.
   

  

 Who you are
   

  

 You are an organized and collaborative program leader who brings clarity and structure to complex technical work. You are comfortable leading programs with defined goals, managing dependencies across teams, and adapting plans as new information emerges.
   

  

 You combine disciplined execution with a continuous improvement mindset. You are comfortable working within established practices while recommending thoughtful improvements that reduce friction and help teams deliver effectively.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience leading technical initiatives from planning through delivery
* Experience coordinating work across Product, Engineering, Data, Operations, or other cross\-functional partners
* Strong program management skills, including planning, risk management, dependency tracking, release readiness, and stakeholder communication

* Ability to understand technical concepts, system dependencies, and their connection to customer or business outcomes
* Experience identifying and implementing continuous improvements to program delivery processes, frameworks, and operating practices to strengthen execution
* Demonstrated ability to build alignment and influence outcomes without direct authority
* Here at Zillow, we value the experience and perspective of candidates with non\-traditional backgrounds. We encourage you to apply if you have transferable skills or related experience.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience supporting experimentation, measurement, or data\-informed product development
* Experience working with advertising, media, or marketplace platforms, such as Google Ad Manager, Prebid, supply\-side platforms, demand\-side platforms, data management platforms, or programmatic infrastructure


 Get to know us
   

  

 At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most\-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.

title: Associate Project Lead
description:
**Department: Operations GBS, International Marketing and Commercial**
**Company: Novo Nordisk Global Business Services (GBS)**
 Do you enjoy bringing together diverse stakeholders, managing complex projects, and creating excellence in execution? If so, we invite you to join Novo Nordisk as an Associate Project Lead in the Commercial Portfolio \& Launch Office within Operations GBS.
   

  

**About The Department**
 The Operations GBS unit will drive executional excellence and efficiency by focusing on all operations\-related activities, including execution of marketed brands, operations of medical affairs, omnichannel operations, commercial analytics, operational communications, customer fulfilment within commercial supply chain and sustainability.
   

  

 You will be anchored in International Marketing \& Commercial Operations GBS in Bangalore, within the IO Cardiometabolic Marketing team. We are the commercial engine helping shape and activate brand strategies across the cardiometabolic portfolio, partnering with IO marketing teams, regions, affiliates and cross\-functional stakeholders to translate strategic priorities into launch\-ready plans, impactful customer engagement and execution that moves at the speed of our ambition.
   

  

**The position**
 As an Associate Project Lead, you will support the planning, governance, and execution of strategic product launches across International Operations markets. You will work closely with global and regional stakeholders to drive launch readiness, enhance launch capabilities, and ensure alignment across commercial, regulatory, supply chain, medical, and pricing functions.
   

  

 You will also contribute to the continuous development and governance of launch planning processes and digital solutions that support launch excellence across Novo Nordisk.
   

  

**Day\-to\-day Your Tasks Will Include**
* Driving launch planning, execution, and readiness activities for strategic product launches across International Operations markets.
* Supporting launch governance forums, cross\-functional launch teams, and launch acceleration initiatives.
* Facilitating stakeholder alignment and identifying risks, dependencies, and oppor\-tunities to accelerate launches.
* Supporting the development, implementation, and governance of launch planning frameworks and processes.
* Contributing to the development and optimization of launch planning tools and systems.
* Coordinating launch data, timelines, and reporting while ensuring compliance with governance requirements.
* Developing dashboards, performance reports, and insights to support informed decision\-making.
* Delivering training programs, onboarding sessions, and capability\-building initia\-tives for affiliates and stakeholders.
* Managing strategic projects, preparing leadership presentations, and supporting governance and review meetings.
* Driving continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen launch excellence and operational efficiency.


**Qualifications**
 To succeed in this role, you will bring:
   

  

* MBA or equivalent postgraduate degree in Business, Marketing, Life Sciences, Pharmacy, or a related field.
* 6 to 8 years of experience in project management, commercial operations, mar\-keting, launch excellence, healthcare consulting, pharmaceutical market research, or related functions.
* Experience working within the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry.
* Strong project management and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Excellent analytical skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and other business reporting tools.
* Strong communication and presentation skills with experience influencing cross\-functional stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience supporting product launches, portfolio management, or go\-to\-market initiatives.
* Familiarity with launch planning processes, governance frameworks, and digital planning platforms.
* Exposure to global or regional pharmaceutical operations.
* Experience managing multiple workstreams across diverse stakeholder groups in a matrix organization


**Working at Novo Nordisk**
 Novo Nordisk is a leading global healthcare company with a 100\-year legacy of driving change to defeat serious chronic diseases. Building on our strong legacy within diabetes, we are growing massively and expanding our commitment, reaching millions around the world, and impacting more than 40 million patient lives daily. All of this has made us one of the 20 most valuable companies in the world by market cap. Our success relies on the joint potential and collaboration of our more than 63,000 employees around the world. We recognize the importance of the unique skills and perspectives our people bring to the table, and we work continuously to bring out the best in them. Working at Novo Nordisk, we’re working toward something bigger than ourselves, and it’s a collective effort. Join us! Together, we go further. Together, we’re life changing.

 To submit your application, please upload your CV online (click on Apply and follow the instructions).

description:
**How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview \& Key Responsibilities)**
 We are seeking a hands\-on Manager, Data Engineering to lead execution across a portfolio of Flight Safety data engineering work while also serving as a senior individual contributor. This role is responsible for prioritization, sequencing, and delivery coordination across competing needs, while providing technical leadership, coaching, and site\-level support for the local engineering effort. The role is expected to operate in a working\-leader model, with approximately 70–80% of time spent contributing directly to technical work and the remaining time focused on team coordination, coaching, and leadership responsibilities.
   

  

**What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)**
**What you need to succeed (minimum qualifications)**
* BS / MS degree in a technical or scientific field with 14\+ years of overall relevant experience.
* Accountable (A) for intake, prioritization, sequencing, and trade\-off decisions across the engineering portfolio. Defines execution priorities, clarifies ownership, escalates constraints, and aligns stakeholder demand with available capacity. May contribute to solution design and implementation but is distinct from the Data Engineer role in owning portfolio\-level direction and delivery decisions.
* Own intake, prioritization, sequencing, and execution visibility across Flight Safety data engineering work
* Provide day\-to\-day leadership for the engineering effort, including work assignment, coordination, follow\-through, and escalation of blockers
* Coach and support the Data Engineer while raising expectations for quality, maintainability, documentation, and disciplined execution
* Serve as the primary point of coordination between stakeholders, analysts, and technical partners on engineering scope, timing, and trade\-offs
* Translate stakeholder needs into clear technical workstreams, delivery plans, and ownership boundaries
* Establish lightweight operating rhythms for intake, prioritization, execution tracking, and decision follow\-up
* Provide hands\-on technical contribution where needed, especially in higher\-complexity or higher\-ambiguity work, while maintaining accountability for overall portfolio delivery
* Identify resource gaps, competing demands, and execution risks, and surface them early with practical options or recommendations
* Reinforce a sustainable engineering model that reduces single\-threaded dependency and increases repeatability over time
* Support site\-level leadership through local coordination, team support, and reinforcement of delivery standards and working norms


 Success Metrics
   

  

* Planning accuracy (planned vs. actual delivery timelines)
* Decision cycle time for prioritization and trade\-offs
* Reduction in blocked or ownerless work
* % of work with clear priority, owner, and expected outcome
* Throughput of completed work across the portfolio
* Reduction in rework caused by unclear scope or conflicting priorities
* Stakeholder clarity and confidence in engineering priorities
* Growth in team independence, consistency, and execution discipline


**Behavioral Competencies**
* Ability to champion a collaborative environment by empowering team members, demonstrating resilience, being inclusive, and building a culture of trust.
* Ability to build and sustain robust networks across internal and external stakeholders.
* Being a coach/mentor/advisor to drive continuous team development and growth.
* Use systemic thinking to drive business results and strategic decisions that enhance organizational outcomes.
* Ability to advocate for customer\-focused innovations, model empathy in decision\-making, inspiring others to approach problems from the customer’s perspective and decisions that reflect an uncompromising commitment to customer safety, fostering trust and loyalty.


**What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)**
 Data Engineering
