The ideal candidate will obsess over customers and have a proven track record of delivering results while managing high level of complexity. Successful candidates will have experience with Program Management in a broad, global organization, have experience working with a variety of cross\-organizational stakeholders, and be able to juggle competing priorities. This candidate must have crisp communication skills, and have experience communicating project status and updates across a global audience. Ability to navigate ambiguous programs, influence without authority, and a high bias for action are critical for success in this role.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As a Program Manager, you will be responsible for identifying, scoping, and delivering large end to end programs. You will have the opportunity to engage with experienced cross\-disciplinary teams to conceive of and design innovative customer facing initiatives. You thrive through creating a vision, building consensus and driving teams towards results. You will anticipate bottlenecks, provide escalation management, anticipate and make trade\-offs, and balance the business needs versus technical constraints. An ability to take large, significantly complex projects and break them down into manageable pieces, and then deliver them in a successful and timely manner is expected. This role will require the candidate be self\-sufficient to analyze large amounts of data. So, working knowledge of SQL is critical for success. You will not be required to build data infrastructure but you will need to be comfortable querying (good foundational knowledge), be nifty with excel (power pivot), and use data to drive / influence discussions. Many a times you will have to leverage existing data generated by other BIEs to drive your programs. Other times, the exact data may not be available and you will need to be self\-sufficient to not be blocked by this.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 Your week will typically start with looking at key input/output metrics and identifying trends/concerns/opportunities. You will engage with stakeholders ad partners to track progress on goals, as well as identify opportunities to further enhance customer experience. You will crisply communicate to senior leadership on status, progress, concerns and help required to unblock key opportunities. The bottom line is to drive improvements which requires strong communication, a flair for identifying data patterns, comfort with analyzing large varied datasets, and a knack of influencing diverse set of stakeholders.
   

  

**About The Team**
 We are building products that help customers to easily identify offers which are closest to them. True to Amazon’s tenets, customer and seller obsession are always at the forefront of our decisions. We innovate and design our services and tools with a focus on customer experience, followed by our focus on technology and worldwide scaling. You will work on the customer’s search experience, build new widgets that drive better discovery of products, improve personalization for the entire customer’s journey, improve our perception of speed, and scale all these products globally.

* Experience owning program strategy, end\-to\-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

title: EMS - Technical Project Manager
description:
IRP systems are developing the next generation of high\-performance e\-powertrain systems that will change the electric vehicles market. We are seeking for an experienced EMS \- Technical Project Manager in India.
   

  

 Requirements:
   

  

 We are looking for a technically strong and execution\-focused EMS \- Technical Project Manager to lead and coordinate manufacturing\-related technical projects across our EMS partner ecosystem. This role will ensure that manufacturing capacity, infrastructure, equipment, processes, and contingency plans are ready to support product mix changes, volume ramp\-ups, and business growth. The position requires a strong understanding of Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS), hands\-on project execution capability, and the ability to operate effectively within a global matrix organization.
   

  

 About us:
   

  

 IRP Systems is an Israeli deep\-tech company at the forefront of electric vehicle (EV) power electronics. We design and manufacture advanced semiconductor\-based power conversion systems for the EV industry, operating across global R\&D, manufacturing, and business locations.
   

  

 You’ll be responsible for the following:
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Line Expansion \& Capacity Readiness
   

  

* Develop and execute line expansion plans to support changing product mix, production requirements, and volume ramp\-up.
* Assess manufacturing capacity, equipment requirements, manpower needs, and infrastructure readiness with EMS partners.
* Lead technical projects related to new production lines, additional assembly capacity, process upgrades, and manufacturing scalability.
* Identify capacity constraints and drive corrective actions to support business and delivery targets.


 CAPEX \& Asset Management
   

  

* Plan, coordinate, and manage IRP’s manufacturing\-related CAPEX projects.
* Ensure effective utilization, deployment, tracking, and maintenance of IRP\-owned equipment, tools, and manufacturing assets.
* Coordinate equipment procurement, installation, qualification, commissioning, and handover activities.
* Monitor CAPEX budgets, project timelines, and implementation milestones.


 Contingency Planning \& Business Continuity
   

  

* Develop and implement contingency plans covering critical equipment, tools, fixtures, spares, and manufacturing infrastructure.
* Identify single points of failure within the EMS manufacturing process.
* Establish backup strategies for critical production equipment, tooling, and process dependencies.
* Ensure availability of critical spares and backup arrangements to minimize production disruptions.


 Manufacturing \& Assembly Process Compliance
   

  

* Ensure manufacturing and assembly processes meet IRP’s technical, quality, reliability, and production requirements.
* Maintain and update manufacturing process requirements, specifications, work instructions, and technical documentation.
* Work closely with EMS partners to ensure adherence to approved processes and manufacturing standards.
* Support process audits, technical reviews, change management, and continuous improvement initiatives.


 Project Management \& Cross\-Functional Coordination
   

  

* Own project planning, execution, tracking, risk management, and closure for assigned technical manufacturing projects.
* Establish milestones, deliverables, timelines, dependencies, and success criteria.
* Coordinate engineering, manufacturing, quality, supply chain, procurement, EMS partners, and global stakeholders.
* Provide regular project status updates, risk assessments, escalation points, and management reports.


 What We Are Looking For
   

  

 Must\-Have Experience
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Proven experience in technical project management within an EMS / Electronics Manufacturing Services environment.
* Strong technical understanding of electronics manufacturing and assembly processes.
* Experience with a state\-of\-the\-art EMS company, preferably in high\-mix, high\-complexity, or automotive\-grade manufacturing.
* Experience managing manufacturing capacity expansion, equipment deployment, CAPEX, or production readiness projects.
* Strong project planning, execution, tracking, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working in a global or matrix organization.


 Technical \& Industry Knowledge
   

  

* Good understanding of EMS manufacturing processes, electronics assembly, production line setup, process validation, and manufacturing readiness.
* Familiarity with automotive and/or aerospace manufacturing standards and quality requirements.
* Understanding of process compliance, technical documentation, change management, and manufacturing controls.
* Experience with contingency planning, critical spares, equipment backup, and manufacturing business continuity.


 Communication \& Leadership Skills
   

  

* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to present project status, risks, investment requirements, and recommendations to senior management.
* Strong coordination and influencing skills across internal teams, EMS partners, and global stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast\-paced environment.


 The Kind of Person Who Thrives Here
   

  

* You are a technical project owner, not just a coordinator.
* You understand how manufacturing works and can challenge technical decisions when required.
* You anticipate risks before they become production disruptions.
* You can move between strategic planning and detailed execution.
* You take ownership of timelines, deliverables, and outcomes.

title: Project Lead
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION** 




  





**ROLE :** 
 PM Lead
 



**EXPERIENCE :** 
 6\-8 years
 



**PRIMARY FOCUS :** 
 Project delivery \& governance
 



**WORK MODEL:** 
 Global stakeholder collaboration
 



**CERTIFICATION:** 
 PMP preferred
 



**Work Mode : Hybrid** 




**Location : Bangalore** 




  





**About Indegene** 




 We are a technology\-led healthcare solutions provider, driven by our purpose to enable healthcare organizations to be future\-ready. We offer accelerated global growth opportunities for talent that is bold, industrious, and nimble. At Indegene, you gain a differentiated career experience at the convergence of healthcare and technology, guided by entrepreneurship, passion, innovation, collaboration, and empathy.
 



 We are purpose\-driven, customer\-obsessed, bold in our actions, nimble in our decision\-making, and industrious in the way we work. Explore opportunities at
 
 www.careers.indegene.com
 




  





**Job Summary** 




 We are looking for a PM Lead to drive successful, on\-time, on\-budget, and quality\-compliant delivery of projects within the Global Safety and Pharmacovigilance Business Unit. The role will partner with global and regional stakeholders, safety operations teams, medical and regulatory functions, technology teams, and external partners to define project scope, establish plans, manage dependencies, monitor progress, and measure outcomes.
 



  





 The PM Lead will retain end\-to\-end project management accountability while applying relevant pharmacovigilance considerations, including regulatory timelines, patient safety priorities, quality controls, inspection readiness, data privacy, and controlled change management.
 



  





**Core Responsibilities** 



* Collect, clarify, and document project requirements; assess options and coordinate best\-fit solutions.
* Define project scope, goals, deliverables, timelines, milestones, resource needs, and success measures.
* Build and maintain integrated project plans using appropriate project management tools.
* Manage project dependencies, critical paths, risks, assumptions, issues, decisions, and change requests.
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams and external partners to ensure timely handoffs and delivery accountability.
* Liaise with project stakeholders on an ongoing basis and facilitate clear, timely decision\-making.
* Develop and deliver status reports, governance updates, proposals, requirements documentation, and presentations.
* Determine the frequency and content of project reporting; analyse results and troubleshoot problem areas.
* Capture stakeholder feedback on performance and delivery, translating insights into continuous improvement actions.
* Facilitate knowledge sharing, lessons learned, and adoption of project management best practices across the business unit.



  





**Global Safety and Pharmacovigilance Nuances** 



* Apply project governance appropriate to pharmacovigilance and safety initiatives, with focus on patient safety, compliance, quality, and traceability.
* Coordinate projects that may involve safety case operations, safety systems, aggregate reporting, signal management, risk management, literature activities, partner/vendor oversight, or regulatory safety submissions.
* Plan delivery around applicable reporting commitments, regulatory due dates, client service\-level expectations, and internal quality checkpoints.
* Partner with Safety, Medical, Regulatory, Quality, Technology, Data Privacy, and Business Operations stakeholders to manage cross\-functional dependencies.
* Support controlled implementation of process, technology, migration, automation, and operating\-model changes through impact assessment, readiness tracking, validation coordination, training, and stabilization planning.
* Maintain inspection\- and audit\-ready project documentation, including approvals, decisions, risks, actions, change history, and evidence of completion.
* Monitor quality and compliance indicators relevant to the project and ensure deviations, risks, and corrective actions are escalated through the appropriate governance forums.
* Coordinate global, regional, and local requirements without losing alignment to the agreed project scope and delivery model.
* Handle safety\-related information with appropriate confidentiality, access control, and data integrity awareness.



  





**Project Governance and Delivery** 



1. Understand and communicate project scope, goals, deliverables, acceptance criteria, and stakeholder expectations.
2. Create governance cadence, meeting structure, decision forums, status reporting, and escalation pathways.
3. Support leadership reviews with concise reporting on schedule, budget, scope, quality, compliance, resource capacity, risks, and dependencies.
4. Identify and resolve issues and conflicts within the project team; escalate material risks early with clear impact and mitigation options.
5. Define project success criteria and ensure they are understood by all involved parties throughout the project lifecycle.
6. Drive project closure, benefits review, documentation handover, lessons learned, and transition to business\-as\-usual operations.



  





**Must Have** 



* 6\-8 years of experience in a project management capacity within life sciences, healthcare, pharmaceutical services, consulting, or a related regulated environment.
* Hands\-on experience managing cross\-functional projects across scope, schedule, cost, quality, risk, resource, communication, and stakeholder dimensions.
* Working understanding of pharmacovigilance or drug safety processes and the importance of regulatory timelines, quality controls, and patient safety.
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast\-paced and sometimes ambiguous global environment.
* Strong sense of urgency, ownership, accountability, and attention to detail.
* Ability to adapt quickly to changing work demands and priorities while maintaining delivery discipline.
* Strong written, oral, facilitation, presentation, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Experience with project management tools and proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.



  





**Desired Profile** 




  




* MBA, M.Pharm, Pharm.D, MSc in Life Sciences, or another relevant postgraduate qualification.
* Prior experience in pharmacovigilance, drug safety, pharmaceutical consulting, safety operations, or healthcare agency environments.
* Exposure to one or more areas such as individual case safety reports, safety databases, aggregate safety reports, signal management, risk management, literature surveillance, regulatory submissions, or safety agreements.
* Experience supporting technology implementation, data migration, process transition, automation, validation, or change management in a regulated environment.
* Experience collaborating with global teams, clients, vendors, and matrixed stakeholders across time zones.
* Ability to conduct research into project\-related issues, understand new concepts quickly, and translate them into practical delivery actions.
* Interest in emerging technologies and their responsible application to project delivery and pharmacovigilance operations.
* PMP, PRINCE2, Agile/Scrum, or comparable project management certification is an added advantage.



  





**Key Competencies** 




**Delivery Leadership** 




 Plans rigorously and drives outcomes.
 



**Safety Mindset** 




 Keeps patient safety and compliance visible.
 



**Stakeholder Alignment** 




 Builds clarity across global teams.
 



**Risk Management** 




 Anticipates, mitigates, and escalates early.
 



**Quality Focus** 




 Maintains traceable, audit\-ready execution.
 



**Adaptability** 




 Responds effectively to changing priorities.
 



**Communication** 




 Conveys complex information concisely.
 



**Continuous Improvement** 




 Uses insights to strengthen delivery.
 



  





**Equal Employment Opportunity** 




 Indegene is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and is committed to a culture of inclusion and diversity. Employment decisions are based on business requirements, candidate merit, and qualifications. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to characteristics protected by applicable law.

 We are seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead high\-stakes, cross\-functional engineering initiatives. In this role, you will bridge business strategy, system architecture, and operational execution. You will drive the technical delivery strategy for complex software integrations, scale distributed systems, and partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Architecture leaders to turn ambitious roadmaps into reliable software.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Technical Delivery Strategy: Architect end\-to\-end program delivery plans for multi\-team initiatives, translating high\-level product requirements into detailed engineering milestones.

 Qualifications
   

  

* Experience: 7\+ years of experience as a TPM, Engineering Manager, or Systems Architect managing complex software development cycles.
* Technical Depth: Deep understanding of distributed systems, service\-oriented/microservices architecture, REST/gRPC APIs, and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure). Ability to hold technical discussions with Principal Engineers and Architects.
* Execution Track Record: Proven history of delivering large\-scale, multi\-team software initiatives from inception to rollout on time and at scale.
* Leadership \& Influence: Outstanding stakeholder management skills; ability to align disparate engineering, product, and business teams without direct authority.
* Data\-Driven: Proficiency with program management frameworks (Jira, Confluence) and using metrics to measure delivery velocity and system reliability.

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.

title: Media Campaign Analyst-1
description:

 As a
 **Media Campaign Analyst** 
 , you will support end\-to\-end campaign planning, execution, and launch, combining media planning expertise, creative program management capabilities, and Guest Experience Management execution.
   

  

 You will leverage media planning, program management, and guest experience best practices to drive campaign readiness and contribute to business outcomes while maintaining operational excellence across campaign workflows. In this role, you will partner with creative, ad operations and P\&I teams to manage campaign workflows, monitor milestones, and ensure alignment across stakeholders throughout the campaign lifecycle. Through strong organizational, analytical, and communication skills, you will contribute to execution excellence and help deliver campaigns that drive awareness, engagement, conversion, and guest satisfaction across the Target ecosystem.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Campaign Ownership**
* Manage campaigns from brief through execution and launch
* Support full\-funnel, omnichannel media and guest experience strategies
* Ensure campaign deliverables are completed accurately and on schedule
* Monitor campaign readiness and execution quality


**Creative Program Management**
* Manage campaign timelines, workflows, and deliverables
* Coordinate execution across teams
* Escalate risks and blockers appropriately
* Ensure adherence to established processes and standards


**Media Strategy \& Validation**
* Develop integrated media plans within established planning frameworks.
* Review AI\-generated recommendations and provide feedback
* Ensure campaign plans align with campaign objectives and business requirements


**Guest Experience Management (GEM) \& Landing Page Optimization**
* Execute landing page optimization strategies
* Monitor guest experience KPIs and identify opportunities
* Support implementation of conversion and discoverability improvements


**Execution \& Launch Governance**
* Oversee readiness across creative, media setup, landing pages and activation
* Ensure adherence to timelines, plans, and quality standards
* Conduct launch readiness reviews and validate all execution components before activation.
* Monitor campaign health throughout execution and coordinate rapid issue resolution when required.


**Cross\-Functional Leadership**
* Co lead CFTs and initiatives with internal teams, stakeholders and partners.
* Maintain stakeholder communication and alignment
* Support successful campaign launch through effective coordination


**Process \& Tools**
* Drive process improvements and scalable best practices
* Leverage media and workflow tools (e.g., DV360, Meta, GAM) for planning, execution, and tracking.
* Identify opportunities to enhance automation, AI adoption, and operational efficiency.
* Contribute to the evolution of integrated campaign planning and guest experience capabilities.


**Skills \& Capabilities**
**Digital Proficiency**
* Strong understanding of digital media ecosystems, including social, programmatic, search, and retail media platforms.
* Ability to leverage platform capabilities and performance insights to inform campaign planning


**Media \& Strategy**
* Full\-funnel media planning across digital channels
* Understanding of platforms, KPIs, and measurement
* Ability to translate business goals into actionable plans


**Strategic \& Analytical Thinking**
* Ability to make independent strategic decisions based on campaign performance, business priorities, and guest insights
* Data\-driven mindset with ability to derive insights and optimize performance


**Guest Experience Management (GEM)**
* Understanding of digital merchandising and ecommerce optimization principles.
* Experience with landing page optimization and conversion\-focused site experiences.
* Knowledge of search, navigation, taxonomy, attribution, and product discoverability best practices.
* Ability to identify and resolve guest journey friction points.
* Understanding of how site experience impacts campaign performance and conversion outcomes.


**Creative Program Management**
* Strong campaign lifecycle and workflow management
* Ability to manage multiple complex campaigns
* Strong risk management and execution discipline
* Understanding of Creative objective alignment, asset\-to\-placement fit, promo/message coherence, performance\-informed creative feedback


**Collaboration \& Ownership**
* Strong stakeholder management and communication
* Ability to influence and drive alignment
* High ownership, accountability, and ability to operate in a fast\-paced environment
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, highly collaborative environment.
* Clear, empathetic communication style focused on delivering exceptional business and guest outcomes.


**Communication, Influence \& Conflict Management**
* Strong executive communication and storytelling skills.
* Ability to influence stakeholders, build alignment, navigate constructive conflict, and drive confident decision\-making across cross\-functional teams.


**Operational Excellence \& Governance**
* Demonstrated ability to drive operational excellence through effective workflow governance, timeline management, dependency management, risk mitigation, and continuous process improvement.


**About You**
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, Business, Economics, Analytics, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in digital media, advertising, marketing, campaign management, media planning, or related disciplines.
* Experience supporting the planning, execution, and optimization of digital marketing or media campaigns.
* Understanding of media planning, audience strategy, campaign measurement, and performance optimization principles.
* Understanding of digital media channels, campaign activation workflows, and measurement methodologies across digital advertising platforms.
* Experience coordinating campaign workflows, timelines, and deliverables across multiple stakeholders.
* Familiarity with ecommerce, digital merchandising, landing page optimization, or guest experience best practices is preferred.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to interpret campaign performance data and identify optimization opportunities.
* Highly organized with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills with the ability to collaborate across teams and functions.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and business reporting tools.
* Self\-motivated, resourceful, and eager to learn new tools, technologies, and ways of working.
* Team\-oriented mindset with a willingness to share knowledge, collaborate effectively, and contribute to team success.

title: Manager, Product Management
description:
Manages the entire product life cycle for certain product(s) (e.g., hardware, software, wireless, web products, medical devices, etc.) from planning to execution to support the organization's strategy and objectives. Develops and directs marketing programs for a significant product or product category. Compiles and evaluates research on the market's product requirements and identifies enhancements to current features and functionality. Establishes marketing strategies, including product direction, advertising, packaging, pricing, expense budgets, profit plans and future product development, to manage a product or product category's life cycle. Interfaces with engineers, designers, suppliers and customers to develop product requirements and specifications. Prepares and coordinates product introductions and updates.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Electronics Solutions division of Nordson delivers cutting\-edge engineering and applications excellence to the world’s semiconductor, automotive electronics, printed circuit boards and precision assembly manufacturer with innovative fluid dispensing and surface treatment solutions. As part of the Growth and Strategy group for this $250M\+\+ division, the Technical Product Manager (TPM) is responsible for the development, and performance of a product line.
   

  

 The TPM oversee the product’s lifecycle, from conception (working with Market Manager and New Product Development Engineering) to discontinuation. This may include supervising Product Line Specialists who are located in the factory/manufacturing sites where the product is made. The TPM provides leadership within the organization to ensure competitiveness of assigned products and development of strategies to grow revenue profitably.
   

  

**Essential Job Duties And Responsibilities**
* Using the NBS Next Phase Gate process in the development of new products, provide leadership in Phases 0\-2 i.e. \#0 Project Request; \#1 Planning/Feasibility; \#2 Proj Requirements where clear technical and commercial requirements are articulated and documented for NPD Engineering.
* Collaborates with cross\-functional teams in Sales, Operation, Marketing and NPD, to ensure successful product launches and iterations with messaging, marketing collateral, sales tools and aids for sales force.
* Continuously analyze market trends and customer feedback to identify opportunities of growth and improvement for existing products.
* Lead cross\-functional efforts for creating competitive offerings.
* 
* Maintain and communicate internally the competitive landscape of our market/products
+ Build internal knowledge of the competitive landscape by supporting MEKKO updates.
+ Develop and maintain tools/processes to collect the latest competitive information and analyzing data to advise on pricing, strategies, future opportunities, etc.
+ Produces competitive analysis materials comparing product with its key competitors for features and pricing in different geographies
+ Lead quarterly competitive reviews/updates
+ Participates in development of market share assessment and price/performance positioning as needed for existing and new products

* Monitor customer satisfaction and contribute to Operations/Sustaining Continuous Improvement projects, Quality and Cost of Poor Quality programs, etc.
* Leads NBS Next Simplification efforts on product lines to ensure progress towards Leadership Level Performance.
* Other duties may be assigned as required.


**Education And Experience Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree and mechanical or electrical engineering is a plus
* Seven to ten years experience in product or market management role. Demonstrated ability to lead growth initiatives and provide guidance to the company about investment opportunities.
* Possess a highly developed attention to detail with strong organizational and project management skills
* Five years experience people management with proven track record at industrial manufacturing environment
* Thorough and accurate, good analytical skills, problem solver, team oriented individual
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Business acumen and the ability to effectively present the organization and its products
* Establish credibility, rapport, respect, and trust throughout the Division, be viewed as a team player, and work effectively in a dynamic, fast paced environment
* High proficiency with Microsoft Office – Excel, PPT etc.
* Knowledge of SAP a plus


**Preferred Skills And Abilities**
* Experience in a similar role supporting capital equipment for the electronics industry.
* Understanding of electronics manufacturing industry. Knowledge about dispensing industry is a plus.
* Effective matrix style management capabilities.
* Ability to multi\-task and effectively manage daily tasks
* Ability to bring positive change; detail oriented; leading by example
* Resides in India and must be able to travel internationally
* Fluent in English and other Asian languages


**Working Conditions and Physical Demands**
**Office environment.** 
 To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed above are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
   

  

**Travel Required**
 Estimated 45%

title: Engineer / Senior Engineer - Installation
description:
Site supervision:
   

  

* Accountable for safety, quality, and productivity during installation and handovers, and for raising and actioning corrective actions to any detected non\-conformities.
* Responsible for the use of correct KONE installation methods and tools by the installation team, and for proper risk assessment for parts of installation where KONE method is not feasible.
* Responsible for proactive site preparations, site readiness, customer deliverables to KONE, site visits and audits, including resolution of non\-conformities with customer (supported by Project Manager as needed)
* Responsible for verifying the site execution plan and field cost management as part of the pre\-delivery review, assuming site execution responsibility, and thereafter installation activities and handovers.
* Responsible for maintaining realistic MS 3c (material delivery to site) throughout the S\-plan, and for confirming of S\-plan milestones 3 – 5z.
* Active support to Project Manager and Project Admin for the verification of payment status according to S\-plan concept and contract terms
* Responsible for planning and organizing installation activities, site storage and logistics, and needed resources and tools.
* Requests materials to site (MS 3x), confirms arrival of KONE materials to site (MS 3c), receives other materials and services at the site, and performs Goods Receipt.
* Performs handover to installation team (KONE and subcontractors), clarifying the scope of work, completion date and other necessary customer milestone dates, as well as target installation hours for own KONE fitters.
* Organizes continuous huddles with the installation team to empower them and proactively prevent interruptions, ensure smooth, continual flow of work on site, with a focus on efficiency and waste reduction.
* Achieves targets for variation sales and change orders during installation, ensures costs attributable to others are claimed and collected.
* Verifies quality of installation and ensures installation the scope of work is completed. Is accountable for final testing of the equipment and for closing any raised items (tester, customer, third party inspector, as is applicable). Completes a successful handover to maintenance.
* Responsible for quality claims / feedbacks, time sheet approvals, installation documentation, reporting of installation progress, status, cost accumulation, and risks, and managing schedule and other changes.
* Responsible for the management of environmental aspects of the installation (waste and hazardous material handling).


 Customer Relationship management:
   

  

* Acts as the primary contact for the customer regarding site management, proactively communicating and using related tools.
* Ensures customer satisfaction with proactive and timely communication, professional installation process, as well as safety and quality of installation.


 People leadership and subcontractor relations:
   

  

* Responsible for verifying that installers, testers and other contractors on site are trained, certified, competent, and capable of performing each installation task.
* Accountable for site operatives’ safety, motivation and wellbeing.
* Responsible for identifying Installation operative training needs and communicating these to respective line managers, HR, installation subcontracting companies and procurement.
* Responsible for managing and developing the performance of the team and individuals.
* Responsible for developing and maintaining a proactive and professional relationship with subcontractors’ installation team and ensures they meet their commitments.


 Continual improvement:
   

  

* Responsible to follow and continually improve standard ways of working according to LEAN principles.
* Motivates and empowers the installation team to identify waste and make improvements, with a focus on teamwork and collaboration.
* Supports and coaches the installation team to improve their standard ways of working.
* Continually identifies and shares opportunities, root causes and improvement ideas with the team and other collaborators, applying lean tools (Go \& See, retrospectives, improvement sessions).
* Promotes success stories of team improvements, recognizing and rewarding efforts to drive continuous improvement.


*At KONE, we are focused on creating an innovative and collaborative working culture where we value the contribution of each individual. Employee engagement is a key focus area for us and we encourage participation and the sharing of information and ideas. Sustainability is an integral part of our culture and the daily practice. We follow ethical business practices and we seek to develop a culture of working together where co\-workers trust and respect each other and good performance is recognized. In being a great place to work, we are proud to offer a range of experiences and opportunities that will help you to achieve your career and personal goals and enable you to live a healthy and balanced life.*
 Read more on
 *https://kone.com/global/en/careers.html*

title: Senior Manager, Technical Services (Network Security)
description:
**Our Mission**
 At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real\-world problems with cutting\-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
   

  

 We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real\-time problem\-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Senior Manager, Technical Services leads multiple delivery pods within the Global Delivery Center Technical Services organization (NetSec) and, where applicable, manages first\-line managers. The role sits between hands\-on delivery leadership and the Director\-level strategic mandate: you will translate the broader Technical Services strategy into concrete operating plans, scale delivery capacity across pods, own executive\-level customer escalations end\-to\-end, and develop the next generation of managers on the team. This position requires seasoned people\-of\-people leadership, strong operational discipline, and a proven ability to build repeatable delivery motions in a high\-growth environment.
   

  

 Your Impact
   

  

 Delivery Program Leadership
   

  

 Cross\-Pod Execution: Own delivery outcomes across multiple pods / functional areas health of engagements, utilization, margin, and customer satisfaction with a weekly operating rhythm and a clear escalation ladder.
   

  

 Playbooks \& Standards: Codify how the Global Delivery Center Technical Services team delivers engagement kickoff templates, quality gates, technical review checklists, handoff protocols and drive consistent adoption across managers and leads.
   

  

 Capacity Planning: Own the multi\-quarter capacity model for your area; partner with Recruiting on the hiring plan and with Sales on the demand forecast.
   

  

 People \& Manager Development
   

  

 Manage Managers: Develop your first\-line managers running structured 1:1s, coaching them through hiring, performance conversations, and escalations rather than doing the work for them.
   

  

 Talent Bench: Own the succession plan and readiness ratings for your area; identify and grow next\- manager candidates from within the IC ranks.
   

  

 Culture Owner: Set the tone for how your teams work together high\-trust, high\-standards, low\- drama and hold the line on it when pressure spikes.
   

  

 Hiring at Scale: Own the end\-to\-end hiring plan for your area role definition, interview loops, calibration, offer strategy and drive the pass\-through rate.
   

  

 Customer \& Sales Partnership
   

  

 Executive Customer Relationships: Be the Technical Services face for strategic accounts in your region QBRs, steering committees, and post\-mortems.
   

  

 Sales \& GTM Alignment: Partner with Sales Leadership and Solutions
   

  

 Consulting on pipeline shape, deal shaping, and services\-attach; help scope large / complex engagements.
   

  

 Partner Enablement: Where relevant, work with the Partner Ecosystem team to grow delivery capacityand quality through channel partners. Escalation
   

  

 Ownership
   

  

 Own the Recovery: Lead customer escalations end\-to\-end for your area — structure the recovery plan, sequence the technical and commercial workstreams, and drive to a written closure.
   

  

 Executive Communication: Represent status crisply upward (Director / VP) and outward (customer executive sponsors) during high\-pressure situations.
   

  

 Operational Rigor
   

  

 Metrics \& Reporting: Own the weekly / monthly business review for your area utilization, delivery health, CSAT, attrition, hiring velocity and act on the signals.
   

  

 QBR Participation: Contribute directly to Regional QBRs with a defensible read on plan\-to\-actuals and a forward view.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Educational Background: Undergraduate degree required in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field; MBA or Masters degree preferred.
   

  

 Proven Leadership: 5\+ years managing service delivery teams of 10\+ professionals in a high\-growth technology environment, including 1\+ year of experience managing other managers or team leads.
   

  

 Security Domain Expertise: Deep working knowledge of Network Security concepts and product delivery — Palo Alto Networks NGFW / Panorama / Prisma Access / SASE strongly preferred; broader familiarity with the adjacent NetSec ecosystem (Cloud, SD\-WAN, ZTNA) valued.
   

  

 Delivery Program Ownership: Track record of running multi\-pod / multi\-account delivery portfolios —building playbooks, standardizing quality bars, and scaling capacity without proportional headcount growth.
   

  

 Manager Development: Concrete examples of first\-line managers you have hired, coached, and grown ,including cases where you handled underperformance decisively.
   

  

 Escalation Command: Demonstrated ability to serve as the calm, decisive owner of high\-visibility customer escalations with a written record of resolutions rather than heroics.
   

  

 Executive Communication: Fluent presenting to internal executives (RVP / VP) and external customer /partner executives; able to translate technical complexity into business outcome.
   

  

 Multitasking Mastery: Proven ability to oversee many concurrent engagements and prioritize a complex workload proactively without dropping commitments.
   

  

**Our Commitment**
 We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
   

  

 We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.
   

  

 Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
   

  

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
   

  

 Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**Manager, Software Engineering – Managed Threat Response**
 Bengaluru, India
   

  

**About Mimecast**
 Mimecast is a leading cybersecurity company that helps organizations protect their people, data, and communications. With over 42,000 customers worldwide, Mimecast has a long history of excellence in Data Archiving and eDiscovery and is recognised as a Leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Digital Communications Governance and Archiving Solutions.
   

  

 We are pioneers in Human Risk Management, recognizing that people are both an organization's greatest asset and its most significant security vulnerability. Our platform addresses the human element of cybersecurity through advanced threat detection, awareness training, Incydr risk management, and data governance. Our Governance, Compliance \& Insight products play a critical role in this mission, ensuring that communications data is archived, discoverable, and compliant, enabling organizations to manage the risk that stems from human actions.
   

  

**AI\-First Engineering at Mimecast**
 Mimecast is an AI\-First engineering organization. Our teams actively leverage AI\-powered development tools across all facets of engineering, from code development to testing, documentation, and operations. We're looking for leaders who don't just use AI tools but champion their adoption and establish new ways of working.
   

  

 Our AI leadership extends beyond how we build to what we build. Our Mihra AI agent delivers 7x faster threat response for customers, and we're recognized as "Agents of Change" in Human Risk Management. Engineers here work at the intersection of cutting\-edge AI tooling and AI\-powered security products that protect organizations worldwide.
   

  

**The driving force behind Collaboration Security at Mimecast**
 Dive into the forefront of innovation with our Managed Threat Response engineering team, where we build the platforms that detect, investigate, and remediate threats on behalf of our customers. Our products leverage the latest technologies and advances in Artificial Intelligence to stay one step ahead of cybercriminals — and we build them the same way.
   

  

**Why Join Our Team?**
*“This is a build role. You will be standing up a new engineering squad in Bengaluru for products our customers depend on every day, in a team where AI is how the work gets done rather than a side experiment. If you are already the person your team turns to — for the technical calls and for the advice — and you want to make that your actual job, this is the step.”* 
 – Hiring Manager
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 As a Manager, Software Engineering you will build and lead a squad covering Mailroom and Threat Portal, with contributions into our Managed Email Incident Response and Remediation products. This is a genuine build: you will hire the team, onboard it, and get it delivering reliably. Your responsibilities will include:
   

  

* Hire, onboard, and retain a new engineering squad, working closely with Recruitment and HR in a highly competitive market.
* Own team\-level delivery — commitments, technical debt, on\-call load, and stakeholder expectations — holding all of them at once without letting any one collapse.
* Run genuinely developmental 1:1s, set clear expectations, and give honest feedback early rather than late, including the difficult kind.
* Create the conditions for engineers to do their best technical work: enough structure that people know what is expected, enough autonomy that they own their technical decisions.
* Make AI\-first engineering a team capability rather than an individual habit — support engineers in building their own agentic development workflows, and hold the quality bar on what those tools produce.
* Know when to coach an engineer through a technical decision and when to make the call yourself, and resolve technical disagreements within the team constructively.
* Partner with Product, Support, and peer engineering teams, representing your team's technical position and delivery risk honestly to senior stakeholders.
* Identify and mitigate technical and delivery risk early, and monitor cloud resource usage for cost savings that do not compromise performance or reliability.


**What You'll Bring**
 This may be your first formal management role. What matters is that you have already been doing much of the job informally, and that you want to develop engineers more than you want to ship the feature yourself.
   

  

* An engineering background you can still use. Hands\-on experience building and running backend services at scale, deep enough that you remain credible in design and code review and can ask the right questions even when you are not the one making the call.
* Evidence that you already develop people. Time as a technical lead, mentor, or onboarding owner — a track record of engineers who got better because of you, and of feedback you gave that was uncomfortable to deliver and useful to receive.
* Proven AI\-first engineering practice, and a view on what it means for a team. You have personally built this way with agentic coding tools, and you have a clear position on what AI\-mature engineering practice should look like across a squad. We work in Cursor, but we care that you have built this way, not which tool you used.
* Critical judgement over AI output, applied as a standard. A working understanding of where these tools fail — hallucinated APIs, plausible\-but\-wrong logic, silent security and performance regressions — and the willingness to hold a team to a quality bar rather than celebrate raw throughput.
* Delivery ownership across a team. Planning, execution, and predictable delivery of complex work; comfort with the trade\-off between delivery speed and engineering quality, and the ability to explain the call you made to both engineers and executives.
* Hiring and team building. Experience attracting, assessing, and onboarding engineering talent, or clear evidence you have been central to it.
* Strong communication across distance. You explain technical concepts credibly to technical and non\-technical audiences, and you work effectively with colleagues distributed across multiple time zones.
* A real appetite for the shift from doing to developing. The instinct to solve problems directly comes from genuine competence; the defining challenge of this role is redirecting that energy into the people around you.
* Nice to have: prior work in cybersecurity or email security; experience managing on\-call rotations and incident response; and experience leading distributed or newly formed teams.


**What We Bring**
 Join our Managed Threat Response team to accelerate your career journey, leading a team whose work has direct and visible customer impact. You will not be doing this alone: you will have the support of senior engineering leadership, a global network of peer engineering managers, and deliberate investment in your development as a leader — this is a role we expect you to grow into and beyond.
   

  

 You and your team will be given first\-class AI development tooling and the mandate to get genuinely good with it. We treat AI engineering capability as a skill we invest in and measure, and we judge teams on the outcomes they ship and the quality they sustain — not on lines of code written.
   

  

 Mimecast offers formal and on\-the\-job learning opportunities and maintains a comprehensive benefits package that helps our employees and their family members sustain a healthy lifestyle. We believe in 'growth that's good', we have 'a culture that cares' and we are on a 'mission that matters'.
   

  

**Our Hybrid Model:** 
 We provide you with the flexibility to live balanced, healthy lives through our hybrid working model that champions both collaborative teamwork and individual flexibility. Employees are expected to come to the office at least two days per week, because working together in person:
   

  

* Fosters a culture of collaboration, communication, performance and learning
* Drives innovation and creativity within and between teams
* Introduces employees to priorities outside of their immediate realm
* Ensures important interpersonal relationships and connections with one another and our community!


**Belonging at Mimecast**
 Cybersecurity is a community effort. That’s why we’re committed to building an inclusive, diverse community that celebrates and welcomes everyone – unless they’re a cybercriminal, of course.
   

  

 We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, and we’d encourage you to join us whatever your background. We particularly welcome applicants from traditionally underrepresented groups.
   

  

 We consider everyone equally: your race, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, ability, marital status, nationality, or any other protected characteristic won’t affect your application.
   

  

*Due to certain obligations to our customers, an offer of employment will be subject to your successful completion of applicable background checks, conducted in accordance with local law.*
*It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment.*

 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

title: Program Mgr : Cost to Serve, RBS : Cost to Serve
description:
**Description**
 About Amazon.com
   

  

 Amazon.com strives to be Earth's most customer\-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want \- low prices, vast selection, and convenience \- Amazon.com continues to grow and evolve as a world\-class e\-commerce platform. Amazon's evolution from Web site to e\-commerce partner to development platform is driven by the spirit of innovation that is part of the company's DNA. The world's brightest technology minds come to Amazon.com to research and develop technology that improves the lives of shoppers and sellers around the world.
   

  

**About RBS**
 RBS is Amazon's cross\-organizational layer connecting Technology, Supply Chain, Operations, and Retail to solve customer problems. The Cost to Serve (CtS) High Risk Value (HRV) team tackles one of Amazon's largest cost leakage pools \- shrink losses from high risk products.
   

  

**The Team Operates Across Three Pillars**
* Defect Identification: Models that flag high\-risk ASINs and surface organized loss patterns earlier than traditional detection methods.
* Defect Elimination: End\-to\-end interventions across the supply chain \- that prevent losses at source.
* Cross\-Org Orchestration: Coordinating across multiple teams to drive shrink reduction at scale. The team's unique value is its ability to see across organizational boundaries and drive accountability through leadership\-tracked cost\-saving goals.


 The primary objective: shift from reactive loss reporting to proactive, mechanism\-driven prevention — reducing Cost to Serve and enabling Free Cash Flow by eliminating shrink at its root cause across the end\-to\-end supply chain.
   

  

**Why You’ll Love This Role**
 You'll own end\-to\-end shrink reduction programs that directly impact Amazon's bottom line \- from identifying the problem through data and signals, to designing interventions that eliminate losses across the supply chain. This isn't a reporting role; you'll build mechanisms, drive cross\-org alignment across Operations, Technology, Retail, and Supply Chain teams, and see your work translate into measurable cost savings at scale. You’ll join a dynamic, fast\-paced, and supportive team that values innovation and strives to solve real\-world challenges.
   

  

 Are you passionate about tackling intricate problems and finding creative solutions to optimize complex supply chain processes? Do you enjoy turning data\-driven insights into action plans that shape the future? If you’re excited about driving change and influencing outcomes across a global network, this is the opportunity for you.
   

  

**About Our Team**
 Diverse Perspectives:
   

  

 We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation. Even if your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply. Whether you’re new to the field, have a non\-traditional background, or have gained expertise in different ways, we value the unique insights you can bring.
   

  

**Commitment To Balance**
 We recognize the importance of maintaining a healthy work\-life balance. We foster an environment where flexibility is not just an option but a priority, ensuring you have the support you need to thrive both at work and at home. When we’re at our best in all areas of life, we’re unstoppable.
   

  

**Inclusive Culture**
 Learning and curiosity are at the heart of our culture. We celebrate what makes us different and support one another through employee\-led groups and ongoing initiatives that champion diversity and inclusion. Our events and learning programs provide a platform for every voice to be heard and valued.
   

  

**Opportunities For Growth**
 As a team dedicated to continuous improvement, we believe in setting ambitious goals and providing the tools to achieve them. You’ll have access to a wealth of mentorship, knowledge\-sharing, and career development resources to help you advance your skills and achieve your professional aspirations.
   

  

 Our team is composed of skilled problem solvers who thrive on tackling cross\-functional challenges. We are dedicated to meeting the needs of our internal stakeholders with a solutions\-oriented approach, always striving for the best possible outcome in everything we do.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* End\-to\-End Defect Ownership: Use a data\-backwards approach \- mining shrink signals, and operational data, to identify root causes of supply chain defects, then design and implement scalable solutions that eliminate them permanently.
* Cross\-Functional Program Leadership: Form and lead cross\-org teams spanning Operations, Technology, Retail, and Supply Chain to drive programs from ideation through execution with high ownership.
* Data\-Driven Solutioning: Translate complex data patterns into actionable interventions \- sizing the opportunity, building mechanisms that prevent recurrence, and driving results without waiting for direction.
* Stakeholder Management: Drive alignment across multiple lines of business on program milestones, escalations, and process changes.


 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Lead the development and execution of comprehensive Cost to Serve (CTS) and Upstream Defect Elimination (UDE) programs, including establishing key performance indicators, process mapping, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Work with various stakeholders \- such as business leaders, legal, finance, quality, etc. \- to drive the execution of key CTS and UDE initiatives. Provide regular updates to stakeholders and management on escalated issues, ensuring transparency and alignment. Facilitate workshops and meetings to ensure smooth implementation across functions.
* Dive deep into data to identify root causes of inefficiencies and opportunities for cost savings. Track and report key performance indicators related to shrink reduction, defect elimination, and process efficiency. Evaluate network performance metrics to proactively identify process improvement opportunities.
* Utilize Lean, Six Sigma, and other process improvement methodologies to optimize supply chain processes, driving quality, speed, and cost\-effectiveness across initiatives.
* Oversee project timelines, resources, and communication with stakeholders to ensure timely delivery of initiatives. Manage day\-to\-day activities and adjust priorities based on emerging CTS reduction opportunities.
* Lead the expansion of CTS reduction efforts into new regions (e.g., APAC, AMENT/MENA) and fulfillment models (e.g., Fulfilled by Amazon, Merchant Fulfilled Network). Develop scalable solutions to address market\-specific challenges while maintaining quality and aligning with strategic growth goals.
* Apply UDE principles to proactively identify and eliminate defects early in the supply chain, minimizing downstream impacts and driving long\-term cost reductions.
* Build coordination pipelines with finance teams to track cost\-saving measures, ensure accurate reporting, and align financial metrics with the team’s cost\-saving objectives.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, Supply Chain, or a related field, or Project Management Professional (PMP) certification
* Analytical skills with proficiency in data\-driven decision\-making and the ability to extract actionable insights from complex datasets
* Experience in stakeholder management and cross\-functional collaboration, with the ability to engage with multiple stakeholders at varied organizational levels


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master’s degree or MBA in Business, Operations, or a related field
* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt certification, with experience in Lean Management, Six Sigma, or other operations engineering tools
* 2\+ years of experience driving process improvements
* Excellent creative thinking skills, with a focus on developing innovative solutions to solve complex problems in a cross\-functional environment, especially under pressure

In very recent years, member firms, such as Australia, Belgium, Canada, Germany, the Netherlands or the United Kingdom have been supported within their tax practice by Deloitte Tax India practice.
   

  

 The UK government provides tax incentives to businesses performing R\&D; Deloitte’s R\&D tax services group is a market leader in helping clients secure these incentives and is the most experienced team in the UK. We are looking for an open minded Information Technology (IT) / Computer Science (CS) professionals with both technical and software development knowledge, coupled with excellent communication skills. Knowledge of the full development lifecycle is sought and an appreciation of the types of technical challenges encountered across this lifecycle.
   

  

 Work you’ll do
   

  

 As a Senior within our team, you will be in a client\-facing role from day one, managing engagements, engaging with financial and technical teams, undertaking detailed financial analyses, and utilising your communication skills to quickly understand client costing methodologies. You will review and prepare high\-quality documentation to quantify eligible R\&D expenditure for tax purposes. This will require you to draw on your existing financial and costing experience, applying it to various industries and R\&D projects.
   

  

 You will work as part of a project team alongside tax practitioners to help companies prepare their claims. You will work on multiple projects in parallel and will therefore have to manage several competing demands on your time.
   

  

 Your day\-to\-day responsibilities will allow you to gain an understanding of the financial structures behind a wide variety of cutting\-edge technologies across different industries. You’ll have the opportunity to take a different career route and to maintain exposure to/increase your knowledge of emerging areas of innovation from a financial perspective.
   

  

 To list some of those key responsibilities:
   

  

* Conducting efficient financial interviews with clients’ finance teams to understand their R\&D expenditure, cost allocation, and financial systems.
* Working directly with clients, Deloitte Partners and Directors taking ownership of end\-to\-end engagement management of R\&D tax claim projects.
* Analysing financial documentation and data from clients to support the development of robust R\&D claim methodologies and prepare detailed costing schedules.
* Invest in, mentor and train a cohort of analysts.
* Champion the one\-team culture across our UK and offshore delivery teams.
* Writing clear, compelling financial reports for appropriate authorities (typically HMRC), based on financial analysis to convey how a client’s R\&D expenditure qualifies for tax relief.
* Lead projects to ensure R\&D claims are delivered to time and within budget.
* Working effectively in diverse teams of tax technicians, costing specialists and technical personnel within an inclusive team culture where people are recognised for their contribution.
* Coordinate data automation for multiple projects concurrently.
* Develop expertise and aptitude towards innovation in financial quantification.


 The Team
   

  

 Our “Global Investment and Innovation Incentives (Gi³)” service line is embedded within Deloitte’s T\&L practice and focused on advising companies in their pursuit of the right incentives by developing and executing an effective incentives strategy for their specific needs. The large majority of our Gi³ team members are scientists and engineers. Gi³ team then offers specific related knowledge and added value consultancy. This expertise allows our clients to take advantage of various incentives and grants related to their priorities in terms of Research \& Development \[R\&D], innovation and sustainability. Further development of their intellectual properties and R\&D activities can then leverage on those governmental support.
   

  

 To assist our clients in dealing with those government incentives, our team based in the UK proposes the services of a multi\-disciplinary team of over 100 specialists (Lawyers, Economists, Scientists, Engineers or IT\-specialists) highly experienced in assisting companies with multi\-jurisdictions compliance, dealing with the complexities of local regulations and procedures – such as communicating with local grant and tax authorities, setting up new registrations and preparation \& filling of government incentives applications.
   

  

 We are principally a UK\-based team with colleagues in the Deloitte USI at Bangalore and are looking to further build our Bangalore capability.
   

  

 What we’re looking for
   

  

 As a senior you will be in a client\-facing role from day one, managing projects, preparing R\&D claims, delegating, and building the team. You will be working with a variety of team members from junior to senior grades and be the main point of contact for your clients.
   

  

 Your responsibilities will include:
   

  

* Lead projects being the main point of contact with a range of senior stakeholders such as financial controllers, finance directors and chief finance officers.
* Taking ownership over design of costing methodology, and execution of R\&D tax engagements through liaison with internal engagement team to deliver high quality work products under budget.
* Build eminence in the market and look for opportunities to grow the practice.
* Build an internal network within Deloitte and gain an understanding of the services the firm can offer to broaden client relationships and differentiate us in the market.
* Work within a project team to ensure that robust R\&D claims are prepared whilst building deep client relationships.
* Preparing clear reports for submission to HMRC to explain how our clients R\&D claims have been prepared.
* Provide financial input into marketing and sales activity based on your area of costing and tax knowledge.
* Work effectively in diverse teams within an inclusive team culture where people are recognised for their contribution.
* Project managing a variety of projects at any given time and being able to delegate and work with the technical and finance team around you.


 Work Location \- Bangalore
   

  

 Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM IST
   

  

**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**
 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
   

  

**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
   

  

**Recruiting tips**
 From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

description:

PPMS team enables the Programme leadership, with a predictable and efficient project performance management \& reporting, and business intelligence to ensure our portfolio of projects are being effectively and efficiently directed, managed, and delivered.  The Associate Practice Director will be responsible for overseeing and managing the project control functions for complex and high\-stakes projects. This role requires advanced and specialized knowledge and skills to deliver complex assignments and projects. The Associate Practice Director will lead client projects or functional teams, manage important resources, navigate complex negotiations, and address high\-risk and complex issues. This position serves as a point of reference for peers due to the level of specialization and experience in interpreting client or functional technical issues and recommending best practices.
   

  

 Your role
   

  

**Leadership And Strategy**
* Provide strategic leadership and direction for the Project Controls team, aligning project control activities with the overall goals and objectives of the organization.
* Develop and implement project control processes, tools, and best practices to improve project delivery and performance.
* Work closely with senior management and other stakeholders to define project control strategies and ensure alignment with business objectives.
* Review of our Key Account Management Plans for all key clients.


**Cost Monitoring And Controls**
* Develop and maintain project cost management systems, including budgeting, forecasting, and cost reporting.
* Ensure accurate and timely cost control, cost estimating, and financial reporting for all projects.
* Analyse cost variances and trends, and work with project managers to implement corrective measures.


**Planning And Scheduling**
* Oversee the development of project schedules, including planning, baseline creation, monitoring, and updating.
* Ensure accurate scheduling practices are in place and that schedules are integrated with cost and resource plans.
* Lead the analysis of schedule variances and recommend corrective actions to ensure project timelines are met.


**Performance Reporting**
* Oversee the preparation and presentation of regular project performance reports to senior management and stakeholders.
* Develop Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to measure project performance, including cost, schedule, quality, and risk.
* Ensure effective communication of project status, issues, and risks to stakeholders.


**Team Development And Leadership**
* Lead, mentor, and develop a high\-performing project controls team, including planners, schedulers, cost controllers, and risk managers.
* Foster a collaborative and results\-oriented team environment, promoting professional development and continuous improvement.
* Conduct performance reviews, provide feedback, and manage team resources effectively.
* Deliver excellent client service on our commissions through quality assurance and regular client care.
* Unlock talent and develop next generation of leaders.
* Develop mentor and support your teams on project / technical delivery.


**Process Improvement**
* Identify opportunities for continuous improvement in project controls processes and systems.
* Implement process improvements to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and effectiveness in project delivery.
* Stay current with industry trends, tools, and best practices, and ensure the organization is leveraging leading\-edge project controls methodologies.


**Stakeholder Engagement**
* Collaborate with project managers, engineers, contractors, and other stakeholders to ensure project control practices are fully integrated into project planning and execution.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to facilitate successful project outcomes.


**About You**
* Masters/bachelor's degree in civil engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related field.
* Minimum of 18 \- 25 years of experience in project controls, with at least 8 years in a leadership or managerial role.
* Strong understanding of project management principles, methodologies, and tools (e.g., Primavera P6, Ecosys, MS Project, Earned Value Management).
* Proven experience in large\-scale capital projects, infrastructure, construction, or engineering environments.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to influence and drive change across multiple levels of the organization.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with a focus on data\-driven decision\-making.
* Relevant certifications such as Project Management Professional (PMP), AACE's Certified Cost Professional (CCP), or PMI's Scheduling Professional (PMI\-SP) are preferred.


 Rewards \& benefits
   

  

 Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.
   

  

**This Includes**
* Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
* Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
* Generous annual leave balance.
* Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
* Remote work opportunities outside of country.
* Company gratuity scheme.
* Discretionary bonus program.
* Relocation assistance.

 Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

description:

 Job Category
   

  

 Customer Success
   

  

 Job Details
   

  

**About Salesforce**
 Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
   

  

 Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
   

  

****Job Details****
**You will be responsible for the successful design and technical delivery of complex, enterprise\-level Salesforce Marketing Cloud solutions for our customers. These technologies include but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce.com products and APIs and Marketing Cloud studios and builders along with cross\-cloud integrations.**
**The solutions you design are built for the long term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience in designing scalable and high\-quality solutions for large enterprise clients.
