title: Senior Manager
description:
**Overview**
 At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer’s and partner’s needs and solve their challenges.
   

  

 Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve.
   

  

 You’ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward\-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about—locally and globally.
   

  

 Come make an impact every day at Zebra.
   

  

**What We're Looking For**
 We are seeking a highly driven and strategic Senior Manager, Software Engineering, to lead the Cloud Core Platform Project, a mission\-critical component of the EMC Software Solutions group. In this senior leadership role, you will oversee the engineering teams responsible for delivering robust, scalable, full\-stack microservices\-based solutions.
   

  

 You will act as the driving force behind our engineering culture, instilling a deep sense of commitment, urgency, and uncompromising quality in everything we build. By aligning technical execution directly with customer needs, you will ensure our solutions provide maximum value. You will guide the overarching system architecture, ensuring the technical excellence of a highly experienced team of Cloud Developers and Test Engineers (each with 8 to 14 years of experience). Furthermore, you will dictate the technical strategy for integrating Zebra technologies, specifically leveraging the Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and modern full\-stack microservices ecosystems to solve complex customer challenges.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
* Strategic Leadership \& Delivery Commitment: Provide senior\-level engineering management for the EMC Cloud Platform project. Instill a culture of extreme ownership, commitment, and urgency to meet critical project timelines without sacrificing the stability or quality of the product.
* People Management, Hiring \& Team Growth: Take full ownership of the end\-to\-end people management lifecycle. Actively drive talent acquisition by recruiting, interviewing, and hiring top\-tier full\-stack and cloud engineering talent; establish clear career progression paths, conduct performance evaluations, and build a cohesive, highly motivated engineering team.
* Customer\-Centric Execution: Continuously align engineering efforts with overarching customer needs and business objectives. Ensure the team understands the "why" behind the product, driving features that directly solve real\-world customer pain points and improve user experience.
* Full\-Stack Microservices Architecture: Direct the end\-to\-end technical strategy for cloud\-native product designs. Oversee the development and scaling of full\-stack microservices architectures, ensuring structural integrity and seamless integration across the stack (JSON, Node.js, and React.js).
* Uncompromising Quality \& Operational Excellence: Establish rigorous operational policies and quality standards. Champion the development and implementation of advanced CI/CD practices, automated testing frameworks, and process optimizations to reduce cycle times while achieving zero\-defect deliveries.
* Cross\-Functional \& Executive Collaboration: Act as the primary technical liaison across Zebra's business units. Frequently interact with Core Platform Zebra Teams and executive leadership to ensure custom application and integration software meet cross\-functional technological and business goals.
* Technology Strategy \& Vision: Guide the engineering team in evaluating and executing complex technical decisions. Drive best practices involving REST APIs, Open API specifications, and the optimal integration of both NoSQL (Firestore) and SQL (PostgreSQL) databases to ensure peak performance and scalability.
* Talent Empowerment \& Mentorship: Act as an internally recognized leader and mentor. Empower senior engineers to push the boundaries of performance, threading, and scalability. Unblock teams rapidly and foster an environment of continuous learning and high accountability.


**Job Qualifications**
**Education**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or an equivalent software engineering discipline.


**Experience \& Leadership Competencies**
* Senior Management \& People Leadership: 15\+ years of extensive software engineering experience, including a strong, multi\-year track record of directly managing, mentoring, and developing software engineering teams.
* Talent Acquisition \& Hiring: Proven experience collaborating with talent acquisition partners to successfully source, interview, and hire highly technical developers, test engineers, and cloud specialists.
* Drive \& Urgency: Demonstrated ability to lead teams with a strong sense of urgency and commitment, successfully navigating fast\-paced environments while maintaining the highest quality standards.
* Customer Empathy: Proven track record of translating complex customer needs into scalable technical solutions, bridging the gap between product management, engineering, and the end\-user.
* Senior Talent Management: Demonstrated expertise in managing, evaluating, and mentoring high\-performing teams of senior developers and Test Engineers.


**Technical Skills (Oversight \& Architecture)**
* Full\-Stack \& Microservices: Proven experience architecting, implementing, and managing highly scalable full\-stack applications and cloud\-native microservices.
* Cloud Expertise: Deep, authoritative knowledge of Google Cloud Platform (GCP), with significant working experience in the Firebase ecosystem (Firestore SDKs, Cloud Functions, Hosting, etc.).
* Core Technologies: Strong hands\-on architectural knowledge of JSON, Node.js, and React.js.
* API \& Integration: Highly familiar with designing resilient REST APIs and leveraging Open API specifications.
* Database Architectures: Comfortable directing data strategies utilizing both NoSQL and SQL databases, particularly Firestore and PostgreSQL.
* Containerization \& Orchestration: Solid exposure to Docker and Kubernetes for microservices orchestration.
* DevOps \& Scalability: Proficient in driving Git workflows, advanced CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring robust application scalability and performance tuning.
* Advanced Problem\-Solving: Exceptional ability to dive into complex technical challenges, debug system\-wide issues, and pivot strategies to keep the engineering team unblocked and moving swiftly.


**Benefits**
 We understand the importance of work\-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well\-being day to promote revitalization and success.
   

  

**Job Posting Statement**
 To protect candidates from falling victim to online fraudulent activity involving fake job postings and employment offers, please be aware our recruiters will always connect with you via @zebra.com email accounts. Applications are only accepted through our applicant tracking system and only accept personal identifying information through that system. Our Talent Acquisition team will not ask for you to provide personal identifying information via e\-mail or outside of the system. If you are a victim of identity theft contact your local police department.
   

  

**AI Technology Statement**
 Zebra Technologies leverages AI technology to evaluate job applications using objective, job\-relevant criteria. This approach enhances efficiency and promotes fairness in the hiring process. However, every decision regarding interviews and hiring is made by our dedicated team, because we believe people make the best decisions about people. For more on how we use technology in hiring and how we process applicant data, see our Zebra Privacy Policy.

India’s $44B devotion economy is still largely offline, and we’re bringing structure, accessibility, and meaning to this massive market, where design and data play a central role in shaping user behavior at scale.

 We are looking for a Program Manager –D2C supply chain to own the complete order\-to\-doorstep journey for SriMandir.store.
 



 You'll sit at the intersection of product, tech, and operations, turning messy real\-world problems (a courier underperforming in a pincode, a spike in NDRs, a stakeholder team asking for a metric that doesn't exist yet) into clear, data\-backed fixes. If you like digging into numbers until they tell you what's actually broken, and then fixing it, this role is built for you.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 



* Own a set of operating metrics (delivery success, RTO, NDR recovery, dispatch TAT, and whatever else matters as we grow) and build the dashboards and review cadences
* Take a messy question like "why did prepaid share drop last month" and actually answer it, then decide what we do differently.
* Work directly with courier and logistics partners on allocation, SLAs and escalations, and just as directly with internal teams on process and tooling gaps.
* Design for scale from day one. What works at current volume should hold up
* Get close enough to customer experience data (reviews, complaints, repeat rates) to spot where ops issues are quietly costing us revenue
* Push for standardisation where it helps (SOPs, playbooks for new couriers or warehouses)
* Build the analytics view when one doesn't exist. If a metric matters and there's no dashboard for it



  





**What Success Looks Like** 



* You can explain, with data, why a metric moved and what you did about it.
* Operational processes you've touched get measurably better
* Manual, repetitive ops work gets replaced by systems and automations that just run, freeing the team from manual work
* You've built a control tower view (dashboards, alerts, exception flags) that surfaces problems the moment they happen



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* 1\-4 years of experience in program management, business analytics, business or product operations
* Strong analytical instincts. Comfortable in Excel and SQL
* Genuine curiosity about how a business works end to end, not just one function of it.
* Ability to work with multiple stakeholders (product, tech, warehouse, external partners)



  





**Good to Have** 



* D2C or e\-commerce experience (not mandatory, but useful context).

**Why This Role?** 




 This is a high\-ownership role where you will directly impact
 **customer experience, operational efficiency and business margins** 
 . You will have the opportunity to build systems and processes that can significantly improve the last\-mile experience for millions of customers.
 



  





**One Team. One Goal. Assisting millions on their digital devotional journeys.**

title: Program Manager, AI Data Ops
description:
**About AiDASH**
 AiDASH is leading the PreventionFirst™movement for electric utilities and transforming grid resilience through its pioneering platform that unifies vegetation, asset, storm, and wildfire intelligence. Powered by SatelliteFirst™ Inspection \& Monitoring, AiDASH delivers comprehensive visibility across the entire grid at the right frequency and budget, using the right data modality. More than 200 customers trust AiDASH to keep the lights on, spend where it counts, and defend every decision, Securing Tomorrow across every mile of the grid. Learn more at www.aidash.com.
   

  

 The PreventionFirst movement is growing, and so is the recognition behind it. In 2026, Forbes named AiDASH one of America's Best Startup Employers for the 4th consecutive year, and TIME included AiDASH among America's Top GreenTech Companies for the 3rd year in a row. Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ ranked AiDASH No. 12 in the San Francisco Bay Area, and No. 59 overall in their selection of the top 500 for 2024\.
   

  

 Join us in Securing Tomorrow Together!
   

  

 The Role
   

  

 AiDASH is looking for a high\-agency Program Manager to help scale our AI Data Ops function: the team responsible for sourcing, processing, and annotating the satellite and remote sensing imagery that powers our AI/ML models.
   

  

 This role is a new addition to the leadership team, created specifically to bring an
 **automation\-first, numbers\-backed, process\-driven** 
 operating model to how Ops runs . This role is designed to reduce operational complexity over time, not to manage individual queues or projects indefinitely. You will sit at the intersection of strategy, operations, vendor management, and data science delivery, helping AI Data Ops evolve from a fast\-scaling function into a well\-designed, repeatable operating system.
   

  

 You will need to zoom in to solve real problems on the ground — a stuck vendor SLA, a high priority escalation, a broken handoff — and zoom out to design the processes, playbooks, and automation that stop the same problems from recurring.
   

  

 This is a high\-visibility, build\-from\-scratch role: you'll be judged on the systems and habits you install, not just the projects you close.
   

  

 How You’ll Make an Impact:
   

  

**Automation \& AI\-native ways of working**
* Identify repetitive, manual workflows across annotation, QA, imagery processing and reporting, and drive their automation — via internal tooling, scripting, RPA, or AI\-assisted workflows.
* Build and own the automation roadmap and drive it seamlessly across the team


**Program \& project management**
* Run structured program governance (milestones, RAID logs, status cadence) across cross\-functional initiatives that no single manager owns end\-to\-end.
* Bring discipline — timelines, ownership, dependencies — to all team initiatives


**Cost reduction**
* Own a cost\-efficiency roadmap for Ops: vendor spend, tooling spends, rework/error costs, and capacity utilization.
* Build the business case and track savings with real numbers\- Clear visible impact


**Vendor performance frameworks**
* Design and own scorecards/SLAs for imagery, annotation and other third\-party vendors.
* Run regular vendor performance reviews and own escalation/renewal/replacement decisions in partnership with managers.


**Cross\-functional ownership \& data ownership**
* Serve as the connective tissue across all managers and leads — surfacing shared problems (tooling, process, vendor etc) that no single manager can fix alone.
* Own org\-wide SOP creation and the dashboard/metrics layer (throughput, quality, SLA, utilization) so every manager works off the same numbers.


**Enable leadership with insight and structure**
* Build dashboards/reports tracking throughput, accuracy, vendor performance, and cost efficiency; define KPIs that drive decisions on quality, capacity, and cost
* Manage budgets across data sourcing, annotation ops, and vendor contracts, identifying cost\-optimization opportunities
* Translate ambiguous problems into structured, actionable plans


 What We're Looking For:
   

  

* 5\+ years of experience spanning program/project management, business operations, or management consulting — ideally with exposure to automation, Ops, vendor management and cost optimization.
* A genuine track record of building metrics/automation programs from scratch — not just running ones someone else designed.
* Comfort with data: you should be able to build and defend a dashboard or a business case yourself, not just commission one.
* Strong written and verbal communication — you'll be the face of Ops in external conversations.
* Experience managing external vendors/partners and negotiating SLAs.
* Bonus: prior exposure to GIS, geospatial, imagery, or annotation\-heavy operations; experience standing up automation/RPA/AI tooling programs (This is not mandatory)
* Must\-have: hands\-on experience working in a startup environment.


 We are proud to be an equal\-opportunity employer. We are committed to embracing diversity and inclusion in our hiring practices, and we promote a work environment where everyone, from any race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin, can do their best work.
   

  

 We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible interview experience for all candidates. Please let us know if you require any accommodation during the interview process, and we will make every effort to meet your needs.

CLO manages a large\-scale ecosystem of vendor partners to drive customer acquisition, retention, and revenue growth across Microsoft’s commercial businesses.

 Program Leadership \& Execution

 Required Qualifications

**Preferred Qualifications**

**Required Skills \& Competencies**
 AI/CI Fluency
   

  

* Ability to streamline processes and eliminate redundancy.
* Ability to apply AI tools and automation to improve program delivery and efficiency.

 Commercial Acumen
   

  

* Understanding of sales drivers, customer lifecycle, and revenue\-based performance metrics
* Ability to connect program execution to measurable business outcomes.


 Vendor \& Stakeholder Management
   

  

* Strong experience in managing vendor performance, governance, and relationships.
* Ability to influence without authority across internal and external stakeholders.


 Core Programme Management Capabilities

 ou are responsible for managing the lifecycle of a complex cross\-functional program with considerable impact. Your program may focus on a single process path in a critical business area or you may work more broadly, managing larger initiatives that span organizations or geographies in support of a significant business objective. You may also be responsible for the delivery of large and complex projects that are not tied to any program. You may be assigned to manage the roadmap for an organization, which may include contributing to OP1/OP2 narratives, and/or ownership of one or more organizational goals. You are accountable for overall program strategy as well as tactically driving teams in and outside your organization to deliver. You are able to define the program (mission, vision, tenets), set objectives, analyze data, drive improvements that are quantified with metrics, and influence resource allocation. You understand the significant business problems in your program space, automation limitations, scaling factors, boundary conditions, and reasons behind leadership decisions (Q: Why did we deliver X? What business goal does it solve? Do we need to deliver something else\-\- if so why, and what? ).
   

  

 To ensure stakeholder needs are aligned, you drive mindful discussions that lead to crisp decisions. You provide a long\-term perspective, context (past, current, and future) for business and technology (at a high level) choices. You partner with customers, internal/external teams, and/or engineering teams to determine what projects move forward and in what priority order. You use your judgment to question proposals and test assumptions (Q. Do we need to deliver this at all?). You enlist senior individual contributors and leaders to ensure solutions scale (or will scale). You make smart trade\-offs (e.g., time vs. effort vs. deliverables). You create plans that have clear, measurable success criteria. You clearly communicate progress and outcomes. You oversee the gap between teams, processes, and systems. You help teams and/or your organization reduce exposure to classic failure modes (e.g., requirements not sufficiently understood or documented, ineffective cross\-team collaboration, long\-term impact(s) from third\-party solutions, security not considered, insufficient stakeholder review, etc.). You are able to solve ambiguous problems and proactively identify and mitigate risks (before they become roadblocks). You demonstrate good judgment in how and when to escalate (without damaging relationships). You are data\-driven. You regularly review metrics and proactively seek out new and improved data/mechanisms for visibility. You ensure your program stays aligned with organizational objectives.
   

  

 You understand and share program\-management best practices. You may be asked to use your knowledge to assess processes, program plans, and operational requirements. You work with teams to improve concurrent project delivery. You streamline and/or eliminate excess process. You influence teams to decouple from dependencies and eliminate problems that stifle innovation or cause user dissatisfaction. You are an excellent communicator. You write effective narratives (e.g., Amazon 6\-pager, PR/FAQ, reporting, etc.) and present them effectively to directors and VPs. You routinely deliver the right things with limited guidance. When confronted with discordant views, you are able to find the best way forward and influence others to follow that path (build consensus). You actively recruit and develop others by mentoring in your organization and/or at your location. You provide constructive peer feedback and promotion assessments for lower level PMs.

 Generally works within a VP org. Influences large customer segments, technology decisions, external entity interaction, etc. Actively mentors and develops others.
   

  

 Work is tactical and strategic. Owns a large program. Manages the lifecycle of complex initiatives. Unblocks teams and increases the speed of delivery. Negotiates resources and priorities. Learning to force multiply . Escalates effectively. Able to find a path forward in difficult situations. Makes trade\-offs between short\-term needs vs. long\-term needs.
   

  

 High impact on. Org goals, and program\-related metrics. May have cross\- region impact
   

  

 Improves, streamlines, and/or eliminates excess process. Drives efficiencies. Creates predictable process paths.

**Description**
 We are building Amazon's first horizontal self\-serve decisioning platform — an intelligence layer that upgrades static rule\-based systems into outcome\-learning, context\-aware decision engines. The platform serves multiple tenants across multiple organizations and domains, each requiring structured onboarding, cross\-org coordination, and production launch governance.
   

  

 We are looking for a Program Manager to own tenant onboarding execution end\-to\-end — from first contact through production launch and steady\-state operations. This role operates at the intersection of platform product, tenant engineering, and business stakeholders — orchestrating complex multi\-party programs where each tenant brings a different tech stack, org structure, data readiness level, and decision type.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Tenant Onboarding Execution
   

  

* Own the end\-to\-end onboarding lifecycle — contract → data readiness → prototyping → shadow mode → production launch.
* Manage parallel tracks across multiple tenants simultaneously at different stages.
* Drive timelines against committed milestones, identify blockers early, and escalate decisively across cross\-org dependencies.


 Cross\-Org Stakeholder Management
   

  

* Navigate multi\-persona commitment structures (builder, system owner, sponsor) across organizational boundaries.
* Coordinate across platform engineering, applied science, BA/RA teams, and tenant\-side engineering.
* Serve as the single\-threaded owner tenant leadership engages with throughout onboarding.


 Process Design \& Operational Excellence
   

  

* Design and iterate on scalable onboarding processes — playbooks, health dashboards, RACI matrices, milestone trackers.
* Drive process improvements as the platform moves from bespoke onboarding to self\-serve at scale.


 Data Readiness \& Pre\-flight
   

  

* Drive data readiness (the \#1 time sink) by providing clear requirements, checklists, and embedded support.
* Coordinate pre\-flight validation: data quality gates, signal checks, and integration testing.
* Ensure contract commitments are met before prototype begins.


 Governance \& Launch Readiness
   

  

* Coordinate shadow mode, launch readiness reviews (circuit breakers, fail\-safes, RACI sign\-off), and transition to steady\-state operations with support handoff and monitoring.


 Pipeline \& Reporting
   

  

* Maintain full pipeline visibility. Report program health with actionable metrics: onboarding velocity, time\-to\-production, blocker resolution.
* Partner with GTM to convert qualified demand into onboarding\-ready tenants.


**About The Team**
 We operate at the intersection of product, science, and GTM — building a platform that connects decision systems across Amazon so that one signal makes all of them smarter. The platform is live with founding tenants, scaling to broad GA, and building pipeline for pan\-Amazon adoption. This role is critical to ensuring that every tenant that enters the funnel moves through onboarding with velocity, quality, and trust.
   

  

 You will work directly with platform leadership, applied science, engineering, BA/RAs, and tenant\-side stakeholders to drive the operational machinery that turns platform readiness into production impact — one tenant at a time, then many in parallel.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 5\+ years in program management, technical program management, or platform operations roles
* Experience managing multi\-party programs with cross\-organizational dependencies and competing priorities
* Demonstrated ability to drive programs in environments with ambiguity — where processes don't exist yet and must be built while executing
* Strong stakeholder management skills — comfortable holding senior leaders accountable to commitments and escalating decisively when programs are at risk
* Track record of managing parallel workstreams (5\+ concurrent programs) with clear milestone tracking and proactive risk management
* Excellent written communication — able to produce clear program documents, status reports, and playbooks that scale beyond the individual


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree, or MBA in management, business administration, economics, engineering, marketing
* Experience in platform onboarding, developer ecosystem programs, or internal tooling adoption at large\-scale technology organizations
* Familiarity with data platform or ML/AI product ecosystems — comfortable navigating conversations about data readiness, model validation, and production governance
* Background in building scalable onboarding processes that reduce per\-tenant effort over time (self\-serve model design)
* Experience with change management in multi\-org environments — driving adoption where commitment requires budget, headcount, and cross\-functional alignment

title: Associate Program Manager - Partnerships
description:
**Associate — Global Strategic Partnerships** 




 You don't just "manage" partners. You build the supply engine that powers a global AI platform.
 



 Joveo's recruitment advertising platform runs on machine learning, real\-time bidding, and predictive optimization — delivering millions of job ads to the right candidates at the right moment. But none of that works without world\-class supply partnerships fueling the machine.
 



 That's where you come in.
 



  





**The Role — In Plain English** 




 You'll own relationships that directly impact revenue, reach, and platform performance across global markets.
 



 This isn't account management with a fancier title. You're the person who spots an untapped supply channel in Southeast Asia on Tuesday, negotiates the commercial terms by Thursday, and has it live and delivering candidates the following week.
 



 Your week might look like this:
 


* **Monday:** 
 Analyze partner performance data. One channel is underpacing — you diagnose why and fix it before anyone escalates.
* **Tuesday:** 
 Jump on a call with a new publisher. Pitch the partnership. Negotiate terms that work for both sides.
* **Wednesday:** 
 Sit with Product and Tech to unblock an integration that's been stalling a high\-value partner launch.
* **Thursday:** 
 Build an automation workflow that eliminates 4 hours of manual reporting your team does every week.
* **Friday:** 
 Present your partner growth roadmap to the CXO. Get buy\-in. Start executing.



 You'll talk to partners in the morning, negotiate contracts before lunch, dig into performance dashboards after, and pitch process improvements to leadership by end of day — all in the same role.
 



  





**What Makes This Different** 




 Most partnership roles at this level put you in a box — either "relationship manager" or "operations associate." This one refuses to separate the two.
 



 You'll own the full lifecycle: find the partner, close the deal, launch the integration, track the numbers, optimize the outcome. End to end. No handoffs to five other teams.
 



 Direct access to CXOs and senior leadership. Real commercial ownership from day one. And you're building systems that scale — not just doing the work, but redesigning how the work gets done.
 



  





**You Might Be Right For This If...** 



* You have 1–4 years in partnerships, supply ops, business operations, or client\-facing roles — ideally in SaaS, Ad Tech, HR Tech, or recruitment advertising
* You've actually negotiated a deal, not just "supported" one. You know what it feels like to own a number.
* You're the person who looks at a messy spreadsheet and sees a pattern everyone else missed
* You can context\-switch between a partner call, a data pull, and a strategy doc without losing momentum
* Process inefficiency physically bothers you. You automate things before anyone asks you to.
* You're comfortable in ambiguity — startup speed doesn't stress you, it sharpens you



  





**What You'll Get** 



* **Real ownership:** 
 Commercial decisions, partner relationships, and operational outcomes — yours from day one
* **Leadership exposure:** 
 Work directly with CXOs and cross\-functional leads across Product, Tech, Sales, and Client Success
* **Growth trajectory:** 
 Previous hires in this function have built entirely new capabilities within Joveo's supply ecosystem
* **Compensation:** 
 Among the most competitive in India, including stock options
* **Global scope:** 
 Partners and markets that span continents — not a single\-geography desk job



  





**If you'd rather build the partnership playbook than follow one — we should talk.** 




 Joveo. Where AI meets the future of work.

**Description**
 Are you passionate about solving business challenges at a global scale? Amazon Retail Business Services is looking for an experienced Business Analyst to join our team and help unlock insights which take our business to the next level. The candidate will be excited about understanding and implementing new and repeatable processes to improve our employee global work authorization experiences. They will do this by partnering with key stakeholders to be curious and comfortable digging deep into the business challenges to understand and identify insights that will enable us to figure out standards to improve our ability to globally scale this program. This role requires an individual with excellent analytical abilities as well as business acumen. The candidate knows and values our customers (internal and external) and will work back from the customer to create structured processes for global expansions of work authorization, and help integrate new countries/new acquisitions into the existing program. They are experts in partnering and earning trust with operations/business leaders to drive these key business decisions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own the development and maintenance of new and existing artifacts focused on analysis of requirements, metrics, and reporting dashboards.
* Partner with operations/business teams to consult, develop and implement KPI’s, automated reporting/process solutions, and process improvements to meet business needs.
* Enable effective decision making by retrieving and aggregating data from multiple sources and compiling it into a digestible and actionable format.
* Prepare and deliver business requirements reviews to the senior management team regarding progress and roadblocks.
* Participate in strategic and tactical planning discussions.
* Design, develop and maintain scaled, automated, user\-friendly systems, reports, dashboards, etc. that will support our business needs.
* Excellent writing skills, to create artifacts easily digestible by business and tech partners.


 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Define and Drive Business Goals: Lead strategic initiatives to reduce Cost to Serve (CtS) across key areas, including inventory defects, shipping costs and operational inefficiencies. Own the lifecycle of these initiatives, from problem definition to solution implementation, with limited leadership direction.
* Data\-Driven Decision\-Making: Use advanced analytics tools to uncover inefficiencies, analyze cost and volume drivers, and develop actionable solutions. Drive detailed discussions based on data insights and align cross\-functional teams on high\-priority initiatives.
* Financial Collaboration: Partner with finance teams to validate cost models, forecast savings and ensure alignment with Amazon’s financial goals. Make trade\-offs between short\-term cost reductions and long\-term strategic objectives to maximize financial impact.
* Cross\-Functional Leadership: Collaborate with cross\-functional teams across finance, operations and supply chain to implement scalable solutions. Unblock teams to increase speed of delivery and ensure alignment on program goals.
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Conduct deep dives into defects to identify systemic inefficiencies, leveraging frameworks like Upstream Defect Elimination (UDE). Influence technology decisions and external entity interactions to resolve complex, undefined problems effectively.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Communicate effectively with senior leaders, presenting data\-driven insights and recommendations to influence decision\-making. Trusted to present decisions to leaders up to three tiers above level, driving alignment across diverse areas.
* Scalable Solutions: Develop and implement scalable programs across geographies, incorporating regional nuances and best practices.


**About The Team**
 Cost to Serve (CTS) aims to identify and eliminate waste, negative experiences, and non\-value activities across the end\-to\-end remit of supply chain and dependent workstreams that slow down resolution for our stakeholders. The primary objective is to reduce Cost To Serve for Amazon and enable “Free Cash Flow” by optimizing the Cost per shipped unit economics across the supply chain systems. Our program will support in establishing the end\-to\-end supply chain checkpoints on how the inventory moves inside Amazon to identify gaps, broken processes/policies to eliminate root causes of systemic difficulties rather than merely addressing symptoms, on behalf of our customers. This team will partner with internal/external stakeholders to establish the FCF/Cost to serve charter based on opportunity size and own specific unique initiatives that are beyond the existing team’s program scope.

 Amazon Operations Infrastructure Solutions (OIS) is seeking an experienced Sr Technical Infrastructure Program Manager (TIPM) for our team. * High attention to detail
* Ability to think strategically and execute methodically
* Demonstrated ability to influence management
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment where continuous innovation is desired
* Committed to learning and expanding professional and technical knowledge
* Demonstrated analytical and quantitative skills and ability to use hard data and metrics to back up assumptions and develop business cases
* Ability to clearly communicate data insights to others
* Willingness to roll up your sleeves and do whatever is necessary; owner mentality
* Demonstrated ability to dive deep in understanding the product, our business, and the market landscape


 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**In This Role**
* You manage complex infrastructure builds, delivering critical solutions, significant improvements, new mechanisms, or deprecating processes that are no longer needed. These efforts require you to work with multiple teams in and/or across organizations.
* You are accountable for the overall strategy of a large program. You successfully manage all stages (from concept to delivery). Your program meets business goals and/or shows measurable improvements in your customer’s experience, business or employee efficiency or execution, compliance adherence, financial or other metrics, etc.
* You understand the interdependencies and functionality of the technologies you work with (e.g. customer requirements, deployment constraints, design limitations, operational support requirements). You influence team priorities and business strategy through data\-supported contributions. You are able to make a case for project priorities, resource allocation, and/or appropriate program adoption, to achieve a desired business outcome, resolve a technical deficiency, or unblock delivery.
* You communicate ideas effectively, verbally and in writing, to a wide range of audiences including Directors and VPs. You foster a constructive dialogue, harmonize discordant views, and lead the resolution of contentious issues (build consensus). You partner successfully with customers, stakeholders, and engineering teams.
* Your program management practices set a great example to others. You routinely and efficiently deliver the right things. You define clear goals and objectives. You drive crisp decisions in your program area about what projects move forward and in what priority order. You proactively identify risks and bring them to the attention of your team and stakeholders with plans for mitigation before they become roadblocks.
* You are a simplifier. You judiciously add, refine, and remove procedures. By applying project management best practices, you increase the productivity and effectiveness of the teams you work with.
* You actively participate in the hiring process as well as mentor others \- improving their skills and ability to get things done.


 A day in the life
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 Here at Amazon, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee\-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 16 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 Our team puts a high value on work\-life balance. It isn’t about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it’s about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life\-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better\-rounded professional and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.
   

  

 Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment.
   

  

 If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you!
   

  

 At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!
   

  

**About The Team**
 This role is specifically to manage cross cutting program for the Amazon Robotics/AFT/OpsTechIT organizations. It is a large multi\-year initiative, involving 30\+ teams, and with significant technical complexity and visibility.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of program management or technical project management experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a related technical field
* Experience in project/program management
* Knowledge of information technology infrastructure domains such as compute server platforms, storage server platforms, server components, network devices, technologies and architectures, IT service delivery principles and best practices
* Experience managing conflict, escalations, negotiating compromise, influencing others and problem solving with engineering teams
* Experience participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results, or experience communicating results to senior leadership
* Experience communicating across technical and non\-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients
* Experience managing large\-scale projects from end to end


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in one or more of the following areas: data center or network capacity planning, data center or network infrastructure program/project management, or related technical fields
* project management certification (e.g., APM, CSM, PMI\-ACP, PRINCE2\)

**Description**
 Prime Video is how hundreds of millions of customers around the world discover, buy, and watch the content they love. Behind every offer a customer sees \- every subscription, channel, rental, purchase, bundle, and deal \- is a set of world\-class systems built and owned by our Commerce team in Bengaluru.
   

  

 We are the Prime Video Offers team: the front of the funnel for Prime Video's global commerce. We own critical services that determine what every customer in all countries can purchase, rent, or subscribe to \- what price they see, what promotions apply, and how offers are composed across product lines. Our systems process billions of requests per day and sit on the critical path for every Prime Video transaction globally.
   

  

 We are at an inflection point. We're expanding Prime Video Commerce into dozens of new markets while simultaneously transforming the underlying architecture \- evolving to deliver flexibility across our products and offers more than ever. These aren't sequential bets; they're happening in parallel, across multiple engineering teams and partner organizations, each with their own roadmaps and constraints. The TPM who owns this will navigate that complexity and make it land.
   

  

 We are looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to own the end\-to\-end delivery of these programs. You will operate at the intersection of engineering, product, and business — making trade\-off decisions, unblocking cross\-org dependencies, driving operational cadence that gives executive leadership confidence without requiring their intervention, and delivering complex multi\-org programs.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Strategic Leadership: Own the delivery strategy for programs with senior leadership visibility \- international expansion across new markets, architecture transformation milestones, and cross\-product capability launches. Define the sequencing, the critical path, and the trade\-offs.
   

  

 Cross\-Org Program Execution: Coordinate delivery across multiple engineering teams and partner organizations. Own the workback plans, dependency maps, risk registers, and escalation paths that keep multi\-quarter programs on track across organizational boundaries.
   

  

 Architecture Transformation Delivery: Drive the program execution of a multi\-year architecture plan — platform buildout, API migration across dozens of consumers, interface harmonization across services, and shared capability rollouts. Sequence these against feature delivery so they compound rather than compete.
   

  

 Operational Cadence \& Mechanisms: Build and run the review cadences and launch readiness mechanisms that drive accountability across stakeholder teams. Give leadership clear, honest visibility — with a path to green, not just a status report.
   

  

 Capacity \& Resource Strategy: Map engineering bandwidth against the launch calendar, surface gaps well before they become blockers, and drive trade\-off decisions when demand exceeds capacity.
   

  

 Efficiency \& Automation: Drive programs that reduce manual launch effort dramatically — automation targets, test coverage milestones, and effort reduction metrics that turn multi\-quarter launches into repeatable, scalable processes.
   

  

 Stakeholder Influence: Partner with senior leaders across multiple organizations to align priorities, negotiate timelines, and resolve structural blockers. Represent program health in leadership forums with clarity and conviction.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 Your morning starts with a launch readiness review for a new territory — multiple teams on the call, you're making the go/no\-go call. Before lunch, you're reviewing a migration burndown with engineering and deciding whether to re\-sequence. In the afternoon, you're in a roadmap discussion with Product and senior leadership, making trade\-off decisions on what to prioritize. You end the day preparing a status update for the leadership staff meeting — clear, honest, with a path forward. You operate across time zones, hold teams accountable without being adversarial, and know when to push versus when to pull in leadership.
   

  

**About The Team**
 We are the Prime Video Commerce Offers team in Bengaluru \- engineers and program managers across all levels who build and own the commerce experiences that customers across the globe interact with every day. We operate as a worldwide team with genuine empathy across time zones. Inclusivity is how we work \- we believe the best ideas come from diverse perspectives, and we actively create space for every voice to be heard.

description:
Avance Clinical is a Contract Research Organisation which offers specialised services supporting drug development for the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industry.
   

  

 The Project Manager \- EPMO will be responsible for managing the planning and execution of internal projects assigned within Avance Clinical's Enterprise Project Management Office (EPMO). Operating within the EPMO's tiered governance model, the Project Manager will be allocated projects from Tier 1 (Explore), Tier 2 (Build), or Tier 3 (Transform) relative to their experience, certifications and demonstrated delivery capability — scaling responsibility as they grow within the function. The role applies established project management principles to ensure consistent, disciplined delivery across the portfolio, and contributes to the EPMO's benefits realisation framework to help measure and report the return on investment of internal initiatives.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities** 
  

  

* Lead allocated EPMO projects — Tier 1 (Explore), Tier 2 (Build) or Tier 3 (Transform) — based on experience and demonstrated capability. This includes development and execution of scope, schedule, budget, resource, risk, change, communications and stakeholder management plans, applied proportionate to project tier and complexity.
* Apply consistent project management principles across all allocated projects, working within the EPMO's flexible delivery framework and adhering to its intake, scoring, governance, reporting and closeout standards.
* For Tier 2 initiatives, partner with the nominated business sponsor to develop and refine concise business cases, ensuring scope, rationale, cost, effort and expected return on investment are clearly articulated and aligned with EPMO scoring criteria.
* For Tier 3 initiatives, deliver under the strategic oversight of the EPMO Director, ensuring full governance is observed and that the named ELT sponsor is appropriately engaged throughout the project lifecycle.
* Contribute to the EPMO's benefits realisation framework — capturing baseline measures at planning, tracking realised benefits through delivery, and providing inputs to the EPMO's ROI and outcomes reporting back to ELT.
* Maintain accurate, current project records in the EPMO portfolio dashboard, including status, resourcing, risks, issues, dependencies, scope changes and benefits\-tracking data.
* Facilitate the requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, training and change management activities required for successful project delivery, working collaboratively with subject matter experts and vendors.
* Identify and escalate emerging risks, scope changes or threshold breaches (effort, cost, dependency) that may trigger tier escalation, in line with the EPMO operating model.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including IT, Technology and Innovation, Quality and Compliance, Finance, Clinical Operations and Senior Management to negotiate resource commitments and ensure on\-time delivery of projects.
* Manage external vendors associated with project deliverables, ensuring scope, schedule and contractual obligations are met.
* Provide regular project status updates and portfolio inputs to the EPMO Director, and contribute to monthly ELT portfolio reporting packs.
* Support continuous improvement of the EPMO's tools, templates, processes and benefits\-tracking methods through feedback, adoption discipline and lessons learned.
* Other duties as directed by Line Management or delegate in line with skills, experience and/or qualifications. Qualifications, Skills and Experience
+ Ordinary degree or equivalent in an appropriate discipline and appropriate industry experience.
+ Bachelor's degree in Project Management, Business, Computer Science or other relevant discipline, and/or recognised project management certifications (e.g. PMP, PRINCE2, Agile/Scrum). Higher tier projects will typically require more advanced qualifications and demonstrated delivery track record.
+ Demonstrated project management experience scaled to the tier of project to be managed:
+ Tier 1 (Explore): early\-career project management experience or relevant transferable experience supporting small, single\-team initiatives.
+ Tier 2 (Build): a minimum of 3 years managing cross\-functional internal projects with named sponsors and defined business cases.
+ Tier 3 (Transform): a minimum of 5 years managing strategic, multi\-stream or transformation projects with executive\-level reporting and accountability for benefits delivery.
+ Experience contributing to benefits realisation, ROI measurement or outcomes reporting frameworks is highly desirable.
+ Experience managing technology, systems integration, ERP, CRM or business process transformation projects will be highly regarded given Avance's current strategic roadmap.
+ Strong working knowledge of established project management methodologies (waterfall, agile and hybrid) and the judgment to apply them proportionate to project size and complexity.

description:
Job Title Senior Project Manager Job Description Summary We are looking for an experienced PMC Project Manager with 15+ years of experience in managing large-scale construction projects from the Client/PMC side.
 
The candidate will act as the Client''s representative and overall project delivery lead, providing independent oversight and management of the project across time, cost, quality, safety, contracts, procurement, design coordination and construction.
 
The position is suitable for candidates with experience in major residential, commercial, hospital, hotel, institutional or mixed-use developments in Bangalore or similar major markets.
 
The Project Manager will be responsible for ensuring that the project is delivered in accordance with the Client''s objectives, approved budget, programme, design intent, quality standards and contractual requirements.
 
The candidate must be capable of managing large contractors and multiple consultants and should have sufficient technical, commercial and contractual knowledge to challenge, guide and control contractor performance on behalf of the Client. Job Description 1. Position Overview We are looking for an experienced PMC Project Manager with 15+ years of experience in managing large-scale construction projects from the Client/PMC side. The candidate will act as the Client''s representative and overall project delivery lead , providing independent oversight and management of the project across time, cost, quality, safety, contracts, procurement, design coordination and construction . The position is suitable for candidates with experience in major residential, commercial, hospital, hotel, institutional or mixed-use developments in Bangalore or similar major markets. The Project Manager will be responsible for ensuring that the project is delivered in accordance with the Client''s objectives, approved budget, programme, design intent, quality standards and contractual requirements . The candidate must be capable of managing large contractors and multiple consultants and should have sufficient technical, commercial and contractual knowledge to challenge, guide and control contractor performance on behalf of the Client . 2. Primary Role Client Representative The PMC Project Manager shall function as the single-point project delivery lead for the PMC , representing the Client''s interests at site. Key responsibilities include: Provide overall leadership to the PMC project team. Act as the primary interface between the Client, PMC, consultants and contractors. Establish project management and governance systems. Ensure that project objectives are clearly communicated to all stakeholders. Monitor and control contractor performance against contractual obligations. Identify project risks and recommend appropriate mitigation measures. Provide independent advice to the Client on project progress, risks, costs, delays and contractual matters. Ensure that all major project decisions are supported by appropriate technical, commercial and schedule analysis. Maintain complete transparency in reporting project status to the Client. Ensure that the Client''s interests are protected throughout the project lifecycle. 3. Project Planning & Schedule Management The Project Manager shall provide overall leadership for project planning and programme control. Responsibilities include: Review and approve the overall Project Master Programme prepared by the Planning team. Review contractor baseline programmes and detailed L2/L3/L4 schedules. Ensure alignment between design, procurement, construction, testing and commissioning schedules. Monitor actual progress against the approved baseline. Identify critical path and near-critical activities. Monitor achievement of contractual and project milestones. Review contractor look-ahead programmes and recovery schedules. Challenge unrealistic contractor programmes and claimed progress. Review the impact of design changes, approvals, procurement and site constraints on the programme. Ensure timely implementation of recovery and mitigation measures. Review and advise the Client on potential Extension of Time claims. Coordinate delay analysis and schedule impact assessments. Ensure that project completion forecasts are realistic and evidence-based. 4. Construction Management Provide overall supervision and management of construction activities through the PMC team. Ensure that contractors execute works in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, method statements and contracts. Monitor construction methodology and sequencing. Ensure adequate deployment of manpower, plant, equipment and materials. Monitor productivity and identify underperformance. Coordinate civil, structural, architectural, MEP, faade, interiors, landscape and external development works. Manage interfaces between various contractors and packages. Identify construction constraints and coordinate timely resolution. Ensure that site activities are properly coordinated to avoid rework and disruption. Monitor construction quality and progress through regular site inspections and reviews. Ensure timely escalation of critical issues to the Client. 5. Contractor Management A key responsibility of the PMC Project Manager will be to manage and control contractor performance on behalf of the Client . The candidate shall: Review contractor mobilisation and resource deployment. Monitor manpower, plant, equipment and material availability. Assess contractor productivity and performance. Conduct regular contractor performance reviews. Establish clear performance expectations and corrective actions. Issue/coordinate appropriate contractual communications through the PMC. Challenge contractor delays, inadequate resources and poor productivity. Review contractor recovery plans. Monitor compliance with contractual milestones. Recommend appropriate contractual remedies in case of persistent underperformance. Ensure that contractor commitments made during progress meetings are tracked and closed. Maintain proper records of contractor performance, delays and non-compliances. 6. Contract Administration & Claims Management The Project Manager shall provide strong oversight of contract administration and claims. Responsibilities include: Review construction contracts and understand key commercial and contractual obligations. Ensure that PMC teams monitor contractor compliance with contractual requirements. Review contractor notices, claims, variations and EOT submissions. Coordinate with the QS/Commercial Manager for evaluation of variations and claims. Ensure timely assessment of additional cost and time implications. Review contractual entitlement and supporting documentation. Ensure proper recording of delay events and Client/contractor responsibilities. Coordinate preparation of recommendations to the Client. Protect the Client from unjustified claims and cost escalation. Ensure that contractual correspondence is properly documented. Assist in dispute avoidance and resolution. Working knowledge of FIDIC, EPC, Design & Build and Item Rate contracts is preferred. 7. Cost Management The PMC Project Manager shall provide overall oversight of project cost control. Responsibilities include: Monitor project cost against the approved budget. Review cost reports prepared by the commercial/QS team. Monitor committed, certified, actual and forecast expenditure. Review variations and change orders. Assess cost impact of design changes and Client instructions. Monitor potential cost overruns. Review contractor claims and commercial submissions. Ensure appropriate approvals are obtained for variations. Monitor project contingency and risk allowances. Provide the Client with an independent assessment of the forecast final cost. Ensure cost and programme implications are considered before recommending major changes. 8. Design Management Coordinate with architects, structural consultants, MEP consultants and specialist consultants. Monitor design deliverables against the construction programme. Ensure timely release of Good for Construction drawings. Identify design gaps and interface issues. Ensure timely closure of RFIs and technical queries. Coordinate design reviews and constructability reviews. Monitor design changes and assess their impact on cost and programme. Coordinate BIM/clash detection processes where applicable. Ensure that construction does not proceed based on incomplete or unapproved information. Maintain a design deliverables and approval tracker. 9. Procurement Management Review and monitor the project procurement strategy. Ensure procurement schedules are aligned with the master programme. Monitor long-lead items and critical equipment. Review vendor approval and material submittal processes. Monitor procurement risks and potential delays. Ensure timely release of purchase orders and subcontract packages. Coordinate procurement with design and construction requirements. Escalate procurement issues that could affect project milestones. Monitor delivery of critical materials and equipment to site. 10. Quality Management The PMC Project Manager shall ensure that the Client''s quality objectives are achieved. Responsibilities include: Implement and monitor the Project Quality Management Plan. Review contractor quality plans and inspection procedures. Monitor compliance with project specifications and approved materials. Ensure inspection and testing procedures are followed. Review quality audits and inspection reports. Monitor NCRs, observations and corrective actions. Identify recurring quality issues and implement preventive measures. Ensure appropriate mock-ups and benchmark samples are approved. Monitor workmanship and finishing standards. Ensure quality documentation is complete for project handover. 11. Health, Safety & Environment Provide leadership to ensure a strong project safety culture. Monitor contractor compliance with HSE requirements. Review contractor HSE plans and performance. Ensure regular safety audits and inspections. Monitor high-risk construction activities. Ensure timely closure of safety observations. Escalate serious safety violations to the Client. Promote a zero-incident / zero-tolerance approach to unsafe practices . Ensure environmental and statutory requirements are complied with. 12. Risk Management The Project Manager shall lead the PMC''s project risk-management process. Responsibilities include: Establish and maintain the Project Risk Register. Identify risks related to: Programme Cost Design Procurement Contractor performance Quality Safety Statutory approvals Contracts and claims Stakeholder interfaces Assess probability and potential impact. Develop mitigation and contingency measures. Monitor implementation of risk mitigation actions. Escalate high-impact risks to the Client. Ensure emerging risks are identified before they become project issues. 13. Project Controls & MIS Ensure that the PMC project controls system provides the Client with an accurate and timely view of project performance. The Project Manager shall review: Master schedule Monthly progress S-curves Critical path Milestone tracking Contractor performance Cost reports Variation/change register Procurement tracker Design tracker Material approval tracker Risk register Issue register NCR/quality tracker HSE performance Manpower and productivity Claims/EOT register Forecast completion dates Forecast final cost The candidate should be capable of interpreting project data and converting it into actionable recommendations , rather than merely reviewing reports. 14. Client Reporting & Stakeholder Management Act as the primary PMC interface with the Client. Conduct weekly and monthly project review meetings. Prepare management-level project reports. Present project status, key risks, delays and commercial issues to senior Client management. Provide clear recommendations and alternative solutions. Ensure timely escalation of critical decisions. Manage expectations of Client, consultants and contractors. Maintain transparent and professional communication with all stakeholders. Ensure that decisions and commitments are properly recorded and followed through. 15. Testing, Commissioning & Handover Develop and monitor the overall testing and commissioning strategy. Coordinate commissioning of MEP and specialist systems. Monitor statutory inspections and approvals. Coordinate snagging and de-snagging activities. Monitor completion of all works against the approved scope. Ensure as-built drawings and O&M manuals are completed. Ensure warranties, test certificates and statutory documentation are compiled. Coordinate final handover to the Client. Ensure smooth transition from construction to operations. 16. PMC Team Leadership The Project Manager will lead and coordinate the PMC team, which may include: Planning Engineer Civil/Structural Engineers Architectural/Finishes Engineers MEP Engineers QA/QC Engineers Safety Engineers QS/Commercial Manager Contracts/Claims personnel Procurement specialists Document Controllers Other specialist consultants Responsibilities include: Define roles and responsibilities. Establish reporting structures. Monitor individual and team performance. Ensure adequate staffing against project requirements. Coordinate multidisciplinary activities. Ensure timely reporting and escalation. Build a strong, collaborative PMC team culture. 17. Authority & Decision-Making The candidate should have the maturity to distinguish between matters that can be resolved at project level and those requiring Client approval. The Project Manager shall: Provide technical and commercial recommendations to the Client. Recommend acceptance/rejection of contractor submissions. Recommend corrective measures for contractor underperformance. Recommend recovery strategies. Recommend variations and change orders based on technical/commercial evaluation. Recommend contractual action where justified. Escalate matters requiring Client approval with clear options and implications. The role is primarily one of independent review, management and recommendation on behalf of the Client, rather than routine contractor supervision. 18. Educational Qualification Mandatory B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering from a recognised institution. Preferred M.Tech / MBA / Post Graduate qualification in Construction or Project Management. PMP / PMI / RICS or equivalent professional certification is an advantage. 19. Experience Requirements 15+ years of total experience in construction/project management. Minimum 810 years in Project Manager / Senior Project Manager / Construction Manager / PMC leadership roles preferred. Demonstrated experience in managing large-scale building projects. Strong Client/PMC-side experience preferred. Experience managing multiple contractors and consultants. Experience in large and complex projects with significant civil, architectural, MEP and specialist interfaces. Preferred Project Experience Experience in one or more of the following: High-rise residential developments Commercial developments Super-speciality hospitals Hotels and hospitality Mixed-use developments Institutional projects Large corporate campuses 20. Technical & Professional Competencies Strong working knowledge of: Construction Management Project Management Primavera P6 / MS Project Project Controls Contract Administration FIDIC / EPC / Design & Build / Item Rate Contracts Cost Management Quantity Surveying fundamentals Variations & Change Management Claims & EOT Delay Analysis Quality Management HSE Management Procurement Management Risk Management Design Management MEP Coordination Testing & Commissioning Advanced MS Excel and MS Office BIM coordination awareness Project dashboards/MIS 21. Leadership & Behavioural Competencies The candidate should demonstrate: Strong leadership and people-management skills. Excellent Client and stakeholder-management capability. Strong technical understanding of building construction. Strong commercial and contractual awareness. Ability to challenge contractors objectively and professionally. Excellent negotiation and conflict-resolution skills. Strong analytical and problem-solving capability. Ability to make decisions under pressure. Excellent written and verbal communication. Strong presentation skills. High degree of ownership and accountability. Ability to manage multiple priorities and interfaces. Proactive approach to risk identification and mitigation. 22. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Project Delivery Achievement of project milestones. Overall programme performance. Effectiveness of recovery strategies. Cost Project cost within approved budget. Control of variations and claims. Accuracy of cost forecasting. Contractor Performance Contractor productivity. Resource deployment. Schedule adherence. Quality and HSE performance. Quality Reduction in NCRs and recurring defects. Timely closure of quality issues. Successful completion and handover. Safety HSE compliance. Reduction/prevention of incidents. Timely closure of safety observations. Client Satisfaction Quality and transparency of reporting. Timely resolution of issues. Quality of recommendations. Effective stakeholder coordination. 23. Ideal Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will be a senior construction professional with strong PMC/Client-side experience , capable of independently managing the delivery of a major project and providing objective advice to the Client. He/she should be able to move beyond routine supervision and provide strategic project leadership , with a strong understanding of: Programme + Cost + Quality + Safety + Contracts + Claims + Procurement + Design + Construction The candidate should be comfortable challenging major contractors such as L&T, Shapoorji Pallonji, Tata Projects, NCC, Afcons or equivalent , while maintaining a professional and collaborative relationship. Overview:
**Working at Atlassian**


Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

**Job Overview**


As a Senior Champion Program Manager (Sr. CPM), your role involves fostering growth, as well as establishing, and nurturing robust connections with Atlassian Champions across APAC supporting them to contribute to the community to have the most impact, and activating them in ways that support business priorities such as driving company user groups, community events, forum contributions, and content creation.


Responsibilities:
**What you’ll own**

**As a senior member of the Champion Engagement \& Experiences team, you’ll drive engagement \& operational excellence for the Champion program.** You are the subject\-matter expert and owner for the operational backbone, keeping the systems, documentation, and engagement mechanics that the whole team runs on healthy and scalable. You’ll:

* Drive program operational excellence: the health of the Champion tech stack, internal and external documentation management, and engagement health metrics
* Obsess over optimizing the program to enhance the Champion experience by launching annual surveys and collecting feedback on a regular basis
* Act as the Champion representative for all Champion Support and Platform \& Delivery\-facing projects such as a CRM migration and revamping the Perks \& Rewards ecosystem
* Serve as point of contact for Champion enablement collaborations such as Champion Hub, lifecycle emails, and Champion Workshops
* Handle first line of escalations and provide recommendations for CPM’s next steps


On a day\-to\-day basis, you’ll cultivate a sense of trust and belonging in the community by engaging with Atlassian Champions through:

* A private Slack community, private forum groups, email, and in person
* Monthly virtual events such as Coffee Chats and Office Hours with regional Champions
* Highlight Champion stories and share APAC regional accomplishments on a consistent basis across quarterly reports, Slack channels, and blog posts
* An Annual Regional Connect event that you’ll host to reward top performing Champions in APAC
* Enforcement of the Champion Program Guidelines


Compensation:

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.


This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.


Qualifications:
**More about you**


To be successful in this role, you will need to be a big\-picture thinker and also able to dive deep into the details that help our Champions feel seen and heard. You're extremely empathetic; you care about what customers need and want to help them achieve their goals. Also:

* 3\+ years of proven experience building, scaling, and influencing the strategy of community, advocacy, or ambassador programs (especially chapter or user\-led models)
* You are a disciplined program operator and business\-rules owner who clearly articulates program needs and outcomes, defines user journeys, anticipates edge cases, and owns documentation, SOPs, and tooling health
* You are able to prioritize, manage deadlines and work collaboratively in a fast\-paced, highly dynamic environment; highly organized, with the ability to work with multiple teams in different countries
* You can seamlessly shift gears between different working styles and regularly learn new processes
* You're a strong communicator and have excellent writing skills
* You’re skilled at advancing and growing relationships with stakeholders/partners and driving executive interactions and alignment with stakeholders and marketing teams
* You're energized by building strong relationships with a diverse group of customers and attending user\-driven events
* You appreciate thinking outside the box, operate with a sense of urgency, and have a knack for finding unique solutions to problems
* You're comfortable working autonomously, but also thrive in a team setting


And it's admired, but not required, if:

* You have experience working in Atlassian products, plus Slack, HubSpot, and Salesforce (added bonus if you're familiar with Bevy and/or Higher Logic Vanilla, Tableau)

**Benefits \& Perks**


Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit **go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits****.**

At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.

Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial \& personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast\-growing business in Asia\-Pacific.
